    function buildBridge(b) {
      const halfLen = BRIDGE_HALF_LEN, hw = BRIDGE_HW;
      // Highest ground anywhere along the crossing decides the deck height, so the
      // planks clear the banks and the bed alike. Sampled densely along the length AND
      // across the width — the old 9-point centreline-only sample was coarse enough
      // that a bump between two sample points (or off to one side) could still poke up
      // through the flat deck partway across the span, not just at the two ends.
      // Solved before the ground was graded (gradeCrossings) and reused here, so the
      // embankment that was cut to meet this deck and the deck itself agree exactly.
      const deckY = b.deckY ?? (crestAcrossStrip(b.x, b.z, b.yaw, halfLen, hw) + 0.3);
      const parts = [];
      const plank = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x7a5a38 });
      const plankDark = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x5a4128 });
      // Slatted deck. Boards run a little wider than their spacing, so what you see
      // between them is a seam rather than a slot down to the river.
      for (let i = 0; i < 21; i++) {
        poiBox(parts, i % 3 ? plank : plankDark, hw * 2, 0.14, 0.82, 0, 0, -halfLen + 0.4 + i * 0.79);
      }
      // Rails + posts.
      for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
        poiBox(parts, plankDark, 0.1, 0.1, halfLen * 2, side * (hw - 0.06), 0.92, 0);
        for (const lz of [-halfLen + 0.4, -halfLen / 2, 0, halfLen / 2, halfLen - 0.4]) {
          poiBox(parts, plank, 0.13, 0.95, 0.13, side * (hw - 0.06), 0.45, lz);
        }
      }
      // Piles down into the riverbed.
      for (const lz of [-halfLen * 0.55, 0, halfLen * 0.55]) {
        for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
          const p = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.16, 0.2, 4.4, 6), plankDark);
          p.position.set(side * (hw - 0.2), -2.1, lz);
          parts.push(p);
        }
      }
      // Structure under the deck. The planks are only 14cm thick, so from the game's
      // overhead camera the whole bridge used to read as a ribbon laid on the air —
      // no edge, no depth, nothing to say it was built. A pair of stringers running
      // the full span under the deck edges, with joists across them, gives the bridge
      // a side to catch light and a shadow line you can actually see from above.
      for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
        poiBox(parts, plankDark, 0.26, 0.46, halfLen * 2, side * (hw - 0.14), -0.31, 0);
      }
      const joists = Math.max(2, Math.round((halfLen * 2) / 2.1));
      for (let i = 0; i <= joists; i++) {
        const lz = -halfLen + (i / joists) * halfLen * 2;
        poiBox(parts, plankDark, hw * 2 - 0.1, 0.2, 0.22, 0, -0.2, lz);
      }
      // No abutment blocks: the ground at both ends was already raised into an earth
      // embankment that comes up to this deck height (gradeCrossings), so the planks
      // meet real, walkable ground instead of a slab of scenery bridging the gap.
      const details = appendLandmarkDetails(parts, 'bridge', b.x, b.z, deckY, b.yaw,
        { halfLen, halfWidth: hw, variant: POI.bridges.indexOf(b) });
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      const mesh = mergeParts(parts, poiMat, { castShadow: true, receiveShadow: true });
      g.add(mesh);
      g.position.set(b.x, deckY, b.z);
      g.rotation.y = b.yaw;
      scene.add(g);
      g.userData.landmarkTheme = details.theme;
      b.mesh = g;
      platforms.push({ x: b.x, z: b.z, hw: hw - 0.15, hl: halfLen, yaw: b.yaw, deckY: deckY + 0.09, landmark: true });
      // End posts block the corners so traffic funnels onto the deck.
      const cy = Math.cos(b.yaw), sy = Math.sin(b.yaw);
      for (const [lx, lz] of [[-hw, -halfLen], [hw, -halfLen], [-hw, halfLen], [hw, halfLen]]) {
        addSolid(b.x + lx * cy + lz * sy, b.z - lx * sy + lz * cy, 0.24, deckY - 1, deckY + 1.4);
      }
      // The rails themselves were purely visual — nothing stopped you walking straight
      // through them off the side. Line both rails with overlapping colliders (waist
      // height, so they don't block standing on the deck itself) so the guardrail
      // actually keeps you on the bridge.
      const railR = 0.5, railStep = 0.8;
      const railN = Math.max(1, Math.round((halfLen * 2 - 0.6) / railStep));
      for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
        const lx = side * (hw - 0.06);
        for (let i = 0; i <= railN; i++) {
          const lz = -halfLen + 0.3 + (i / railN) * (halfLen * 2 - 0.6);
          addSolid(b.x + lx * cy + lz * sy, b.z - lx * sy + lz * cy, railR, deckY + 0.35, deckY + 1.3);
        }
      }
    }

    function buildFenceRun(ax, az, bx, bz, seed) {
      const rnd = mulberry32(seed);
      const dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az;
      const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
      const parts = [];
      const postMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x5a442c });
      const railMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x6e5536 });
      const postN = Math.max(3, Math.round(len / 2.2));
      const gy0 = sampleHeight(ax, az);
      const midX = (ax + bx) * 0.5, midZ = (az + bz) * 0.5;
      const gyMid = sampleHeight(midX, midZ);
      const lm = {
        kind: 'fence', x: midX, z: midZ, gy: gyMid, ax, az, bx, bz,
        hp: FENCE_MAX_HP, maxHp: FENCE_MAX_HP, alive: true,
        mesh: null, colliders: [], debrisColor: 0x5a442c,
        rubbleRadius: Math.min(4.5, Math.max(1.2, len * 0.35))
      };
      for (let i = 0; i <= postN; i++) {
        const t = i / postN;
        const px = ax + dx * t, pz = az + dz * t;
        const gy = sampleHeight(px, pz) - 0.04;
        // Gaps / collapsed sections — skip some posts and rails.
        const collapsed = rnd() < 0.22 || (i > 0 && i < postN && rnd() < 0.12);
        if (collapsed) {
          // Fallen post / rail on ground.
          if (rnd() < 0.7) {
            poiBox(parts, postMat, 0.12, 0.12, 1.1 + rnd() * 0.6,
              px - ax, gy - gy0 + 0.1, pz - az, rnd() * 3, 0.2 + rnd() * 0.5, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.4);
          }
          continue;
        }
        const ph = 0.95 + rnd() * 0.25;
        const lean = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.15;
        poiBox(parts, postMat, 0.14, ph, 0.14, px - ax, gy - gy0 + ph * 0.5, pz - az, 0, lean);
        // Posts only — walk through gaps; tagged so bullets damage the whole run.
        lm.colliders.push(addSolid(px, pz, 0.18, gy, gy + ph, lm));
        // Rails toward next standing post (approximate).
        if (i < postN && rnd() < 0.75) {
          const t2 = (i + 1) / postN;
          const qx = ax + dx * t2, qz = az + dz * t2;
          const midLocalX = (px + qx) * 0.5 - ax, midLocalZ = (pz + qz) * 0.5 - az;
          const seg = Math.hypot(qx - px, qz - pz);
          const yaw = Math.atan2(qx - px, qz - pz);
          const gy2 = sampleHeight(qx, qz) - 0.04;
          const midY = (gy + gy2) * 0.5 - gy0;
          const hasUpperRail = rnd() < 0.85;
          if (hasUpperRail) poiBox(parts, railMat, 0.08, 0.08, seg * 0.92, midLocalX, midY + 0.72, midLocalZ, yaw);
          const hasLowerRail = rnd() < 0.7;
          if (hasLowerRail) poiBox(parts, railMat, 0.08, 0.08, seg * 0.9, midLocalX, midY + 0.38, midLocalZ, yaw, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.25);
          // Whichever rail(s) actually got drawn also block movement — previously only
          // the posts collided, so the whole span between them (rails and all) was
          // freely walkable, which read as the fence just not being there. A gapless
          // chain of small circles along the span closes that off; a segment that got
          // NEITHER rail this roll stays a real, intentional gap.
          if (hasUpperRail || hasLowerRail) {
            const railY0 = Math.min(gy, gy2), railY1 = Math.max(gy, gy2) + 1.05;
            const railR = 0.3;
            const segCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(seg / 0.55));
            for (let ri = 0; ri <= segCount; ri++) {
              const rt = ri / segCount;
              const rx = px + (qx - px) * rt, rz = pz + (qz - pz) * rt;
              lm.colliders.push(addSolid(rx, rz, railR, railY0, railY1, lm));
            }
          }
        }
      }
      const mesh = mergeParts(parts, poiMat, { castShadow: true, receiveShadow: true });
      mesh.position.set(ax, gy0, az);
      scene.add(mesh);
      lm.mesh = mesh;
      landmarks.push(lm);
      return lm;
    }

    function buildWreck(cx, cz, seed) {
      const rnd = mulberry32(seed);
      const yaw = rnd() * Math.PI * 2;
      const c = Math.cos(yaw), s = Math.sin(yaw);
      const wheelY = (x, z) => sampleHeight(cx + x * c + z * s, cz - x * s + z * c);
      const fl = wheelY(-1.14, -2.02), fr = wheelY(1.14, -2.02);
      const rl = wheelY(-1.14, 2.05), rr = wheelY(1.14, 2.05);
      const gy = (fl + fr + rl + rr) / 4 - 0.035;
      const tilt = Math.atan2((fl + fr - rl - rr) / 2, 4.07);
      const roll = Math.atan2((fr + rr - fl - rl) / 2, 2.28);
      const parts = [];
      const site = POI.wrecks.find(p => p.x === cx && p.z === cz);
      const details = appendLandmarkDetails(parts, 'wreck', cx, cz, gy, yaw,
        { variant: POI.wrecks.indexOf(site), tilt, roll });

      const g = new THREE.Group();
      const mesh = mergeParts(parts, poiMat, { castShadow: true, receiveShadow: true });
      g.add(mesh);
      if (POI.wrecks.indexOf(site) === 0) {
        // GP-120: worn shipping identity painted onto the medical truck's bed sides.
        const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = 768; cv.height = 256;
        const ctx = cv.getContext('2d'); ctx.fillStyle = '#c6c6ab'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.font = 'bold 91px "Arial Black", sans-serif'; ctx.fillText(sayText('hq.designation.branch'), 384, 106);
        ctx.font = 'bold 66px "Arial Black", sans-serif'; ctx.fillText(sayText('hq.designation.name'), 384, 194);
        for (let i = 0; i < 105; i++) ctx.clearRect((i * 137) % 768, (i * 61) % 245, 4 + i % 12, 2 + i % 4);
        const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv); tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
        const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true, alphaTest: .1, depthWrite: false, roughness: 1 });
        const marks = new THREE.Group(); marks.name = 'medical-wreck-markings'; marks.rotation.set(tilt, 0, roll);
        const geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.04, .347);
        for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
          const label = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material); label.position.set(side * 1.143, 1.43, 1.88); label.rotation.y = side * Math.PI / 2; marks.add(label);
        }
        g.add(marks);
      }
      g.position.set(cx, gy, cz);
      g.rotation.y = yaw;
      scene.add(g);
      details.register();
      g.userData.landmarkTheme = details.theme;
      if (site) site.mesh = g;
    }

    function buildRadioMast(cx, cz) {
      const gy = groundMinAround(cx, cz, 1.0);
      const parts = [];
      const steel = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8a9098, metalness: 0.65, roughness: 0.4 });
      const steelDark = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x5a6068, metalness: 0.6, roughness: 0.45 });
      const mastH = 14.5;
      // Skinny lattice: four legs + cross braces.
      const leg = 0.55;
      for (const [lx, lz] of [[-leg, -leg], [leg, -leg], [-leg, leg], [leg, leg]]) {
        poiBox(parts, steel, 0.1, mastH, 0.1, lx, mastH * 0.5, lz);
      }
      for (let y = 1.5; y < mastH - 0.5; y += 2.2) {
        poiBox(parts, steelDark, leg * 2, 0.07, 0.07, 0, y, -leg);
        poiBox(parts, steelDark, leg * 2, 0.07, 0.07, 0, y, leg);
        poiBox(parts, steelDark, 0.07, 0.07, leg * 2, -leg, y, 0);
        poiBox(parts, steelDark, 0.07, 0.07, leg * 2, leg, y, 0);
        // Diagonals are fitted between the actual leg joints by the detail builder.
      }
      // The dish bowl, feeder and cabinet are part of the shared static dressing.
      poiBox(parts, steel, 0.06, 1.8, 0.06, 0, mastH + 0.6, 0);
      poiBox(parts, steelDark, 1.4, 0.12, 1.4, 0, 0.08, 0); // base pad

      const details = appendLandmarkDetails(parts, 'mast', cx, cz, gy);

      const mesh = mergeParts(parts, poiMat, { castShadow: true, receiveShadow: true });
      mesh.position.set(cx, gy, cz);
      scene.add(mesh);
      addSolid(cx, cz, 0.85, gy, gy + mastH * 0.55);
      details.register();
      mesh.userData.landmarkTheme = details.theme;
      if (POI.mast) POI.mast.mesh = mesh;

      // Blinking red beacon — night-visible nav light.
      const light = new THREE.PointLight(0xff2211, 0, 28, 2);
      light.position.set(cx, gy + mastH + 0.4, cz);
      scene.add(light);
      const bulb = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.18, 8, 8),
        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xff2200, emissive: 0xff1100, emissiveIntensity: 1.6 })
      );
      bulb.position.copy(light.position);
      scene.add(bulb);
      campfires.push({ x: cx, z: cz, y: gy + mastH, light, phase: 0, beacon: true, bulb });
    }

    function buildWarningSign(s) {
      const gy = sampleHeight(s.x, s.z) - 0.03;
      const parts = [];
      const post = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x4a4034 });
      const board = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: s.kind === 'keepout' ? 0xb83a2e : 0xc9a12a, roughness: 0.7
      });
      poiBox(parts, post, 0.08, 1.55, 0.08, 0, 0.78, 0);
      poiBox(parts, board, 0.9, 0.55, 0.06, 0, 1.45, 0.02);
      // Simple stripe / X mark via thin bars.
      if (s.kind === 'keepout') {
        poiBox(parts, post, 0.7, 0.06, 0.04, 0, 1.45, 0.06, 0.6);
        poiBox(parts, post, 0.7, 0.06, 0.04, 0, 1.45, 0.06, -0.6);
      } else {
        poiBox(parts, post, 0.55, 0.08, 0.04, 0, 1.45, 0.06);
      }
      const mesh = mergeParts(parts, poiMat, { castShadow: true });
      mesh.position.set(s.x, gy, s.z);
      mesh.rotation.y = s.yaw || 0;
      scene.add(mesh);
      const lm = {
        kind: 'sign', x: s.x, z: s.z, gy,
        hp: SIGN_MAX_HP, maxHp: SIGN_MAX_HP, alive: true,
        mesh, colliders: [], debrisColor: s.kind === 'keepout' ? 0x8f3028 : 0x9f8428,
        rubbleRadius: 0.55
      };
      lm.colliders.push(addSolid(s.x, s.z, 0.24, gy, gy + 1.7, lm));
      landmarks.push(lm);
    }

    function buildSandbagBarricade(cx, cz, seed) {
      const rnd = mulberry32(seed);
      const yaw = rnd() * Math.PI * 2;
      const parts = [];
      const bag = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x7a6e4e });
      const bagDark = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x5c5340 });
      const wood = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x5a4630 });
      // Abandoned sandbags + a couple of solid barricade planks near cabin.
      const ox = 3.8 + rnd(), oz = -2.4 - rnd();
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const lx = ox + (i % 3) * 0.55 - 0.5;
        const lz = oz + Math.floor(i / 3) * 0.5;
        const dy = sampleHeight(cx + lx, cz + lz) - sampleHeight(cx, cz);
        poiBox(parts, i % 2 ? bag : bagDark, 0.7, 0.32, 0.4, lx, dy + 0.18, lz, rnd() * 0.4);
      }
      poiBox(parts, bagDark, 0.65, 0.3, 0.38, ox + 0.3, 0.48, oz + 0.1, 0.2);
      poiBox(parts, wood, 1.6, 0.12, 0.14, ox - 0.2, 0.55, oz + 1.1, 0.3, 0.15);
      poiBox(parts, wood, 1.2, 0.12, 0.14, ox + 0.8, 0.35, oz + 1.4, -0.5, 0.4);
      const gy = sampleHeight(cx, cz);
      const mesh = mergeParts(parts, poiMat, { castShadow: true, receiveShadow: true });
      mesh.position.set(cx, gy, cz);
      mesh.rotation.y = yaw;
      scene.add(mesh);
      // Soft scenery blockers on the pile + planks (low wall).
      const cy = Math.cos(yaw), sy = Math.sin(yaw);
      const wx = cx + ox * cy + oz * sy, wz = cz - ox * sy + oz * cy;
      addSolid(wx, wz, 0.95, gy, gy + 0.75);
      const px = cx + (ox - 0.1) * cy + (oz + 1.2) * sy;
      const pz = cz - (ox - 0.1) * sy + (oz + 1.2) * cy;
      addSolid(px, pz, 0.7, gy, gy + 0.65);
    }

    // === Boundary wall ===
    // A 15ft stone rampart running the full circumference at the edge of the playable
    // circle (LAND_MAX). The player and zombies are already clamped to this same
    // radius everywhere in the movement code (clampToLand, and the zombie equivalent
    // a few hundred lines down) — that boundary has always existed, just invisibly.
    // This gives it a physical face: you now hit a wall exactly where you always
    // stopped, instead of an empty field that quietly refuses to let you walk further.
    //
    // It is laid as real masonry: a dark mortar core with individual stones set proud
    // of it in courses, offset half a stone per course. Each stone is also tilted a
    // degree or two off true, which is what actually sells it — a ring of perfectly
    // co-planar faces all catch the sun identically and read as one flat grey band no
    // matter how the colours are varied, whereas tilted faces each take the light
    // differently and the wall resolves into separate blocks.
    const FT = 0.3048;
    const WALL_HEIGHT = 15 * FT;      // 15 ft of wall standing above whatever it crosses
    const WALL_THICK = 2 * FT;        // 2 ft thick
    const WALL_SEGS = 800;            // one stone column per segment: ~1.73m of arc each
    const WALL_COURSE_H = 0.55;       // stone course height
    const WALL_INNER_R = LAND_MAX;
    const WALL_OUTER_R = LAND_MAX + WALL_THICK;
    const WALL_FOOT_DIG = 1.4;        // footing buried below the lowest nearby ground
    const WALL_STONE_PROUD = 0.07;    // how far a stone face stands off the mortar
    const WALL_MORTAR_GAP = 0.11;     // joint left around each stone
    const WALL_STONE_TILT = 0.055;    // how far a stone face leans off true

    // True when a point falls in the ring the wall occupies, with `pad` of clearance
    // either side. Props test against this so nothing is scattered standing inside the
    // masonry — a tree trunk or boulder growing straight through the wall was the
    // giveaway that the wall had been dropped on top of the world rather than built
    // into it.
    function inWallBand(x, z, pad = 0) {
      const r = Math.hypot(x, z);
      return r > WALL_INNER_R - pad && r < WALL_OUTER_R + pad;
    }

    // Where the river runs out through the wall. A boundary wall that simply dammed
    // the map's only river would be obvious nonsense, so the wall opens into an arch
    // here and the gap is barred with a metal grate — the water leaves, nothing else
    // does. Solved off the river's own polyline so the arch lands on the water rather
    // than merely near it.
    const WALL_GATE = (function solveWallGate() {
      const rAt = (s) => { const p = riverPointAt(s); return Math.hypot(p.x, p.z); };
      // bracket the crossing first — the river's distance from the map centre is not
      // monotonic, so a blind binary search could lock onto the wrong stretch
      let lo = -1, hi = -1;
      const STEP = 1 / 400;
      for (let s = 0; s < 1 - STEP; s += STEP) {
        if ((rAt(s) - WALL_INNER_R) * (rAt(s + STEP) - WALL_INNER_R) <= 0) { lo = s; hi = s + STEP; break; }
      }
      if (lo < 0) return null; // river never reaches the wall
      for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
        const mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
        if ((rAt(lo) - WALL_INNER_R) * (rAt(mid) - WALL_INNER_R) <= 0) hi = mid; else lo = mid;
      }
      const p = riverPointAt((lo + hi) / 2);
      const surf = riverBedAt(riverProject(p.x, p.z).s) + 1.05;
      // Snap the opening to whole wall segments. If a segment straddles the jamb, one
      // of its ends sits on the buried footing and the other on the arch's springing
      // line, and the core face between them slopes from underground up to the spring
      // — which opens a triangular gap of daylight under the wall right beside the
      // arch. Whole segments keep every piece either solid or open, never both.
      const segAng = (Math.PI * 2) / WALL_SEGS;
      const ang = Math.round(Math.atan2(p.z, p.x) / segAng) * segAng;
      const halfAngle = Math.max(2, Math.round(((RIVER_SURF * 1.45) / WALL_INNER_R) / segAng)) * segAng;
      let bed = Infinity;
      for (let k = -5; k <= 5; k++) {
        const a = ang + (k / 5) * halfAngle;
        for (const rt of [0, 0.5, 1]) {
          const r = WALL_INNER_R + rt * WALL_THICK;
          bed = Math.min(bed, sampleHeight(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r));
        }
      }
      return { ang, halfAngle, spring: surf + 0.5, rise: 2.3, bed: bed - 0.5, surf };
    })();

    // Underside of the arch at a given bearing, or null where the wall is solid. The
    // very edges return the springing height rather than null, so a point sitting
    // exactly on a jamb resolves to the arch rather than falling through to the
    // buried footing.
    function wallArchY(ang) {
      if (!WALL_GATE) return null;
      let d = ang - WALL_GATE.ang;
      while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
      while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
      const u = d / WALL_GATE.halfAngle;
      if (u < -1.0001 || u > 1.0001) return null;
      const uu = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, u));
      return WALL_GATE.spring + WALL_GATE.rise * Math.sqrt(1 - uu * uu);
    }

    // Whether a whole wall segment is part of the opening, decided by its midpoint.
    // Testing the endpoints instead leaves the outermost segment of the arch with one
    // end open and one end solid, which is what put a slice of daylight beside the
    // jamb; by the midpoint a segment is wholly one or the other.
    function segInGate(i) {
      if (!WALL_GATE) return false;
      const a = ((i + 0.5) / WALL_SEGS) * Math.PI * 2;
      let d = a - WALL_GATE.ang;
      while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
      while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
      return Math.abs(d) < WALL_GATE.halfAngle;
    }

    // Grey stone with block-to-block variation. `seed` decorrelates neighbouring
    // stones so the courses don't band together into one tone.
    function stoneColor(wx, wz, seed, out) {
      const n = fbm(wx * 0.09 + 41.7, wz * 0.09 - 18.2, 3);
      const jitter = (hash2((seed * 37) | 0, (seed * 71 + 13) | 0) - 0.5) * 0.30;
      const shade = 0.58 + n * 0.13 + jitter;
      out.setRGB(shade, shade * 0.985, shade * 0.95);
      const grime = fbm(wx * 0.22 - 7.4, wz * 0.22 + 12.1, 2) * 0.5 + 0.5;
      out.multiplyScalar(0.90 + grime * 0.18);
      return out;
    }

    function buildBoundaryWall() {
      const N = WALL_SEGS;
      const M = N * 2;                 // half-segment resolution, so alternate courses
                                       // can be offset by half a stone
      const groundY = new Float32Array(M);
      const topY = new Float32Array(M);
      const floorY = new Float32Array(M);
      for (let m = 0; m < M; m++) {
        const a = (m / M) * Math.PI * 2;
        const cx = Math.cos(a), sz = Math.sin(a);
        // Lowest ground across the footing's width AND a little either side along the
        // arc: a wall is long and thin, so a dip between two samples is even easier to
        // miss than it was under the bridge abutments.
        let lo = Infinity;
        for (const t of [0, 0.5, 1]) {
          const r = WALL_INNER_R + t * WALL_THICK;
          lo = Math.min(lo, sampleHeight(cx * r, sz * r));
        }
        const da = (0.5 / M) * Math.PI * 2;
        for (const sign of [-1, 1]) {
          const a2 = a + sign * da;
          lo = Math.min(lo, sampleHeight(Math.cos(a2) * WALL_INNER_R, Math.sin(a2) * WALL_INNER_R));
        }
        groundY[m] = lo;
        // Where the wall crosses water, 15ft above the LAKEBED leaves a rampart that
        // barely breaks the surface — measured on this map it came out as much as 3m
        // UNDER the waterline, so you could have swum straight over the map's edge.
        // The height that matters is 15ft above whatever surface is actually there.
        const wl = waterLevelAt(cx * (WALL_INNER_R + WALL_THICK * 0.5), sz * (WALL_INNER_R + WALL_THICK * 0.5));
        const ref = (wl !== null && wl > lo) ? wl : lo;
        topY[m] = ref + WALL_HEIGHT;
        const arch = wallArchY(a);
        floorY[m] = arch !== null ? arch : lo - WALL_FOOT_DIG;
      }

      const positions = [];
      const colors = [];
      const col = new THREE.Color();
      const mortar = new THREE.Color(0x46443f);
      const pushQuad = (p0, p1, p2, p3, c) => {
        positions.push(p0[0], p0[1], p0[2], p1[0], p1[1], p1[2], p2[0], p2[1], p2[2]);
        positions.push(p0[0], p0[1], p0[2], p2[0], p2[1], p2[2], p3[0], p3[1], p3[2]);
        for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) colors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
      };
      const pushQuad2 = (p0, p1, p2, p3, c) => { // both facings, for surfaces whose
        pushQuad(p0, p1, p2, p3, c);             // visible side depends on where you
        pushQuad(p3, p2, p1, p0, c);             // stand (arch soffit, jambs)
      };
      const at = (ang, r, y) => [Math.cos(ang) * r, y, Math.sin(ang) * r];

      // --- mortar core: the solid wall the stones are laid onto -------------------
      const coreIn = WALL_INNER_R + WALL_STONE_PROUD;
      const coreOut = WALL_OUTER_R - WALL_STONE_PROUD;
      for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        const m0 = i * 2, m1 = (i * 2 + 2) % M;
        const a0 = (m0 / M) * Math.PI * 2, a1 = ((i + 1) / N) * Math.PI * 2;
        const t0 = topY[m0], t1 = topY[m1];
        // Whole-segment decision: open segments stop at the arch, solid ones run down
        // to the buried footing. Never a blend of the two across one segment.
        const open = segInGate(i);
        const b0 = open ? wallArchY(a0) : groundY[m0] - WALL_FOOT_DIG;
        const b1 = open ? wallArchY(a1) : groundY[m1] - WALL_FOOT_DIG;
        pushQuad(at(a0, coreIn, t0), at(a0, coreIn, b0), at(a1, coreIn, b1), at(a1, coreIn, t1), mortar);
        pushQuad(at(a0, coreOut, t0), at(a1, coreOut, t1), at(a1, coreOut, b1), at(a0, coreOut, b0), mortar);
        const cap = stoneColor(Math.cos(a0) * WALL_INNER_R, Math.sin(a0) * WALL_INNER_R, i * 977, col).clone();
        cap.multiplyScalar(1.12);
        pushQuad(at(a0, WALL_INNER_R, t0), at(a0, WALL_OUTER_R, t0), at(a1, WALL_OUTER_R, t1), at(a1, WALL_INNER_R, t1), cap);
        // Arch soffit: closes the underside of the opening so it reads as a built
        // vault rather than a hole cut through a cardboard wall.
        if (open) {
          pushQuad2(at(a0, WALL_INNER_R, b0), at(a0, WALL_OUTER_R, b0),
                    at(a1, WALL_OUTER_R, b1), at(a1, WALL_INNER_R, b1), mortar);
        }
      }
      // Jambs: the cut ends of the wall either side of the opening.
      if (WALL_GATE) {
        for (const sgn of [-1, 1]) {
          const a = WALL_GATE.ang + sgn * WALL_GATE.halfAngle;
          pushQuad2(at(a, WALL_INNER_R, WALL_GATE.spring), at(a, WALL_OUTER_R, WALL_GATE.spring),
                    at(a, WALL_OUTER_R, WALL_GATE.bed), at(a, WALL_INNER_R, WALL_GATE.bed), mortar);
        }
      }

      // --- stones ------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Laid from the top down so the coping line stays true and the courses rake with
      // the terrain. Keeps going until the course is under the ground line — over the
      // lake that means a much taller stack, which is exactly what should be there —
      // and stops at the arch's curve over the river, leaving stepped voussoirs.
      let stoneCount = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < 96; c++) {
          const odd = (c & 1) === 1;
          const m0 = (i * 2 + (odd ? 1 : 0)) % M;
          const m1 = (m0 + 2) % M;
          const a0 = (m0 / M) * Math.PI * 2;
          const a1 = a0 + (2 / M) * Math.PI * 2;
          const floor0 = floorY[m0], floor1 = floorY[m1];
          const yTop0 = topY[m0] - c * WALL_COURSE_H;
          const yTop1 = topY[m1] - c * WALL_COURSE_H;
          if (yTop0 <= floor0 + 0.04 && yTop1 <= floor1 + 0.04) break;
          let yBot0 = Math.max(yTop0 - WALL_COURSE_H, floor0);
          let yBot1 = Math.max(yTop1 - WALL_COURSE_H, floor1);
          const gap = WALL_MORTAR_GAP;
          const ga = (gap / WALL_INNER_R) * 0.5;
          const sa0 = a0 + ga, sa1 = a1 - ga;
          const seed = i * 131 + c * 7919;
          const h1 = hash2((seed * 13) | 0, (seed * 29 + 5) | 0);
          const h2 = hash2((seed * 53 + 7) | 0, (seed * 97 + 3) | 0);
          // A stone is a flat face leaned slightly off the ring: one tilt along its
          // length, one up its height, so neighbouring blocks catch the light at
          // different angles instead of all lying dead flush.
          const tiltU = (h1 - 0.5) * WALL_STONE_TILT;
          const tiltV = (h2 - 0.5) * WALL_STONE_TILT;
          const proud = WALL_STONE_PROUD + (h1 - 0.5) * 0.02;
          const rIn = (du, dv) => WALL_INNER_R - proud + tiltU * du + tiltV * dv;
          const rOut = (du, dv) => WALL_OUTER_R + proud - tiltU * du - tiltV * dv;
          const wx0 = Math.cos(sa0) * WALL_INNER_R, wz0 = Math.sin(sa0) * WALL_INNER_R;
          const cIn = stoneColor(wx0, wz0, seed, col).clone();
          const cOut = stoneColor(wx0 + 3.1, wz0 - 2.7, seed + 17, col).clone();
          const tA = yTop0 - gap * 0.5, tB = yTop1 - gap * 0.5;
          const bA = Math.min(tA - 0.04, yBot0 + gap * 0.5), bB = Math.min(tB - 0.04, yBot1 + gap * 0.5);
          pushQuad(at(sa0, rIn(-1, 1), tA), at(sa0, rIn(-1, -1), bA),
                   at(sa1, rIn(1, -1), bB), at(sa1, rIn(1, 1), tB), cIn);
          pushQuad(at(sa0, rOut(-1, 1), tA), at(sa1, rOut(1, 1), tB),
                   at(sa1, rOut(1, -1), bB), at(sa0, rOut(-1, -1), bA), cOut);
          stoneCount++;
        }
      }

      const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
      geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
      geo.computeVertexNormals();
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, poiMat);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(mesh);
      buildRiverGrate();
      // Small, separately culled repair stations dress only dry wall sections.
      // Leave the other agents' cave mouths and water crossings clear.
      for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) {
        const a = (i + 0.5) / 48 * Math.PI * 2, r = WALL_INNER_R - 0.35;
        const x = Math.cos(a) * r, z = Math.sin(a) * r;
        if (POI.caves.some(c => Math.hypot(c.x - x, c.z - z) < 24)) continue;
        if ([-3, 0, 3].some(t => waterDepthAt(x - Math.sin(a) * t, z + Math.cos(a) * t) > 0.02)) continue;
        if (wallArchY(a) !== null) continue;
        const gy = sampleHeight(x, z), yaw = Math.atan2(-x, -z), parts = [];
        const topAt = lx => topY[(Math.round((a + lx / r) / (Math.PI * 2) * M) + M) % M] - gy;
        const details = appendLandmarkDetails(parts, 'wall', x, z, gy, yaw, { variant: i, height: topAt(0), topAt });
        const station = mergeParts(parts, poiMat, { castShadow: true, receiveShadow: true });
        station.position.set(x, gy, z); station.rotation.y = yaw;
        station.userData.landmarkTheme = details.theme;
        scene.add(station); details.register();
      }
      return { mesh, stones: stoneCount, tris: positions.length / 9 };
    }

    // Black iron bars filling the river arch: the water leaves the map, nothing else
    // does. Bars follow the arch, so they are tallest mid-channel.
    function buildRiverGrate() {
      if (!WALL_GATE) return null;
      const g = WALL_GATE;
      const iron = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x15171b });
      const ironLit = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x23262c });
      const parts = [];
      const midR = WALL_INNER_R + WALL_THICK * 0.5;
      const span = g.halfAngle * 2 * WALL_INNER_R;
      const nBars = Math.max(5, Math.round(span / 0.62));
      const barY = (u) => g.spring + g.rise * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - u * u));
      for (let i = 0; i <= nBars; i++) {
        const u = -1 + (2 * i) / nBars;
        const a = g.ang + u * g.halfAngle;
        const top = barY(u);
        const h = top - g.bed;
        if (h <= 0.25) continue;
        const bar = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.11, h, 0.11), i % 2 ? iron : ironLit);
        bar.position.set(Math.cos(a) * midR, g.bed + h * 0.5, Math.sin(a) * midR);
        bar.rotation.y = -a;
        parts.push(bar);
      }
      // Horizontal rails tying the bars together, cut into short chords so they follow
      // the wall's curve and stop where the arch comes down.
      for (const frac of [0.28, 0.66]) {
        for (let i = 0; i < nBars; i++) {
          const u0 = -1 + (2 * i) / nBars, u1 = -1 + (2 * (i + 1)) / nBars;
          const y0 = g.bed + (barY(u0) - g.bed) * frac;
          const y1 = g.bed + (barY(u1) - g.bed) * frac;
          if (barY(u0) - g.bed <= 0.4 || barY(u1) - g.bed <= 0.4) continue;
          const a0 = g.ang + u0 * g.halfAngle, a1 = g.ang + u1 * g.halfAngle;
          const x0 = Math.cos(a0) * midR, z0 = Math.sin(a0) * midR;
          const x1 = Math.cos(a1) * midR, z1 = Math.sin(a1) * midR;
          const len = Math.hypot(x1 - x0, z1 - z0);
          const rail = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.09, 0.09, len * 1.04), iron);
          rail.position.set((x0 + x1) * 0.5, (y0 + y1) * 0.5, (z0 + z1) * 0.5);
          rail.rotation.y = Math.atan2(x1 - x0, z1 - z0);
          parts.push(rail);
        }
      }
      const mesh = mergeParts(parts, poiMat, { castShadow: true, receiveShadow: true });
      scene.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    // === Fuel barrels ===
    // Scattered near the points of interest. Two rounds set one off; the blast is a
    // grenade's worth of hurt to everything nearby — zombies, props, your walls, you —
    // and any barrel caught in it goes up too.
    const barrelRedMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xa8261c, roughness: 0.55, metalness: 0.45 });
    const barrelRimMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x3a2a26, roughness: 0.6, metalness: 0.5 });
    const barrelBandMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xe0b83a, roughness: 0.5, metalness: 0.3 });
    const barrelGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.36, 0.36, 0.95, 14);
    const barrelRimGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.375, 0.375, 0.05, 14);
    const barrelBandGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.365, 0.365, 0.16, 14);
    // CL-72 (P-43): a drum is one mesh, one draw: its parts merged once into a vertex-coloured geometry that
    // every drum shares (it was six meshes each).
    let drumGeoMerged = null, drumMatMerged = null;
    function drumMergedGeometry() {
      if (drumGeoMerged) return drumGeoMerged;
      const parts = [
        [barrelGeo, 0xa8261c, 0, 0.475, 0], [barrelRimGeo, 0x3a2a26, 0, 0.12, 0], [barrelRimGeo, 0x3a2a26, 0, 0.82, 0],
        [barrelBandGeo, 0xe0b83a, 0, 0.5, 0], [new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.06, 0.06, 0.04, 8), 0x3a2a26, 0.18, 0.97, 0.1],
        [rbox(0.16, 0.16, 0.02, 0.01), 0x3a2a26, 0, 0.5, 0.36]
      ];
      const pos = [], nor = [], col = [], c = new THREE.Color();
      for (const [geo, hex, px, py, pz] of parts) {
        const gg = (geo.index ? geo.toNonIndexed() : geo.clone()).translate(px, py, pz);
        const P = gg.attributes.position, N = gg.attributes.normal;
        c.setHex(hex);
        for (let i = 0; i < P.count; i++) { pos.push(P.getX(i), P.getY(i), P.getZ(i)); nor.push(N.getX(i), N.getY(i), N.getZ(i)); col.push(c.r, c.g, c.b); }
        gg.dispose();
      }
      drumGeoMerged = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      drumGeoMerged.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
      drumGeoMerged.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nor, 3));
      drumGeoMerged.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col, 3));
      drumGeoMerged.computeBoundingSphere();
      drumMatMerged = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.55, metalness: 0.42 });
      return drumGeoMerged;
    }
    function buildBarrel(x, z, yaw) {
      const gy = groundMinAround(x, z, 0.4) - 0.02;
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      const body = new THREE.Mesh(drumMergedGeometry(), drumMatMerged);
      body.castShadow = true; body.receiveShadow = true;
      g.add(body);
      g.position.set(x, gy, z);
      g.rotation.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.06, yaw, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.06);
      scene.add(g);
      const lm = { kind: 'barrel', x, z, gy, hp: 14, maxHp: 14, alive: true, mesh: g, colliders: [], debrisColor: 0x8a2a1a, rubbleRadius: 0 };
      lm.colliders.push(addSolid(x, z, 0.4, gy, gy + 1.0, lm));
      landmarks.push(lm);
      return lm;
    }
    // CL-72 (P-43): fuel drums back on the map, at the wrecks, the sheds and the mast only: at most 8, from a fixed
    // seed (rule 10: the same drums in the same places every load). None within 30 m of a cave mouth (a blast there is
    // a poke), 35 m of the HQ or 8 m of an objective. They chain, and every morning the ones he blew up are back.
    const mapDrums = [];
    const MAP_DRUMS_MAX = 8;
    function buildMapDrums(objectiveCentres) {
      const rnd = mulberry32(0xd72a43);
      const anchors = [];
      for (const w of POI.wrecks) anchors.push([w, 3.4, 6.5]);
      for (const sh of POI.sheds) anchors.push([sh, 3.2, 6.0]);
      if (POI.mast) anchors.push([POI.mast, 8.5, 11.5]);
      const ok = (x, z) => {
        if (!Number.isFinite(x) || !Number.isFinite(z) || Math.hypot(x, z) > LAND_MAX - 4) return false;
        if (Math.hypot(x, z) < 35) return false;                                            // the HQ
        if (waterDepthAt(x, z) > 0.02 || terrainSlope(x, z) > 0.35 || distToRiver(x, z) < RIVER_WIDTH + 2) return false;
        for (const c of POI.caves || []) if (Math.hypot(c.x - x, c.z - z) < 30) return false;
        for (const o of objectiveCentres || []) if (Math.hypot(o.x - x, o.z - z) < 8) return false;
        for (const ws of worldSolids) if (Math.hypot(ws.x - x, ws.z - z) < ws.radius + 0.7) return false;
        return true;
      };
      const put = (x, z) => {
        const lm = buildBarrel(x, z, rnd() * Math.PI * 2);
        lm.mapDrum = true;
        lm.spawnColliders = lm.colliders.slice();   // a fresh match restores it like any landmark
        mapDrums.push(lm);
      };
      for (const [a, r0, r1] of anchors) {
        if (mapDrums.length >= MAP_DRUMS_MAX) break;
        for (let tries = 0; tries < 14; tries++) {
          const ang = rnd() * Math.PI * 2, r = r0 + rnd() * (r1 - r0);
          const x = a.x + Math.cos(ang) * r, z = a.z + Math.sin(ang) * r;
          if (!ok(x, z)) continue;
          put(x, z);
          // Most get a second beside them: pairs chain.
          if (mapDrums.length < MAP_DRUMS_MAX && rnd() < 0.7) {
            const a2 = rnd() * Math.PI * 2, x2 = x + Math.cos(a2) * 0.95, z2 = z + Math.sin(a2) * 0.95;
            if (ok(x2, z2)) put(x2, z2);
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    // Each morning (startPrep) and at a fresh match: the drums he blew up stand again, their scorch marks gone.
    function restoreMapDrums() {
      for (const lm of mapDrums) {
        if (lm.scorch) { scene.remove(lm.scorch); lm.scorch = null; }
        if (lm.alive) continue;
        for (const solid of lm.spawnColliders) { if (worldSolids.indexOf(solid) < 0) worldSolids.push(solid); if (lm.colliders.indexOf(solid) < 0) lm.colliders.push(solid); }
        lm.alive = true; lm.hp = lm.maxHp;
        if (lm.mesh) lm.mesh.visible = true;
      }
    }
    function buildBarrels() {
      const rnd = mulberry32(0xba44e1);
      const anchors = [];
      for (const s of POI.sheds) anchors.push(s, s);
      for (const w of POI.wrecks) anchors.push(w);
      for (const c of POI.campsites) anchors.push(c);
      for (const c of POI.cabins) anchors.push(c);
      if (POI.mast) anchors.push(POI.mast, POI.mast);
      if (POI.sandbags) anchors.push(POI.sandbags);
      if (POI.dock) anchors.push(POI.dock);
      let placed = 0;
      for (const a of anchors) {
        if (!a || !Number.isFinite(a.x) || !Number.isFinite(a.z)) continue;
        for (let tries = 0; tries < 12 && placed < 22; tries++) {
          const ang = rnd() * Math.PI * 2, r = 3.2 + rnd() * 3.5;
          let x = a.x + Math.cos(ang) * r, z = a.z + Math.sin(ang) * r;
          if (Math.hypot(x, z) > LAND_MAX - 4) continue;
          if (waterDepthAt(x, z) > 0.02 || terrainSlope(x, z) > 0.35) continue;
          if (distToRiver(x, z) < RIVER_WIDTH + 2) continue;
          const spot = resolveStaticProps(x, z, 0.6);
          x = spot.x; z = spot.z;
          let clear = true;
          for (const ws of worldSolids) if (Math.hypot(ws.x - x, ws.z - z) < ws.radius + 0.7) { clear = false; break; }
          if (!clear) continue;
          buildBarrel(x, z, rnd() * Math.PI * 2);
          placed++;
          // A second one beside it now and then — pairs chain nicely.
          if (rnd() < 0.4 && placed < 22) {
            const a2 = rnd() * Math.PI * 2;
            const x2 = x + Math.cos(a2) * 0.95, z2 = z + Math.sin(a2) * 0.95;
            if (waterDepthAt(x2, z2) <= 0.02 && terrainSlope(x2, z2) <= 0.35) { buildBarrel(x2, z2, rnd() * Math.PI * 2); placed++; }
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    // Burning ground left by a napalm drum.
    const firePools = [];
    function updateFirePools(dt) {
      for (let i = firePools.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const f = firePools[i];
        f.t -= dt;
        if (f.t <= 0) { firePools.splice(i, 1); continue; }
        f.tick -= dt;
        if (f.tick <= 0) {
          f.tick = 0.4;
          for (const z of zombiesNear(f.x, f.z, f.r, _zNear)) {
            if (Math.hypot(z.mesh.position.x - f.x, z.mesh.position.z - f.z) > f.r) continue;
            igniteZombie(z, 1.6, true);
            damageZombie(z, 9, { kind: 'generic', dir: { x: 0, z: 0 }, defense: true, fire: true });   // GB-104: the Fire column (was x (1 - fireResist))
          }
        }
        for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
          const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * f.r;
          spawnMote(f.x + Math.cos(a) * r, sampleHeight(f.x + Math.cos(a) * r, f.z + Math.sin(a) * r) + 0.2, f.z + Math.sin(a) * r, emberMat, {
            vx: 0, vy: 1.1 + Math.random(), vz: 0, grav: -0.3, drag: 0.7, life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.4, scale: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.6
          });
        }
        requestEffectLight(f.x, sampleHeight(f.x, f.z) + 1, f.z, 0xff7a2a, 3.2, 12);
      }
    }
    let drumScorchGeo = null, drumScorchMat = null;
    const placedScorches = [];
    function barrelExplode(lm) {
      const x = lm.x, z = lm.z, y = lm.gy + 0.5;
      // Fling the drum itself, then the blast.
      spawnChunks(x, y, z, 0xa8261c, 10, 6);
      spawnChunks(x, y, z, 0x3a2a26, 6, 5);
      spawnEmbers(x, y, z, 22, 1.8);
      for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        spawnMote(x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8, y + Math.random() * 0.6, z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8, smokeMat, {
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2, vy: 2 + Math.random() * 2.5, vz: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
          grav: 0.1, drag: 0.6, life: 1.2 + Math.random() * 1.2, scale: 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.8, grow: true
        });
      }
      explodeGrenade({ pos: { x, y, z }, mesh: _bombDummy, damage: 70, blastMul: lm.napalm ? 1.2 : 1, defense: true, byMarine: !!lm.byMarine, barrel: true });   // GB-101: byMarine, a drum he set off // (hurts you too — see explodeGrenade)
      // A napalm drum leaves the ground burning: anything in the pool catches fire.
      if (lm.napalm) firePools.push({ x, z, r: 4.2, t: 6, tick: 0 });
      // A fuel drum is a trap you placed, so its blast spares what you built — it used
      // to flatten the wall it was stood beside, which is exactly where you put one.
      // Placed drums sit in the build grid; free the cell now it is gone, or that spot
      // stayed "taken" for the rest of the match.
      if (lm.gx != null && cellOccupant(lm.gx, lm.gz, lm.level | 0, lm.slot || 'base') === lm) {
        buildCells.delete(cellKey(lm.gx, lm.gz, lm.level | 0, lm.slot || 'base'));
      }
      if (house.active && houseBoxDist(x, z) < 3.8) damageHouse(22);
      // Scorched drum stays behind as a low obstacle-free wreck. CL-72: one shared geometry and material (each
      // blast used to make a new pair that was never freed), one scorch per drum, gone when the drum comes back;
      // placed drums keep the last 24.
      if (lm.scorch) scene.remove(lm.scorch);
      const wreck = new THREE.Mesh(drumScorchGeo || (drumScorchGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.34, 0.38, 0.22, 12)), drumScorchMat || (drumScorchMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1e1a18, roughness: 1 })));
      wreck.position.set(x, lm.gy + 0.11, z);
      wreck.rotation.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, Math.random() * 6, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4);
      scene.add(wreck);
      lm.scorch = wreck;
      if (!lm.mapDrum) { placedScorches.push(wreck); while (placedScorches.length > 24) scene.remove(placedScorches.shift()); }
    }

    // === The caves and the sinkhole ==============================================
    // Six cave mouths ring the rim of the map, one per sixth of the compass, and the
    // horde pours out of them — every land zombie walks out of a mouth now instead of
    // clawing up out of open ground. The one exception is the drowned, who come up out
    // of a sinkhole in the lake bed and swim in from there. Both places are lethal to
    // enter yourself: the mouths are guarded (see beginScriptedKill) and the sinkhole
    // has tenants. Nothing can be built within CAVE_BUILD_CLEAR of a mouth.
    const CAVE_BUILD_CLEAR = 25;
    // Wide enough that the tentacle ring sits fully inside the abyss, not half on the bed.
    const LAKE_HOLE = { x: LAKE.x + 4, z: LAKE.z - 3, r: 10.5, grabR: 12.5, depth: 18 };
    function nearCave(x, z, d) {
      for (const c of POI.caves) if (Math.hypot(x - c.x, z - c.z) < d) return true;
      return false;
    }
    const CAVE_COMPASS_NAMES = {
      N: 'North Cave', NE: 'Northeast Cave', E: 'East Cave', SE: 'Southeast Cave',
      S: 'South Cave', SW: 'Southwest Cave', W: 'West Cave', NW: 'Northwest Cave'
    };
    function caveLocationName(x, z) {
      return CAVE_COMPASS_NAMES[compassName(x, z)] || 'Outer Rim Cave';
    }
    function caveNearestBearing(ang) {
      let best = null, bd = Infinity;
      for (const c of POI.caves) {
        const d = Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(c.ang - ang), Math.cos(c.ang - ang)));
        if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = c; }
      }
      return best;
    }
    // === Cave designs ===============================================================
    // Six caves, six different places. Each is a hill the land itself rises into — the
    // terrain heightfield is raised into the mound, so it wears the same grass, soil and
    // rock as the valley, grows the same grass tufts and carries trees on its back — and
    // a rock face at its front with the mouth in it. The mouth is sized per cave but
    // never smaller than the colossus (about 4.7m tall, 3m across the shoulders) needs.
    //   w, h:    mouth half-width at the floor and height
    //   p:       mouth shape — superellipse exponent (1.2 pointed cleft, 2 round arch,
    //            3+ a low, flat-topped maw)
    //   skew:    lean of the opening (x shift per metre of height)
    //   dome:    the hill: A half-width, Lf/Lb reach in front of/behind its crown, H
    //            height, pz crown offset behind the mouth, lump noise, lean (one
    //            shoulder higher), ridge (>1 sharpens it into a ridge)
    //   face:    how far the rock face spreads round the mouth (s) and how rough it is
    //   colours: rock, dark (shadowed/wet), moss, streak, floor (the trodden dooryard)
    const CAVE_DESIGNS = {
      // A low, wide grotto in a dark, dripping bank, curtained with moss.
      wet: {
        w: 3.7, h: 6.0, p: 3.0, skew: 0,
        dome: { mode: 'bank', A: 16, Lf: 9, Lb: 15, H: 9.5, pz: -3.5, lump: 0.22, lean: -0.12, ridge: 1 },
        face: { s: 3.6, relief: 0.5, back: 3.2 }, turf: 0.95,
        rock: 0x46534f, dark: 0x1f2b29, moss: 0x3f6435, streak: 0x2b3f33, floor: 0x333b35,
        eyeY: 2.05, eyeTint: 0x9ee8b9
      },
      // An old barrow: a round turf mound with a stone-framed door and a tree on top.
      hill: {
        w: 3.3, h: 6.3, p: 2.0, skew: 0,
        dome: { mode: 'barrow', A: 13, Lf: 11, Lb: 13, H: 8.5, pz: -5.5, lump: 0.06, lean: 0, ridge: 1 },
        face: { s: 2.8, relief: 0.25, back: 2.6 }, turf: 1,
        rock: 0x7b7563, dark: 0x4a4538, moss: 0x5b8a3c, streak: 0x6a6450, floor: 0x5b4b35,
        eyeY: 2.1, eyeTint: 0xd6e8b6
      },
      // Under an ancient tree: its roots grip the hill and frame a leaning mouth.
      root: {
        w: 3.4, h: 6.6, p: 1.75, skew: 0.12,
        dome: { A: 11, Lf: 9, Lb: 12, H: 10, pz: -5, lump: 0.32, lean: 0.12, ridge: 1 },
        face: { s: 3.4, relief: 0.45, back: 3.0 }, turf: 0.9,
        rock: 0x5e564a, dark: 0x352c24, moss: 0x55793a, streak: 0x3d2e22, floor: 0x4d3f2d,
        eyeY: 2.1, eyeTint: 0xd6e8b6

          const obstacles = worldSolids.filter(s => Math.hypot(s.x-gx,s.z-gz)<130).map(s => { const p=toLocal(s.x,s.z);return{x:p.x,z:p.z,r:(s.radius||0)+2.5}; });
          for (const t of trees) if (Math.hypot(t.x-gx,t.z-gz)<130) { const p=toLocal(t.x,t.z);obstacles.push({x:p.x,z:p.z,r:(t.trunkRadius||.3)+2.7}); }

    // FOB Threshold's own: the sealed door on the north face (LOCKDOWN, clawed) and the motto under the parapet.

    // A field-note site in reach, for E when nothing else is (GP-91's readPropNote).

    }
    // === Destructible landmarks (cabins, tower, campsites, graveyard, sheds, fences) ===
    // Player fire chips away at a structure's shared hp pool; once it runs out the
    // whole thing hides and a rubble pile takes its place. Plain scenery (bridge posts,
    // the dock, wrecks, mast, signs, sandbags) is untouched — addSolid() only tags a
    // collider with a landmark when the structure that owns it opts in.
    const CABIN_MAX_HP = 150;
    const TOWER_MAX_HP = 260;
    const CAMPSITE_MAX_HP = 90;
    const GRAVEYARD_MAX_HP = 110;
    const SHED_MAX_HP = 70;
    const FENCE_MAX_HP = 50;
    const SIGN_MAX_HP = 18;
    // TOWER_LADDER_OUT lives up with the other early world-gen constants (BRIDGE_HALF_LEN
    // etc.) since the path-routing code needs it before this point in the file.
    const TOWER_LADDER_R = 0.95;    // how close you need to walk to grab it
    const TOWER_DECK_HALF = 1.4;    // deck footprint half-width once you're up top
    // CL-19 (Jerry): the deck's railings stop you. They stand at ±1.43 (bars 0.1 thick) and
    // top out 0.86 m above the deck; the south side has a 1.09 m gap where the ladder lands.
    const TOWER_RAIL_IN = 1.43 - 0.05;   // inner face of the rails
    const TOWER_RAIL_TOP = 0.86;         // above the deck: jump higher than this and you clear them
    const TOWER_GAP_HALF = 0.3;          // centre-line corridor through the ladder gap
    const TOWER_CLIMB_SPEED = 3.6;
    const TOWER_SIEGE_RADIUS = 3.0; // zombies this close to the base count as attacking it
    const TOWER_DPS_PER_ZOMBIE = 5.5;
    const TOWER_REGEN_RATE = 5;     // hp/sec once nothing is pounding on it
    const TOWER_REGEN_DELAY = 3;    // seconds of peace before it starts healing

    let tower = null;          // set by buildWatchtower(), if the map rolled one
    let climbingTower = false; // true while riding the ladder
    let onTowerDeck = false;   // true while standing on top
    // True while out of your depth in the lake/river. Read by tryFire (no shooting
    // while swimming) and updateMarinePose (paddle animation instead of the walk

    let playerSwimming = false;

    const rubbleWood = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x4a331e });

    function damageLandmark(lm, amount, byMarine = false) {
      if (!lm || !lm.alive) return;

      if (lm.hp <= 0) { lm.byMarine = !!byMarine; destroyLandmark(lm); }   // GB-101: who finished it (a drum he set off is his blast)
    }

    function destroyLandmark(lm) {
      if (!lm || !lm.alive) return;
      lm.alive = false;
      lm.hp = 0;
      if (lm.mesh) lm.mesh.visible = false;
      if (lm.light) lm.light.intensity = 0;
      if (lm.bar) lm.bar.visible = false;
      if (lm.emberMesh) lm.emberMesh.visible = false;
      if (lm.campfire) lm.campfire.dead = true; // stop updateCampfires from re-lighting a doused camp
      for (const s of lm.colliders) {
        const i = worldSolids.indexOf(s);
        if (i >= 0) worldSolids.splice(i, 1);
      }
      lm.colliders.length = 0;
      if (lm.kind === 'barrel') { barrelExplode(lm); return; }
      if (lm.kind === 'fence' && lm.ax != null) {
        const fdx = lm.bx - lm.ax, fdz = lm.bz - lm.az;
        const flen = Math.hypot(fdx, fdz) || 1;
        const steps = Math.max(3, Math.round(flen / 2.2));
        for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
          const t = i / steps;
          const px = lm.ax + fdx * t, pz = lm.az + fdz * t;

      addShake(Math.max(0.2, 0.6 - shakeDist * 0.02));

      buildLandmarkRubble(lm);
    }

    // A low, jumbled pile of debris left where the building stood — still enough of an
    // obstacle to matter, but nothing you could climb or hide behind any more.
    function buildLandmarkRubble(lm) {
      const parts = [];
      if (lm.kind === 'fence' && lm.ax != null) {
        const fdx = lm.bx - lm.ax, fdz = lm.bz - lm.az;
        const flen = Math.hypot(fdx, fdz) || 1;
        const n = Math.max(8, Math.round(flen * 2.2));
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const t = Math.random();
          const lx = lm.ax + fdx * t - lm.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35;
          const lz = lm.az + fdz * t - lm.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35;
          const w = 0.22 + Math.random() * 0.4;
          poiBox(parts, Math.random() < 0.5 ? rubbleWood : rubbleWoodLight,
            w, 0.12 + Math.random() * 0.16, w * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.9),
            lx, sampleHeight(lm.x + lx, lm.z + lz) - lm.gy + 0.06 + Math.random() * 0.12, lz,
            Math.random() * Math.PI, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4);
        }
        const mesh = mergeParts(parts, poiMat, { castShadow: true, receiveShadow: true });
        mesh.position.set(lm.x, lm.gy, lm.z);
        scene.add(mesh);
        lm.rubbleMesh = mesh;
        const steps = Math.max(2, Math.round(flen / 3));
        for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
          const t = i / steps;
          const px = lm.ax + fdx * t, pz = lm.az + fdz * t;
          const gy = sampleHeight(px, pz);
          lm.colliders.push(addSolid(px, pz, 0.32, gy, gy + 0.5, null));
        }
        for (const c of lm.colliders) c.rubble = lm;
        return;
      }
      const n = 12 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8);
      const rad = lm.rubbleRadius || 1.8;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const r = Math.random() * rad;
        const w = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.55;
        poiBox(parts, Math.random() < 0.5 ? rubbleWood : rubbleWoodLight,
          w, 0.16 + Math.random() * 0.2, w * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.9),
          Math.cos(a) * r, 0.08 + Math.random() * 0.14, Math.sin(a) * r,
          Math.random() * Math.PI, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4);
      }
      const mesh = mergeParts(parts, poiMat, { castShadow: true, receiveShadow: true });
      mesh.position.set(lm.x, lm.gy, lm.z);
      scene.add(mesh);
      lm.rubbleMesh = mesh;
      lm.colliders.push(addSolid(lm.x, lm.z, rad * 0.55, lm.gy, lm.gy + 0.7, null));
      for (const c of lm.colliders) c.rubble = lm;
    }

    // Rubble is in the way of your feet, not of your building: putting something down
    // on it (or taking a shovel to it) clears the pile away.
    function clearRubble(lm) {
      if (!lm) return;
      if (lm.rubbleMesh) { scene.remove(lm.rubbleMesh); lm.rubbleMesh = null; }
      for (const s of lm.colliders) {
        const i = worldSolids.indexOf(s);
        if (i >= 0) worldSolids.splice(i, 1);
      }
      lm.colliders.length = 0;
    }
    // The landmark (still standing, or a rubble pile) with a collider reaching into
    // the square around (cx, cz), if any.
    function landmarkInSquare(cx, cz, half, rubble) {
      for (const ws of worldSolids) {
        const lm = rubble ? ws.rubble : ws.landmark;
        if (!lm || (!rubble && !lm.alive)) continue;
        if (Math.abs(ws.x - cx) < half + ws.radius && Math.abs(ws.z - cz) < half + ws.radius) return lm;
      }
      return null;

    function clearRubbleInSquare(cx, cz, half) {

    }

    // Floating hp readout above the tower, shown only once it's been hit. Billboards to

    function updateTowerBar() {

      const hurt = tower.alive && tower.hp < tower.maxHp - 0.5;
      tower.bar.visible = hurt;
      if (!hurt) return;
      const frac = Math.max(0, tower.hp / tower.maxHp);

    // Climbing the watchtower: walk up to the ladder and hold forward to grab it, hold
    // forward/back to go up/down, and stepping onto the deck at the top hands control
    // back to normal ground movement (with the deck standing in for the ground). There
    // is no separate "climb down" ritual required to get off — the deck has no fall
    // damage under it, so hopping off any edge works just as well as backing down the
    // ladder.
    let ladderClimbAcc = 0;   // CL-161
    function updateTowerClimb(dt) {
      if (!tower || !tower.alive) {
        if (climbingTower || onTowerDeck) {
          climbingTower = false;
          onTowerDeck = false;
          grounded = false;
        }
        return;
      }

      if (climbingTower) {
        const climbDir = (keys.ArrowUp || keys.KeyW ? 1 : 0) - (keys.ArrowDown || keys.KeyS ? 1 : 0);
        player.position.x = tower.ladderX;
        player.position.z = tower.ladderZ;
        player.position.y += climbDir * TOWER_CLIMB_SPEED * dt;
        ladderClimbAcc += Math.abs(climbDir) * TOWER_CLIMB_SPEED * dt;   // CL-161: a rung every 0.45 m
        if (ladderClimbAcc >= 0.45) { ladderClimbAcc = 0; if (AudioSys.ladderStep) AudioSys.ladderStep(); }
        velX = 0; velZ = 0; vy = 0;
        if (player.position.y <= tower.gy) {
          player.position.y = tower.gy;
          climbingTower = false;
          grounded = true;
        } else if (player.position.y >= tower.deckY) {
          player.position.set(tower.x, tower.deckY, tower.z - (TOWER_DECK_HALF - 0.25));
          climbingTower = false;
          onTowerDeck = true;
          grounded = true;
        }
        return;
      }

      if (!onTowerDeck) {
        const dLadder = Math.hypot(player.position.x - tower.ladderX, player.position.z - tower.ladderZ);
        const wantsUp = keys.ArrowUp || keys.KeyW;
        if (dLadder < TOWER_LADDER_R && grounded && wantsUp && Math.abs(player.position.y - tower.gy) < 0.6) {
          climbingTower = true;
          player.position.x = tower.ladderX;
          player.position.z = tower.ladderZ;
          player.position.y = tower.gy + 0.05;
          velX = 0; velZ = 0; vy = 0;
        }
      }
    }

    // Zombies that pile up at the tower's base while someone is using it are treated as
    // laying siege to it — enough of them at once will bring it down. Leave it alone and
    // it slowly repairs itself instead of decaying forever on its own.
    function updateTowerSiege(dt) {
      if (!tower || !tower.alive) return;
      const occupied = onTowerDeck || climbingTower;
      if (!occupied) {
        tower.idleT += dt;
        if (tower.idleT > TOWER_REGEN_DELAY && tower.hp < tower.maxHp) {
          tower.hp = Math.min(tower.maxHp, tower.hp + TOWER_REGEN_RATE * dt);
        }
        return;
      }
      tower.idleT = 0;
      let attackers = 0;
      for (const z of zombies) {
        if (!z.alive) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(z.mesh.position.x - tower.x, z.mesh.position.z - tower.z);
        if (d < TOWER_SIEGE_RADIUS + z.radius) attackers++;
      }
      if (attackers <= 0) return;
      tower.hp -= attackers * TOWER_DPS_PER_ZOMBIE * dt;

        spawnDust(tower.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.6, tower.gy + 0.4, tower.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.6, 3);
      }
      if (tower.hp <= 0) collapseTower();
    }

    // The tower comes down: whoever was up there rides it down and eats a heavy hit

          + 'min-width:240px;max-width:min(440px,92vw);padding:10px 16px 12px;border:1px solid #e3b62b88;border-left:4px solid #e3b62b;border-radius:3px;'
          + 'background:linear-gradient(180deg,#232a1ded,#151a11ed);box-shadow:0 14px 40px #000a;color:#e8e2c8;font-family:var(--font-hud,sans-serif);text-align:left}'
          + '#stockNotice.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}#stockNotice b{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#e3b62b}'
