    function updateStockNotice(dt) {
      if (stockNotice.t > 0) {
        stockNotice.t -= dt;
        if (stockNotice.t <= 0) { stockNotice.t = 0; if (gameStarted && !gameOver && !won && phase === 'prep') showStockNotice(stockNotice.guns); }
      } else if (stockNotice.hold > 0) {
        stockNotice.hold -= dt;
        if (stockNotice.hold <= 0 && stockNotice.el) stockNotice.el.classList.remove('show');
      }
    }
    function updateBanner(dt) {
      updateStockNotice(dt);   // CL-114
      if (bannerTimer > 0) {
        bannerTimer -= dt;
        if (bannerTimer <= 0) bigBannerEl.classList.remove('show');
      }
    }

    // Compass name for a world direction. North is +z and east is -x: facing north, the
    // camera's screen-right is world -x, so this is the handedness the player sees.
    function compassName(dx, dz) {
      const names = ['N', 'NE', 'E', 'SE', 'S', 'SW', 'W', 'NW'];
      let deg = Math.atan2(-dx, dz) * 180 / Math.PI;
      if (deg < 0) deg += 360;
      return names[Math.round(deg / 45) % 8];
    }

    // Two maps share one baked landscape.
    //  - The minimap (top right) is local: 50 m around the marine, and it turns with the
    //    camera so map-up is always screen-up — W on the keyboard is up on the map, whatever
    //    way you have swung the view. It used to be the whole world, north-up, with the
    //    marine a speck and every direction needing a mental rotation to match the screen.
    //  - Tab brings up the full map: the whole world, north-up, for finding your way.
    // The wave's bearing arcs stay on the minimap's rim — they are directions, not places,
    // so they are right however far away the horde is.
    // The bake is north-up and mirrored in x to match the view: facing north, world -x is
    // on screen-right, so east sits on the map's right.
    const minimapEl = document.getElementById('minimap');
    const minimapCtx = minimapEl.getContext('2d');
    const MAP_R = 235;          // world radius the bake covers
    const MAP_PX = 328;         // minimap canvas (2x its CSS size, so lines stay sharp)
    const MINI_R = 50;          // world radius the minimap shows
    const BAKE_PX = 1024;       // ~2.2 px per metre: still crisp blown up to 50 m
    minimapEl.width = MAP_PX; minimapEl.height = MAP_PX;
    const mapBake = document.createElement('canvas');
    mapBake.width = BAKE_PX; mapBake.height = BAKE_PX;
    const bakeScale = BAKE_PX / (2 * MAP_R); // bake px per metre
    function worldToBake(x, z) {
      return { x: (MAP_R - x) * bakeScale, y: (MAP_R - z) * bakeScale };
    }
    // Canvas angle of a world heading given as a yaw (facing = (sin yaw, cos yaw)), for
    // shapes drawn pointing up on a north-up map: rotate(this).
    const mapRotForYaw = (yaw) => -yaw;

    function bakeMinimap() {
      const ctx = mapBake.getContext('2d');
      const img = ctx.createImageData(BAKE_PX, BAKE_PX);
      const d = img.data;
      for (let py = 0; py < BAKE_PX; py++) {
        const wz = MAP_R - (py + 0.5) / bakeScale;
        for (let px = 0; px < BAKE_PX; px++) {
          const wx = MAP_R - (px + 0.5) / bakeScale;
          const i = (py * BAKE_PX + px) * 4;
          if (wx * wx + wz * wz > MAP_R * MAP_R) { d[i + 3] = 0; continue; }
          const h = sampleHeight(wx, wz);
          let r, g, b;
          if (waterLevelAt(wx, wz) !== null) {
            r = 38; g = 92; b = 150;
          } else if (h > 34) {
            const t = Math.min(1, (h - 34) / 40);
            r = 120 + t * 120; g = 120 + t * 122; b = 118 + t * 128;
          } else {
            const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (h + 8) / 26));
            r = 58 + t * 46; g = 118 + t * 26; b = 58 + t * 8;
          }
          // A touch of hillshade so relief reads when it is blown up on the minimap.
          const hx = sampleHeight(wx - 1.5, wz) - h, hz = sampleHeight(wx, wz - 1.5) - h;
          const shade = Math.max(0.78, Math.min(1.18, 1 + (hx + hz) * 0.06));
          d[i] = r * shade; d[i + 1] = g * shade; d[i + 2] = b * shade; d[i + 3] = 235;
        }
      }
      ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
      // Tracks are stroked rather than tested per pixel: at this resolution a per-pixel
      // distance-to-every-segment test cost more than the rest of the bake put together.
      ctx.save();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(BAKE_PX / 2, BAKE_PX / 2, MAP_R * bakeScale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.clip();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgb(156,138,104)'; // tan, not rust: must never be mistaken for a zombie blip
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round'; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      for (const line of PATHS) {
        // Busier trails draw broader, as they are on the ground (at least the old
        // width, so a footpath still reads on the map).
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3.8, (line.hw || TRAIL_HW) * 2.6) * bakeScale;
        ctx.beginPath();
        line.forEach((p, k) => { const q = worldToBake(p.x, p.z); if (k) ctx.lineTo(q.x, q.y); else ctx.moveTo(q.x, q.y); });
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
      // GP-146: landmarks are drawn live, so discovery cannot leak through the bake.
    }

    // Shared blip drawing. `toMap(x, z)` returns canvas coords (or null to skip).
    function mapDot(ctx, p, color, r) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, r + 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = color;
      ctx.fill();
    }
    function mapSquare(ctx, p, color, s) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
      ctx.fillRect(p.x - s / 2 - 1.2, p.y - s / 2 - 1.2, s + 2.4, s + 2.4);
      ctx.fillStyle = color;
      ctx.fillRect(p.x - s / 2, p.y - s / 2, s, s);
    }
    function mapArrow(ctx, p, rot, k) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.rotate(rot);
      ctx.scale(k, k);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -9); ctx.lineTo(6, 6); ctx.lineTo(0, 3); ctx.lineTo(-6, 6);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.85)';
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
    const mapLandmarkIntel = createMapLandmarkIntel();
    function currentMapLandmarks() {
      return mapLandmarks(POI, house.present ? house.group.position : null, LAKE_HOLE);
    }
    // Every live blip, in whatever projection the caller hands in.
    const uiCaveWarnings = new Map();
    const mapEnemyIntel = createEnemyMapIntel();
    const mapSightPoint = new THREE.Vector3(), mapSightNdc = new THREE.Vector3();
    let mapEnemySightTick = 0;
    window.addEventListener('dw-game', ({detail}) => {
      if (detail?.type === 'run-reset') { mapEnemyIntel.reset(); mapLandmarkIntel.reset(); mapEnemySightTick = 0; }
    });
    function mapEnemyVisible(enemy) {
      if (!enemy.mesh.visible) return false;
      mapSightPoint.copy(enemy.mesh.position); mapSightPoint.y += (enemy.hitH || 1.5) * .65;
      mapSightNdc.copy(mapSightPoint).project(camera);
      return Math.abs(mapSightNdc.x) <= 1 && Math.abs(mapSightNdc.y) <= 1 &&
        mapSightNdc.z >= -1 && mapSightNdc.z <= 1 && !shotBlocked(camera.position, mapSightPoint);
    }
    let objectiveRuntime = null;
    window.addEventListener('dw-cave-warn', ({ detail }) => {
      if (!detail || !Number.isInteger(detail.index) || detail.index < 0) return;
      if (detail.level === 1 || detail.level === 2) uiCaveWarnings.set(detail.index, detail.level);
      else uiCaveWarnings.delete(detail.index);
    });
    const buildAttackPulses = createBuildAttackPulses();
    const farBuildWarnings = createFarBuildWarnings();
    window.addEventListener('dw-game', ({detail}) => {
      if (detail?.type !== 'build-hit' && detail?.type !== 'run-reset') return;
      const now = performance.now();
      buildAttackPulses.handle(detail, detail.type === 'run-reset' ? [] : builds, now);
      const cue = farBuildWarnings.handle(detail, detail.type === 'run-reset' ? {} : {
        active: gameStarted && !gameOver && !won && !paused && !shopOpen,
        x: player.position.x, z: player.position.z, yaw: camYawCurrent
      }, now);
      if (cue) {
        // A distant defense warning uses the existing sound bus/mute controls.
        const material = ['light','heavy','flame','mortar'].includes(detail.kind) ? 'turret' : 'wood';
        if (cue.broke) AudioSys.buildBreak(material, cue.volume, cue.pan);
        else AudioSys.buildHit(material, cue.volume, cue.pan);
      }
    });
    function drawMapBlips(ctx, toMap, sz, projection) {
      for (const [index, level] of uiCaveWarnings) {
        const cave = POI.caves[index]; if (!cave) continue;
        const p = toMap(cave.x, cave.z); if (!p) continue;
        const radius = (7 + (1 + Math.sin(performance.now() * (level === 2 ? .006 : .003))) * 2) * sz;
        ctx.save(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.strokeStyle = level === 2 ? '#ff755e' : '#ead399'; ctx.lineWidth = 2 * sz; ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore();
      }
      const buildAlertTime = performance.now();
      drawBuildAlerts(ctx, buildAlertMarkers(buildAttackPulses.snapshot(builds, buildAlertTime), { toMap, projection }),
        { scale: sz, timeMs: buildAlertTime });
      if (house.present) { const p = toMap(house.group.position.x, house.group.position.z); if (p) mapSquare(ctx, p, '#7cdea0', 9 * sz); }
      { const p = toMap(KIOSK.x, KIOSK.z); if (p) mapSquare(ctx, p, '#ffd24a', 7 * sz); }
      for (const s of supplyDrops) {
        if (s.state === 'gone') continue;
        const p = toMap(s.x, s.z);
        if (p) mapSquare(ctx, p, (performance.now() % 700 < 350) ? '#ffe066' : '#ffaa00', 8 * sz);
      }
      // Zombies: small red dots that flash (~2 Hz) with a glow behind them, so they read
      // at a glance against any terrain. Brutes, demons and the colossus are drawn larger.
      const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.001 * Math.PI * 2 * 2.1);
      const core = 'rgb(255,' + Math.round(20 + pulse * 50) + ',' + Math.round(20 + pulse * 40) + ')';
      const dim = 'rgb(' + Math.round(150 + pulse * 105) + ',0,0)';
      const glow = 'rgba(255,30,30,' + (0.12 + pulse * 0.3).toFixed(2) + ')';
      for (const z of mapEnemyIntel.markers(zombies, player.position, isNight)) {
        const p = toMap(z.mesh.position.x, z.mesh.position.z);
        if (!p) continue;
        const big = (z.typeKey === 'colossus' || z.typeKey === 'guardian') ? 1.65 : (z.typeKey === 'brute' || z.typeKey === 'demon' ? 1.2 : 1);
        const r = 2.4 * big * sz;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, r * (1.5 + pulse * 0.9), 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = glow;
        ctx.fill();
        mapDot(ctx, p, pulse > 0.5 ? core : dim, r);
      }
    }

    function currentMapMissions() {
      return mapMissionMarkers({active:gameStarted && !gameOver && !won && !training.active && !hollow.below(),
        snapshot:objectiveRuntime?.snapshot(), selected:(objectiveRuntime?.markers() || []).filter(m=>m.selected).map(m=>m.id),
        player:player.position, skulls:skullBag.count, bank:HQ_WINDOW_FRONT, extraction:extractionFor(day), dock:POI.dock});
    }

    let minimapTick = 0;
    function drawMinimap(dt) {
      mapEnemySightTick -= dt;
      if (gameStarted && mapEnemySightTick <= 0) {
        mapEnemySightTick = .2;
        mapEnemyIntel.observe(zombies, player.position, mapEnemyVisible);
        if (!training.active && !hollow.below()) mapLandmarkIntel.observe(currentMapLandmarks(), player.position);
      }
      if (fullMapOpen) drawFullMap(dt);
      minimapTick -= dt;
      if (minimapTick > 0) return;
      minimapTick = 1 / 30;
      const ctx = minimapCtx;
      const W = MAP_PX, C = W / 2, RIM = C - 7;
      const px = player.position.x, pz = player.position.z;
      const yaw = camYawCurrent;
      const cy = Math.cos(yaw), sy = Math.sin(yaw);
      const k = (C - 4) / MINI_R;                 // canvas px per metre
      // World -> minimap: screen-right is world (-cos yaw, sin yaw), screen-up is
      // (sin yaw, cos yaw), exactly the axes WASD moves along.
      const toLocal = (x, z) => {
        const dx = x - px, dz = z - pz;
        const lx = -dx * cy + dz * sy, ly = dx * sy + dz * cy;
        if (lx * lx + ly * ly > MINI_R * MINI_R) return null; // only what is within 50 m
        return { x: C + lx * k, y: C - ly * k };
      };
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, W);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(C, C, C - 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.clip();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,12,24,0.85)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, W);
      // Terrain: the bake, turned by the camera heading and blown up to 50 m.
      // (Bake +x is world -x and bake +y is world -z; under this map those land on
      // (cos yaw, sin yaw) and (-sin yaw, cos yaw) — a plain rotation by +yaw.)
      {
        const pb = worldToBake(px, pz);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(C, C);
        ctx.rotate(yaw);
        ctx.scale(k / bakeScale, k / bakeScale);
        ctx.translate(-pb.x, -pb.y);
        ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
        ctx.drawImage(mapBake, 0, 0);
        ctx.restore();
      }
      // Range rings at 25 m and the 50 m edge, so distance reads off the map.
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.13)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(C, C, 25 * k, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      // Map-up follows the camera; the white marine arrow turns independently.
      drawMapCamera(ctx, {x:C,y:C}, {yaw:0,
        halfFov:Math.atan(Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov)/2)*camera.aspect), reach:30*k});
      drawMapBlips(ctx, toLocal, 1, { x: px, z: pz, yaw, center: C, scale: k, rim: RIM - 8 });
      drawScoutingMarks(ctx, { preview: getWavePreview(day), day, phase, alarmActive: !!hq.seq }, POI.caves,
        { x: px, z: pz, yaw, center: C, scale: k, rim: RIM - 22 });
      drawBountyMarks(ctx, bountyIntel.markers({ day, phase, alarmActive: !!hq.seq }),
        { x: px, z: pz, yaw, center: C, scale: k, rim: RIM - 42 });
      drawCacheMarks(ctx, cacheIntel.markers({ runId: uiRunId, day, sites: objectiveRuntime?.snapshot()?.sites || [] }),
        { x: px, z: pz, yaw, center: C, scale: k, rim: RIM - 56 });
      drawMapLandmarks(ctx, mapLandmarkIntel.labels(currentMapLandmarks()), toLocal, {size:W,mini:true});
      drawMapMissions(ctx, projectMapMissions(currentMapMissions(), toLocal,
        {x:px,z:pz,yaw,center:C,scale:k,rim:RIM-32}));
      ctx.restore();

      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(10,14,8,0.85)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(C, C, C - 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();

      // GP-145: bearings come from living enemies relative to the marine, not
      // spawn headings around world centre. The same projection draws their dots.
      const rimAngle = (wx, wz) => Math.atan2(-(wx * sy + wz * cy), -wx * cy + wz * sy);
      if (gameStarted) drawEnemyBearings(ctx, mapEnemyIntel.markers(zombies, player.position, isNight),
        { x: px, z: pz, yaw, center: C, rim: RIM });

      // Marine in the middle, arrow pointing where he faces relative to the view.
      mapArrow(ctx, { x: C, y: C }, yaw - aimYaw, 1);

      // Compass letters ride the rim so north is always findable.
      ctx.font = 'bold 17px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
      const inset = C - 17;
      for (const [label, wx, wz] of [['N', 0, 1], ['E', -1, 0], ['S', 0, -1], ['W', 1, 0]]) {
        const a = rimAngle(wx, wz);
        const x = C + Math.cos(a) * inset, y = C + Math.sin(a) * inset;
        ctx.strokeText(label, x, y);
        ctx.fillStyle = label === 'N' ? '#ffd24a' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
        ctx.fillText(label, x, y);
      }
    }

    // --- Full map (Tab) ---------------------------------------------------------------
    const fullMapEl = document.getElementById('fullMap');
    const fullMapCanvas = document.getElementById('fullMapCanvas');
    const fullMapCtx = fullMapCanvas.getContext('2d');
    let fullMapOpen = false, fullMapTick = 0;
    function setFullMap(on) {
      if (!!on !== fullMapOpen && AudioSys.mapToggle) AudioSys.mapToggle(!!on);   // CL-161
      fullMapOpen = !!on;
      fullMapEl.classList.toggle('show', fullMapOpen);
      fullMapEl.setAttribute('aria-hidden', String(!fullMapOpen));
      const legend = document.getElementById('mapLegend');
      if (legend) {
        legend.replaceChildren(document.createTextNode(dwText('map.close') + ' · '));
        for (const [key,color] of [['zombies','#ff3030'],['kiosk','#ffd24a'],['hq','#7cdea0'],['builds','#5ad8ff']]) {
          const chip = document.createElement('i'); chip.style.background = color;
          legend.append(chip, document.createTextNode(dwText('map.' + key) + ' · '));
        }
        legend.append(document.createTextNode([dwText('map.playerFacing'), dwText('map.cameraFacing'), dwText('map.mission.bearing'),
          dwText('map.reach', {distance:50})].join(' · ')));
      }
      if (fullMapOpen) { fullMapTick = 0; drawFullMap(0); }
    }
    function drawFullMap(dt) {
      fullMapTick -= dt;
      if (fullMapTick > 0) return;
      fullMapTick = 1 / 20;
      const css = Math.round(Math.max(120, Math.min(innerWidth * 0.86, innerHeight - 190)));
      const W = Math.round(css * Math.min(2, devicePixelRatio || 1));
      if (fullMapCanvas.width !== W) {
        fullMapCanvas.width = W; fullMapCanvas.height = W;
        fullMapCanvas.style.width = css + 'px'; fullMapCanvas.style.height = css + 'px';
        const card = fullMapEl.querySelector('.card'); if (card) card.style.width = (css + 26) + 'px';
      }
      const ctx = fullMapCtx;
      const C = W / 2;
      const s = W / BAKE_PX;
      const sz = W / 600;                      // blip size relative to a ~600 px map
      const toFull = (x, z) => { const p = worldToBake(x, z); return { x: p.x * s, y: p.y * s }; };
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, W);
      ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
      ctx.drawImage(mapBake, 0, 0, W, W);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(10,14,8,0.9)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 4 * sz;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(C, C, C - 2 * sz, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      // The minimap's reach, so the two maps visibly relate.
      const pp = toFull(player.position.x, player.position.z);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)';
      ctx.setLineDash([6 * sz, 5 * sz]);
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5 * sz;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pp.x, pp.y, MINI_R * bakeScale * s, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      drawMapBlips(ctx, toFull, sz);
      drawMapLandmarks(ctx, mapLandmarkIntel.labels(currentMapLandmarks()), toFull, {size:W,scale:sz});
      drawMapCamera(ctx, pp, {yaw:camYawCurrent,
        halfFov:Math.atan(Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov)/2)*camera.aspect), reach:30*bakeScale*s,scale:sz});
      const missions = currentMapMissions();
      drawMapMissions(ctx, projectMapMissions(missions, toFull), {scale:sz});
      const missionLegend = document.getElementById('mapMissionLegend');
      const missionWords = mapMissionLegend(missions);
      if (missionLegend && missionLegend.textContent !== missionWords) missionLegend.textContent = missionWords;
      mapArrow(ctx, pp, mapRotForYaw(aimYaw), 1.4 * sz);
      ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(22 * sz) + 'px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.lineWidth = 4 * sz; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
      const inset = 26 * sz;
      for (const [label, x, y] of [['N', C, inset], ['E', W - inset, C], ['S', C, W - inset], ['W', inset, C]]) {
        ctx.strokeText(label, x, y);
        ctx.fillStyle = label === 'N' ? '#ffd24a' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
        ctx.fillText(label, x, y);
      }
    }

    // Bird flocks turning lazy circles over the valley. They scatter nothing and fix
    // nothing — the sky just shouldn't be dead.
    const birdFlocks = [];
    function buildBirds() {
      const rnd = mulberry32(0xb14d5);
      const birdMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x1c1e24 });
      const anchors = [
        { x: 0, z: 0 }, { x: LAKE.x + 30, z: LAKE.z + 20 }, { x: 90, z: 90 }
      ];
      for (let f = 0; f < 3; f++) {
        const parts = [];
        const n = 4 + ((rnd() * 4) | 0);
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const bx = (rnd() - 0.5) * 5, by = (rnd() - 0.5) * 1.6, bz = (rnd() - 0.5) * 6;
          // Each bird was two crossed slabs, which at this range read as a plus sign.
          // A small body, an inner wing and a swept outer panel per side gives the
          // gull-wing silhouette instead, and the whole flock is still one merged mesh.
          const scale = 0.85 + rnd() * 0.5;
          const dihedral = 0.34 + rnd() * 0.26;
          const body = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.11, 0.09, 0.42), birdMat);
          body.position.set(bx, by, bz);
          body.scale.setScalar(scale);
          parts.push(body);
          for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
            const inner = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.34, 0.03, 0.17), birdMat);
            inner.position.set(bx + side * 0.2 * scale, by + 0.03 * scale, bz);
            inner.rotation.z = -side * dihedral;
            inner.scale.setScalar(scale);
            parts.push(inner);
            const outer = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.34, 0.025, 0.1), birdMat);
            outer.position.set(
              bx + side * 0.5 * scale,
              by + (0.03 + Math.sin(dihedral) * 0.32) * scale,
              bz - 0.09 * scale
            );
            outer.rotation.z = -side * (dihedral + 0.22);
            outer.rotation.y = side * 0.3;
            outer.scale.setScalar(scale);
            parts.push(outer);
          }
        }
        const mesh = mergeParts(parts, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ vertexColors: true }));
        mesh.frustumCulled = false;
        scene.add(mesh);
        birdFlocks.push({
          mesh,
          cx: anchors[f].x, cz: anchors[f].z,
          radius: 36 + rnd() * 30,
          height: 26 + rnd() * 16,
          ang: rnd() * Math.PI * 2,
          speed: (0.05 + rnd() * 0.05) * (rnd() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1)
        });
      }
    }

    function updateBirds(dt) {
      for (const f of birdFlocks) {
        f.ang += f.speed * dt;
        const x = f.cx + Math.cos(f.ang) * f.radius;
        const z = f.cz + Math.sin(f.ang) * f.radius;
        f.mesh.position.set(x, f.height + Math.sin(f.ang * 3) * 2.5, z);
        // Face along the direction of travel around the circle.
        f.mesh.rotation.y = -f.ang + (f.speed > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI);
        f.mesh.rotation.z = Math.sin(wind.time * 1.5 + f.ang * 4) * 0.14; // wing tilt
      }
    }

    // Firelight flicker + drifting embers, active from dusk to dawn.
    let emberCd = 0;
    function updateCampfires(dt) {
      const dark = isNight || skyUniforms.uNight.value > 0.35;
      emberCd -= dt;
      for (const f of campfires) {
        if (f.dead) { f.light.intensity = 0; continue; }
        if (f.beacon) {
          f.phase += dt;
          const on = (f.phase % 1.0) < 0.65;
          f.light.intensity = dark && on ? 3.2 : 0;
          if (f.bulb && f.bulb.material) f.bulb.material.emissiveIntensity = dark && on ? 2.2 : 0.15;
          continue;
        }
        f.phase += dt * (f.lantern ? 3 : 9);
        const flick = Math.sin(f.phase) * 0.5 + Math.sin(f.phase * 2.7) * 0.3;
        f.light.intensity = dark ? (f.lantern ? 1.5 + flick * 0.15 : 2.4 + flick * 0.8) : 0;
        // GB-102 (P-109): a campfire drops to embers while it pours (a lantern is under glass) and comes back after;
        // one puff of steam as the rain takes it.
        const cfWet = f.lantern ? 0 : rainWet();
        f.light.intensity *= 1 - 0.8 * cfWet;
        if (!f.lantern && cfWet > 0.3 && !f.steamed) { f.steamed = true; spawnSmokePuff(f.x, f.y + 0.5, f.z, { tone: 'pale', size: 0.6, grow: 1.8, vy: 0.9, life: 1.6, peak: 0.5 }); }
        else if (cfWet < 0.05) f.steamed = false;
        if (!f.lantern && dark && emberCd <= 0 && cfWet < 0.5 &&
            Math.hypot(f.x - player.position.x, f.z - player.position.z) < 45) {
          spawnMote(f.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, f.y + 0.45, f.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, emberMat, {
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, vy: 1.1 + Math.random() * 0.9, vz: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4,
            grav: -0.3, drag: 0.4, life: 0.9 + Math.random() * 0.8, scale: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.25
          });
          emberCd = 0.12;
        }
      }
    }

    // --- Wind -------------------------------------------------------------------
    // A single gust value drives trees, grass, reeds and drifting leaves, so the whole
    // world leans together instead of every prop wobbling on its own clock.
    const wind = { dirX: 1, dirZ: 0, strength: 0.5, time: 0 };
    function updateWind(dt) {
      wind.time += dt;
      const t = wind.time;
      wind.strength = 0.5 + 0.32 * Math.sin(t * 0.21) + 0.18 * Math.sin(t * 0.73 + 1.3);
      const turn = Math.sin(t * 0.055) * 0.55 + 0.6;
      wind.dirX = Math.cos(turn);
      wind.dirZ = Math.sin(turn);
    }

    const _trampleCand = [];
    function updateWindSway() {
      const t = wind.time;
      if (foliageWindOnGPU) {
        foliageWind.time.value = t;
        foliageWind.dirX.value = wind.dirX;
        foliageWind.dirZ.value = wind.dirZ;
        foliageWind.strength.value = wind.strength;
        foliageWind.player.value.copy(player.position);
        // Nearest walking zombies (to the player — that is where the grass is looked at).
        const tr = foliageWind.tramplers;
        let n = 0;
        if (typeof zombies !== 'undefined') {
          const px = player.position.x, pz = player.position.z;
          _trampleCand.length = 0;
          for (const z of zombies) {
            if (!z.alive || z.knockT > 0 || z.typeKey === 'colossus') continue;
            const d = Math.hypot(z.mesh.position.x - px, z.mesh.position.z - pz);
            if (d < 26) _trampleCand.push(z, d);
          }
          // Small insertion-sort of pairs by distance; the list is short.
          for (let i = 2; i < _trampleCand.length; i += 2) {
            const zc = _trampleCand[i], dc = _trampleCand[i + 1];
            let j = i - 2;
            while (j >= 0 && _trampleCand[j + 1] > dc) { _trampleCand[j + 2] = _trampleCand[j]; _trampleCand[j + 3] = _trampleCand[j + 1]; j -= 2; }
            _trampleCand[j + 2] = zc; _trampleCand[j + 3] = dc;
          }
          for (let i = 0; i < _trampleCand.length && n < tr.length; i += 2) tr[n++].value.copy(_trampleCand[i].mesh.position);
        }
        for (; n < tr.length; n++) tr[n].value.set(0, -100, 0);
      }
      for (const s of windSwayables) {
        const g = Math.sin(t * 1.9 + s.phase) * 0.6 + Math.sin(t * 0.87 + s.phase * 1.7) * 0.4;
        const k = s.amount * wind.strength * g;
        s.mesh.rotation.x = k * wind.dirZ;
        s.mesh.rotation.z = -k * wind.dirX;
      }
    }

    // Ripple the water surfaces. Cheap vertex wave, no shader required.
    //
    // "Cheap" is relative: this rewrites and re-uploads every water vertex every
    // frame — about 4,800 of them across the river and the lake — and under a node
    // renderer that upload is a real per-frame cost rather than the near-free thing it
    // was on WebGL. The wave amplitude is 5.5cm on the river and 9cm on the lake, so
    // from a long way off it is far below one pixel: past the gate distance below,
    // the surface is simply left where it is. The wave is a function of absolute time,
    // so when the player walks back into range it picks up at the current phase with
    // nothing to see. (The properly WebGPU-shaped fix is to move this to a TSL
    // positionNode and stop touching the buffer at all — noted in the perf report.)
    //
    // Each target's footprint is measured once, from the same base array the wave
    // reads, so the gate can never disagree with the geometry it is gating.
    const WATER_WAVE_GATE = 130; // metres past the surface's own extent
    function waterGateInfo(w) {
      if (w._gate) return w._gate;
      const base = w.base;
      let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minZ = Infinity, maxZ = -Infinity;
      for (let i = 0; i < base.length; i += 3) {
        const x = base[i], z = base[i + 2];
        if (x < minX) minX = x; if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
        if (z < minZ) minZ = z; if (z > maxZ) maxZ = z;
      }
      const cx = (minX + maxX) * 0.5, cz = (minZ + maxZ) * 0.5;
      w._gate = { cx, cz, r: Math.hypot(maxX - cx, maxZ - cz) };
      return w._gate;
    }

    function updateWater(t) {
      // One uniform write feeds every surface that made it onto the GPU.
      if (waterTimeUniform) waterTimeUniform.value = t;
      // Without the shader, the same swell done on the CPU — only near the player.
      for (const w of waterSurfaceTargets) {
        if (w.gpu) continue;
        const attr = w.mesh.geometry.attributes.position, arr = attr.array, base = w.base;
        const px = player.position.x, pz = player.position.z;
        for (let i = 0, v = 0; i < arr.length; i += 3, v++) {
          const x = base[i], z = base[i + 2];
          if (Math.abs(x - px) > 90 || Math.abs(z - pz) > 90) continue;
          const amp = smoothstep01((w.depth[v] - 0.05) / 0.75) * (w.lake[v] * 0.04 + 0.01);
          arr[i + 1] = base[i + 1] + amp * (Math.sin(x * 0.23 + z * 0.11 + t * 0.9) * 0.6 + Math.sin(-x * 0.09 + z * 0.31 + t * 1.3) * 0.4 + Math.sin(x * 0.53 - z * 0.47 + t * 2.1) * 0.25);
        }
        attr.needsUpdate = true;
      }
      for (const w of waterWaveTargets) {
        if (w.gpu) continue; // the shader is doing it
        const g = waterGateInfo(w);
        if (Math.hypot(player.position.x - g.cx, player.position.z - g.cz) > g.r + WATER_WAVE_GATE) continue;
        const attr = w.mesh.geometry.attributes.position;
        const arr = attr.array;
        const base = w.base;
        for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 3) {
          const x = base[i], z = base[i + 2];
          arr[i + 1] = base[i + 1] +
            Math.sin(x * WAVE_K.xFreq + t * w.freq * WAVE_K.xTime) * w.amp +
            Math.sin(z * WAVE_K.zFreq - t * w.freq * WAVE_K.zTime) * w.amp * WAVE_K.zAmp;
        }
        attr.needsUpdate = true;
      }
    }

    // === Weather (rain & fog) ===
    // A rare, randomly-timed shower system: streaks fall in a volume that rides with
    // the camera, ripples dot the lake and river where drops land, puddles bloom on
    // flat dry ground and dry back out once the sky clears, and the fog thickens into a
    // close, grey murk while it lasts. Everything here reads off `weather.intensity`,
    // an eased 0..1 value, so fading in and out is just one lerp per system.
    const RAIN_FOG_COLOR = new THREE.Color(0x8b96a3);
    const _rainFogTmp = new THREE.Color();
    const _rainObj = new THREE.Object3D();

    const weather = {
      raining: false,
      intensity: 0,      // eased 0..1 — drives fog, light, rain opacity and rain audio
      rainTimeLeft: 0,
      // First shower can arrive a little sooner than the usual gap between storms.
      timer: 70 + Math.random() * 90
    };

    function scheduleNextRain() {
      // Long, randomised dry spell so storms read as an occasional event, not a metronome.
      weather.timer = 100 + Math.random() * 170; // ~1.5–4.5 minutes between showers
    }

    // --- Falling rain streaks ----------------------------------------------------
    const RAIN_MAX = 520;
    const RAIN_RADIUS = 52;
    const RAIN_HEIGHT = 42;
    const RAIN_BASE = -12; // dips below camera height so streaks reach the ground near the player
    const rainGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.01, 0.022, 1, 3, 1, true);
    const rainMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: 0xaecdee, transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false, fog: false
    });
    const rainMesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(rainGeo, rainMat, RAIN_MAX);
    rainMesh.frustumCulled = false;
    rainMesh.visible = false;
    scene.add(rainMesh);
    const rainDrops = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < RAIN_MAX; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * RAIN_RADIUS;
      rainDrops.push({
        x: Math.cos(a) * r, z: Math.sin(a) * r,
        y: RAIN_BASE + Math.random() * RAIN_HEIGHT,
        speed: 24 + Math.random() * 12,
        len: 0.65 + Math.random() * 0.7
      });
    }

    function updateRain(dt) {
      const on = weather.intensity > 0.01;
      rainMesh.visible = on;
      if (!on) return;
      const cx = camera.position.x, cz = camera.position.z, cy = camera.position.y;
      // A gentle slant with the wind rather than dead-vertical rain.
      const tiltX = wind.dirZ * 0.16, tiltZ = -wind.dirX * 0.16;
      // Light showers thin the streak count out instead of just fading everything —
      // reads more like a drizzle than a see-through downpour.
      const shown = Math.max(40, Math.round(RAIN_MAX * (0.25 + weather.intensity * 0.75)));
      for (let i = 0; i < RAIN_MAX; i++) {
        const d = rainDrops[i];
        if (i < shown) {
          d.y -= d.speed * dt;
          if (d.y < RAIN_BASE) {
            d.y += RAIN_HEIGHT;
            const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            const r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * RAIN_RADIUS;
            d.x = Math.cos(a) * r; d.z = Math.sin(a) * r;
          }
          _rainObj.position.set(cx + d.x, cy + d.y, cz + d.z);
          _rainObj.rotation.set(tiltX, 0, tiltZ);
          _rainObj.scale.set(1, d.len, 1);
        } else {
          // Parked far below rather than shrunk to zero — cheaper than resizing the
          // instance buffer, and avoids a visible pop when the shower intensifies.
          _rainObj.position.set(cx, cy - 400, cz);
          _rainObj.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
          _rainObj.scale.set(1, 1, 1);
        }
        _rainObj.updateMatrix();
        rainMesh.setMatrixAt(i, _rainObj.matrix);
      }
      rainMesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
      rainMat.opacity = 0.4 * weather.intensity;
    }

    // --- Fog, light & cloud response ----------------------------------------------
    // Runs after updateDayNight has set this frame's baseline, so rain always layers
    // on top of the natural cycle instead of fighting it frame to frame.
    function updateWeatherFog() {
      const k = weather.intensity;
      if (k < 0.001 || hurtFlash > 0) return;
      scene.fog.near += (Math.min(scene.fog.near, 9) - scene.fog.near) * k;
      scene.fog.far += (85 - scene.fog.far) * k;
      _rainFogTmp.copy(scene.fog.color).lerp(RAIN_FOG_COLOR, k * 0.8);
      scene.fog.color.copy(_rainFogTmp);
      sun.intensity *= (1 - k * 0.35);
      hemi.intensity *= (1 - k * 0.12);
      cloudMat.opacity = Math.min(1, cloudMat.opacity + k * 0.5);
      cloudMat.emissiveIntensity *= (1 - k * 0.55);
      cloudMat.color.lerp(RAIN_FOG_COLOR, k * 0.5);
    }

    // --- Droplets landing on open water --------------------------------------------
    let rainDropletCd = 0;
    function updateRainDroplets(dt) {
      if (weather.intensity < 0.05) return;
      rainDropletCd -= dt;
      if (rainDropletCd > 0) return;
      rainDropletCd = Math.max(0.05, 0.3 - weather.intensity * 0.22);
      for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const r = Math.random() * 44;
        const x = player.position.x + Math.cos(a) * r;
        const z = player.position.z + Math.sin(a) * r;
        const wl = waterLevelAt(x, z);
        if (wl === null) continue;
        spawnRipple(x, wl + 0.01, z, 0.14 + Math.random() * 0.14, 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.3);
      }
    }

    // --- Puddles gathering on flat, dry ground -------------------------------------
    // A puddle used to be a perfectly round, flat-colour, hard-edged disc — every one
    // identical, stamped onto the ground with no blending at the rim. Instead, bake a
    // handful of soft, irregular "puddle blob" textures once (a noisy outline, a
    // radial gradient from a bright reflective centre out to fully transparent at the
    // edge) and hand each puddle instance one of them, so puddles read as wet patches
    // rather than decals.
    const PUDDLE_MAX = 40;
    const PUDDLE_TEX_COUNT = 5;
    function makePuddleTexture(seed) {
      const size = 128;
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = canvas.height = size;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      const rnd = mulberry32(seed);
      const cx = size / 2, cy = size / 2;
      const n = 12;
      const pts = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2;
        const r = (0.66 + rnd() * 0.3) * (size * 0.46);
        pts.push([cx + Math.cos(a) * r, cy + Math.sin(a) * r]);
      }
      // Smooth the noisy control points into a blob outline via quadratics through
      // each edge's midpoint — the same trick as a rounded, randomised polygon.
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        const p0 = pts[i % n], p1 = pts[(i + 1) % n];
        const mx = (p0[0] + p1[0]) / 2, my = (p0[1] + p1[1]) / 2;
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(mx, my); else ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p0[0], p0[1], mx, my);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.save();
      ctx.clip();
      const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, size * 0.48);
      grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(206,226,236,0.95)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(112,152,174,0.88)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.8, 'rgba(58,88,108,0.6)');
      grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(40,62,78,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
      ctx.restore();
      return new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
    }
    const puddleTextures = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < PUDDLE_TEX_COUNT; i++) puddleTextures.push(makePuddleTexture(0xf00d + i * 733));

    // One material per blob texture, built once. A puddle picking a new shape used to
    // swap the texture on its own material and set needsUpdate, which rebuilds that
    // material's pipeline — a hitch every time it rained. Now each puddle just points
    // at whichever of these prebuilt materials it wants; the pipelines already exist.
    // Opacity is still per-puddle, so each texture's material carries its own fade and
    // puddles sharing a texture are kept off each other by the variant index below.
    const puddleMatPool = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < PUDDLE_MAX; i++) {
      puddleMatPool.push(new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        map: puddleTextures[i % PUDDLE_TEX_COUNT], color: 0xffffff, roughness: 0.12, metalness: 0.55,
        transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false
      }));
    }
    // CL-18 (Jerry): puddles came out as half circles. A flat disc at the centre's height
    // sinks its downhill half into any slope, and the ground mesh is not flat even where
    // the slope test passes. Now each puddle is its own small disc draped over the ground:
    // a centre, three rings of 24, every vertex at the ground's height under it. It is
    // re-draped only when its radius has grown enough to matter.
    const PUD_SEG = 24, PUD_RINGS = 3, PUD_VERTS = 1 + PUD_SEG * PUD_RINGS, PUD_LIFT = 0.035;
    const _pudIndex = (() => {
      const idx = [];
      for (let k = 0; k < PUD_SEG; k++) idx.push(0, 1 + (k + 1) % PUD_SEG, 1 + k);
      for (let r = 0; r < PUD_RINGS - 1; r++) for (let k = 0; k < PUD_SEG; k++) {
        const a = 1 + r * PUD_SEG + k, b = 1 + r * PUD_SEG + (k + 1) % PUD_SEG, c = a + PUD_SEG, d = b + PUD_SEG;
        idx.push(a, b, c, b, d, c);
      }
      return idx;
    })();
    function makePuddleGeo() {
      const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(PUD_VERTS * 3), 3));
      const nrm = new Float32Array(PUD_VERTS * 3);
      for (let i = 0; i < PUD_VERTS; i++) nrm[i * 3 + 1] = 1;
      geo.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.BufferAttribute(nrm, 3));
      geo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(PUD_VERTS * 2), 2));
      geo.setIndex(_pudIndex);
      return geo;
    }
    function drapePuddle(p, radius) {
      const geo = p.mesh.geometry, P = geo.attributes.position.array, UV = geo.attributes.uv.array;
      const rot = p.uvRot || 0;
      P[0] = p.x; P[1] = sampleHeight(p.x, p.z) + PUD_LIFT; P[2] = p.z; UV[0] = 0.5; UV[1] = 0.5;
      let lo = P[1], hi = P[1];
      for (let r = 0; r < PUD_RINGS; r++) {
        const f = (r + 1) / PUD_RINGS;
        for (let k = 0; k < PUD_SEG; k++) {
          const a = (k / PUD_SEG) * Math.PI * 2, i = 1 + r * PUD_SEG + k;
          const x = p.x + Math.cos(a) * radius * f, z = p.z + Math.sin(a) * radius * f;
          const y = sampleHeight(x, z) + PUD_LIFT;
          P[i * 3] = x; P[i * 3 + 1] = y; P[i * 3 + 2] = z;
          if (y < lo) lo = y; if (y > hi) hi = y;
          UV[i * 2] = 0.5 + 0.5 * f * Math.cos(a + rot); UV[i * 2 + 1] = 0.5 + 0.5 * f * Math.sin(a + rot);
        }
      }
      geo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
      geo.attributes.uv.needsUpdate = true;
      geo.boundingSphere = new THREE.Sphere(new THREE.Vector3(p.x, (lo + hi) / 2, p.z), radius + (hi - lo));
      p.drawR = radius;
    }
    const puddles = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < PUDDLE_MAX; i++) {
      const mat = puddleMatPool[i];
      mat.polygonOffset = true; mat.polygonOffsetFactor = -2; mat.polygonOffsetUnits = -2;
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(makePuddleGeo(), mat);
      mesh.visible = false;
      mesh.renderOrder = 1;
      mesh.frustumCulled = true;
      mesh.matrixAutoUpdate = false;   // world-space vertices at the origin
      scene.add(mesh);
      puddles.push({ mesh, mat, x: 0, z: 0, baseR: 1, wetness: 0, active: false, drawR: 0, uvRot: 0 });
    }
    let puddleSpawnCd = 0;

    function updatePuddles(dt) {
      const raining = weather.intensity > 0.04;
      if (raining) {
        puddleSpawnCd -= dt;
        if (puddleSpawnCd <= 0) {
          puddleSpawnCd = 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.3;
          const free = puddles.find(p => !p.active);
          if (free) {
            for (let tries = 0; tries < 8; tries++) {
              const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
              const r = 6 + Math.random() * 40;
              const x = player.position.x + Math.cos(a) * r;
              const z = player.position.z + Math.sin(a) * r;
              if (!inLand(x, z, 4)) continue;
              if (terrainSlope(x, z) > 0.05) continue;   // CL-18: water gathers on the flat (was 0.09)
              if (waterDepthAt(x, z) > 0.02) continue;
              free.active = true;
              free.x = x; free.z = z;
              free.wetness = 0.03;
              free.baseR = 1.1 + Math.random() * 2.1;
              // Fresh blob shape + orientation each time a puddle is (re)used, so the
              // small shared texture pool doesn't read as repetition.
              // Rotation alone re-randomises how the blob reads, without touching the
              // material (see puddleMatPool): no texture swap, no pipeline rebuild.
              free.uvRot = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;   // (CL-18: turned in UV, the mesh is draped)
              free.drawR = 0;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      for (const p of puddles) {
        if (!p.active) continue;
        p.wetness += (raining ? 0.05 + weather.intensity * 0.09 : -0.045) * dt;
        if (p.wetness <= 0 && !raining) {
          p.active = false;
          p.mesh.visible = false;
          continue;
        }
        p.wetness = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, p.wetness));
        p.mesh.visible = p.wetness > 0.02;
        if (p.mesh.visible) {
          const s = p.baseR * (0.3 + 0.7 * p.wetness);
          if (Math.abs(s - p.drawR) > Math.max(0.05, s * 0.04)) drapePuddle(p, s);
          p.mat.opacity = 0.62 * p.wetness;
        }
      }
    }

    // --- Top-level driver -----------------------------------------------------------
    function updateWeather(dt) {
      if (!gameStarted) { rainMesh.visible = false; return; }
      if (!weather.raining) {
        weather.timer -= dt;
        if (weather.timer <= 0) {
          weather.raining = true;
          weather.rainTimeLeft = 22 + Math.random() * 48; // a shower lasts ~20s–70s
        }
      } else {
        weather.rainTimeLeft -= dt;
        if (weather.rainTimeLeft <= 0) {
          weather.raining = false;
          scheduleNextRain();
        }
      }
      const target = weather.raining ? 1 : 0;
      weather.intensity += (target - weather.intensity) * Math.min(1, dt / 4);

          f.vy -= 16 * dt; f.x += f.vx * dt; f.y += f.vy * dt; f.z += f.vz * dt;
        } else { f.x = f.to.x; f.y = f.to.y; f.z = f.to.z; }
        f.mesh.position.set(f.x, f.y, f.z);
        f.mesh.rotation.y += dt * 4;

      }
      if (!gameStarted) return;
      // He picks up the holy grenade by walking over it.
      if (!R.holy && R.reliquary.userData.grenade.visible && !gameOver && !won) {
        const b = R.reliquaryAt;
        for (const p of players) {
          if (p.dummy || !p.local || !playerAlive(p)) continue;
          if (Math.hypot(p.position.x - b.x, p.position.z - b.z) < 1.3) {
            R.holy = true;

            if (AudioSys.pickup) AudioSys.pickup();

            publishUI('pickup', { id: 'holyGrenade' });

      const tgtP = rabbitTarget();
      const tgt = tgtP && !gameOver && !won ? { x: tgtP.position.x, z: tgtP.position.z, alive: true } : null;
      for (const e of stepRabbit(r, dt, tgt)) {

      m.visible = r.mode !== 'asleep';

        m.position.set(r.x, gy + r.y, r.z);
        m.rotation.y = r.yaw;
        if (r.mode === 'held') { m.position.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02; m.position.z += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02; }
        if (r.mode === 'dead') { m.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2; m.position.y = gy + 0.12; }
        else m.rotation.z = 0;

      }
    }
    function resetWeatherToSpawn() {
      resetLightning();
      resetRabbitMound();   // CL-93: the rabbit asleep again, the holy grenade back in its box, his head on   // CL-92: no strikes left over, the boots back at the mast
      weather.raining = false;
      weather.intensity = 0;
      weather.rainTimeLeft = 0;

      puddleSpawnCd = 0;

        p.active = false;
        p.wetness = 0;
        p.mesh.visible = false;
