    }

    function seatPropY(obj, x, z, footprint = 0, yOff = 0) {
      obj.position.y = groundMinAround(x, z, footprint) + yOff;
    }

    function reseatAllProps() {
      for (const t of trees) {
        if (t.group) seatPropY(t.group, t.x, t.z, t.trunkRadius * 2.2);
        if (t.stumpMesh) seatPropY(t.stumpMesh, t.x, t.z, t.trunkRadius * 1.4);
      }
      for (const rock of rocks) {
        if (rock.mesh) seatPropY(rock.mesh, rock.x, rock.z, rock.radius * 0.9, -0.08);
      }
      for (const f of foliage) {
        if (f.mesh) seatPropY(f.mesh, f.x, f.z, 0.25);
      }
    }

    // Expanding land no longer rebuilds the world — it just moves the boundary and
    // lifts the tint, so props keep their exact positions.
    // The mountain wall past the play radius is the map edge now, so there is no berm
    // to move — expanding only lifts the tint.
    function refreshLandMesh() {
      updateLandTint();
      landREl.textContent = String(Math.round(landRadius));
    }

    // === Terrain props (trees, rocks, foliage) ===

    // mergeParts lives in core/geometry.js.

    // --- Foliage (capped) ---
    const foliage = [];
    const groundFoliageArt = createGroundFoliage(THREE);
    const MAX_GRASS = 3200;
    const MAX_BUSH = 260;
    const MAX_FERN = 260;
    const MAX_FLOWER = 340;
    const MAX_MUSHROOM = 110;
    const MAX_CLUTTER = 220;
    const grassMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x668947, roughness: 0.95, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
    const grassMat2 = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x809951, roughness: 0.95, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
    const grassMat3 = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xa09961, roughness: 0.95, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
    const grassMats = [grassMat, grassMat, grassMat2, grassMat3];
    const bushMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x4a703d, roughness: 1 });
    const bushMat2 = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x617e45, roughness: 1 });
    const blossomMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf3d9e8, roughness: 0.85 });
    const fernMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x668c4e, roughness: 0.9, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
    const stemMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x4d8a3f, roughness: 0.9, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
    const mushCapMats = [
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xc0392b, roughness: 0.7 }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xa9694a, roughness: 0.85 }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xd9a441, roughness: 0.8 })
    ];
    const mushDotMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf5f0e6, roughness: 0.8 });
    const mushStemMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xe8dcc0, roughness: 0.85 });
    const twigMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x5c4326, roughness: 1 });
    const pebbleMat2 = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8b8f88, roughness: 0.9 });
    // Ground litter is mixed stone, so the clutter patches get a few tints and a pool
    // of shapes instead of one grey dodecahedron. These are colour carriers for
    // mergeParts (the patch is baked into foliageMat), hence no roughness variation.
    const pebbleTints = [
      pebbleMat2,
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x6e7370, roughness: 0.9 }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x9c8f7c, roughness: 0.9 }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xa5a69e, roughness: 0.9 })
    ];
    const pebbleGeos = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
      const r = 0.035 + (k % 3) * 0.022;
      const g = k % 3 === 0 ? new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(r, 0)
        : (k % 3 === 1 ? new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(r, 0) : new THREE.TetrahedronGeometry(r * 1.25, 0));
      pebbleGeos.push(roughenStone(g, 0.2, 0x9eb1 + k * 53));
    }
    // Wildflower colour palettes — petal + centre — picked as a pair per cluster.
    const FLOWER_PALETTES = [
      { petal: 0xffffff, center: 0xf4c542 }, // daisy
      { petal: 0xf4c542, center: 0x8a5a1a }, // buttercup
      { petal: 0xb389d4, center: 0xf4c542 }, // lavender
      { petal: 0xe1495a, center: 0x3a1a12 }, // poppy
      { petal: 0xf28fb0, center: 0xf4c542 }  // pink wildflower
    ];
    const FLOWER_MATS = FLOWER_PALETTES.map(p => ({
      petal: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: p.petal, roughness: 0.7 }),
      center: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: p.center, roughness: 0.6 })
    }));
    const foliageMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.95, side: THREE.DoubleSide
    });

    // Pull up every tuft, bush and flower whose root is inside a square: a build
    // clears its own ground. In a baked chunk the tuft's vertices are collapsed onto
    // one buried point, so nothing is drawn and the chunk stays one draw call.
    function clearFoliageInSquare(cx, cz, half) {
      for (const c of foliageChunks) {
        const spans = c.userData.spans;
        if (!spans) continue;
        const pos = c.geometry.getAttribute('position');
        let touched = false;
        for (const sp of spans) {
          if (sp.gone || Math.abs(sp.x - cx) > half || Math.abs(sp.z - cz) > half) continue;
          sp.gone = true; touched = true;
          for (let i = sp.start; i < sp.start + sp.count; i++) pos.setXYZ(i, sp.x, -500, sp.z);
        }
        if (touched) pos.needsUpdate = true;
      }
      // The per-tuft meshes of ?foliage=legacy.
      for (const f of foliage) {
        if (!f.mesh || Math.abs(f.x - cx) > half || Math.abs(f.z - cz) > half) continue;
        f.mesh.visible = false;
      }
    }
    function clearFoliage() {
      for (const f of foliage) {
        if (!f.mesh) continue;
        scene.remove(f.mesh);
        f.mesh.geometry.dispose();
      }
      foliage.length = 0;
      for (const c of foliageChunks) { scene.remove(c); c.geometry.dispose(); }
      foliageChunks.length = 0;
    }

    // === Foliage chunks =========================================================
    // Measured on the real GPU: ground cover was 1,746 of 2,745 draw calls — 64% of
    // everything the renderer touched each frame — and under the WebGPU renderer the
    // cost of a frame is almost entirely the CPU time spent per draw, not the GPU.
    // Every grass tuft, bush, fern, flower, mushroom and twig was its own mesh so that
    // it could sway on its own rotation.
    //
    // Now the map is cut into cells and everything in a cell is merged into one mesh.
    // The sway moves into the vertex shader: each vertex carries the amount it should
    // move (its tuft's sway × its height above the tuft's base, so roots stay planted
    // and tips move) and its tuft's phase, and a TSL positionNode pushes it along the
    // wind direction. The maths is the small-angle equivalent of the rotation the
    // old per-mesh path applied, so the field moves the way it did — it just costs
    // ~100 draws instead of ~1,750.
    //
    // Bushes cast shadows and grass doesn't, so a cell yields up to two chunks.
    // ?foliage=legacy keeps the old per-tuft meshes.
    const FOLIAGE_LEGACY = /[?&]foliage=legacy(&|=|$)/i.test(location.search);
    const FOLIAGE_CELL = 30;
    const foliageChunks = [];
    // Ground-cover draw distance (graphics preset; 0 = unlimited). Hiding a mesh is
    // free under the node renderer — its pipeline is already compiled — so this can
    // flip chunks every few frames without costing a shader build.
    let foliageCullDist = GFX_PRESETS[gfxKey].foliage;
    let _foliageCullTick = 0, _foliageCullApplied = -1;
    function cullFoliageByDistance() {
      if (foliageCullDist <= 0) {
        if (_foliageCullApplied !== 0) { for (const c of foliageChunks) c.visible = true; _foliageCullApplied = 0; }
        return;
      }
      if ((_foliageCullTick++ & 3) !== 0 && _foliageCullApplied === foliageCullDist) return;
      _foliageCullApplied = foliageCullDist;
      const px = gameStarted ? player.position.x : camera.position.x, pz = gameStarted ? player.position.z : camera.position.z;
      for (const c of foliageChunks) {
        const s = c.geometry.boundingSphere;
        const dx = s.center.x - px, dz = s.center.z - pz, r = foliageCullDist + s.radius;
        c.visible = dx * dx + dz * dz < r * r;
      }
    }
    const foliageWind = { time: null, dirX: null, dirZ: null, strength: null, player: null, tramplers: null };
    const TRAMPLER_SLOTS = 4; // the nearest few zombies flatten grass too
    let foliageWindOnGPU = false;

    function buildFoliageChunkMaterial() {
      const { uniform, vec3, sin, attribute, positionLocal, max, float } = TSL;
      if (!foliageWind.time) {
        foliageWind.time = uniform(0);
        foliageWind.dirX = uniform(1);
        foliageWind.dirZ = uniform(0);
        foliageWind.strength = uniform(0.5);
        foliageWind.player = uniform(new THREE.Vector3(0, -100, 0));
        foliageWind.tramplers = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < TRAMPLER_SLOTS; i++) foliageWind.tramplers.push(uniform(new THREE.Vector3(0, -100, 0)));
      }
      const sway = attribute('sway', 'vec3'); // x: amount × height, y: phase, z: height above the tuft's base
      const t = foliageWind.time;
      const phase = sway.y;
      const g = sin(t.mul(1.9).add(phase)).mul(0.6).add(sin(t.mul(0.87).add(phase.mul(1.7))).mul(0.4));
      const k = foliageWind.strength.mul(g).mul(sway.x);
      // Trampling: within a short radius of the player, blades lean away from them,
      // more the taller the blade. The chunks sit at the origin, so local == world.
      // The same push is summed for the player and the nearest few zombies (their
      // uniforms are parked far underground when unused, so they cost nothing).
      const BEND_R = 1.1;
      let pushX = float(0.0), pushZ = float(0.0), flat = float(0.0);
      const feet = [foliageWind.player, ...foliageWind.tramplers];
      for (const u of feet) {
        const toBlade = positionLocal.xz.sub(u.xz);
        const dist = toBlade.length();
        const bend = max(float(0.0), float(1.0).sub(dist.div(BEND_R)));
        const push = toBlade.div(max(dist, float(0.02))).mul(bend.mul(bend)).mul(sway.z).mul(0.9);
        pushX = pushX.add(push.x); pushZ = pushZ.add(push.y); flat = flat.add(bend);
      }
      const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardNodeMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.95, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
      mat.positionNode = positionLocal.add(vec3(foliageWind.dirX.mul(k).add(pushX), flat.mul(sway.z).mul(-0.35), foliageWind.dirZ.mul(k).add(pushZ)));
      return mat;
    }

    function bakeFoliageChunks() {
      if (FOLIAGE_LEGACY) return;
      // One material for every chunk. If the node material can't be built the chunks
      // still go in with the plain material — static grass, but still one draw a cell.
      let chunkMat = null;
      try { chunkMat = buildFoliageChunkMaterial(); foliageWindOnGPU = true; }
      catch (err) { console.warn('Grave Shift: GPU foliage sway failed to build, ground cover will be static.', err); chunkMat = foliageMat; }

      const cells = new Map();
      const _v = new THREE.Vector3();
      for (const f of foliage) {
        if (!f.mesh) continue;
        const sw = windSwayables.find((w) => w.mesh === f.mesh);
        const cx = Math.floor(f.x / FOLIAGE_CELL), cz = Math.floor(f.z / FOLIAGE_CELL);
        const key = cx + ',' + cz + ',' + (f.mesh.castShadow ? 's' : 'n');
        let cell = cells.get(key);
        if (!cell) { cell = { items: [], castShadow: !!f.mesh.castShadow }; cells.set(key, cell); }
        cell.items.push({ f, sw });
      }
      for (const cell of cells.values()) {
        let total = 0;
        for (const it of cell.items) total += it.f.mesh.geometry.attributes.position.count;
        const positions = new Float32Array(total * 3);
        const normals = new Float32Array(total * 3);
        const colors = new Float32Array(total * 3);
        const sway = new Float32Array(total * 3);
        let o = 0;
        for (const { f, sw } of cell.items) {
          const m = f.mesh;
          m.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
          m.updateMatrix();
          const g = m.geometry;
          const pos = g.attributes.position, nrm = g.attributes.normal, col = g.attributes.color;
          const amount = sw ? sw.amount : 0, phase = sw ? sw.phase : 0;
          cell.spans = cell.spans || [];
          cell.spans.push({ start: o, count: pos.count, x: f.x, z: f.z });
          for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
            const w = (o + i) * 3;
            const ly = pos.getY(i); // height above the tuft's base, before placement
            _v.fromBufferAttribute(pos, i).applyMatrix4(m.matrix);
            positions[w] = _v.x; positions[w + 1] = _v.y; positions[w + 2] = _v.z;
            normals[w] = nrm.getX(i); normals[w + 1] = nrm.getY(i); normals[w + 2] = nrm.getZ(i);
            colors[w] = col.getX(i); colors[w + 1] = col.getY(i); colors[w + 2] = col.getZ(i);
            sway[(o + i) * 3] = amount * Math.max(0, ly);
            sway[(o + i) * 3 + 1] = phase;
            sway[(o + i) * 3 + 2] = Math.max(0, ly);
          }
          o += pos.count;
          scene.remove(m);
          g.dispose();
          f.mesh = null;
          if (sw) { const k = windSwayables.indexOf(sw); if (k >= 0) windSwayables.splice(k, 1); }
        }
        const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
        geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
        geo.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
        geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
        geo.setAttribute('sway', new THREE.BufferAttribute(sway, 3));
        geo.computeBoundingSphere();
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, chunkMat);
        mesh.castShadow = cell.castShadow;
        mesh.receiveShadow = false;
        mesh.userData.spans = cell.spans || [];
        mesh.matrixAutoUpdate = false;       // CL-28: world-space geometry at the origin; never moves
        scene.add(mesh);
        foliageChunks.push(mesh);
      }
    }

    function makeGrassTuft(x, z, rnd, moisture = 0.5) {
      const parts = [];
      const n = 7 + Math.floor(rnd() * 7);
      // Parched ground leans gold, lush ground leans green — same palette either way,
      // just weighted differently so the transition between them reads naturally.
      const mats = moisture < 0.45 ? [grassMat3, grassMat3, grassMat2] : grassMats;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const bh = 0.22 + rnd() * 0.32;
        const blade = new THREE.Mesh(groundFoliageArt.blade(0.07 + rnd() * 0.03, bh), mats[(rnd() * mats.length) | 0]);
        blade.position.set((rnd() - 0.5) * 0.58, bh * 0.5 - 0.03, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.58);
        blade.rotation.y = rnd() * Math.PI;
        blade.rotation.z = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.4;
        parts.push(blade);
      }
      const g = mergeParts(parts, foliageMat);
      groundFoliageArt.shade(g, 'grass');
      g.position.set(x, groundMinAround(x, z, 0.3), z);
      scene.add(g);
      foliage.push({ mesh: g, kind: 'grass', x, z });
      windSwayables.push({ mesh: g, phase: rnd() * 6.28, amount: 0.16 });
    }

    function makeBush(x, z, rnd) {
      const parts = [];
      const bmat = rnd() < 0.5 ? bushMat : bushMat2;
      const n = 4 + Math.floor(rnd() * 2);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const puff = new THREE.Mesh(groundFoliageArt.shrub(0.24 + rnd() * 0.17), bmat);
        puff.position.set((rnd() - 0.5) * 0.42, 0.2 + rnd() * 0.16, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.42);
        parts.push(puff);
      }
      // A little under a third carry pale petalled blossoms among the leaves.
      if (rnd() < 0.28) {
        const dots = 4 + Math.floor(rnd() * 5);
        for (let i = 0; i < dots; i++) {
          const dot = new THREE.Mesh(groundFoliageArt.flower(0.045 + rnd() * 0.025), blossomMat);
          const a = rnd() * Math.PI * 2, r = 0.18 + rnd() * 0.28;
          dot.position.set(Math.cos(a) * r, 0.28 + rnd() * 0.2, Math.sin(a) * r);
          parts.push(dot);
        }
      }
      const g = mergeParts(parts, foliageMat, { castShadow: true });
      groundFoliageArt.shade(g, 'bush');
      g.position.set(x, groundMinAround(x, z, 0.3), z);
      scene.add(g);
      foliage.push({ mesh: g, kind: 'bush', x, z });
      windSwayables.push({ mesh: g, phase: rnd() * 6.28, amount: 0.05 });
    }

    function makeFern(x, z, rnd) {
      const parts = [];
      const n = 6 + Math.floor(rnd() * 3);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const leaf = new THREE.Mesh(groundFoliageArt.fern(0.2 + rnd() * 0.08, 0.38 + rnd() * 0.14), fernMat);
        const ang = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2 + rnd();
        leaf.position.set(Math.sin(ang) * 0.1, 0.025, Math.cos(ang) * 0.1);
        leaf.rotation.y = ang;
        leaf.rotation.x = -0.1;
        parts.push(leaf);
      }
      const g = mergeParts(parts, foliageMat);
      groundFoliageArt.shade(g, 'fern');
      g.position.set(x, groundMinAround(x, z, 0.2), z);
      scene.add(g);
      foliage.push({ mesh: g, kind: 'fern', x, z });
      windSwayables.push({ mesh: g, phase: rnd() * 6.28, amount: 0.11 });
    }

    // Small wildflower clusters — a splash of colour through the meadow band, between
    // the dry high ground and the damp fern country by the water.
    function makeFlowerCluster(x, z, rnd) {
      const pal = FLOWER_MATS[(rnd() * FLOWER_MATS.length) | 0];
      const parts = [];
      const n = 2 + Math.floor(rnd() * 3);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const fx = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.4, fz = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.4;
        const stemH = 0.16 + rnd() * 0.14;
        const stem = new THREE.Mesh(groundFoliageArt.flowerStem(stemH), stemMat);
        stem.position.set(fx, stemH * 0.5, fz);
        stem.rotation.y = rnd() * Math.PI;
        parts.push(stem);
        const bloom = new THREE.Mesh(groundFoliageArt.flower(0.07 + rnd() * 0.03), pal.petal);
        bloom.position.set(fx, stemH + 0.02, fz);
        bloom.scale.y = 1;
        parts.push(bloom);
        const center = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(0.026, 0), pal.center);
        center.position.set(fx, stemH + 0.05, fz);
        parts.push(center);
      }
      const g = mergeParts(parts, foliageMat);
      groundFoliageArt.shade(g, 'flower');
      g.position.set(x, groundMinAround(x, z, 0.25), z);
      scene.add(g);
      foliage.push({ mesh: g, kind: 'flower', x, z });
      windSwayables.push({ mesh: g, phase: rnd() * 6.28, amount: 0.13 });
    }

    // Toadstools tucked in the shade — same damp corners the ferns like.
    function makeMushroomCluster(x, z, rnd) {
      const parts = [];
      const n = 2 + Math.floor(rnd() * 3);
      const capMat = mushCapMats[(rnd() * mushCapMats.length) | 0];
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const mx = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.3, mz = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.3;
        const s = 0.5 + rnd() * 0.6;
        const stemH = 0.14 * s;
        const stem = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.02 * s, 0.028 * s, stemH, 5), mushStemMat);
        stem.position.set(mx, stemH * 0.5, mz);
        parts.push(stem);
        const cap = new THREE.Mesh(groundFoliageArt.mushroomCap(0.09 * s), capMat);
        cap.position.set(mx, stemH, mz);
        parts.push(cap);
        if (capMat === mushCapMats[0] && rnd() < 0.7) {
          for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) {
            const dot = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.014 * s, 4, 4), mushDotMat);
            const a = rnd() * Math.PI * 2, r = 0.04 * s;
            dot.position.set(mx + Math.cos(a) * r, stemH + 0.05 * s, mz + Math.sin(a) * r);
            parts.push(dot);
          }
        }
      }
      const g = mergeParts(parts, foliageMat);
      groundFoliageArt.shade(g, 'mushroom');
      g.position.set(x, groundMinAround(x, z, 0.15), z);
      scene.add(g);
      foliage.push({ mesh: g, kind: 'mushroom', x, z });
    }

    // Forest-floor texture: twigs and pebbles with no motion of their own.
    function makeClutter(x, z, rnd) {
      const parts = [];
      const n = 1 + Math.floor(rnd() * 3);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (rnd() < 0.5) {
          const twig = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.012, 0.018, 0.22 + rnd() * 0.18, 5), twigMat);
          twig.position.set((rnd() - 0.5) * 0.5, 0.02, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.5);
          twig.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
          twig.rotation.y = rnd() * Math.PI;
          parts.push(twig);
        } else {
          const peb = new THREE.Mesh(
            pebbleGeos[(rnd() * pebbleGeos.length) | 0],
            pebbleTints[(rnd() * pebbleTints.length) | 0]
          );
          // Half-bedded in the leaf litter rather than resting on top of it.
          const sc = 0.7 + rnd() * 1.1;
          peb.scale.set(sc, sc * (0.6 + rnd() * 0.4), sc);
          peb.position.set((rnd() - 0.5) * 0.5, 0.012 + rnd() * 0.02, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.5);
          peb.rotation.set(rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3);
          parts.push(peb);
        }
      }
      const g = mergeParts(parts, foliageMat);
      g.position.set(x, groundMinAround(x, z, 0.2), z);
      scene.add(g);
      foliage.push({ mesh: g, kind: 'clutter', x, z });
    }

    // Seeded and built once over the whole map — expanding land used to reshuffle every
    // tuft to a new random spot, which made the ground visibly "crawl".
    // Ground cover follows the land: lush near water, sparse on dry high ground, and
    // nothing at all in the water or on anything you could not stand on.
    function plantable(x, z, maxSlope = 0.45) {
      if (waterDepthAt(x, z) > 0.02) return false;
      if (terrainSlope(x, z) > maxSlope) return false;
      if (nearPOI(x, z, 6)) return false;
      if (distToPath(x, z) < 1.4) return false;
      if (yardWearAt(x, z) > 0.35) return false; // the HQ yard is packed bare
      if (inWallBand(x, z, 0.5)) return false; // nothing growing out of the masonry
      return true;
    }

    function moistureAt(x, z) {
      const riverD = distToRiver(x, z);
      const lakeD = Math.hypot(x - LAKE.x, z - LAKE.z);
      const h = sampleHeight(x, z);
      let m = 0.5 + fbm(x * 0.0065 + 21.7, z * 0.0065 - 13.2, 3) * 0.42;
      m += 0.45 * smoothstep01(1 - riverD / 26);
      m += 0.40 * smoothstep01(1 - lakeD / (LAKE.r + 30));
      m -= smoothBand(6, 30, h) * 0.45;
      return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, m));
    }

    function rebuildFoliage() {
      clearFoliage();
      const rnd = mulberry32(0xf0117a6e);
      // Ground cover stops at the playable edge; the mountains beyond read as bare rock.
      const spread = LAND_MAX + 10;
      function randSpot(minR) {
        for (let tries = 0; tries < 24; tries++) {
          const a = rnd() * Math.PI * 2;
          // Biased inward so the playable middle stays lush without flooding the map.
          const r = minR + Math.pow(rnd(), 1.2) * (spread - minR);
          const x = Math.cos(a) * r, z = Math.sin(a) * r;
          if (r > 2.2) return [x, z];
        }
        return [3, 3];
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < MAX_GRASS; i++) {
        const [x, z] = randSpot(0.5);
        if (!plantable(x, z, 0.5)) continue;
        // Thins out on dry ground, but never bare — even parched dirt keeps a
        // scrubby minimum so nowhere on the walkable map reads as empty.
        const m = moistureAt(x, z);
        if (rnd() > 0.42 + m * 0.55) continue;
        makeGrassTuft(x, z, rnd, m);
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < MAX_BUSH; i++) {
        const [x, z] = randSpot(2);
        if (!plantable(x, z, 0.42)) continue;
        if (rnd() > 0.22 + moistureAt(x, z) * 0.72) continue;
        makeBush(x, z, rnd);
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < MAX_FERN; i++) {
        const [x, z] = randSpot(1.5);
        if (!plantable(x, z, 0.4)) continue;
        // Ferns want shade and damp — they cluster near the water.
        if (rnd() > moistureAt(x, z) * 1.15) continue;
        makeFern(x, z, rnd);
      }
      // Wildflowers like it neither bone-dry nor waterlogged — the meadow band
      // between the fern country and the dry high ground.
      for (let i = 0; i < MAX_FLOWER; i++) {
        const [x, z] = randSpot(1);
        if (!plantable(x, z, 0.42)) continue;
        const m = moistureAt(x, z);
        if (m < 0.3 || m > 0.85) continue;
        if (rnd() > 0.55) continue;
        makeFlowerCluster(x, z, rnd);
      }
      // Mushrooms want the same shade and damp as ferns.
      for (let i = 0; i < MAX_MUSHROOM; i++) {
        const [x, z] = randSpot(1);
        if (!plantable(x, z, 0.4)) continue;
        if (rnd() > moistureAt(x, z) * 0.9) continue;
        makeMushroomCluster(x, z, rnd);
      }
      // Twigs and pebbles: generic forest-floor texture, everywhere walkable.
      for (let i = 0; i < MAX_CLUTTER; i++) {
        const [x, z] = randSpot(1);
        if (!plantable(x, z, 0.48)) continue;
        if (rnd() > 0.7) continue;
        makeClutter(x, z, rnd);
      }
      spawnBugs();
      spawnWildlife();
    }

    // --- Bees & butterflies (Grave Shift critters) --------------------------------
    // Land on flower pads (bush tops as fallback), flutter / forage, die in 1 HP.
    const bugs = [];
    const MAX_BUGS = 24;
    const BUG_HIT_R = 0.24;
    let _bugPads = [];

    const beeYellowMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf0c040, roughness: 0.72 });
    const beeBlackMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1a1a18, roughness: 0.85 });
    const beeWingMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xddeeff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.35, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false
    });
    const butteBodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2a2418, roughness: 0.8 });
    const BUTTE_WING_COLORS = [0xff8c2a, 0x3a7cff, 0xffe066, 0xb44dff, 0xff5577, 0x44ddaa];

    function listFlowerPads() {
      const pads = [];
      for (const f of foliage) {
        if (f.kind !== 'flower') continue;
        const y = sampleHeight(f.x, f.z) + 0.42 + Math.random() * 0.12;
        pads.push({ x: f.x, y, z: f.z });
      }
      if (pads.length < 6) {
        for (const f of foliage) {
          if (f.kind !== 'bush') continue;
          const y = sampleHeight(f.x, f.z) + 0.48 + Math.random() * 0.1;
          pads.push({ x: f.x, y, z: f.z });
          if (pads.length >= 18) break;
        }
      }
      return pads;
    }

    function refreshBugPads() {
      _bugPads = listFlowerPads();
    }

    function makeBeeMesh() {
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      const s = 0.14 + Math.random() * 0.04;
      const b1 = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.055, 0.045, 0.08), beeYellowMat);
      const b2 = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05, 0.04, 0.035), beeBlackMat);
      b2.position.z = 0.035;
      const b3 = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.048, 0.038, 0.03), beeYellowMat);
      b3.position.z = 0.065;
      const head = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.024, 5, 4), beeBlackMat);
      head.position.z = -0.05;
      const wingL = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.07, 0.04), beeWingMat);
      const wingR = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.07, 0.04), beeWingMat);
      wingL.position.set(-0.035, 0.025, 0);
      wingR.position.set(0.035, 0.025, 0);
      g.add(b1, b2, b3, head, wingL, wingR);
      g.scale.setScalar(s / 0.15);
      g.traverse(ch => { if (ch.isMesh) { ch.castShadow = false; ch.receiveShadow = false; } });
      g.userData.wingL = wingL;
      g.userData.wingR = wingR;
      g.userData.kind = 'bee';
      return g;
    }

    function makeButterflyMesh() {
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      const s = 0.22 + Math.random() * 0.08;
      const col = BUTTE_WING_COLORS[(Math.random() * BUTTE_WING_COLORS.length) | 0];
      const wingMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: col, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85, side: THREE.DoubleSide, roughness: 0.55, depthWrite: false
      });
      const body = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.01, 0.012, 0.12, 5), butteBodyMat);
      body.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
      const wingL = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.14, 0.1), wingMat);
      const wingR = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.14, 0.1), wingMat);
      wingL.geometry.translate(-0.07, 0, 0);
      wingR.geometry.translate(0.07, 0, 0);
      wingL.position.set(0, 0.008, 0);
      wingR.position.set(0, 0.008, 0);
      g.add(body, wingL, wingR);
      g.scale.setScalar(s / 0.25);
      g.traverse(ch => { if (ch.isMesh) { ch.castShadow = false; ch.receiveShadow = false; } });
      g.userData.wingL = wingL;
      g.userData.wingR = wingR;
      g.userData.wingMat = wingMat;
      g.userData.kind = 'butterfly';
      return g;
    }

    function clearBugs() {
      for (const b of bugs) {
        if (!b.mesh) continue;
        scene.remove(b.mesh);
        b.mesh.traverse(ch => {
          if (!ch.isMesh) return;
          if (ch.geometry) { try { ch.geometry.dispose(); } catch (_) {} }
          if (ch.material && ch.material !== beeYellowMat && ch.material !== beeBlackMat &&
              ch.material !== beeWingMat && ch.material !== butteBodyMat) {
            try { ch.material.dispose(); } catch (_) {}
          }
        });
      }
      bugs.length = 0;
    }

    function pickBugPad(excludeIdx) {
      if (!_bugPads.length) refreshBugPads();
      if (!_bugPads.length) return null;
      let idx = (Math.random() * _bugPads.length) | 0;
      if (_bugPads.length > 1 && idx === excludeIdx) idx = (idx + 1) % _bugPads.length;
      return { pad: _bugPads[idx], idx };
    }

    function spawnOneBug(kind) {
      if (bugs.length >= MAX_BUGS) return;
      if (!_bugPads.length) refreshBugPads();
      const mesh = kind === 'bee' ? makeBeeMesh() : makeButterflyMesh();
      const picked = pickBugPad(-1);
      let x, z;
      if (picked) {
        x = picked.pad.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4;
        z = picked.pad.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4;
      } else {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const r = 8 + Math.random() * Math.min(40, landRadius * 0.35);
        x = Math.cos(a) * r;
        z = Math.sin(a) * r;
      }
      const gh = sampleHeight(x, z);
      const y = gh + 0.6 + Math.random() * 1.4;
      mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
      scene.add(mesh);
      bugs.push({
        kind,
        mesh,
        hp: 1,
        alive: true,
        hiddenForRain: false,
        mode: kind === 'bee' ? 'wander' : 'fly',
        target: picked ? { x: picked.pad.x, y: picked.pad.y, z: picked.pad.z } : null,
        vel: { x: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2, y: 0, z: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 },
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        landTimer: 0,
        flowerIdx: picked ? picked.idx : -1,
        hoverAng: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        inspect: kind === 'bee' ? (0.3 + Math.random() * 0.5) : 0
      });
      if (bugsShouldHide()) {
        mesh.visible = false;
        bugs[bugs.length - 1].hiddenForRain = true;
      }
    }

    function spawnBugs() {
      clearBugs();
      refreshBugPads();
      let n = 18 + ((Math.random() * 11) | 0); // 18-28
      if (typeof isNight !== 'undefined' && isNight) n = Math.max(10, Math.floor(n * 0.65));
      n = Math.min(n, MAX_BUGS);
      const nBees = Math.round(n * 0.4);
      for (let i = 0; i < nBees; i++) spawnOneBug('bee');
      for (let i = nBees; i < n; i++) spawnOneBug('butterfly');
    }

    function killBug(b) {
      if (!b || !b.alive) return;
      b.alive = false;
      const p = b.mesh.position;
      const col = b.kind === 'bee' ? 0xffdd44 : 0xff8844;
      spawnChunks(p.x, p.y, p.z, col, 3, 2.2);
      spawnChunks(p.x, p.y, p.z, 0xffaa66, 2, 1.6);
      scene.remove(b.mesh);
      b.mesh.traverse(ch => {
        if (!ch.isMesh) return;
        if (ch.geometry) { try { ch.geometry.dispose(); } catch (_) {} }
        if (ch.material && ch.material !== beeYellowMat && ch.material !== beeBlackMat &&
            ch.material !== beeWingMat && ch.material !== butteBodyMat) {
          try { ch.material.dispose(); } catch (_) {}
        }
      });
      b.mesh = null;
    }

    function bugSeekTarget(b, dt, speed, wobble) {
      if (!b.target) return 99;
      const px = b.mesh.position.x, py = b.mesh.position.y, pz = b.mesh.position.z;
      const dx = b.target.x - px, dy = b.target.y - py, dz = b.target.z - pz;
      const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz) || 1;
      const nx = dx / dist, ny = dy / dist, nz = dz / dist;
      const wx = Math.sin(b.phase * 1.7) * wobble;
      const wy = Math.sin(b.phase * 2.3 + 1.1) * wobble * 0.55;
      const wz = Math.cos(b.phase * 1.3) * wobble;
      const k = Math.min(1, dt * 3.5);
      b.vel.x += (nx * speed + wx - b.vel.x) * k;
      b.vel.y += (ny * speed * 0.7 + wy - b.vel.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 3.2);
      b.vel.z += (nz * speed + wz - b.vel.z) * k;
      return dist;
    }

    function bugClampFlight(b) {
      const c = clampToLand(b.mesh.position.x, b.mesh.position.z, 2.5);
      b.mesh.position.x = c.x;
      b.mesh.position.z = c.z;
      const gh = sampleHeight(b.mesh.position.x, b.mesh.position.z);
      if (b.mode !== 'land') {
        const minY = gh + 0.4, maxY = gh + 2.5;
        if (b.mesh.position.y < minY) { b.mesh.position.y = minY; b.vel.y = Math.max(0, b.vel.y); }
        if (b.mesh.position.y > maxY) { b.mesh.position.y = maxY; b.vel.y = Math.min(0, b.vel.y); }
      }
    }

    function bugPickNewFlower(b) {
      const picked = pickBugPad(b.flowerIdx);
      if (!picked) {
        b.target = null;
        b.mode = 'wander';
        return;
      }
      b.flowerIdx = picked.idx;
      b.target = { x: picked.pad.x, y: picked.pad.y, z: picked.pad.z };
      b.mode = b.kind === 'bee' ? 'wander' : 'fly';
      if (b.kind === 'bee') b.inspect = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.9;
    }

    function bugsShouldHide() {
      // Shelter during rain storms — intensity ramps in/out with weather system
      return !!(weather && (weather.raining || weather.intensity > 0.08));
    }

    function updateBugs(dt) {
      if (!bugs.length) return;
      const hide = bugsShouldHide();
      for (let i = bugs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const b = bugs[i];
        if (!b.alive || !b.mesh) { bugs.splice(i, 1); continue; }
        // Disappear / shelter while raining; come back when it clears
        if (hide) {
          if (b.mesh.visible) {
            b.mesh.visible = false;
            b.hiddenForRain = true;
            b.vel.x = b.vel.y = b.vel.z = 0;
          }
          continue;
        }
        if (b.hiddenForRain) {
          b.hiddenForRain = false;
          b.mesh.visible = true;
          // Pop back into a short takeoff so they don't teleport onto flowers mid-rain
          b.mode = 'takeoff';
          b.landTimer = 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.5;
          b.vel.y = b.kind === 'bee' ? 2.4 : 1.5;
          b.vel.x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
          b.vel.z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
          const h = sampleHeight(b.mesh.position.x, b.mesh.position.z);
          if (b.mesh.position.y < h + 0.6) b.mesh.position.y = h + 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.6;
        }
        const isBee = b.kind === 'bee';
        b.phase += dt;

        const wl = b.mesh.userData.wingL, wr = b.mesh.userData.wingR;
        if (wl && wr) {
          if (b.mode === 'land') {
            const a = Math.sin(b.phase * (isBee ? 18 : 6)) * (isBee ? 0.08 : 0.04);
            wl.rotation.z = a; wr.rotation.z = -a;
          } else if (isBee) {
            const a = Math.sin(b.phase * 42) * 0.55;
            wl.rotation.z = a; wr.rotation.z = -a;
          } else {
            const a = Math.sin(b.phase * 16) * 0.85;
            wl.rotation.z = a; wr.rotation.z = -a;
          }
        }

        if (b.mode === 'land') {
          b.landTimer -= dt;
          if (b.target) {
            const k = Math.min(1, dt * 8);
            b.mesh.position.x += (b.target.x - b.mesh.position.x) * k;
            b.mesh.position.y += (b.target.y - b.mesh.position.y) * k;
            b.mesh.position.z += (b.target.z - b.mesh.position.z) * k;
          }
          b.vel.x *= 0.85; b.vel.y *= 0.85; b.vel.z *= 0.85;
          if (b.landTimer <= 0) {
            b.mode = 'takeoff';
            b.vel.y = isBee ? 2.8 : 1.6;
            b.vel.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
            b.vel.z += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
            b.landTimer = 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.4;
          }
        } else if (b.mode === 'takeoff') {
          b.landTimer -= dt;
          b.mesh.position.x += b.vel.x * dt;
          b.mesh.position.y += b.vel.y * dt;
          b.mesh.position.z += b.vel.z * dt;
          b.vel.y -= 1.2 * dt;
          if (b.landTimer <= 0) bugPickNewFlower(b);
        } else {
          if (!b.target) bugPickNewFlower(b);
          let dist = 99;
          if (isBee) {
            if (b.inspect > 0 && b.target) {
              b.inspect -= dt;
              b.hoverAng += dt * 4.5;
              const r = 0.35;
              const hx = b.target.x + Math.cos(b.hoverAng) * r;
              const hz = b.target.z + Math.sin(b.hoverAng * 2) * r * 0.6;
              const hy = b.target.y + 0.25 + Math.sin(b.hoverAng * 3) * 0.12;
              const saved = b.target;
              b.target = { x: hx, y: hy, z: hz };
              dist = bugSeekTarget(b, dt, 5.5, 1.8);
              b.target = saved;
              if (b.inspect <= 0) b.mode = 'fly';
            } else {
              dist = bugSeekTarget(b, dt, 6.2, 1.2);
              if (dist < 0.35) {
                b.mode = 'land';
                b.landTimer = 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.2;
                b.vel.x = b.vel.y = b.vel.z = 0;
              }
            }
          } else {
            dist = bugSeekTarget(b, dt, 2.8, 2.4);
            b.vel.y += Math.sin(b.phase * 3.1) * 0.4 * dt;
            if (dist < 0.4) {
              b.mode = 'land';
              b.landTimer = 2 + Math.random() * 4;
              b.vel.x = b.vel.y = b.vel.z = 0;
            }
          }
          b.mesh.position.x += b.vel.x * dt;
          b.mesh.position.y += b.vel.y * dt;
          b.mesh.position.z += b.vel.z * dt;
        }

        bugClampFlight(b);
        const spd = Math.hypot(b.vel.x, b.vel.z);
        if (spd > 0.15) b.mesh.rotation.y = Math.atan2(b.vel.x, b.vel.z);
      }
    }

    function hitBugsSegment(ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz) {
      let best = null, bestT = 2;
      for (const b of bugs) {
        if (!b.alive || !b.mesh || !b.mesh.visible || b.hiddenForRain) continue;
        const p = b.mesh.position;
        const t = segmentHitsCylinder(ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, p.x, p.z, BUG_HIT_R, p.y - 0.12, p.y + 0.18);
        if (t !== null && t < bestT) { bestT = t; best = b; }
      }
      return best;
    }

    function meleeBugs(reach, fx, fz, minDot) {
      for (const b of bugs) {
        if (!b.alive || !b.mesh || !b.mesh.visible || b.hiddenForRain) continue;
        const dx = b.mesh.position.x - player.position.x;
        const dz = b.mesh.position.z - player.position.z;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (d < reach + 0.2) {
          const dy = b.mesh.position.y - (player.position.y + 0.9);
          if (Math.abs(dy) > 2.2) continue;
          const dot = (dx * fx + dz * fz) / (d || 1);
          if (dot > minDot) killBug(b);
        }
      }
    }

    // --- Ambient wildlife (birds / rabbits / frogs) -----------------------------
    // Fill the world with non-combat critters. Prefer scare/flee; 1HP shootable
    // like bugs (tiny puff, no cash). Mirrors bugs[] spawn/update/hit patterns.
    const birds = [];
    const rabbits = [];
    const frogs = [];
    const squirrels = [];
    const turtles = [];
    const fishes = [];
    const burrows = [];
    const nests = [];
    const lilyPads = [];
    const MAX_BIRDS = 14;
    const MAX_RABBITS = 9;
    const MAX_FROGS = 8;
    const MAX_SQUIRRELS = 9;
    const MAX_TURTLES = 6;
    const MAX_FISH = 14;
    const MAX_BURROWS = 5;
    const MAX_NESTS = 6;
    const MAX_LILYPADS = 6;
    const BIRD_HIT_R = 0.28;
    const RABBIT_HIT_R = 0.22;
    const FROG_HIT_R = 0.16;
    const SQUIRREL_HIT_R = 0.2;
    const TURTLE_HIT_R = 0.24;
    const FISH_HIT_R = 0.16;
    const WILD_PLAYER_SCARE_R = 8;
    const BIRD_ATTACK_DURATION = 10; // seconds a nest-robbed bird spends furious
    const _nestWorldPos = new THREE.Vector3();

    const birdBodyMats = [
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x6b5a48, roughness: 0.85 }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8a8a8a, roughness: 0.82 }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xd8d4cc, roughness: 0.78 }),

    const RABBIT_COATS = [

    // The bird was a sphere, a smaller sphere, a cone and two flat boxes for wings.
    // Now it has a tapered body, a pale breast, a head with eyes either side of a
    // short beak, a fanned tail and two-piece wings: an inner wing out of the shoulder
    // and swept primaries beyond it. The wings stay Groups pivoted at the shoulder so
    // the existing flap (wingL.rotation.z) hinges where a wing actually hinges, and
    // the outer panel is angled so the flap folds and spreads the tips as it beats.
    function makeBirdMesh() {
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      const bodyMat = birdBodyMats[(Math.random() * birdBodyMats.length) | 0];
      const body = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.085, 7, 6), bodyMat);
      body.scale.set(1, 0.82, 1.45);
      // Rump tapering back into the tail rather than ending on the sphere.
      const rump = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.055, 0.11, 6), bodyMat);
      rump.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
      rump.position.set(0, 0.004, -0.15);
      const breast = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.06, 6, 5), birdBreastMat);
      breast.scale.set(0.92, 0.72, 1.15);
      breast.position.set(0, -0.026, 0.035);
      const head = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.042, 6, 5), bodyMat);
      head.position.set(0, 0.032, 0.105);
      const beak = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.012, 0.042, 4), birdBeakMat);
      beak.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
      beak.position.set(0, 0.026, 0.148);
      const eyeL = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.0075, 4, 3), birdEyeMat);
      eyeL.position.set(-0.03, 0.045, 0.122);
      const eyeR = eyeL.clone();
      eyeR.position.x = 0.03;
      // Tail: a flat fan of three feathers, splayed and tipped up a little.
      const tail = new THREE.Group();
      tail.position.set(0, 0.008, -0.175);
      tail.rotation.x = -0.14;
      for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
        const f = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.028, 0.006, 0.105), birdWingMat);
        f.position.set(i * 0.023, 0, -0.048);
        f.rotation.y = i * 0.26;
        tail.add(f);
      }

      // Sized off the body: the torso is ~0.085 across, so the inner panel has to start
      // outside that or it just disappears into the sphere and leaves the narrow outer
      // panel sticking out on its own — which reads as a plank bolted to a ball, not a
      // wing. Half-span works out near twice the body length, and the chord tapers from
      // the shoulder to the swept primaries.
      const wing = (side) => {
        const pivot = new THREE.Group();
        pivot.position.set(side * 0.02, 0.026, 0.006);
        const innerW = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.12, 0.013, 0.1), birdWingMat);
        innerW.position.set(side * 0.055, 0, -0.008);
        innerW.rotation.y = side * -0.1;
        const outerW = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.11, 0.009, 0.068), birdWingTipMat);
        outerW.position.set(side * 0.165, -0.004, -0.034);
        outerW.rotation.y = side * -0.32;  // primaries swept back off the elbow
        outerW.rotation.z = side * -0.12;
        pivot.add(innerW, outerW);
        return pivot;
      };
      const wingL = wing(-1), wingR = wing(1);

      g.add(body, rump, breast, head, beak, eyeL, eyeR, tail, wingL, wingR);

      g.traverse(ch => { if (ch.isMesh) { ch.castShadow = false; ch.receiveShadow = false; } });
      g.userData.wingL = wingL;
      g.userData.wingR = wingR;
      g.userData.tail = tail;
      skinMergeGroup(THREE, g, { bones: 'self', name: 'bird-skin' });   // CL-140: one draw, not twenty
      return g;
    }

    // A rabbit used to be five blobs: body, head, belly and two capsule ears. It now

    function makeRabbitMesh() {

      eyeL.position.set(-0.045, 0.078, 0.132);

      // Paws tucked under the chest, hind feet flat along the ground.
      const pawL = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.022, 5, 4), belly);
      pawL.scale.set(0.8, 0.7, 1.4);

      const footL = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.028, 5, 4), fur);

      footL.position.set(-0.062, -0.068, -0.03);

      const tail = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.027, 5, 4), rabbitTailMat);

        eyeL, eyeR, earL, earR, pawL, pawR, footL, footR, tail);
      // Mostly young adults, with the occasional big hare.
      const s = (Math.random() < 0.12 ? 1.08 + Math.random() * 0.18 : 0.74 + Math.random() * 0.3);
      g.scale.setScalar(s);
      g.traverse(ch => { if (ch.isMesh) { ch.castShadow = false; ch.receiveShadow = false; } });
      g.userData.earL = earL;
      g.userData.earR = earR;
      g.userData.tail = tail;
      g.userData.baseScale = s;
      skinMergeGroup(THREE, g, { bones: 'self', name: 'rabbit-skin' });   // CL-140: one draw, not twenty
