    function makeFishMesh(kind) {
      const K = kind || FISH_KINDS[(Math.random() * FISH_KINDS.length) | 0];
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      const backMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: K.back, roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.1 });
      const sideMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: K.side, roughness: 0.4, metalness: 0.15 });
      const bellyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: K.belly, roughness: 0.5, metalness: 0.05 });
      const finMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: K.fin, roughness: 0.6, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
      // A spindle: long, deep in the middle, tapering to the tail.
      const body = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.07, 10, 7), sideMat);
      body.scale.set(0.55, 0.7, 1.9);
      const back = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.066, 10, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI * 0.42), backMat);
      back.scale.set(0.57, 0.72, 1.86);
      back.position.y = 0.004;
      const belly = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.064, 10, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2, Math.PI * 0.6, Math.PI * 0.4), bellyMat);
      belly.scale.set(0.53, 0.7, 1.8);
      const tailPivot = new THREE.Group();
      tailPivot.position.set(0, 0, -0.12);
      const tailShape = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      tailShape.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute([0, 0.0, 0.01, 0, 0.055, -0.075, 0, 0.0, -0.05, 0, 0.0, 0.01, 0, 0.0, -0.05, 0, -0.05, -0.075], 3));
      tailShape.computeVertexNormals();
      const tail = new THREE.Mesh(tailShape, finMat);
      tailPivot.add(tail);
      const dorsalShape = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      dorsalShape.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute([0, 0.045, 0.035, 0, 0.085, -0.01, 0, 0.042, -0.05], 3));
      dorsalShape.computeVertexNormals();
      const dorsal = new THREE.Mesh(dorsalShape, finMat);
      g.add(body, back, belly, tailPivot, dorsal);
      const s = (0.85 + Math.random() * 0.6) * K.len;
      g.scale.setScalar(s);
      g.traverse(ch => { if (ch.isMesh) { ch.castShadow = false; ch.receiveShadow = false; } });
      g.userData.tail = tailPivot;
      g.userData.body = body;
      g.userData.baseScale = s;
      skinMergeGroup(THREE, g, { bones: 'self', name: 'fish-skin' });   // CL-140
      return g;
    }

    function disposeWildMesh(mesh) {
      if (!mesh) return;
      scene.remove(mesh);
      mesh.traverse(ch => {
        if (!ch.isMesh) return;
        if (ch.geometry) { try { ch.geometry.dispose(); } catch (_) {} }
        if (ch.material &&
            ch.material !== birdWingMat && ch.material !== rabbitBodyMat &&
            ch.material !== birdWingTipMat && ch.material !== birdBreastMat &&
            ch.material !== birdBeakMat && ch.material !== birdEyeMat &&
            ch.material !== rabbitInnerEarMat && ch.material !== rabbitEyeMat &&
            ch.material !== rabbitNoseMat && ch.material !== rabbitTailMat &&
            !RABBIT_COATS.some(c => c.fur === ch.material || c.belly === ch.material || c.ear === ch.material) &&
            ch.material !== rabbitEarMat && ch.material !== rabbitBellyMat &&
            ch.material !== frogBodyMat && ch.material !== frogEyeMat &&
            ch.material !== frogThroatMat &&
            ch.material !== burrowMoundMat && ch.material !== burrowHoleMat &&
            ch.material !== burrowDirtMat &&
            ch.material !== lilyPadMat && ch.material !== lilyFlowerMat && ch.material !== lilyFlowerCoreMat &&
            ch.material !== squirrelBodyMat && ch.material !== squirrelBellyMat && ch.material !== squirrelTailMat &&
            ch.material !== turtleShellMat && ch.material !== turtleShellRimMat && ch.material !== turtleSkinMat &&
            ch.material !== fishFinMat &&
            birdBodyMats.indexOf(ch.material) < 0) {
          try { ch.material.dispose(); } catch (_) {}
        }
      });
    }

    // Nests live as children of a tree's canopy group (so they sway and fall with
    // the tree for free), never as direct scene children — so they get their own
    // disposer that detaches from whatever parent they're actually on.
    function disposeNestMesh(mesh) {
      if (!mesh) return;
      if (mesh.parent) mesh.parent.remove(mesh);
      mesh.traverse(ch => {
        if (!ch.isMesh) return;
        if (ch.geometry) { try { ch.geometry.dispose(); } catch (_) {} }
        if (ch.material && ch.material !== nestTwigMat && ch.material !== nestEggMat) {
          try { ch.material.dispose(); } catch (_) {}
        }
      });
    }

    function clearWildlife() {
      for (const b of birds) disposeWildMesh(b.mesh);
      for (const r of rabbits) disposeWildMesh(r.mesh);
      for (const f of frogs) disposeWildMesh(f.mesh);
      for (const sq of squirrels) disposeWildMesh(sq.mesh);
      for (const tu of turtles) disposeWildMesh(tu.mesh);
      for (const fi of fishes) disposeWildMesh(fi.mesh);
      for (const bu of burrows) disposeWildMesh(bu.mesh);
      for (const n of nests) disposeNestMesh(n.mesh);
      for (const lp of lilyPads) disposeWildMesh(lp.mesh);
      birds.length = 0;
      rabbits.length = 0;
      frogs.length = 0;
      squirrels.length = 0;
      turtles.length = 0;
      fishes.length = 0;
      burrows.length = 0;
      nests.length = 0;
      lilyPads.length = 0;
    }

    function wildRandLandSpot(minR, maxR) {
      for (let tries = 0; tries < 24; tries++) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const r = minR + Math.random() * (maxR - minR);
        const x = Math.cos(a) * r;
        const z = Math.sin(a) * r;
        if (!inLand(x, z, 2.5)) continue;
        return { x, z };
      }
      return { x: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20, z: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20 };
    }

    // A burrow is a static prop (indestructible, never repositioned) that gives
    // rabbits somewhere real to flee to instead of just blinking out in place.
    function spawnOneBurrow() {
      if (burrows.length >= MAX_BURROWS) return;
      let x, z, ok = false;
      for (let t = 0; t < 30; t++) {
        const spot = wildRandLandSpot(10, Math.min(55, landRadius * 0.42));
        x = spot.x; z = spot.z;
        if (distToStream(x, z) > STREAM_WIDTH * 1.4) { ok = true; break; }
      }
      if (!ok) return;
      const gh = sampleHeight(x, z);
      const facing = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const mesh = makeBurrowMesh();
      mesh.position.set(x, gh, z);
      mesh.rotation.y = facing;
      scene.add(mesh);
      // The mouth is offset toward "facing" from the mound centre — this is exactly
      // where a fleeing rabbit needs to arrive to duck in.
      burrows.push({
        mesh, x, z, facing,
        mouthX: x + Math.sin(facing) * 0.4,
        mouthZ: z + Math.cos(facing) * 0.4
      });
    }

    // The shovel fills a burrow in. Any rabbit living there loses its home (and one
    // hiding down it pops back out), so nothing comes up inside your walls again.
    function removeBurrow(bu) {
      const i = burrows.indexOf(bu);
      if (i < 0) return;
      burrows.splice(i, 1);
      disposeWildMesh(bu.mesh);
      for (const r of rabbits) {
        if (r.home !== bu) continue;
        r.home = null;
        if (r.mode === 'hidden' || r.mode === 'entering' || r.mode === 'toburrow') {
          r.mode = 'idle'; r.mesh.visible = true; r.squash = 0; r.hopCd = 0.2;
        }
      }
    }
    function burrowInCell(cx, cz, half) {
      return burrows.find((bu) => Math.abs(bu.x - cx) <= half && Math.abs(bu.z - cz) <= half) || null;
    }

    function spawnBurrows() {
      const n = 4 + ((Math.random() * 2) | 0); // 4-5
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(n, MAX_BURROWS); i++) spawnOneBurrow();
    }

    // A nest rides along as a child of its tree's canopy group, so wind sway and a
    // tree fall/burn move (and eventually drop) it for free — no extra bookkeeping.
    function spawnOneNest() {
      if (nests.length >= MAX_NESTS) return;
      const candidates = trees.filter(t => t.alive && !t.falling && (t.canopyTop || 0) > 2.2);
      if (!candidates.length) return;
      const tree = candidates[(Math.random() * candidates.length) | 0];
      const mesh = makeNestMesh();
      const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const r = (tree.canopyRadius || 1) * (0.25 + Math.random() * 0.35);
      const y = (tree.canopyBottom || 1) + (tree.canopyTop - tree.canopyBottom || 1) * (0.45 + Math.random() * 0.4);
      // The canopy group sits at the crown's pivot, partway up the trunk.
      mesh.position.set(Math.cos(ang) * r, y - (tree.canopyPivotY || 0), Math.sin(ang) * r);
      tree.canopy.add(mesh);
      nests.push({ mesh, tree, alive: true });
    }

    function spawnNests() {
      const n = 4 + ((Math.random() * 3) | 0); // 4-6
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(n, MAX_NESTS); i++) spawnOneNest();
    }

    function nestWorldPos(nest, out) {
      out.set(0, 0, 0);
      nest.mesh.getWorldPosition(out);
      return out;
    }

    function spawnOneBird() {
      if (birds.length >= MAX_BIRDS) return;
      const spot = wildRandLandSpot(10, Math.min(55, landRadius * 0.45));
      const gh = sampleHeight(spot.x, spot.z);
      const cruise = 3.5 + Math.random() * 4.5;
      const mesh = makeBirdMesh();
      mesh.position.set(spot.x, gh + cruise, spot.z);
      scene.add(mesh);
      const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const home = nests.length ? nests[(Math.random() * nests.length) | 0] : null;
      birds.push({
        mesh, hp: 1, alive: true,
        mode: 'cruise',
        scareT: 0,
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        cruiseH: cruise,
        cx: spot.x, cz: spot.z,
        orbitR: 6 + Math.random() * 14,
        orbitAng: ang,
        orbitSpd: (0.18 + Math.random() * 0.22) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1),
        vel: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
        wx: spot.x + Math.cos(ang) * 8, wz: spot.z + Math.sin(ang) * 8,
        home,
        roostT: 5 + Math.random() * 16,
        perchT: 0
      });
    }

    function spawnOneRabbit() {
      if (rabbits.length >= MAX_RABBITS) return;
      const home = burrows.length ? burrows[(Math.random() * burrows.length) | 0] : null;
      let x, z, ok = false;
      for (let t = 0; t < 30; t++) {
        let spot;
        if (home) {
          const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          const r = 2 + Math.random() * 7;
          spot = { x: home.x + Math.cos(a) * r, z: home.z + Math.sin(a) * r };
          if (!inLand(spot.x, spot.z, 2.5)) continue;
        } else {
          spot = wildRandLandSpot(8, Math.min(50, landRadius * 0.4));
        }
        x = spot.x; z = spot.z;
        if (distToStream(x, z) > STREAM_WIDTH * 1.2) { ok = true; break; }
      }
      if (!ok) return;
      const gh = sampleHeight(x, z);
      const mesh = makeRabbitMesh();
      mesh.position.set(x, gh + 0.12, z);
      scene.add(mesh);
      rabbits.push({
        mesh, hp: 1, alive: true,
        mode: 'idle',
        scareT: 0, hideT: 0,
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        hopCd: 0.4 + Math.random() * 1.2,
        vel: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
        facing: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        hiddenForRain: false,
        home,
        squash: 0,
        earT: 1 + Math.random() * 2.5,
        earFlick: 0,
        burrowT: 0
      });
      if (groundCrittersShouldHide()) {
        mesh.visible = false;
        rabbits[rabbits.length - 1].hiddenForRain = true;
      }
    }

    // A lily pad is found rather than guessed: walk the river's own centreline and
    // ask waterLevelAt whether the offset point actually landed in the water — same
    // trick as the burrow mouth, just wetter.
    function spawnOneLilyPad() {
      if (lilyPads.length >= MAX_LILYPADS) return;
      // Lily pads grow where the water lies still — the lake's shallows, not a
      // running river.
      for (let t = 0; t < 60; t++) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, rr = LAKE.r * (0.4 + Math.random() * 1.0);
        const x = LAKE.x + Math.cos(a) * rr, z = LAKE.z + Math.sin(a) * rr;
        const wl = waterLevelAt(x, z);
        if (wl === null) continue;
        const dp = wl - sampleHeight(x, z);
        if (dp < 0.35 || dp > 1.6 || waterCurrentAt(x, z) > 0.02) continue;
        const mesh = makeLilyPadMesh();
        mesh.position.set(x, wl + 0.015, z);
        mesh.rotation.y = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        scene.add(mesh);
        lilyPads.push({ mesh, x, y: wl + 0.015, z });
        return;
      }
    }

    function spawnLilyPads() {
      const n = 5 + ((Math.random() * 3) | 0); // 5-7
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(n, MAX_LILYPADS); i++) spawnOneLilyPad();
    }

    function spawnOneFrog() {
      if (frogs.length >= MAX_FROGS) return;
      const home = lilyPads.length ? lilyPads[(Math.random() * lilyPads.length) | 0] : null;
      let x, z, ok = false;
      const lo = STREAM_WIDTH * 1.05, hi = STREAM_WIDTH * 3.0;
      for (let t = 0; t < 40; t++) {
        let spot;
        if (home) {
          const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          const r = 1.5 + Math.random() * 5;
          spot = { x: home.x + Math.cos(a) * r, z: home.z + Math.sin(a) * r };
        } else {
          spot = wildRandLandSpot(6, Math.min(60, landRadius * 0.5));
        }
        const d = distToStream(spot.x, spot.z);
        // On dry ground at the water's edge: by the river, or round the lake.
        const dryEdge = waterDepthAt(spot.x, spot.z) <= 0 && waterNear(spot.x, spot.z, 3.5);
        if ((d >= lo && d <= hi && waterDepthAt(spot.x, spot.z) <= 0) || dryEdge) { x = spot.x; z = spot.z; ok = true; break; }
      }
      if (!ok) return;
      const gh = sampleHeight(x, z);
      const mesh = makeFrogMesh();
      mesh.position.set(x, gh + 0.06, z);
      scene.add(mesh);
      frogs.push({
        mesh, hp: 1, alive: true,
        mode: 'sit',
        scareT: 0, hideT: 0,
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        hopCd: 1.0 + Math.random() * 2.5,
        vel: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
        facing: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        hiddenForRain: false,
        dayQuiet: Math.random() < 0.55,
        home,
        squash: 0,
        diveT: 0,
        blinkT: 0.8 + Math.random() * 2,
        blink: 0,
        croakT: 1.5 + Math.random() * 4,
        croakBurstT: 0
      });
      const fr = frogs[frogs.length - 1];
      if (groundCrittersShouldHide()) {
        mesh.visible = false;
        fr.hiddenForRain = true;
      } else if (!isNight && fr.dayQuiet) {
        mesh.visible = false;
        fr.mode = 'dayhide';
      }
    }

    // A squirrel's home is simply an existing tree — no separate prop needed, since
    // it climbs the trunk itself. It stays a normal scene child throughout (never
    // reparented under the tree), so hit-detection and the scare check always see
    // its real world position; the climb/perch math below just points it at the
    // right spot on that trunk each frame.
    function spawnOneSquirrel() {
      if (squirrels.length >= MAX_SQUIRRELS) return;
      const candidates = trees.filter(t => t.alive && !t.falling && (t.canopyBottom || 0) > 1.2);
      const home = candidates.length ? candidates[(Math.random() * candidates.length) | 0] : null;
      let x, z, ok = false;
      for (let t = 0; t < 30; t++) {
        let spot;
        if (home) {
          const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          const r = 1.5 + Math.random() * 6;
          spot = { x: home.x + Math.cos(a) * r, z: home.z + Math.sin(a) * r };
        } else {
          spot = wildRandLandSpot(8, Math.min(50, landRadius * 0.4));
        }
        if (inLand(spot.x, spot.z, 2.5) && distToStream(spot.x, spot.z) > STREAM_WIDTH * 1.1) {
          x = spot.x; z = spot.z; ok = true; break;
        }
      }
      if (!ok) return;
      const gh = sampleHeight(x, z);
      const mesh = makeSquirrelMesh();
      mesh.position.set(x, gh + 0.09, z);
      scene.add(mesh);
      squirrels.push({
        mesh, hp: 1, alive: true,
        mode: 'idle',
        scareT: 0,
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        hopCd: 0.4 + Math.random() * 1.2,
        vel: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
        facing: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        hiddenForRain: false,
        home,
        squash: 0,
        tailFlickT: 1 + Math.random() * 2.5,
        tailFlick: 0,
        climbAngle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        climbH: 0,
        climbTarget: 0,
        perchT: 0
      });
      if (groundCrittersShouldHide()) {
        mesh.visible = false;
        squirrels[squirrels.length - 1].hiddenForRain = true;
      }
    }

    function spawnSquirrels() {
      const n = 5 + ((Math.random() * 4) | 0); // 5-8
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(n, MAX_SQUIRRELS); i++) spawnOneSquirrel();
    }

    // World-space point on the home tree's trunk for the current climb angle/height.
    // A squirrel is never actually reparented under the tree (unlike a nest) — it
    // stays a normal scene child the whole time, so hit-detection and the scare
    // check always see its real position. This is just where that position is.
    function squirrelTrunkPos(s) {
      const home = s.home;
      const yaw = home.group.rotation.y;
      const lr = (home.trunkRadius || 0.3) + 0.04;
      const lx = Math.cos(s.climbAngle) * lr, lz = Math.sin(s.climbAngle) * lr;
      return {
        x: home.x + lx * Math.cos(yaw) - lz * Math.sin(yaw),
        y: home.group.position.y + s.climbH,
        z: home.z + lx * Math.sin(yaw) + lz * Math.cos(yaw)
      };
    }

    // No home prop for turtles — just an anchor point on the bank they amble
    // around. Their defence isn't fleeing (too slow); it's pulling in and riding
    // it out, so there's nowhere they need to run to.
    function spawnOneTurtle() {
      if (turtles.length >= MAX_TURTLES) return;
      let x, z, ok = false;
      const lo = STREAM_WIDTH * 1.0, hi = STREAM_WIDTH * 2.6;
      for (let t = 0; t < 40; t++) {
        const spot = wildRandLandSpot(6, Math.min(55, landRadius * 0.45));
        const d = distToStream(spot.x, spot.z);
        // On dry ground at the water's edge: by the river, or round the lake.
        const dryEdge = waterDepthAt(spot.x, spot.z) <= 0 && waterNear(spot.x, spot.z, 3.5);
        if ((d >= lo && d <= hi && waterDepthAt(spot.x, spot.z) <= 0) || dryEdge) { x = spot.x; z = spot.z; ok = true; break; }
      }
      if (!ok) return;
      const gh = sampleHeight(x, z);
      const mesh = makeTurtleMesh();
      mesh.position.set(x, gh + 0.04, z);
      scene.add(mesh);
      turtles.push({
        mesh, hp: 1, alive: true,
        mode: 'idle',
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        vel: { x: 0, z: 0 },
        facing: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        anchorX: x, anchorZ: z,
        moveCd: 1 + Math.random() * 3,
        retractT: 0
      });
    }

    function spawnTurtles() {
      const n = 4 + ((Math.random() * 3) | 0); // 4-6
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(n, MAX_TURTLES); i++) spawnOneTurtle();
    }

    // Fish live in small schools, each with a home stretch of water: open lake, or a
    // run of the river. A school's middle wanders slowly about its home, and its fish
    // keep together around it.
    const fishSchools = [];
    // CL-53 (Jerry): the "little black specks" over the pit's runes were fish, schools that had
    // wandered over the sinkhole and down the well (dark backs against the glow). Nothing
    // swims over the pit now: for a fish, the water there is not water (and the thing
    // down there would have it). It keeps 3 m clear of the hole's edge.
    const FISH_PIT_CLEAR = 3;
    function fishDepthAt(x, z) {
      if (Math.hypot(x - LAKE_HOLE.x, z - LAKE_HOLE.z) < LAKE_HOLE.r + FISH_PIT_CLEAR) return 0;
      const wl = waterLevelAt(x, z);
      return wl === null ? 0 : wl - sampleHeight(x, z);
    }
    function pickWaterSpot(habitat) {
      for (let t = 0; t < 60; t++) {
        let x, z;
        if (habitat === 'lake') {
          const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, r = Math.random() * LAKE.r * 1.1;
          x = LAKE.x + Math.cos(a) * r; z = LAKE.z + Math.sin(a) * r;
          if (waterCurrentAt(x, z) > 0.05) continue;
        } else {
          const pt = riverPointAt(0.12 + Math.random() * (RIVER_JOIN_S - 0.2));
          x = pt.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5; z = pt.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
          if (Math.hypot(x, z) > LAND_MAX - 8) continue;
        }
        if (fishDepthAt(x, z) > (habitat === 'lake' ? 0.9 : 0.6)) return { x, z };
      }
      return null;
    }
    function spawnSchool(habitat, n) {
      const home = pickWaterSpot(habitat);
      if (!home) return;
      const kind = FISH_KINDS[(Math.random() * FISH_KINDS.length) | 0];
      const school = { habitat, x: home.x, z: home.z, tx: home.x, tz: home.z, retarget: 0, members: [] };
      fishSchools.push(school);
      for (let i = 0; i < n && fishes.length < MAX_FISH; i++) {
        const x = home.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.6, z = home.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.6;
        const wl = waterLevelAt(x, z);
        if (wl === null) continue;
        const mesh = makeFishMesh(kind);
        const bed = sampleHeight(x, z);
        mesh.position.set(x, bed + (wl - bed) * 0.5, z);
        scene.add(mesh);
        const f = {
          mesh, hp: 1, alive: true, school,
          mode: 'swim',
          phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
          heading: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, speed: 0.3, pitch: 0,
          depthFrac: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.3, depthT: 2 + Math.random() * 4,
          vel: { x: 0, z: 0 },
          scareT: 0, burstT: 0,
          riseCd: 12 + Math.random() * 30, riseT: 0, leapT: 0, leapVy: 0,
          anchorX: x, anchorZ: z
        };
        school.members.push(f);
        fishes.push(f);
      }
    }
    function spawnFish() {
      fishSchools.length = 0;
      // Three schools in the lake, two holding in the river's runs.
      spawnSchool('lake', 4); spawnSchool('lake', 3); spawnSchool('lake', 3);
      spawnSchool('river', 2); spawnSchool('river', 2);
    }

    function spawnWildlife() {
      clearWildlife();
      spawnBurrows();
      spawnNests();
      spawnLilyPads();
      const nb = 10 + ((Math.random() * 5) | 0); // 10-14
      const nr = 6 + ((Math.random() * 4) | 0);  // 6-9
      const nf = 5 + ((Math.random() * 4) | 0);  // 5-8
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(nb, MAX_BIRDS); i++) spawnOneBird();
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(nr, MAX_RABBITS); i++) spawnOneRabbit();
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(nf, MAX_FROGS); i++) spawnOneFrog();
      spawnSquirrels();
      spawnTurtles();
      spawnFish();
    }

    function groundCrittersShouldHide() {
      return !!(weather && (weather.raining || weather.intensity > 0.12));
    }

    function killWildlife(w, color, dirX = 0, dirZ = 0) {
      if (!w || !w.alive) return;
      w.alive = false;
      const p = w.mesh.position;
      spawnChunks(p.x, p.y, p.z, color || 0xaa8866, 2, 1.5);
      spawnBlood(p.x, p.y + 0.08, p.z, dirX || 0, dirZ || 0, 8, 0.95);
      disposeWildMesh(w.mesh);
      w.mesh = null;
    }

    function scareWildlife(wx, wz, radius, strength) {
      const R = radius || 14;
      const S = strength == null ? 1 : strength;
      for (const b of birds) {
        if (!b.alive || !b.mesh) continue;
        const dx = b.mesh.position.x - wx;
        const dz = b.mesh.position.z - wz;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (d > R) continue;
        const fall = 1 - d / R;
        const nx = (dx / (d || 1));
        const nz = (dz / (d || 1));
        b.mode = 'scatter';
        b.scareT = 2.2 + Math.random() * 1.8;
        b.vel.x = nx * (7 + 10 * S * fall) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3;
        b.vel.z = nz * (7 + 10 * S * fall) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3;
        b.vel.y = 4 + 6 * S * fall + Math.random() * 3;
      }
      for (const r of rabbits) {
        if (!r.alive || !r.mesh || !r.mesh.visible) continue;
        const dx = r.mesh.position.x - wx;
        const dz = r.mesh.position.z - wz;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (d > R * 0.85) continue;
        const fall = 1 - d / (R * 0.85);
        const nx = dx / (d || 1), nz = dz / (d || 1);
        r.mode = 'bolt';
        r.scareT = 1.4 + Math.random() * 1.2;
        r.hideT = 0;
        r.vel.x = nx * (9 + 8 * S * fall);
        r.vel.z = nz * (9 + 8 * S * fall);
        r.vel.y = 2.5 + Math.random() * 1.5;
        r.facing = Math.atan2(nx, nz);
      }
      for (const f of frogs) {
        if (!f.alive || !f.mesh || !f.mesh.visible) continue;
        const dx = f.mesh.position.x - wx;
        const dz = f.mesh.position.z - wz;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (d > R * 0.7) continue;
        // Jump toward stream (water) then hide
        let sx = 0, sz = 0;
        {
          // Approximate stream direction: move to lower distToStream
          const step = 0.8;
          let best = distToStream(f.mesh.position.x, f.mesh.position.z);
          for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
            const a = (k / 8) * Math.PI * 2;
            const tx = f.mesh.position.x + Math.cos(a) * step;
            const tz = f.mesh.position.z + Math.sin(a) * step;
            const dd = distToStream(tx, tz);
            if (dd < best) { best = dd; sx = Math.cos(a); sz = Math.sin(a); }
          }
        }
        if (sx === 0 && sz === 0) {
          sx = dx / (d || 1); sz = dz / (d || 1);
        }
        f.mode = 'flee';
        f.scareT = 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.5;
        f.hideT = 2.5 + Math.random() * 2;
        f.vel.x = sx * (4 + 3 * S);
        f.vel.z = sz * (4 + 3 * S);
        f.vel.y = 3.2 + Math.random() * 1.5;
        f.facing = Math.atan2(sx, sz);
      }
      for (const s of squirrels) {
        if (!s.alive || !s.mesh || !s.mesh.visible) continue;
        const fleeing = s.mode === 'bolt' || s.mode === 'climbing' || s.mode === 'perched' || s.mode === 'descending';
        if (fleeing) continue;
        const dx = s.mesh.position.x - wx;
        const dz = s.mesh.position.z - wz;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (d > R * 0.8) continue;
        const fall = 1 - d / (R * 0.8);
        const nx = dx / (d || 1), nz = dz / (d || 1);
        s.mode = 'bolt';
        s.scareT = 1.6 + Math.random() * 1.4;
        s.vel.x = nx * (8 + 7 * S * fall);
        s.vel.z = nz * (8 + 7 * S * fall);
        s.vel.y = 2 + Math.random() * 1.5;
        s.facing = Math.atan2(nx, nz);
      }
      for (const tu of turtles) {
        if (!tu.alive || !tu.mesh || tu.mode !== 'idle') continue;
        const dx = tu.mesh.position.x - wx;
        const dz = tu.mesh.position.z - wz;
        if (Math.hypot(dx, dz) > R * 0.6) continue;
        tu.mode = 'retracting';
        tu.retractT = 0;
        tu.vel.x = tu.vel.z = 0;
      }
      for (const fi of fishes) {
        if (!fi.alive || !fi.mesh) continue;
        const dx = fi.mesh.position.x - wx;
        const dz = fi.mesh.position.z - wz;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (d > R * 0.6) continue;
        fishFlee(fi, dx, dz, 1 + S * 0.6);
      }
    }

    function updateWildlife(dt) {
      const px = nearestPlayer(0, 0).position.x, pz = nearestPlayer(0, 0).position.z;
      const hideGround = groundCrittersShouldHide();
      const night = !!(typeof isNight !== 'undefined' && isNight);

      // --- Birds ---
      for (let i = birds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const b = birds[i];
        if (!b.alive || !b.mesh) { birds.splice(i, 1); continue; }
        if (b.home && (!b.home.tree || !b.home.tree.alive)) b.home = null; // nest's tree came down
        b.phase += dt;
        const wl = b.mesh.userData.wingL, wr = b.mesh.userData.wingR;
        if (wl && wr) {
          const angry = b.mode === 'scatter' || b.mode === 'attack';
          const targetFreq = angry ? 26 : (b.mode === 'perch' ? 0 : (b.mode === 'toNest' ? 16 : 12));
          const targetAmp = angry ? 0.85 : (b.mode === 'perch' ? 0 : 0.55);
          const a = Math.sin(b.phase * targetFreq) * targetAmp;
          // Eased toward the target rather than snapped, so folding at the nest
          // reads as settling rather than a pop.
          wl.rotation.z += (a - wl.rotation.z) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);
          wr.rotation.z += (-a - wr.rotation.z) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);
        }
        // Player proximity scare (this bird only) — interrupts perch/approach too,
        // but not a bird that's already furious over its nest.
        {
          const dP = Math.hypot(b.mesh.position.x - px, b.mesh.position.z - pz);
          if (dP < WILD_PLAYER_SCARE_R && b.mode !== 'scatter' && b.mode !== 'attack') {
            const dx = b.mesh.position.x - px, dz = b.mesh.position.z - pz;
            const inv = 1 / (dP || 1);
            b.mode = 'scatter';
            b.scareT = 2.0 + Math.random() * 1.5;
            b.vel.x = dx * inv * 8 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
            b.vel.z = dz * inv * 8 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
            b.vel.y = 5 + Math.random() * 3;
          }
        }
        if (b.mode === 'scatter') {
          b.scareT -= dt;
          b.mesh.position.x += b.vel.x * dt;
          b.mesh.position.y += b.vel.y * dt;
          b.mesh.position.z += b.vel.z * dt;
          b.vel.y -= 2.5 * dt;
          b.vel.x *= Math.exp(-0.4 * dt);
          b.vel.z *= Math.exp(-0.4 * dt);
          if (b.scareT <= 0) {
            b.mode = 'cruise';
            b.cx = b.mesh.position.x;
            b.cz = b.mesh.position.z;
            b.orbitAng = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            b.cruiseH = 3.5 + Math.random() * 4;
            b.roostT = 8 + Math.random() * 16;
          }
        } else if (b.mode === 'toNest' && !b.home) {
          // Flying home and its nest is gone (the tree came down while it was away): back to cruising.
          // Claude, 2026-09-29, for Grokbot's page error (nestWorldPos read a null nest).
          b.mode = 'cruise'; b.roostT = 6 + Math.random() * 14;
        } else if (b.mode === 'toNest') {
          const wp = nestWorldPos(b.home, _nestWorldPos);
          const dx = wp.x - b.mesh.position.x;
          const dy = (wp.y + 0.12) - b.mesh.position.y;
          const dz = wp.z - b.mesh.position.z;
          const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);
          const k = Math.min(1, dt * 2.4);
          b.vel.x += (dx * 1.1 - b.vel.x) * k;
          b.vel.y += (dy * 1.1 - b.vel.y) * k;
          b.vel.z += (dz * 1.1 - b.vel.z) * k;
          b.mesh.position.x += b.vel.x * dt;
          b.mesh.position.y += b.vel.y * dt;
          b.mesh.position.z += b.vel.z * dt;
          b.approachT = (b.approachT || 0) + dt;
          const spd = Math.hypot(b.vel.x, b.vel.y, b.vel.z);
          if ((dist < 0.35 && spd < 2.5) || b.approachT > 6) {
            b.mode = 'perch';
            b.perchT = 4 + Math.random() * 8;
            b.vel.x = b.vel.y = b.vel.z = 0;
            b.approachT = 0;
          }
        } else if (b.mode === 'perch') {
          if (!b.home) { b.mode = 'cruise'; b.roostT = 6 + Math.random() * 14; }
          else {
            const wp = nestWorldPos(b.home, _nestWorldPos);
            b.mesh.position.set(wp.x, wp.y + 0.12 + Math.sin(b.phase * 2.4) * 0.008, wp.z);
            b.mesh.rotation.x = Math.sin(b.phase * 1.7) * 0.04;
            b.perchT -= dt;
            if (b.perchT <= 0) {
              b.mode = 'cruise';
              b.cx = wp.x; b.cz = wp.z;
              b.orbitAng = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
              b.cruiseH = 3.5 + Math.random() * 4;
              b.vel.y = 3;
              b.roostT = 10 + Math.random() * 20;
              b.mesh.rotation.x = 0;
            }
          }
          continue; // position is fully authored above; skip the ground clamp below
        } else if (b.mode === 'attack') {
          // Its nest just came down — it has nothing left to lose for a while.
          b.attackT -= dt;
          if (b.attackT <= 0) {
            b.mode = 'cruise';
            b.cx = b.mesh.position.x; b.cz = b.mesh.position.z;
            b.orbitAng = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            b.cruiseH = 3.5 + Math.random() * 4;
          } else {
            const dxh = px - b.mesh.position.x, dzh = pz - b.mesh.position.z;
            const dHoriz = Math.hypot(dxh, dzh);
            if (b.swoopPhase === 'recover') {
              b.recoverT -= dt;
              b.vel.x *= Math.exp(-0.6 * dt);
              b.vel.z *= Math.exp(-0.6 * dt);
              b.vel.y *= Math.exp(-0.8 * dt);
              b.mesh.position.x += b.vel.x * dt;
              b.mesh.position.y += b.vel.y * dt;
              b.mesh.position.z += b.vel.z * dt;
              if (b.recoverT <= 0 || dHoriz > 7) b.swoopPhase = 'dive';
            } else {
              // Dive phase: steer at roughly torso height and swipe on a close pass.
              const targetY = nearestPlayer(0, 0).position.y + 1.1;
              const dx = px - b.mesh.position.x;
              const dy = targetY - b.mesh.position.y;
              const dz = pz - b.mesh.position.z;
              const k = Math.min(1, dt * 3.2);
              b.vel.x += (dx * 1.6 - b.vel.x) * k;
              b.vel.y += (dy * 1.6 - b.vel.y) * k;
              b.vel.z += (dz * 1.6 - b.vel.z) * k;
              b.mesh.position.x += b.vel.x * dt;
              b.mesh.position.y += b.vel.y * dt;
              b.mesh.position.z += b.vel.z * dt;
              b.swoopCd = Math.max(0, (b.swoopCd || 0) - dt);
              if (dHoriz < 1.1 && Math.abs(b.mesh.position.y - targetY) < 1.4 && b.swoopCd <= 0) {
                damagePlayer(1, 'bird');
                spawnChunks(b.mesh.position.x, b.mesh.position.y, b.mesh.position.z, 0x887766, 2, 1.2);
                const away = 1 / (dHoriz || 1);
                b.vel.x = -dx * away * 6 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
                b.vel.z = -dz * away * 6 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
                b.vel.y = 4 + Math.random() * 2;
                b.swoopPhase = 'recover';
                b.recoverT = 1.0 + Math.random() * 0.8;
                b.swoopCd = 1.4;
              }
            }
          }
        } else {
          // Gentle orbit / waypoint wander
          if (b.home) {
            b.roostT -= dt;
            if (b.roostT <= 0) { b.mode = 'toNest'; b.approachT = 0; }
          }
          b.orbitAng += b.orbitSpd * dt;
          const tx = b.cx + Math.cos(b.orbitAng) * b.orbitR;
          const tz = b.cz + Math.sin(b.orbitAng) * b.orbitR;
          const gh = sampleHeight(tx, tz);
          let targetY = gh + b.cruiseH;
          if (weather && weather.intensity > 0.2) targetY = gh + Math.max(2.2, b.cruiseH * 0.55);
          const dx = tx - b.mesh.position.x;
          const dy = targetY - b.mesh.position.y;
          const dz = tz - b.mesh.position.z;
          const k = Math.min(1, dt * 1.8);
          b.vel.x += (dx * 0.9 - b.vel.x) * k;
          b.vel.y += (dy * 0.7 - b.vel.y) * k;
          b.vel.z += (dz * 0.9 - b.vel.z) * k;
          b.mesh.position.x += b.vel.x * dt;
          b.mesh.position.y += b.vel.y * dt;
          b.mesh.position.z += b.vel.z * dt;
        }
        const c = clampToLand(b.mesh.position.x, b.mesh.position.z, 2);
        b.mesh.position.x = c.x; b.mesh.position.z = c.z;
        const gh2 = sampleHeight(b.mesh.position.x, b.mesh.position.z);
        if (b.mesh.position.y < gh2 + 1.2) {
          b.mesh.position.y = gh2 + 1.2;
          b.vel.y = Math.max(0, b.vel.y);
        }
        const spd = Math.hypot(b.vel.x, b.vel.z);
        if (spd > 0.2) b.mesh.rotation.y = Math.atan2(b.vel.x, b.vel.z);
      }

      // --- Rabbits ---
      for (let i = rabbits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const r = rabbits[i];
        if (!r.alive || !r.mesh) { rabbits.splice(i, 1); continue; }
        if (hideGround) {
          if (r.mesh.visible) {
            r.mesh.visible = false;
            r.hiddenForRain = true;
            r.vel.x = r.vel.y = r.vel.z = 0;
          }
          continue;
        }
        if (r.hiddenForRain) {
          r.hiddenForRain = false;
          r.mesh.visible = true;
          r.mode = 'idle';
          r.hopCd = 0.5 + Math.random();
        }
        {
          const dP = Math.hypot(r.mesh.position.x - px, r.mesh.position.z - pz);
          const fleeing = r.mode === 'bolt' || r.mode === 'toburrow' || r.mode === 'entering' || r.mode === 'hidden';
          if (dP < WILD_PLAYER_SCARE_R * 0.7 && !fleeing && r.mode !== 'hide') {
            const dx = r.mesh.position.x - px, dz = r.mesh.position.z - pz;
            const inv = 1 / (dP || 1);
            r.mode = 'bolt';
            r.scareT = 1.4 + Math.random();
            r.vel.x = dx * inv * 10;
            r.vel.z = dz * inv * 10;
            r.vel.y = 2.5 + Math.random();
            r.facing = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
          }
        }
        r.phase += dt;
        // Ear twitch — idle little-tell, paused while bolting/underground.
        r.earT -= dt;
        if (r.earT <= 0 && r.mode !== 'bolt' && r.mode !== 'hidden' && r.mode !== 'entering') {
          r.earT = 1.5 + Math.random() * 2.5;
          r.earFlick = 1;
        }
        if (r.earFlick > 0) r.earFlick = Math.max(0, r.earFlick - dt * 3.2);
        const earL = r.mesh.userData.earL, earR = r.mesh.userData.earR;
        if (earL && earR) {
          const tw = Math.sin(r.earFlick * Math.PI) * 0.4;
          earL.rotation.x = -tw;
          earR.rotation.x = -tw * 0.8;
        }
        // Hop squash/stretch — decays toward neutral every frame; the branches
        // below give it a kick (positive = airborne stretch, negative = squash).
        r.squash *= Math.max(0, 1 - dt * 7);
        {
          const base = r.mesh.userData.baseScale || 1;
          const sy = base * (1 + r.squash);
          const sxz = base * (1 - r.squash * 0.4);
          r.mesh.scale.set(sxz, sy, sxz);
        }
        if (r.mode === 'bolt') {
          r.scareT -= dt;
          // Bend the flight path toward home rather than snapping onto it — reads
          // as heading for cover, not as a scripted teleport.
          if (r.home) {
            const hx = r.home.mouthX - r.mesh.position.x;
            const hz = r.home.mouthZ - r.mesh.position.z;
            const hd = Math.hypot(hx, hz) || 1;
            r.vel.x += (hx / hd) * 6 * dt;
            r.vel.z += (hz / hd) * 6 * dt;
          }
          r.mesh.position.x += r.vel.x * dt;
          r.mesh.position.z += r.vel.z * dt;
          r.mesh.position.y += r.vel.y * dt;
          r.vel.y -= 14 * dt;
          const gh = sampleHeight(r.mesh.position.x, r.mesh.position.z);
          if (r.mesh.position.y <= gh + 0.12) {
            r.mesh.position.y = gh + 0.12;
            r.vel.y = 2.2 + Math.random();
            r.vel.x *= 0.92; r.vel.z *= 0.92;
          }
          if (r.scareT <= 0) {
            if (r.home) { r.mode = 'toburrow'; r.burrowT = 0; }
            else {
              r.mode = 'hide';
              r.hideT = 1.5 + Math.random() * 1.5;
              r.vel.x = r.vel.y = r.vel.z = 0;
              r.mesh.visible = false;
            }
          }
        } else if (r.mode === 'toburrow') {
          r.burrowT += dt;
          const hx = r.home.mouthX - r.mesh.position.x;
          const hz = r.home.mouthZ - r.mesh.position.z;
          const hd = Math.hypot(hx, hz);
          const ang = Math.atan2(hx, hz);
          r.facing = ang;
          r.vel.x = Math.sin(ang) * 4.5;
          r.vel.z = Math.cos(ang) * 4.5;
          r.mesh.position.x += r.vel.x * dt;
          r.mesh.position.z += r.vel.z * dt;
          const gh = sampleHeight(r.mesh.position.x, r.mesh.position.z);
          r.mesh.position.y += (gh + 0.12 - r.mesh.position.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 8);
          if (r.burrowT > 5 && hd >= 0.4) {
            // Could not get there (a wall in the way): go to ground where it stands
            // rather than popping out of the burrow on the far side of the wall.
            r.mode = 'hide';
            r.hideT = 1.5 + Math.random() * 1.5;
            r.vel.x = r.vel.y = r.vel.z = 0;
            r.mesh.visible = false;
          } else if (hd < 0.4) {
            r.mode = 'entering';
            r.burrowT = 0;
            r.vel.x = r.vel.y = r.vel.z = 0;
          }
        } else if (r.mode === 'entering') {
          r.burrowT += dt;
          const t = Math.min(1, r.burrowT / 0.22);
          r.squash = -t * 0.7;
          if (t >= 1) {
            r.mode = 'hidden';
            r.hideT = 2 + Math.random() * 2.5;
            r.mesh.visible = false;
            r.mesh.position.x = r.home.mouthX;
            r.mesh.position.z = r.home.mouthZ;
            r.mesh.position.y = sampleHeight(r.home.mouthX, r.home.mouthZ) + 0.12;
            r.squash = 0;
          }
          continue;
        } else if (r.mode === 'hidden') {
          r.hideT -= dt;
          if (r.hideT <= 0) {
            r.mode = 'exiting';
            r.burrowT = 0;
            r.mesh.visible = true;
            r.squash = -0.5;
          }
          continue;
        } else if (r.mode === 'exiting') {
          r.burrowT += dt;
          const t = Math.min(1, r.burrowT / 0.22);
          r.squash = -0.5 * (1 - t);
          if (t >= 1) {
            r.mode = 'idle';
            r.hopCd = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.8;
          }
        } else if (r.mode === 'hide') {
          // Legacy fallback for a world with no burrows: hide in place.
          r.hideT -= dt;
          if (r.hideT <= 0) {
            r.mode = 'idle';
            r.mesh.visible = true;
            r.hopCd = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.8;
          }
          continue;
        } else {
          r.hopCd -= dt;
          if (r.hopCd <= 0) {
            let ang = r.facing + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4;
            if (r.home) {
              const hx = r.home.x - r.mesh.position.x, hz = r.home.z - r.mesh.position.z;
              if (Math.hypot(hx, hz) > 12) {
                // Strayed too far from the den — bias the next hop homeward
                // rather than snapping the leash taut.
                ang = Math.atan2(hx, hz) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.0;
              }
            }
            r.facing = ang;
            r.vel.x = Math.sin(ang) * (2.2 + Math.random() * 1.5);
            r.vel.z = Math.cos(ang) * (2.2 + Math.random() * 1.5);
            r.vel.y = 2.4 + Math.random() * 1.2;
            r.hopCd = 0.7 + Math.random() * 1.6;
            r.squash = 0.35;
          }
          r.mesh.position.x += r.vel.x * dt;
          r.mesh.position.z += r.vel.z * dt;
          r.mesh.position.y += r.vel.y * dt;
          r.vel.y -= 16 * dt;
          r.vel.x *= Math.exp(-2.5 * dt);
          r.vel.z *= Math.exp(-2.5 * dt);
        }
        // Prefer staying off deep water
        if (distToStream(r.mesh.position.x, r.mesh.position.z) < STREAM_WIDTH * 1.05) {
          const away = Math.atan2(r.mesh.position.x, r.mesh.position.z); // crude
          r.mesh.position.x += Math.sin(away) * 0.4;
          r.mesh.position.z += Math.cos(away) * 0.4;
        }
        const c = clampToLand(r.mesh.position.x, r.mesh.position.z, 2);
        r.mesh.position.x = c.x; r.mesh.position.z = c.z;
        // Your walls stop rabbits like they stop everything else: they hop along the
        // outside of a compound instead of straight through it into the middle.
        if (builds.length) {
          const pb = resolveHardBuildCollisions(r.mesh.position.x, r.mesh.position.z, 0.18, false, r.mesh.position.y);
          if (pb.x !== r.mesh.position.x || pb.z !== r.mesh.position.z) {
            r.mesh.position.x = pb.x; r.mesh.position.z = pb.z;
            r.vel.x *= -0.3; r.vel.z *= -0.3;
          }
        }
        const gh = sampleHeight(r.mesh.position.x, r.mesh.position.z);
        if (r.mesh.position.y < gh + 0.12) {
          r.mesh.position.y = gh + 0.12;
          r.vel.y = 0;
        }
        r.mesh.rotation.y = r.facing;
      }

      // --- Frogs ---
      for (let i = frogs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const f = frogs[i];
        if (!f.alive || !f.mesh) { frogs.splice(i, 1); continue; }
        if (hideGround) {
          if (f.mesh.visible) {
            f.mesh.visible = false;
            f.hiddenForRain = true;
            f.vel.x = f.vel.y = f.vel.z = 0;
          }
          continue;
        }
        if (f.hiddenForRain) {
          f.hiddenForRain = false;
          f.mode = night || !f.dayQuiet ? 'sit' : 'dayhide';
          f.mesh.visible = f.mode !== 'dayhide';
          f.hopCd = 0.5 + Math.random();
        }
        const submerged = f.mode === 'diving' || f.mode === 'hidden' || f.mode === 'surfacing';
        // Day: quieter / often hidden; night: active
        if (!night && f.dayQuiet && f.mode !== 'flee' && f.mode !== 'hide' && !submerged) {
          f.mode = 'dayhide';
          f.mesh.visible = false;
          continue;
        }
        if (night && f.mode === 'dayhide') {
          f.mode = 'sit';
          f.mesh.visible = true;
          f.hopCd = 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.6;
        }
        f.phase += dt;
        // Blink and croak — paused while submerged, day-hidden, or mid-flee; a frog
        // that's already gone quiet shouldn't keep ticking these underwater.
        if (f.mesh.visible) {
          f.blinkT -= dt;
          if (f.blinkT <= 0) { f.blinkT = 2 + Math.random() * 4; f.blink = 1; }
          if (f.blink > 0) f.blink = Math.max(0, f.blink - dt * 8);
          const eyeL = f.mesh.userData.eyeL, eyeR = f.mesh.userData.eyeR;
          if (eyeL && eyeR) {
            const shut = 1 - Math.min(1, f.blink * 2);
            eyeL.scale.y = eyeR.scale.y = Math.max(0.08, shut);
          }
          const idleCall = f.mode === 'sit' || f.mode === 'hop';
          if (idleCall && night) {
            f.croakT -= dt;
            if (f.croakT <= 0 && f.croakBurstT <= 0) {
              f.croakBurstT = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5;
              f.croakT = 2.5 + Math.random() * 5;
            }
          }
          const throat = f.mesh.userData.throat;
          if (throat) {
            if (f.croakBurstT > 0) {
              f.croakBurstT = Math.max(0, f.croakBurstT - dt);
              const pulse = Math.max(0, Math.sin(f.phase * 13));
              throat.scale.y = 0.6 + pulse * 0.9;
              throat.scale.x = throat.scale.z = 0.85 + pulse * 0.35;
            } else {
              throat.scale.y += (0.6 - throat.scale.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);
              throat.scale.x = throat.scale.z = 1;
            }
          }
        }
        // Hop squash/stretch — same decay-and-kick shape the rabbits use.
        f.squash *= Math.max(0, 1 - dt * 8);
        {
          const base = f.mesh.userData.baseScale || 1;
          const sy = base * (1 + f.squash);
          const sxz = base * (1 - f.squash * 0.35);
          f.mesh.scale.set(sxz, sy, sxz);
        }
        {
          const dP = Math.hypot(f.mesh.position.x - px, f.mesh.position.z - pz);
          if (dP < 5 && f.mesh.visible && f.mode !== 'flee' && f.mode !== 'hide' && !submerged) {
            // Leap toward its home lily pad if it has one, else toward the nearest water.
            let sx = 0, sz = 0;
            if (f.home) {
              const hx = f.home.x - f.mesh.position.x, hz = f.home.z - f.mesh.position.z;
              const hd = Math.hypot(hx, hz) || 1;
              sx = hx / hd; sz = hz / hd;
            } else {
              let best = distToStream(f.mesh.position.x, f.mesh.position.z);
              for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
                const a = (k / 8) * Math.PI * 2;
                const dd = distToStream(f.mesh.position.x + Math.cos(a) * 0.8, f.mesh.position.z + Math.sin(a) * 0.8);
                if (dd < best) { best = dd; sx = Math.cos(a); sz = Math.sin(a); }
              }
              if (!sx && !sz) { sx = (f.mesh.position.x - px) / (dP || 1); sz = (f.mesh.position.z - pz) / (dP || 1); }
            }
            f.mode = 'flee';
            f.scareT = 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.4;
            f.hideT = 2.2 + Math.random() * 1.5;
            f.vel.x = sx * 5; f.vel.z = sz * 5; f.vel.y = 3.2;
            f.facing = Math.atan2(sx, sz);
          }
        }
        if (f.mode === 'flee') {
          f.scareT -= dt;
          // Bend the leap toward home mid-air — the same trick the rabbits use
          // heading for their burrow.
          if (f.home) {
            const hx = f.home.x - f.mesh.position.x, hz = f.home.z - f.mesh.position.z;
            const hd = Math.hypot(hx, hz) || 1;
            f.vel.x += (hx / hd) * 5 * dt;
            f.vel.z += (hz / hd) * 5 * dt;
          }
          f.mesh.position.x += f.vel.x * dt;
          f.mesh.position.z += f.vel.z * dt;
          f.mesh.position.y += f.vel.y * dt;
          f.vel.y -= 18 * dt;
          const gh = sampleHeight(f.mesh.position.x, f.mesh.position.z);
          if (f.mesh.position.y <= gh + 0.05) {
            f.mesh.position.y = gh + 0.05;
            f.vel.y = 0;
          }
          if (f.scareT <= 0) {
            if (f.home) {
              f.mode = 'diving';
              f.diveT = 0;
              f.vel.x = f.vel.y = f.vel.z = 0;
            } else {
              f.mode = 'hide';
              f.mesh.visible = false;
              f.vel.x = f.vel.y = f.vel.z = 0;
            }
          }
        } else if (f.mode === 'diving') {
          // A quick squash-down slide onto the pad, then under.
          f.diveT += dt;
          const t = Math.min(1, f.diveT / 0.2);
          f.squash = -t * 0.75;
          f.mesh.position.x += (f.home.x - f.mesh.position.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 10);
          f.mesh.position.z += (f.home.z - f.mesh.position.z) * Math.min(1, dt * 10);
          if (t >= 1) {
            f.mode = 'hidden';
            f.hideT = 2.2 + Math.random() * 1.5;
            f.mesh.visible = false;
            f.mesh.position.x = f.home.x;
            f.mesh.position.z = f.home.z;
            f.mesh.position.y = f.home.y - 0.15;
            f.squash = 0;
            spawnSplash(f.home.x, f.home.y, f.home.z, 5, 0.6);
            spawnRipple(f.home.x, f.home.y + 0.01, f.home.z, 0.5, 1.1);
          }
          continue;
        } else if (f.mode === 'hidden') {
          f.hideT -= dt;
          if (f.hideT <= 0) {
            f.mode = 'surfacing';
            f.diveT = 0;
            f.mesh.visible = true;
            f.squash = -0.5;
            f.mesh.position.x = f.home.x;
            f.mesh.position.z = f.home.z;
            f.mesh.position.y = f.home.y;
            spawnSplash(f.home.x, f.home.y, f.home.z, 5, 0.6);
            spawnRipple(f.home.x, f.home.y + 0.01, f.home.z, 0.5, 1.1);
          }
          continue;
        } else if (f.mode === 'surfacing') {
          f.diveT += dt;
          const t = Math.min(1, f.diveT / 0.2);
          f.squash = -0.5 * (1 - t);
          if (t >= 1) {
            f.mode = 'sit';
            f.hopCd = 0.8 + Math.random();
          }
        } else if (f.mode === 'hide') {
          // Legacy fallback for a frog with no lily pad: hide in place.
          f.hideT -= dt;
          if (f.hideT <= 0) {
            f.mode = 'sit';
            f.mesh.visible = true;
            f.hopCd = 0.8 + Math.random();
          }
          continue;
        } else if (f.mode === 'dayhide') {
          continue;
        } else {
          // sit / hop along bank
          const hopMul = night ? 1.0 : 0.35;
          f.hopCd -= dt * (night ? 1.4 : 0.6);
          if (f.hopCd <= 0) {
            // Prefer staying in stream band
            let ang = f.facing + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.2;
            const d0 = distToStream(f.mesh.position.x, f.mesh.position.z);
            const mid = STREAM_WIDTH * 2;
            if (d0 < STREAM_WIDTH * 1.1 || d0 > STREAM_WIDTH * 2.8) {
              let bestA = ang, bestScore = 1e9;
              for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
                const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const tx = f.mesh.position.x + Math.sin(a) * 1.2;
                const tz = f.mesh.position.z + Math.cos(a) * 1.2;
                const score = Math.abs(distToStream(tx, tz) - mid);
                if (score < bestScore) { bestScore = score; bestA = a; }
              }
              ang = bestA;
            }
            if (f.home) {
              const hx = f.home.x - f.mesh.position.x, hz = f.home.z - f.mesh.position.z;
              if (Math.hypot(hx, hz) > 10) {
                // Strayed too far from its lily pad — bias the next hop homeward.
                ang = Math.atan2(hx, hz) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.0;
              }
            }
            f.facing = ang;
            const spd = (1.6 + Math.random() * 1.4) * hopMul * (night ? 1.3 : 1);
            f.vel.x = Math.sin(ang) * spd;
            f.vel.z = Math.cos(ang) * spd;
            f.vel.y = (2.0 + Math.random() * 1.4) * (night ? 1.15 : 0.85);
            f.hopCd = (night ? 0.45 : 1.4) + Math.random() * (night ? 1.1 : 2.5);
            f.mode = 'hop';
            f.squash = 0.3;
          }
          f.mesh.position.x += f.vel.x * dt;
          f.mesh.position.z += f.vel.z * dt;
          f.mesh.position.y += f.vel.y * dt;
          f.vel.y -= 20 * dt;
          f.vel.x *= Math.exp(-3 * dt);
          f.vel.z *= Math.exp(-3 * dt);
          const gh = sampleHeight(f.mesh.position.x, f.mesh.position.z);
          if (f.mesh.position.y <= gh + 0.05) {
            f.mesh.position.y = gh + 0.05;
            f.vel.y = 0;
            if (f.mode === 'hop' && Math.hypot(f.vel.x, f.vel.z) < 0.3) f.mode = 'sit';
          }
        }
        const c = clampToLand(f.mesh.position.x, f.mesh.position.z, 1.5);
        f.mesh.position.x = c.x; f.mesh.position.z = c.z;
        f.mesh.rotation.y = f.facing;
        // Tiny bob when sitting
        if (f.mode === 'sit') {
          const gh = sampleHeight(f.mesh.position.x, f.mesh.position.z);
          f.mesh.position.y = gh + 0.05 + Math.sin(f.phase * 3) * 0.01;
        }
      }

      // --- Squirrels ---
      for (let i = squirrels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const s = squirrels[i];
        if (!s.alive || !s.mesh) { squirrels.splice(i, 1); continue; }
        if (hideGround) {
          if (s.mesh.visible) {
            s.mesh.visible = false;
            s.hiddenForRain = true;
            s.vel.x = s.vel.y = s.vel.z = 0;
          }
          continue;
        }
        if (s.hiddenForRain) {
          s.hiddenForRain = false;
          s.mesh.visible = true;
          s.mode = 'idle';
          s.hopCd = 0.5 + Math.random();
        }
        // Home tree gone: however far up it the squirrel got, it comes straight
        // back down to the ground rather than being left stranded mid-air.
        if (s.home && (!s.home.alive || s.home.falling)) {
          s.home = null;
          if (s.mode === 'climbing' || s.mode === 'perched' || s.mode === 'descending') {
            const gh = sampleHeight(s.mesh.position.x, s.mesh.position.z);
            s.mesh.position.y = gh + 0.09;
            s.mode = 'idle';
            s.hopCd = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.6;
          }
        }
        s.phase += dt;
        // Tail flick — idle tell, paused while climbing/fleeing.
        s.tailFlickT -= dt;
        if (s.tailFlickT <= 0 && s.mode !== 'bolt' && s.mode !== 'climbing') {
          s.tailFlickT = 1.5 + Math.random() * 2.5;
          s.tailFlick = 1;
        }
        if (s.tailFlick > 0) s.tailFlick = Math.max(0, s.tailFlick - dt * 3);
        const tail = s.mesh.userData.tail;
        if (tail) tail.rotation.x = -Math.sin(s.tailFlick * Math.PI) * 0.5;
        // Hop squash/stretch — same shape as the rabbits.
        s.squash *= Math.max(0, 1 - dt * 7);
        {
          const base = s.mesh.userData.baseScale || 1;
          const sy = base * (1 + s.squash);
          const sxz = base * (1 - s.squash * 0.4);
          s.mesh.scale.set(sxz, sy, sxz);
        }
        const fleeing = s.mode === 'bolt' || s.mode === 'climbing' || s.mode === 'perched' || s.mode === 'descending';
        if (!fleeing) {
          const dP = Math.hypot(s.mesh.position.x - px, s.mesh.position.z - pz);
          if (dP < WILD_PLAYER_SCARE_R * 0.75) {
            const dx = s.mesh.position.x - px, dz = s.mesh.position.z - pz;
            const inv = 1 / (dP || 1);
            s.mode = 'bolt';
            s.scareT = 1.6 + Math.random() * 1.4;
            s.vel.x = dx * inv * 9;
            s.vel.z = dz * inv * 9;
            s.vel.y = 2 + Math.random();
            s.facing = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
          }
        }
        if (s.mode === 'bolt') {
          s.scareT -= dt;
          // Bend the sprint toward home, same trick the rabbits use for their burrow.
          if (s.home) {
            const hx = s.home.x - s.mesh.position.x, hz = s.home.z - s.mesh.position.z;
            const hd = Math.hypot(hx, hz) || 1;
            s.vel.x += (hx / hd) * 7 * dt;
            s.vel.z += (hz / hd) * 7 * dt;
          }
          s.mesh.position.x += s.vel.x * dt;
          s.mesh.position.z += s.vel.z * dt;
          s.mesh.position.y += s.vel.y * dt;
          s.vel.y -= 15 * dt;
          const gh = sampleHeight(s.mesh.position.x, s.mesh.position.z);
          if (s.mesh.position.y <= gh + 0.09) {
            s.mesh.position.y = gh + 0.09;
            s.vel.y = 2 + Math.random();
            s.vel.x *= 0.9; s.vel.z *= 0.9;
          }
          if (s.home) {
            const hx = s.home.x - s.mesh.position.x, hz = s.home.z - s.mesh.position.z;
            if (Math.hypot(hx, hz) < 0.5 || s.scareT <= 0) {
              s.mode = 'climbing';
              s.climbH = 0;
              s.climbTarget = (s.home.canopyBottom || 2) * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.3);
              s.vel.x = s.vel.y = s.vel.z = 0;
            }
          } else if (s.scareT <= 0) {
            s.mode = 'idle';
            s.hopCd = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.6;
          }
        } else if (s.mode === 'climbing') {
          s.climbH += dt * (s.climbTarget / 0.45 || 3);
          if (s.climbH >= s.climbTarget) {
            s.climbH = s.climbTarget;
            s.mode = 'perched';
            s.perchT = 3 + Math.random() * 5;
          }
          const p = squirrelTrunkPos(s);
          s.mesh.position.set(p.x, p.y, p.z);
          s.mesh.rotation.y = s.climbAngle + s.home.group.rotation.y;
          continue;
        } else if (s.mode === 'perched') {
          s.perchT -= dt;
          const p = squirrelTrunkPos(s);
          s.mesh.position.set(p.x, p.y + Math.sin(s.phase * 2) * 0.006, p.z);
          s.mesh.rotation.y = s.climbAngle + s.home.group.rotation.y;
          if (s.perchT <= 0) s.mode = 'descending';
          continue;
        } else if (s.mode === 'descending') {
          s.climbH -= dt * (s.climbTarget / 0.4 || 3);
          if (s.climbH <= 0) {
            s.climbH = 0;
            s.mode = 'idle';
            s.hopCd = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.8;
            const bx = s.home.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.2, bz = s.home.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.2;
            const gh = sampleHeight(bx, bz);
            s.mesh.position.set(bx, gh + 0.09, bz);
          } else {
            const p = squirrelTrunkPos(s);
            s.mesh.position.set(p.x, p.y, p.z);
            s.mesh.rotation.y = s.climbAngle + s.home.group.rotation.y;
            continue;
          }
        } else {
          // Idle hop-forage, leashed to its home tree when it has one.
          s.hopCd -= dt;
          if (s.hopCd <= 0) {
            let ang = s.facing + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4;
            if (s.home) {
              const hx = s.home.x - s.mesh.position.x, hz = s.home.z - s.mesh.position.z;
              if (Math.hypot(hx, hz) > 10) ang = Math.atan2(hx, hz) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.0;
            }
            s.facing = ang;
            s.vel.x = Math.sin(ang) * (2 + Math.random() * 1.3);
            s.vel.z = Math.cos(ang) * (2 + Math.random() * 1.3);
            s.vel.y = 2 + Math.random();
            s.hopCd = 0.6 + Math.random() * 1.4;
            s.squash = 0.3;
          }
          s.mesh.position.x += s.vel.x * dt;
          s.mesh.position.z += s.vel.z * dt;
          s.mesh.position.y += s.vel.y * dt;
          s.vel.y -= 15 * dt;
          s.vel.x *= Math.exp(-2.5 * dt);
          s.vel.z *= Math.exp(-2.5 * dt);
        }
        if (distToStream(s.mesh.position.x, s.mesh.position.z) < STREAM_WIDTH * 1.05) {
          const away = Math.atan2(s.mesh.position.x, s.mesh.position.z);
          s.mesh.position.x += Math.sin(away) * 0.4;
          s.mesh.position.z += Math.cos(away) * 0.4;
        }
        const cs = clampToLand(s.mesh.position.x, s.mesh.position.z, 2);
        s.mesh.position.x = cs.x; s.mesh.position.z = cs.z;
        const ghs = sampleHeight(s.mesh.position.x, s.mesh.position.z);
        if (s.mesh.position.y < ghs + 0.09) {
          s.mesh.position.y = ghs + 0.09;
          s.vel.y = 0;
        }
        s.mesh.rotation.y = s.facing;
      }

      // --- Turtles ---
      for (let i = turtles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const tu = turtles[i];
        if (!tu.alive || !tu.mesh) { turtles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
        tu.phase += dt;
        const head = tu.mesh.userData.head, neck = tu.mesh.userData.neck, legs = tu.mesh.userData.legs;
        if (tu.mode === 'idle') {
          const dP = Math.hypot(tu.mesh.position.x - px, tu.mesh.position.z - pz);
          if (dP < WILD_PLAYER_SCARE_R * 0.55) {
            // Too slow to run — it just pulls everything in and waits you out.
            tu.mode = 'retracting';
            tu.retractT = 0;
            tu.vel.x = tu.vel.z = 0;
          } else {
            tu.moveCd -= dt;
            if (tu.moveCd <= 0) {
              let ang = tu.facing + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.6;
              const hx = tu.anchorX - tu.mesh.position.x, hz = tu.anchorZ - tu.mesh.position.z;
              if (Math.hypot(hx, hz) > 6) ang = Math.atan2(hx, hz) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8;
              tu.facing = ang;
              tu.vel.x = Math.sin(ang) * 0.35;
              tu.vel.z = Math.cos(ang) * 0.35;
              tu.moveCd = 2 + Math.random() * 3;
            }
            tu.mesh.position.x += tu.vel.x * dt;
            tu.mesh.position.z += tu.vel.z * dt;
            tu.mesh.rotation.y = tu.facing;
          }
        } else if (tu.mode === 'retracting') {
          tu.retractT += dt;
          const t = Math.min(1, tu.retractT / 0.18);
          const sc = Math.max(0.05, 1 - t);
          if (head) head.scale.setScalar(sc);
          if (neck) neck.scale.setScalar(sc);
          if (legs) for (const l of legs) {
            const b = l.userData.baseScale || { x: 1, y: 1, z: 1 };
            l.scale.set(b.x * sc, b.y * sc, b.z * sc);
          }
          if (t >= 1) {
            if (head) head.visible = false;
            if (neck) neck.visible = false;
            if (legs) for (const l of legs) l.visible = false;
            tu.mode = 'retracted';
            tu.retractT = 2 + Math.random() * 2.5;
          }
        } else if (tu.mode === 'retracted') {
          tu.retractT -= dt;
          if (tu.retractT <= 0) {
            if (head) head.visible = true;
            if (neck) neck.visible = true;
            if (legs) for (const l of legs) l.visible = true;
            tu.mode = 'emerging';
            tu.retractT = 0;
          }
        } else if (tu.mode === 'emerging') {
          tu.retractT += dt;
          const t = Math.min(1, tu.retractT / 0.18);
          if (head) head.scale.setScalar(t);
          if (neck) neck.scale.setScalar(t);
          if (legs) for (const l of legs) {
            const b = l.userData.baseScale || { x: 1, y: 1, z: 1 };
            l.scale.set(b.x * t, b.y * t, b.z * t);
          }
          if (t >= 1) tu.mode = 'idle';
        }
        const ct = clampToLand(tu.mesh.position.x, tu.mesh.position.z, 1.5);
        tu.mesh.position.x = ct.x; tu.mesh.position.z = ct.z;
        const ght = sampleHeight(tu.mesh.position.x, tu.mesh.position.z);
        tu.mesh.position.y = ght + 0.04 + Math.sin(tu.phase * 1.2) * 0.005;
      }

      // --- Fish ---
      updateFish(dt, px, pz);
    }

    // A fish bolts: a burst of speed straight away from the fright, turning fast, then
    // slows and drifts back to its school.
    function fishFlee(fi, dx, dz, strength = 1) {
      fi.mode = 'flee';
      fi.scareT = 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.7;
      fi.heading = Math.atan2(dx, dz) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6;
      fi.speed = Math.max(fi.speed, 3.2 * strength);
      fi.riseT = 0;
    }
    const _fishProbe = (x, z, h, d) => fishDepthAt(x + Math.sin(h) * d, z + Math.cos(h) * d);
    function updateFish(dt, px, pz) {
      // Schools: each middle wanders about its home water.
      for (const sc of fishSchools) {
        sc.members = sc.members.filter((f) => f.alive && f.mesh);
        if (!sc.members.length) continue;
        let mx = 0, mz = 0;
        for (const f of sc.members) { mx += f.mesh.position.x; mz += f.mesh.position.z; }
        sc.x = mx / sc.members.length; sc.z = mz / sc.members.length;
        sc.retarget -= dt;
        if (sc.retarget <= 0 || Math.hypot(sc.tx - sc.x, sc.tz - sc.z) < 1.5) {
          sc.retarget = 8 + Math.random() * 14;
          for (let t = 0; t < 12; t++) {
            const r = sc.habitat === 'lake' ? 6 + Math.random() * 14 : 3 + Math.random() * 7;
            const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            const x = sc.x + Math.cos(a) * r, z = sc.z + Math.sin(a) * r;
            if (fishDepthAt(x, z) > (sc.habitat === 'lake' ? 0.9 : 0.55) && (sc.habitat !== 'lake' || waterCurrentAt(x, z) < 0.05)) { sc.tx = x; sc.tz = z; break; }
          }
        }
      }
      for (let i = fishes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const fi = fishes[i];
        if (!fi.alive || !fi.mesh) { fishes.splice(i, 1); continue; }
        const P = fi.mesh.position;
        const sc = fi.school;
        fi.phase += dt;
        // Something big on the bank or in the water close by: bolt.
        const dPf = Math.hypot(P.x - px, P.z - pz);
        if (fi.mode !== 'flee' && dPf < 5.5) fishFlee(fi, P.x - px, P.z - pz, 1);
        // The current where it is (river fish swim against it to hold their place).
        let cx = 0, cz = 0;
        const cur = waterCurrentAt(P.x, P.z);
        if (cur > 0.02) { const rp = riverProject(P.x, P.z); const [fx, fz] = riverFlowDir(rp.s); cx = fx * cur; cz = fz * cur; }
        let want = fi.heading, spd = fi.speed, turnRate = 2.2;
        if (fi.mode === 'flee') {
          fi.scareT -= dt;
          turnRate = 7;
          spd = Math.max(0.8, fi.speed - dt * 2.2);
          if (fi.scareT <= 0) fi.mode = 'swim';
        } else if (sc) {
          // Keep with the school, don't crowd, and follow its drift.
          let ax = 0, az = 0, sx = 0, sz = 0, hx = 0, hz = 0, n = 0;
          for (const o of sc.members) {
            if (o === fi || !o.mesh) continue;
            const dx = o.mesh.position.x - P.x, dz = o.mesh.position.z - P.z, d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
            if (d < 0.55) { sx -= dx / (d || 1) * (0.55 - d) * 3; sz -= dz / (d || 1) * (0.55 - d) * 3; }
            hx += Math.sin(o.heading); hz += Math.cos(o.heading); n++;
          }
          ax = (sc.x - P.x) * 0.35 + (sc.tx - P.x) * 0.12; az = (sc.z - P.z) * 0.35 + (sc.tz - P.z) * 0.12;
          let dx = ax + sx + hx * 0.25, dz = az + sz + hz * 0.25;
          if (sc.habitat === 'river' && cur > 0.1) {
            // Holding in the run: nose into the current and swim just hard enough to
            // stay put, edging about its lie.
            dx = -cx * 2 + dx * 0.4; dz = -cz * 2 + dz * 0.4;
            spd = cur * (0.95 + Math.sin(fi.phase * 0.7) * 0.12) + 0.08;
          } else {
            // Cruising: slow, with the odd lazy burst.
            fi.burstT -= dt;
            if (fi.burstT <= 0) fi.burstT = 3 + Math.random() * 6;
            spd = 0.35 + 0.25 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(fi.phase * 0.9 + i)) + (fi.burstT < 0.5 ? 0.9 : 0);
          }
          want = Math.atan2(dx, dz) + Math.sin(fi.phase * 0.6 + i * 1.7) * 0.35;
        }
        // Never into the shallows: feel ahead, and turn toward whichever side is deeper.
        const ahead = 0.9 + spd * 0.6;
        if (_fishProbe(P.x, P.z, want, ahead) < 0.4) {
          const l = _fishProbe(P.x, P.z, want + 0.9, ahead), r = _fishProbe(P.x, P.z, want - 0.9, ahead);
          want = l > r ? want + 1.1 : want - 1.1;
          if (Math.max(l, r) < 0.4) want += Math.PI * 0.8;
          turnRate = Math.max(turnRate, 5);
        }
        // Turn at a fish's rate, not instantly.
        let dh = Math.atan2(Math.sin(want - fi.heading), Math.cos(want - fi.heading));
        const maxT = turnRate * dt;
        dh = Math.max(-maxT, Math.min(maxT, dh));
        fi.heading += dh;
        fi.speed += (spd - fi.speed) * Math.min(1, dt * 2.5);
        fi.vel.x = Math.sin(fi.heading) * fi.speed + cx;
        fi.vel.z = Math.cos(fi.heading) * fi.speed + cz;
        const nx = P.x + fi.vel.x * dt, nz = P.z + fi.vel.z * dt;
        // Only ever into water deep enough to swim in.
        if (fishDepthAt(nx, nz) > 0.28) { P.x = nx; P.z = nz; }
        else fi.heading += Math.PI * 0.5 * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1);
        // Height in the water: somewhere in the middle of the column, drifting, never
        // at the surface unless rising to take something.
        const wl = waterLevelAt(P.x, P.z);
        const bed = sampleHeight(P.x, P.z);
        if (wl !== null) {
          fi.depthT -= dt;
          if (fi.depthT <= 0) { fi.depthT = 3 + Math.random() * 5; fi.depthFrac = 0.25 + Math.random() * 0.5; }
          let ty = bed + (wl - bed) * fi.depthFrac;
          ty = Math.min(ty, wl - 0.2); ty = Math.max(ty, bed + 0.12);
          // Rising: up to take a fly off the surface, a ring on the water, back down.
          fi.riseCd -= dt;
          if (fi.mode === 'swim' && fi.riseCd <= 0 && fi.riseT <= 0 && fi.leapT <= 0 && sc && sc.habitat === 'lake') {
            if (Math.random() < 0.12 && wl - bed > 1.0) { fi.leapT = 0.01; fi.leapVy = 2.6 + Math.random() * 0.8; }
            else fi.riseT = 1.6;
            fi.riseCd = 18 + Math.random() * 35;
          }
          if (fi.riseT > 0) {
            fi.riseT -= dt;
            ty = wl - 0.05;
            if (fi.riseT < 0.8 && fi.riseT + dt >= 0.8 && Math.abs(P.y - (wl - 0.05)) < 0.15) spawnRipple(P.x, wl + 0.02, P.z, 0.35, 1.3);
          }
          if (fi.leapT > 0) {
            // Out of the water in an arc, and back in with a splash.
            if (fi.leapT === 0.01) { P.y = wl - 0.05; spawnSplash(P.x, wl + 0.05, P.z, 4, 0.5); }
            fi.leapT += dt;
            fi.leapVy -= 9.8 * dt;
            P.y += fi.leapVy * dt;
            fi.pitch = Math.atan2(fi.leapVy, Math.max(0.5, fi.speed + 1.2)) * 0.8;
            fi.speed = Math.max(fi.speed, 1.2);
            if (P.y < wl - 0.05 && fi.leapVy < 0) { fi.leapT = 0; spawnSplash(P.x, wl + 0.05, P.z, 6, 0.7); spawnRipple(P.x, wl + 0.02, P.z, 0.6, 1.4); }
          } else {
            const vy = (ty - P.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 1.6);
            P.y += vy;
            fi.pitch += (Math.max(-0.5, Math.min(0.5, vy / Math.max(dt, 1e-3) * 0.4)) - fi.pitch) * Math.min(1, dt * 4);
          }
        }
        // Body: face the way it swims, pitch with the climb, tail beating faster the
        // harder it swims, the whole body flexing a little with the beat.
        fi.mesh.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
        fi.mesh.rotation.order = 'YXZ';
        const beat = 5 + fi.speed * 9;
        fi.tailPh = (fi.tailPh || 0) + dt * beat;
        const wag = Math.sin(fi.tailPh) * (0.3 + Math.min(0.5, fi.speed * 0.15));
        fi.mesh.rotation.y = fi.heading + wag * 0.12;
        fi.mesh.rotation.x = -fi.pitch;
        const tailFin = fi.mesh.userData.tail;
        if (tailFin) tailFin.rotation.y = wag;
      }
    }

    function hitWildlifeSegment(ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz) {
      let best = null, bestT = 2, bestKind = null;
      for (const b of birds) {
        if (!b.alive || !b.mesh || !b.mesh.visible) continue;
        const p = b.mesh.position;
        const t = segmentHitsCylinder(ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, p.x, p.z, BIRD_HIT_R, p.y - 0.1, p.y + 0.15);
        if (t !== null && t < bestT) { bestT = t; best = b; bestKind = 'bird'; }
      }
      for (const r of rabbits) {
        if (!r.alive || !r.mesh || !r.mesh.visible || r.hiddenForRain) continue;
        const p = r.mesh.position;
        const t = segmentHitsCylinder(ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, p.x, p.z, RABBIT_HIT_R, p.y - 0.05, p.y + 0.22);
        if (t !== null && t < bestT) { bestT = t; best = r; bestKind = 'rabbit'; }
      }
      for (const f of frogs) {
        if (!f.alive || !f.mesh || !f.mesh.visible || f.hiddenForRain) continue;
        const p = f.mesh.position;
        const t = segmentHitsCylinder(ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, p.x, p.z, FROG_HIT_R, p.y - 0.04, p.y + 0.12);
        if (t !== null && t < bestT) { bestT = t; best = f; bestKind = 'frog'; }
      }
      for (const s of squirrels) {
        if (!s.alive || !s.mesh || !s.mesh.visible || s.hiddenForRain) continue;
        const p = s.mesh.position;
        const t = segmentHitsCylinder(ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, p.x, p.z, SQUIRREL_HIT_R, p.y - 0.06, p.y + 0.18);
        if (t !== null && t < bestT) { bestT = t; best = s; bestKind = 'squirrel'; }
      }
      for (const tu of turtles) {
        if (!tu.alive || !tu.mesh) continue;
        const p = tu.mesh.position;
        const t = segmentHitsCylinder(ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, p.x, p.z, TURTLE_HIT_R, p.y - 0.03, p.y + 0.14);
        if (t !== null && t < bestT) { bestT = t; best = tu; bestKind = 'turtle'; }
      }

        if (!fi.alive || !fi.mesh) continue;
        const p = fi.mesh.position;
        const t = segmentHitsCylinder(ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, p.x, p.z, FISH_HIT_R, p.y - 0.06, p.y + 0.06);
        if (t !== null && t < bestT) { bestT = t; best = fi; bestKind = 'fish'; }
      }

    }

    function meleeWildlife(reach, fx, fz, minDot) {
      const hitList = [];
      for (const b of birds) {
        if (!b.alive || !b.mesh || !b.mesh.visible) continue;
        hitList.push({ w: b, col: 0x887766, yOff: 0.5 });
      }
      for (const r of rabbits) {
        if (!r.alive || !r.mesh || !r.mesh.visible || r.hiddenForRain) continue;
        hitList.push({ w: r, col: 0x8b6a4a, yOff: 0.15 });
      }
      for (const f of frogs) {
        if (!f.alive || !f.mesh || !f.mesh.visible || f.hiddenForRain) continue;
        hitList.push({ w: f, col: 0x3d8b4a, yOff: 0.08 });
      }
      for (const s of squirrels) {
        if (!s.alive || !s.mesh || !s.mesh.visible || s.hiddenForRain) continue;
        hitList.push({ w: s, col: 0x9a5a34, yOff: 0.12 });
      }
      for (const tu of turtles) {
        if (!tu.alive || !tu.mesh) continue;
        hitList.push({ w: tu, col: 0x3f5c34, yOff: 0.08 });
      }
      for (const fi of fishes) {
        if (!fi.alive || !fi.mesh) continue;
        hitList.push({ w: fi, col: 0x6a7a8a, yOff: 0 });
      }
      for (const item of hitList) {
        const w = item.w;
        const dx = w.mesh.position.x - player.position.x;
        const dz = w.mesh.position.z - player.position.z;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (d < reach + 0.25) {
          const dy = w.mesh.position.y - (player.position.y + 0.9);

    // --- Impact motes (footfall dust, water splash, ambient drift) ---------------
    // Shared geometry and materials; particles shrink out instead of fading so no

    const motes = [];
    const MAX_MOTES = 260;
    const moteGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.08, 4, 3);
    const dustMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: 0xc6b48f, transparent: true, opacity: 0.5, depthWrite: false
    });
    const splashMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: 0xcfeaff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85, depthWrite: false
    });
    const emberMat = glowMat(new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: 0xffd27a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, depthWrite: false
    }), 2.2);

    // Mote meshes are pooled and never leave the scene. The flamethrower alone asks
    // for ~37 motes a second and each ground fire another ~14, and under the node
    // renderer every scene.add/scene.remove is renderer bookkeeping (and a fresh
    // Mesh is a fresh allocation for the GC to take back), so at that rate the
    // churn is visible as stutter. Idle meshes are parked with visible=false —
    // safe here in a way it is NOT for lights, because hiding a mesh doesn't change
    // the light set and so doesn't invalidate any material's compiled pipeline.
    // The pool can never outgrow MAX_MOTES, since that is what gates spawning.
    const motePool = [];

    function acquireMoteMesh(mat) {
      let mesh = motePool.pop();
      if (!mesh) {
