        mesh.frustumCulled = true;
        scene.add(mesh);
      }
      mesh.material = mat; // the three mote materials are themselves shared, not per-particle
      mesh.visible = true;
      return mesh;
    }

    function releaseMoteMesh(mesh) {
      mesh.visible = false;
      mesh.scale.setScalar(0.0001);
      motePool.push(mesh);
    }

    // === Generic effect-mesh pool ==============================================
    // The same argument as the mote pool, generalised. Casings, blood spatter, debris
    // chunks and gib pieces all shared their geometry and (since the material pools)
    // their materials, but each one was still a new THREE.Mesh that got added to the
    // scene and removed again a second or two later. Under the node renderer every one
    // of those is renderer-side bookkeeping, and they happen at the rate the player
    // pulls the trigger. Pools are keyed by geometry, since that is what a recycled
    // mesh cannot change; the material is reassigned on take, which is free because
    // the pooled materials were all built from the same configuration.
    const _meshPools = new Map();

    function acquireEffectMesh(geo, mat, cap) {
      let pool = _meshPools.get(geo);
      if (!pool) { pool = []; _meshPools.set(geo, pool); }
      let mesh = pool.pop();
      if (!mesh) {
        mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
        mesh.userData.effectPooled = true;
        mesh.userData.poolCap = cap || 160;
        scene.add(mesh);
      }
      mesh.material = mat;
      mesh.visible = true;
      mesh.scale.setScalar(1);
      mesh.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
      mesh.quaternion.set(0, 0, 0, 1);
      mesh.castShadow = false;
      mesh.renderOrder = 0;
      return mesh;
    }

    function releaseEffectMesh(mesh) {
      if (!mesh) return;
      mesh.visible = false;
      if (mesh.userData && mesh.userData.shell) { if (shellMeshPool.length < 40) shellMeshPool.push(mesh); else scene.remove(mesh); return; }
      if (!mesh.userData || !mesh.userData.effectPooled) { scene.remove(mesh); return; }
      const pool = _meshPools.get(mesh.geometry);
      if (pool && pool.length < mesh.userData.poolCap) pool.push(mesh);
      else scene.remove(mesh);
    }

    function spawnMote(x, y, z, mat, opts) {
      if (motes.length >= MAX_MOTES) return;
      const mesh = acquireMoteMesh(mat);
      mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
      const scale = opts.scale;
      mesh.scale.setScalar(scale);
      motes.push({
        mesh, scale,
        vx: opts.vx, vy: opts.vy, vz: opts.vz,
        grav: opts.grav, drag: opts.drag,
        age: 0, life: opts.life, grow: !!opts.grow
      });
    }

    function spawnDust(x, y, z, count) {
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const s = 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.1;
        spawnMote(x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, y + 0.06, z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, dustMat, {
          vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.8, vz: Math.sin(a) * s,
          grav: 2.2, drag: 2.4, life: 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.4,
          scale: 1.1 + Math.random() * 1.2, grow: true
        });
      }
    }

    function spawnSplash(x, y, z, count, power = 1) {
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const s = (0.9 + Math.random() * 1.8) * power;
        spawnMote(x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35, y + 0.05, z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35, splashMat, {
          vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: (2.0 + Math.random() * 2.6) * power, vz: Math.sin(a) * s,
          grav: 13, drag: 0.5, life: 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.35,
          scale: 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.7
        });
      }
    }

        const ripples = [];
    const MAX_RIPPLES = 64;
    const rippleGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.85, 1.0, 16);
    rippleGeo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);

    // Ripples fade individually, so each needs its own opacity and therefore its own
    // material — but "its own" can mean one of a fixed set handed round rather than a
    // fresh one per splash. The pool is capped by MAX_RIPPLES, the same thing that
    // caps how many can be alive, so it can never grow past that. (The old recycle
    // path also called dispose() on `oldest.mesh.geometry`, which is the *shared*
    // rippleGeo — that tore down the geometry every other ripple once the cap was
    // reached, and every mesh still using it had to re-upload.)
    const ripplePool = [];

    function spawnRipple(x, y, z, scale = 1.0, life = 1.2) {
      if (ripples.length >= MAX_RIPPLES) {
        const oldest = ripples.shift();
        releaseRippleMesh(oldest.mesh);
      }
      let mesh = ripplePool.pop();
      if (!mesh) {
        mesh = new THREE.Mesh(rippleGeo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
          color: 0x90c3e8, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide
        }));
        mesh.material.userData.pooled = true;
        scene.add(mesh);
      }
      mesh.visible = true;
      mesh.material.opacity = 0.55;
      mesh.position.set(x, y + 0.02, z);
      mesh.scale.setScalar(scale);
      ripples.push({ mesh, scale, life, age: 0, opacity: 0.55 });
    }

    function releaseRippleMesh(mesh) {
      mesh.visible = false;
      ripplePool.push(mesh);
    }

    function updateRipples(dt) {
      for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const r = ripples[i];
        r.age += dt;
        const t = r.age / r.life;
        if (t >= 1) {
          releaseRippleMesh(r.mesh);
          ripples.splice(i, 1);
          continue;
        }
        // Grows to a bit over 3x rather than 4.5x. A swimmer's wake was reaching ~12m
        // across, which on a person is less a ripple than a crop circle.
        r.mesh.scale.setScalar(r.scale * (1.0 + t * 2.2));
        r.mesh.material.opacity = r.opacity * (1.0 - t);
      }
    }

    function spawnEmbers(x, y, z, count, power = 1) {
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const s = (1.2 + Math.random() * 2.4) * power;
        spawnMote(x, y, z, emberMat, {
          vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: (1.5 + Math.random() * 3.2) * power, vz: Math.sin(a) * s,
          grav: 7, drag: 1.1, life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.6,
          scale: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.6
        });
      }
    }

    // Ambient life around the player: pollen drifting in daylight, fireflies after
    // dark. Costs almost nothing and makes the air feel occupied.
    let ambientCd = 0;
    function updateAmbientLife(dt) {
      if (!gameStarted) return;
      ambientCd -= dt;
      if (ambientCd > 0) return;
      ambientCd = 0.12;
      if (motes.length > MAX_MOTES * 0.6) return;
      // Fish breaking the surface when you're near the lake.
      if (Math.random() < 0.06 && lakeDist(player.position.x, player.position.z) < LAKE_FILL + 40) {
        const fa = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const fr = Math.random() * LAKE.r * 0.85;
        const fx = LAKE.x + Math.cos(fa) * fr, fz = LAKE.z + Math.sin(fa) * fr;
        if (waterLevelAt(fx, fz) !== null) spawnSplash(fx, LAKE.level + 0.05, fz, 4, 0.8);
      }
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const r = 3 + Math.random() * 14;
      const x = player.position.x + Math.cos(a) * r;
      const z = player.position.z + Math.sin(a) * r;
      const g = sampleHeight(x, z);
      if (isNight) {
        spawnMote(x, g + 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.8, z, emberMat, {
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35, vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, vz: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,
          grav: 0, drag: 0.1, life: 1.6 + Math.random() * 1.4, scale: 0.28 + Math.random() * 0.2
        });
      } else {
        spawnMote(x, g + 0.4 + Math.random() * 2.4, z, dustMat, {
          vx: wind.dirX * wind.strength * 0.9, vy: 0.12 + Math.random() * 0.2, vz: wind.dirZ * wind.strength * 0.9,
          grav: 0.05, drag: 0.02, life: 2.2 + Math.random() * 1.6, scale: 0.22 + Math.random() * 0.2
        });
      }
    }

    function updateMotes(dt) {
      for (let i = motes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const m = motes[i];
        m.age += dt;
        const t = m.age / m.life;
        if (t >= 1) {
          releaseMoteMesh(m.mesh);
          motes.splice(i, 1);
          continue;
        }
        m.vy -= m.grav * dt;
        const d = Math.max(0, 1 - m.drag * dt);
        m.vx *= d; m.vz *= d;
        m.mesh.position.x += m.vx * dt;
        m.mesh.position.y += m.vy * dt;
        m.mesh.position.z += m.vz * dt;
        m.mesh.scale.setScalar(m.scale * (1 - t) * (m.grow ? 0.5 + t : 1));
      }
    }

    // --- Debris / chunks ---
    const debris = [];
    const MAX_DEBRIS = 80;
    const chunkGeo = new THREE.TetrahedronGeometry(0.18, 0);

    // === Particle material pools ===============================================
    // A node renderer builds a GPU pipeline per material INSTANCE. The old habit of
    // `new MeshStandardMaterial(...)` per blood spatter, debris chunk and — worst of
    // all — per ejected shell casing meant building a fresh pipeline on every single
    // shot. On WebGL that was nearly free, because three caches compiled programs by
    // configuration and every one of those identical materials shared one program.
    // Here it is not free, and it is a large part of the combat stutter.
    //
    // These pools hand out a bounded, recycled set instead. Each pooled material keeps
    // its own opacity, so particles still fade independently, and each pool is sized to
    // its system's own particle cap — so two live particles can never end up sharing
    // one. Recycling is least-recently-used, matching the FIFO way particles expire.
    //
    // Pooled materials are also made dispose-proof: the particle systems call
    // material.dispose() in a dozen places when a particle dies, and a pooled material
    // must outlive that. The pools are bounded, so nothing leaks by never freeing them.
    function poolProof(m) {
      m.userData.pooled = true;
      m.dispose = function () {}; // reused, not released — see above
      return m;
    }
    // Pools are deliberately sized to twice their system's particle cap. Recycling is
    // round-robin, and particle lifetimes are randomised, so a newer particle can
    // outlive an older one; at exactly 1x the cap that could hand a material to a new
    // particle while the previous holder was still fading, popping it back to full
    // opacity. At 2x, a material is not reused until a whole cap's worth of further
    // particles have been spawned, by which time the old one is long gone.
    const POOL_SLACK = 2;
    function makeMatPool(size, make) {
      size = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(size * POOL_SLACK));
      const pool = [];
      let next = 0;
      return function take() {
        if (pool.length < size) { const m = poolProof(make()); pool.push(m); return m; }
        const m = pool[next];
        next = (next + 1) % size;
        return m;
      };
    }
    // Chunks come in a handful of colours (bark, stone, metal, flesh…), so the pools are
    // keyed by colour; the number of distinct keys stays small.
    const _chunkPools = new Map();
    function chunkMat(color) {
      let take = _chunkPools.get(color);
      if (!take) {
        take = makeMatPool(MAX_DEBRIS, () => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, roughness: 0.9, transparent: true, opacity: 1 }));
        _chunkPools.set(color, take);
      }
      return take();
    }

    function spawnChunks(x, y, z, color, count, impulse = 4) {
      const n = Math.min(count, MAX_DEBRIS - debris.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const mat = chunkMat(color);
        mat.opacity = 1; // pooled: reset what the previous user faded
        const mesh = acquireEffectMesh(chunkGeo, mat, MAX_DEBRIS + 8);
        mesh.position.set(x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, y + Math.random() * 0.2, z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3);
        mesh.scale.setScalar(0.5 + Math.random() * 1.2);
        mesh.castShadow = true;
        const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const sp = impulse * (0.5 + Math.random());
        debris.push({
          mesh,
          vx: Math.cos(ang) * sp,
          vy: 2 + Math.random() * impulse,
          vz: Math.sin(ang) * sp,
          life: 1.2 + Math.random() * 0.8,
          age: 0
        });
      }
    }

    function updateDebris(dt) {
      for (let i = debris.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const d = debris[i];
        d.age += dt;
        d.vy -= 14 * dt;
        d.mesh.position.x += d.vx * dt;
        d.mesh.position.y += d.vy * dt;
        d.mesh.position.z += d.vz * dt;
        d.mesh.rotation.x += dt * 4 * (1 + Math.abs(d.vx));
        d.mesh.rotation.z += dt * 3 * (1 + Math.abs(d.vz));
        {
          const px = d.mesh.position.x, pz = d.mesh.position.z;
          const gh = sampleHeight(px, pz) + 0.05;
          if (d.mesh.position.y < gh) {
            d.mesh.position.y = gh;
            // Reflect off the actual surface so chunks tumble downhill rather than
            // pogoing straight up wherever they land.
            const v = reflectOnTerrain(px, pz, d.vx, d.vy, d.vz, 0.28, 0.62);
            d.vx = v.x; d.vy = v.y; d.vz = v.z;
            if (Math.abs(d.vy) < 0.6) d.vy = 0;
            const wet = waterDepthAt(px, pz);
            if (wet > 0.05 && !d.splashed) {
              d.splashed = true;
              spawnSplash(px, gh + wet, pz, 3, 0.7);
            }
          }
        }
        const fade = Math.max(0, 1 - d.age / d.life);
        d.mesh.material.opacity = fade;
        if (d.age >= d.life) {
          releaseEffectMesh(d.mesh);
          d.mesh.material.dispose(); // pooled materials no-op this (see poolProof)
          debris.splice(i, 1);
        }
      }
    }

    // --- Blood FX ---
    // Droplets and ground marks are two InstancedMeshes: one draw call for every
    // droplet in the air and one for every mark on the ground. They used to be a mesh
    // (and a pooled material) each — up to 90 droplets and 50 marks, ~140 draws — and
    // a mark lasted four seconds, so a fight left nothing behind. Now there can be far
    // more of both for less: marks are fixed ring-buffer slots that stay ~45 s, dry from
    // wet red to dark brown as they age, and shrink away at the end instead of fading
    // (no per-mark opacity needed), and a droplet that lands leaves a spatter where it
    // fell. The counts stay at MAX always, unused slots scaled to nothing, so the
    // shaders compile at load rather than on the first kill.
    const MAX_BLOOD_P = 260;
    const MAX_BLOOD_D = 360;
    const BLOOD_DECAL_LIFE = 45;
    const bloodParticles = [];   // { x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, age, life, s }
    const bloodDecals = [];      // ring-buffer slots, see addBloodDecal
    const bloodGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.06, 5, 4);
    const decalGeo = new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.28, 10);
    const _bm = new THREE.Matrix4(), _bq = new THREE.Quaternion(), _bs = new THREE.Vector3(), _bp = new THREE.Vector3();
    const _bZero = new THREE.Matrix4().makeScale(0, 0, 0);
    const bloodDropMesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(bloodGeo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x7a0000 }), MAX_BLOOD_P);
    bloodDropMesh.frustumCulled = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_BLOOD_P; i++) bloodDropMesh.setMatrixAt(i, _bZero);
    scene.add(bloodDropMesh);
    const bloodDecalMesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(decalGeo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.88, depthWrite: false,
      polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -2, polygonOffsetUnits: -2
    }), MAX_BLOOD_D);
    bloodDecalMesh.frustumCulled = false;
    bloodDecalMesh.instanceColor = new THREE.InstancedBufferAttribute(new Float32Array(MAX_BLOOD_D * 3), 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_BLOOD_D; i++) { bloodDecalMesh.setMatrixAt(i, _bZero); bloodDecalMesh.instanceColor.setXYZ(i, 0.5, 0, 0); }
    scene.add(bloodDecalMesh);
    const BLOOD_WET = new THREE.Color(0x8e0a06), BLOOD_DRY = new THREE.Color(0x2c0a06), _bc = new THREE.Color();
    let decalNext = 0, decalColorT = 0;

    // A mark on the ground. `grow` seconds to spread to full size (0 = at once).
    function addBloodDecal(x, z, size, grow = 0, life = BLOOD_DECAL_LIFE) {
      if (waterLevelAt(x, z) !== null) return; // nothing lies on water
      const i = decalNext;
      decalNext = (decalNext + 1) % MAX_BLOOD_D;
      let d = bloodDecals[i];
      if (!d) { d = bloodDecals[i] = { q: new THREE.Quaternion(), i }; }
      d.x = x; d.z = z;
      // Stacked marks get a hair of height each so overlapping pools don't z-fight.
      d.y = sampleHeight(x, z) + 0.05 + (i % 7) * 0.002;
      // Along the ground's normal, spun about it so no two look stamped out alike.
      d.q.setFromUnitVectors(AXIS_Z, terrainNormal(x, z));
      _bq.setFromAxisAngle(AXIS_Z, Math.random() * Math.PI * 2);
      d.q.multiply(_bq);
      d.s = size; d.sx = 0.75 + Math.random() * 0.5; d.grow = grow; d.age = 0; d.life = life; d.live = true;
      _bc.copy(BLOOD_WET);
      bloodDecalMesh.instanceColor.setXYZ(i, _bc.r, _bc.g, _bc.b);
      bloodDecalMesh.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
      writeDecal(d);
    }
    function writeDecal(d) {
      let k = 1;
      if (d.grow > 0) k *= Math.min(1, 0.3 + 0.7 * d.age / d.grow);
      const tail = d.life - d.age;
      if (tail < 3) k *= Math.max(0, tail / 3);
      _bp.set(d.x, d.y, d.z);
      _bs.set(d.s * d.sx * k, d.s * k, 1);
      _bm.compose(_bp, d.q, _bs);
      bloodDecalMesh.setMatrixAt(d.i, _bm);
      bloodDecalMesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    }

    function emitBloodDrop(x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, life, s) {
      if (bloodParticles.length >= MAX_BLOOD_P) bloodParticles.shift();
      bloodParticles.push({ x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, age: 0, life, s });
    }

    function spawnBlood(x, y, z, dirX = 0, dirZ = 0, amount = 6, force = 1) {
      const dlen = Math.hypot(dirX, dirZ) || 0;
      const nx = dlen > 0.01 ? dirX / dlen : 0;
      const nz = dlen > 0.01 ? dirZ / dlen : 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
        const spray = (1.6 + Math.random() * 2.4) * force;
        emitBloodDrop(
          x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15, y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2, z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15,
          nx * spray * (0.7 + Math.random() * 1.4) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.2,
          1.2 + Math.random() * 3.5 * force,
          nz * spray * (0.7 + Math.random() * 1.4) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.2,
          0.45 + Math.random() * 0.55, 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.9);
      }
      addBloodDecal(x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8);
    }

    // Exit wound: a heavy round carries a spray out of the far side, low and fast along
    // its line, and paints a streak on the ground behind the body.
    function spawnExitSpray(x, y, z, dirX, dirZ, power = 1) {
      const dl = Math.hypot(dirX, dirZ) || 1, nx = dirX / dl, nz = dirZ / dl;
      const n = Math.round(6 + 6 * power);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const sp = (4 + Math.random() * 5) * (0.7 + power * 0.5);
        const side = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.6;
        emitBloodDrop(x + nx * 0.3, y + (Math.random() - 0.3) * 0.25, z + nz * 0.3,
          nx * sp - nz * side, 0.6 + Math.random() * 2.2, nz * sp + nx * side,
          0.35 + Math.random() * 0.4, 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8);
      }
      const marks = 2 + Math.round(power * 2);
      for (let k = 0; k < marks; k++) {
        const d = 0.7 + k * (0.55 + Math.random() * 0.45) * (0.8 + power * 0.4);
        const w = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
        addBloodDecal(x + nx * d - nz * w, z + nz * d + nx * w, (1.1 - k * 0.2) * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.5) * (0.8 + power * 0.3));
      }
    }

    // A pulse from a stump: up and out, a little each beat.
    function spawnSpurt(x, y, z, dirX, dirZ, strength = 1) {
      const n = 3 + ((Math.random() * 3) | 0);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        emitBloodDrop(x, y, z,
          dirX * (1.4 + Math.random() * 1.6) * strength + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8,
          (2.4 + Math.random() * 2.2) * strength,
          dirZ * (1.4 + Math.random() * 1.6) * strength + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8,
          0.5 + Math.random() * 0.4, 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.6);
      }
    }

    function updateBlood(dt) {
      // Droplets: integrate, draw packed at the front of the instance buffer, and the
      // ones that reach the ground leave a spatter behind about a third of the time.
      let n = 0;
      for (let i = bloodParticles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const b = bloodParticles[i];
        b.age += dt;
        b.vy -= 12 * dt;
        b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt; b.z += b.vz * dt;
        const gy = sampleHeight(b.x, b.z);
        if (b.age >= b.life || b.y < gy) {
          if (b.y < gy + 0.1 && Math.random() < 0.35) addBloodDecal(b.x, b.z, 0.22 + Math.random() * 0.3);
          bloodParticles.splice(i, 1);
        }
      }
      for (const b of bloodParticles) {
        const sc = b.s * (1 - 0.55 * b.age / b.life);
        _bp.set(b.x, b.y, b.z);
        _bs.set(sc, sc * 1.3, sc);
        _bq.identity();
        _bm.compose(_bp, _bq, _bs);
        bloodDropMesh.setMatrixAt(n++, _bm);
      }
      for (let i = n; i < (bloodDropMesh.userData.lastN || MAX_BLOOD_P); i++) bloodDropMesh.setMatrixAt(i, _bZero);
      bloodDropMesh.userData.lastN = n;
      bloodDropMesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
      // Marks: only the ones changing size are rewritten; the drying colour is swept
      // twice a second.
      decalColorT -= dt;
      const sweep = decalColorT <= 0;
      if (sweep) decalColorT = 0.5;
      for (const d of bloodDecals) {
        if (!d || !d.live) continue;
        d.age += dt;
        if (d.age >= d.life) { d.live = false; bloodDecalMesh.setMatrixAt(d.i, _bZero); bloodDecalMesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true; continue; }
        if ((d.grow > 0 && d.age < d.grow + dt) || d.life - d.age < 3) writeDecal(d);
        if (sweep) {
          _bc.copy(BLOOD_WET).lerp(BLOOD_DRY, Math.min(1, d.age / 20));
          bloodDecalMesh.instanceColor.setXYZ(d.i, _bc.r, _bc.g, _bc.b);
        }
      }
      if (sweep) bloodDecalMesh.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
    }

    function clearBlood() {
      bloodParticles.length = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < MAX_BLOOD_P; i++) bloodDropMesh.setMatrixAt(i, _bZero);
      bloodDropMesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
      for (const d of bloodDecals) if (d) { d.live = false; bloodDecalMesh.setMatrixAt(d.i, _bZero); }
      bloodDecalMesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    }

    // Headshot: the head goes in a puff of red mist as well as pieces.
    const bloodMistMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x6e0606, transparent: true, opacity: 0.4, depthWrite: false });
    function spawnBloodMist(x, y, z, dirX, dirZ) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        spawnMote(x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, bloodMistMat, {
          vx: dirX * 1.6 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4, vy: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.9, vz: dirZ * 1.6 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4,
          grav: 0.6, drag: 1.6, life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.4, scale: 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.4, grow: true
        });
      }
    }

    // --- Gore gib pieces (meat chunks + detached limbs) ---
    const gibPieces = [];
    const MAX_GIB = 80;
    const gibBoxGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.2, 0.26, 0.16);
    const gibCapGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.07, 0.2, 3, 6);
    const gibSphereGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.1, 6, 5);
    const MEAT_COLORS = [0x8a1a1a, 0xa82828, 0x6e1010, 0xc44a4a, 0x5a0c0c, 0xb03040];

    // Gibs fade out individually, so each piece needs its own opacity and so its own
    // material — but the pool hands the same ones round instead of minting a fresh
    // MeshStandardMaterial per chunk. An explosive burst is 16 pieces; a big fight is
    // hundreds a minute. Pool depth is MAX_GIB * POOL_SLACK and only MAX_GIB pieces
    // can be alive at once, so a material can never be recycled out from under a
    // piece that is still fading. Colour is the only thing that varies, and setHex
    // on a uniform doesn't touch the compiled pipeline.
    const _meatMatPool = makeMatPool(MAX_GIB, () => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff, roughness: 0.55, metalness: 0.02, transparent: true, opacity: 1,
      emissive: 0x3a0505, emissiveIntensity: 0.18
    }));
    const _eyeMatPool = makeMatPool(16, () => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff, roughness: 0.5, metalness: 0.05, transparent: true, opacity: 1,
      emissive: 0xffffff, emissiveIntensity: 0.4
    }));

    function meatMat(baseHex) {
      const col = baseHex != null ? baseHex : MEAT_COLORS[(Math.random() * MEAT_COLORS.length) | 0];
      const m = _meatMatPool();
      m.color.setHex(col);
      m.opacity = 1;
      return m;
    }

    function eyeMat(eyeColor) {
      const m = _eyeMatPool();
      m.color.setHex(eyeColor);
      m.emissive.setHex(eyeColor);
      m.opacity = 1;
      return m;
    }

    function spawnGibBurst(x, y, z, skinColor, eyeColor, dirX, dirZ, style = 'explosive') {
      { const sa = sndAt(x, z); AudioSys.gore(sa.v, sa.pan, style === 'explosive'); }
      const outward = Math.hypot(dirX, dirZ) > 0.05;
      const ox = outward ? dirX / Math.hypot(dirX, dirZ) : 0;
      const oz = outward ? dirZ / Math.hypot(dirX, dirZ) : 0;
      const count = style === 'explosive' ? 16
        : (style === 'chainsaw' ? 12
        : (style === 'pellet' ? 8
        : (style === 'shred' ? 6 : 4)));
      const impulse = style === 'explosive' ? 8.5
        : (style === 'chainsaw' || style === 'shred' ? 6.2
        : (style === 'pellet' ? 4.2 : 3.8));
      for (let i = 0; i < count && gibPieces.length < MAX_GIB; i++) {
        const roll = Math.random();
        const geo = roll < 0.35 ? gibSphereGeo : (roll < 0.7 ? gibCapGeo : gibBoxGeo);
        const isEye = i === 0 && eyeColor;
        const mat = isEye ? eyeMat(eyeColor) : meatMat(i % 4 === 0 ? skinColor : null);
        const mesh = acquireEffectMesh(geo, mat, MAX_GIB + 8);
        mesh.castShadow = true;
        const sx = 0.55 + Math.random() * 1.15;
        const sy = 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.35;
        const sz = 0.55 + Math.random() * 1.1;
        mesh.scale.set(sx, sy, sz);
        mesh.position.set(x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45, y + 0.25 + Math.random() * 0.85, z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45);
        mesh.rotation.set(Math.random() * 6, Math.random() * 6, Math.random() * 6);
        const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const sp = impulse * (0.4 + Math.random());
        let vx = Math.cos(ang) * sp;
        let vz = Math.sin(ang) * sp;
        if (outward) {
          vx += ox * impulse * (0.45 + Math.random() * 0.7);
          vz += oz * impulse * (0.45 + Math.random() * 0.7);
        }
        if (style === 'chainsaw' || style === 'shred') {
          vx += ox * 5; vz += oz * 5;
        }
        gibPieces.push({
          mesh,
          vx, vy: 2.8 + Math.random() * impulse * 0.9, vz,
          life: 1.8 + Math.random() * 1.2,
          age: 0,
          spinX: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12,
          spinZ: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12
        });
      }
    }

    function spawnFleshChunks(x, y, z, dirX, dirZ, color, n = 3) {
      const outward = Math.hypot(dirX, dirZ) > 0.05;
      const ox = outward ? dirX / Math.hypot(dirX, dirZ) : 0;
      const oz = outward ? dirZ / Math.hypot(dirX, dirZ) : 0;
      const count = Math.max(1, n | 0);
      for (let i = 0; i < count && gibPieces.length < MAX_GIB; i++) {
        const roll = Math.random();
        const geo = roll < 0.4 ? gibSphereGeo : (roll < 0.75 ? gibCapGeo : gibBoxGeo);
        const mesh = acquireEffectMesh(geo, meatMat(color), MAX_GIB + 8);
        mesh.castShadow = true;
        const s = 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.9;
        mesh.scale.set(s * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.6), s * (0.8 + Math.random()), s * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.5));
        mesh.position.set(x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, y + Math.random() * 0.5, z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3);
        mesh.rotation.set(Math.random() * 6, Math.random() * 6, Math.random() * 6);
        const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const sp = 3.2 * (0.5 + Math.random());
        gibPieces.push({
          mesh,
          vx: Math.cos(ang) * sp + ox * 2.5,
          vy: 2.2 + Math.random() * 3,
          vz: Math.sin(ang) * sp + oz * 2.5,
          life: 1.4 + Math.random() * 0.9,
          age: 0,
          spinX: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 11,
          spinZ: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 11
        });
      }
    }

    // CL-136 (Jerry, 2026-10-09: "massive freeze when spawning zombies in training and shooting them"): three's
    // Object3D.copy deep-copies userData through JSON.stringify, and a userData that holds other objects (a limb
    // group's elbowG and upper, a gun's flash and laser, the HQ hatches' moving parts) serialises those whole,
    // geometry, materials and textures included. Every dismembered limb was a 400 ms stall and 150 MB of string
    // (measured on the 5080 with the camera's probe), one for each arm, leg and head that came off under fire.
    // This clone copies the tree, the transforms, the geometry and material references, and only the plain values
    // of userData (numbers, strings, plain objects); never another object.
    const _cloneLeanEmpty = Object.freeze({});
    function cloneLean(obj, recursive = true) {
      const ud = obj.userData; obj.userData = _cloneLeanEmpty;
      let c;
      try { c = new obj.constructor().copy(obj, false); } finally { obj.userData = ud; }
      const keep = {};
      for (const k in ud) {
        const v = ud[k];
        if (v == null || typeof v !== 'object') keep[k] = v;
        else if (!(v.isObject3D || v.isMaterial || v.isTexture || v.isBufferGeometry)) { try { keep[k] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v)); } catch (_) { /* a cycle: left out */ } }
      }
      c.userData = keep;
      if (recursive) for (const ch of obj.children) c.add(cloneLean(ch, true));

      mesh.rotateX((Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4);
      _casingVel.set(
        2.0 + Math.random() * 1.6,
        1.5 + Math.random() * 1.4,
        -0.5 - Math.random() * 0.9
      );
      _casingVel.applyQuaternion(_casingQuat);
      casings.push({
        mesh,
        vx: _casingVel.x,
        vy: _casingVel.y,
        vz: _casingVel.z,
        ax: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 16,
        ay: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20,
        az: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 16,
        age: 0,
        life: 1.7 + Math.random() * 0.9,
        bounced: false,
        settled: false
      });
      if (AudioSys.brassTink) AudioSys.brassTink();
    }

    function updateCasings(dt) {
      for (let i = casings.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const c = casings[i];
        c.age += dt;
        if (!c.settled) {
          c.vy -= 16 * dt;
          c.mesh.position.x += c.vx * dt;
          c.mesh.position.y += c.vy * dt;
          c.mesh.position.z += c.vz * dt;
          c.mesh.rotation.x += c.ax * dt;
          c.mesh.rotation.y += c.ay * dt;
          c.mesh.rotation.z += c.az * dt;
          const gh = sampleHeight(c.mesh.position.x, c.mesh.position.z) + 0.02;
          if (c.mesh.position.y < gh) {
            c.mesh.position.y = gh;
            if (!c.bounced) {
              c.bounced = true;
              c.vy = Math.abs(c.vy) * 0.28 + 0.4;
              c.vx *= 0.55;
              c.vz *= 0.55;
              c.ax *= 0.5; c.ay *= 0.5; c.az *= 0.5;
              if (AudioSys.brassTink && !c.quiet) AudioSys.brassTink();
            } else {
              c.settled = true;
              c.vy = 0; c.vx = 0; c.vz = 0;
              c.ax = 0; c.ay = 0; c.az = 0;
            }
          }
        }
        const fadeStart = c.life * 0.55;
        if (c.age > fadeStart) {
          c.mesh.material.opacity = Math.max(0, 1 - (c.age - fadeStart) / (c.life - fadeStart));
        }
        if (c.age >= c.life) {
          releaseEffectMesh(c.mesh);
          c.mesh.material.dispose(); // pooled: a no-op, kept so an un-pooled material still frees
          casings.splice(i, 1);
        }
      }
    }

    // --- Dropped pistol magazines (reload eject) ---
    const droppedMags = [];
    const MAX_DROPPED_MAGS = 12;
    let droppedMagNight = isNight;
    const droppedMagGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.055, 0.12, 0.08);
    const _dropMagPos = new THREE.Vector3();
    const _dropMagVel = new THREE.Vector3();
    const _dropMagQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();

    function recycleOldestDroppedMag() {
      if (!droppedMags.length) return;
      const old = droppedMags.shift();
      scene.remove(old.mesh);
      old.mesh.material.dispose();
    }

    function clearDroppedMags() {
      for (const m of droppedMags) {
        scene.remove(m.mesh);
        m.mesh.material.dispose();
      }
      droppedMags.length = 0;
      droppedMagNight = isNight;
    }

    function clearDroppedMagLoot() {
      for (let i = droppedMags.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (!droppedMags[i].loot) continue;
        scene.remove(droppedMags[i].mesh);
        droppedMags[i].mesh.material.dispose();
        droppedMags.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    function spawnDroppedMag(gun = getActiveGun(), loot = null) {
      if (reloading && !loot) return; // R stows; only the chosen double-tap makes recoverable ground loot.
      if (!loot && gun === getActiveGun() && akimboOn()) spawnDroppedMag(offhandMeshes[currentWeapon]);
      if (!gun || (!gun.userData.mag && !loot)) return;
      if (droppedMags.length >= MAX_DROPPED_MAGS) recycleOldestDroppedMag();
      gun.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      if (gun.userData.mag) {
        gun.userData.mag.updateMatrixWorld(true);
        gun.userData.mag.getWorldPosition(_dropMagPos);
        gun.userData.mag.getWorldQuaternion(_dropMagQuat);
      } else { gun.getWorldPosition(_dropMagPos); gun.getWorldQuaternion(_dropMagQuat); }
      const mat = gunAccent.clone();
      mat.transparent = true;
      mat.opacity = 1;
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(gun.userData.mag?.geometry || droppedMagGeo, mat);
      mesh.position.copy(_dropMagPos);
      mesh.quaternion.copy(_dropMagQuat);
      if (gun.userData.mag) gun.userData.mag.getWorldScale(mesh.scale);
      mesh.castShadow = false;
      scene.add(mesh);
      // Fall mostly down + slight outward tumble in world space
      _dropMagVel.set(
        (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.9,
        -0.4 - Math.random() * 0.5,
        (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.9
      );
      droppedMags.push({
        mesh,
        vx: _dropMagVel.x,
        vy: _dropMagVel.y,
        vz: _dropMagVel.z,
        ax: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10,
        ay: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
        az: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10,
        age: 0,
        life: loot ? Infinity : 3.2 + Math.random() * 1.2,
        loot, playerCleared: false,
        bounced: false,
        settled: false
      });
    }

    function updateDroppedMags(dt) {
      if (isNight !== droppedMagNight) { clearDroppedMagLoot(); droppedMagNight = isNight; }
      for (let i = droppedMags.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const m = droppedMags[i];
        m.age += dt;
        if (!m.settled) {
          m.vy -= 16 * dt;
          m.mesh.position.x += m.vx * dt;
          m.mesh.position.y += m.vy * dt;
          m.mesh.position.z += m.vz * dt;
          m.mesh.rotation.x += m.ax * dt;
          m.mesh.rotation.y += m.ay * dt;
          m.mesh.rotation.z += m.az * dt;
          const gh = sampleHeight(m.mesh.position.x, m.mesh.position.z) + 0.04;
          if (m.mesh.position.y < gh) {
            m.mesh.position.y = gh;
            if (!m.bounced) {
              m.bounced = true;
              m.vy = Math.abs(m.vy) * 0.22 + 0.25;
              m.vx *= 0.45;
              m.vz *= 0.45;
              m.ax *= 0.4; m.ay *= 0.4; m.az *= 0.4;
              if (AudioSys.magThud) AudioSys.magThud();
            } else {
              m.settled = true;
              m.vy = 0; m.vx = 0; m.vz = 0;
              m.ax = 0; m.ay = 0; m.az = 0;
            }
          }
        }
        if (m.loot && m.settled) {
          const carrier = nearestPlayer(m.mesh.position.x, m.mesh.position.z);
          const distance = carrier ? Math.hypot(carrier.position.x - m.mesh.position.x, carrier.position.z - m.mesh.position.z) : Infinity;
          if (distance > 1.4) m.playerCleared = true;
          if (m.playerCleared && distance < 1.0 && pickUpMagazine(magazineStore, m.loot)) {
            syncMagazine(m.loot.weapon); updateAmmoHud();
            if (AudioSys.ammoPickup) AudioSys.ammoPickup(); else AudioSys.pickup(); scene.remove(m.mesh); m.mesh.material.dispose(); droppedMags.splice(i, 1); continue;   // CL-162
          }
        }
        const fadeStart = m.life * 0.6;
        if (m.age > fadeStart) {
          m.mesh.material.opacity = Math.max(0, 1 - (m.age - fadeStart) / (m.life - fadeStart));
        }
        if (m.age >= m.life) {
          scene.remove(m.mesh);
          m.mesh.material.dispose();
          droppedMags.splice(i, 1);
        }
      }
    }

    // --- Destructible rocks ---
    // --- Rocks ---
    // Every rock on the map used to be the same rock: a detail-1 dodecahedron with one
    // icosahedron chunk and a moss blob stuck on, scaled up or down. They are now grown
    // from five archetypes over a shared stone kit —
    //   erratic  rounded, glacier-dumped, sitting deep with a lump or two fused on
    //   angular  a fresh fracture: sharp facets, a sheared face, shards at its foot
    //   slab     low sedimentary plates, stacked and tilted off true
    //   spire    an upright blade standing out of a skirt of its own debris
    //   cluster  a knot of three to five stones sharing one footprint
    // — in one of five stone types, so the same silhouette reads differently in
    // granite, basalt, sandstone, limestone or schist.
    //
    // Two details do most of the work. Surfaces are displaced by a noise hashed off
    // the vertex POSITION rather than its index: polyhedron geometry duplicates every
    // corner, so index-based jitter would pull a rock apart along its own edges, while
    // hashing the position moves every copy of a corner together and the facets stay
    // welded. And colour is shaded per vertex after the merge — bleached and dry toward
    // the crown, damp and dark at the foot, with grain speckle and, on sedimentary
    // stone, horizontal bedding — so flat low-poly faces stop reading as flat.
    const rocks = [];
    const rockMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.9, metalness: 0.07 });
    // bed = how strongly this stone shows bedding layers; w = how common it is.
    const STONE_TYPES = [
      { base: 0x7f8a9b, dark: 0x474e5c, light: 0xa6b0bf, bed: 0.00, tough: 1.00, w: 4 }, // granite
      { base: 0x4d525b, dark: 0x262a31, light: 0x717783, bed: 0.00, tough: 1.25, w: 2 }, // basalt
      { base: 0x9a8365, dark: 0x675640, light: 0xc3aa83, bed: 0.55, tough: 0.75, w: 3 }, // sandstone
      { base: 0x97a09a, dark: 0x636b67, light: 0xbac1b6, bed: 0.35, tough: 0.85, w: 2 }, // limestone
      { base: 0x6e6a74, dark: 0x3e3b46, light: 0x928e99, bed: 0.45, tough: 0.90, w: 1 }  // schist
    ];
    const STONE_PICK = STONE_TYPES.flatMap(t => Array(t.w).fill(t));
    const ROCK_MOSS = [0x46732f, 0x3c6a33, 0x54803a];
    const ROCK_LICHEN = [0x9aa86a, 0xb5b391, 0x8d9d7c];
    // mergeParts bakes each part's material colour into the merged vertex colours, so
    // these are colour carriers only — every rock is drawn with rockMat. Cached by hex
    // (and the shades are quantised) so a mapful of rocks shares a few dozen of them.
    const _stoneTints = new Map();
    function stoneTint(hex) {
      let m = _stoneTints.get(hex);
      if (!m) { m = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: hex }); _stoneTints.set(hex, m); }
      return m;
    }
    const _stoneA = new THREE.Color(), _stoneB = new THREE.Color();
    // t < 0 walks the stone toward its shadow colour, t > 0 toward its bleached one.
    function stoneShade(type, t) {
      const q = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, Math.round(t * 5) / 5));
      _stoneA.setHex(type.base).lerp(_stoneB.setHex(q > 0 ? type.light : type.dark), Math.abs(q));
      return _stoneA.getHex();
    }
    // Repeatable -1..1 from a position. The truncation is deliberate: identical
    // coordinates must hash identically or the facets tear open (see the note above).
    function stoneNoise(x, y, z, seed) {
      let h = Math.imul(((x * 733.1) | 0) ^ ((seed * 374761393) | 0), 0x27d4eb2d);
      h = Math.imul(h ^ ((y * 911.7) | 0), 0x165667b1);
      h = Math.imul(h ^ ((z * 1301.3) | 0), 0x9e3779b1);
      h ^= h >>> 13;
      return ((h >>> 0) / 0x80000000) - 1;
    }
    // Push every vertex in or out along its own radius by two octaves of that noise,
    // then shear it sideways as well. The radial term alone barely touches a box —
    // it just slides the corners along their diagonals — and that is what made the
    // stacked plates of a slab read as a pile of crates. The lateral term is what
    // knocks the edges out of true and makes them look broken instead of sawn.
    function roughenStone(geo, amp, seed) {
      const pos = geo.attributes.position;
      // Shear amplitude is scaled per axis off the shape's own extents, not off one
      // overall radius: a spire is five times taller than it is wide, and a single
      // radius would shove its flanks sideways by most of its height and leave a
      // shark fin instead of a blade.
      geo.computeBoundingBox();
      const bb = geo.boundingBox;
      const ex = (bb.max.x - bb.min.x) * 0.5 || 1;
      const ey = (bb.max.y - bb.min.y) * 0.5 || 1;
      const ez = (bb.max.z - bb.min.z) * 0.5 || 1;
      for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
        const x = pos.getX(i), y = pos.getY(i), z = pos.getZ(i);
        const n1 = stoneNoise(x, y, z, seed);
        const n2 = stoneNoise(x * 2.7, y * 2.7, z * 2.7, seed ^ 0x5f3a7b);
        const n3 = stoneNoise(x * 1.3 + 7, y * 1.3 - 3, z * 1.3 + 11, seed ^ 0x13c6ef);
        const f = 1 + (n1 * 0.72 + n2 * 0.28) * amp;
        pos.setXYZ(i,
          x * f + n3 * amp * ex * 0.5,
          y * f + n2 * amp * ey * 0.28,
          z * f + n1 * amp * ez * 0.5);
      }
      pos.needsUpdate = true;
      geo.computeVertexNormals();
      return geo;
    }
    // Vertical light gradient, grain speckle, bedding — and the moss.
    //
    // Moss and lichen used to be flattened spheres stuck on the rock, which at any
    // real viewing angle read as a green sticker floating above the stone. They are
    // painted into the vertex colours instead: growth follows the up-facing faces,
    // broken into patches by a noise field, so it wraps whatever shape it lands on and
    // costs no extra geometry. mossAmt/lichenAmt are 0..1 per rock.
    function shadeStoneMesh(mesh, type, seed, mossAmt = 0, lichenAmt = 0, mossHex = 0x46732f, lichenHex = 0x9aa86a) {
      const geo = mesh.geometry;
      const col = geo.attributes.color, pos = geo.attributes.position;
      if (!col) return;
      const nrm = geo.attributes.normal;
      _stoneA.setHex(mossHex);
      const mr = _stoneA.r, mg = _stoneA.g, mb = _stoneA.b;
      _stoneB.setHex(lichenHex);
      const lr = _stoneB.r, lg = _stoneB.g, lb = _stoneB.b;
      let minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
      for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
        const y = pos.getY(i);
        if (y < minY) minY = y;
        if (y > maxY) maxY = y;
      }
      const span = (maxY - minY) || 1;
      for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
        const x = pos.getX(i), y = pos.getY(i), z = pos.getZ(i);
        const t = (y - minY) / span;
        let k = 0.62 + 0.55 * t * t;
        k *= 1 + stoneNoise(x * 6.1, y * 6.1, z * 6.1, seed ^ 0x2b1d05) * 0.1;
        // Facet-scale mottling: neighbouring faces drift apart in tone, so a flat
        // low-poly face stops reading as a single painted panel.
        k *= 1 + stoneNoise(x * 1.9, y * 1.9, z * 1.9, seed ^ 0x77a10b) * 0.14;
        if (type.bed > 0) k *= 1 + Math.sin(y * 24 + seed) * 0.075 * type.bed;
        let r = Math.min(1, col.getX(i) * k);
        let g = Math.min(1, col.getY(i) * k);
        let b = Math.min(1, col.getZ(i) * k);
        if (nrm && (mossAmt > 0 || lichenAmt > 0)) {
          const up = nrm.getY(i);
          if (mossAmt > 0 && up > 0.25) {
            // Patchy: the noise field decides where it took, the normal and the
            // height decide whether it could take there at all.
            const field = stoneNoise(x * 2.6, y * 2.2, z * 2.6, seed ^ 0x5eed17) * 0.5 + 0.5;
            const m = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (up - 0.25) / 0.5))
              * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (field - 0.42) / 0.3))
              * Math.min(1, 0.35 + t) * mossAmt;
            r += (mr - r) * m; g += (mg - g) * m; b += (mb - b) * m;
          }
          if (lichenAmt > 0) {
            // Lichen is flatter, crustier and does not care which way the face points.
            const spot = stoneNoise(x * 5.4 + 3, y * 5.4, z * 5.4 - 2, seed ^ 0x1c4e9b) * 0.5 + 0.5;
            const l = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (spot - 0.66) / 0.2)) * lichenAmt * 0.85;
            r += (lr - r) * l; g += (lg - g) * l; b += (lb - b) * l;
          }
        }
        col.setXYZ(i, r, g, b);
      }
      col.needsUpdate = true;
    }

    // s is the rock's overall size in metres-ish; kind/seed let the caller pin a
    // particular rock down, and are otherwise derived from the position.
    function makeRock(x, z, s = 1, rot = 0, opts = {}) {
      const seed = opts.seed != null ? opts.seed
        : (((x * 73856093) ^ (z * 19349663)) | 0);
      const rnd = mulberry32(seed >>> 0);
      const type = opts.type || STONE_PICK[(rnd() * STONE_PICK.length) | 0];
      // Big stone tends to survive as a whole boulder or a bedding stack; small stone
      // is what's left after something broke, so it skews angular and clustered.
      let kind = opts.kind;
      if (!kind) {
        const r = rnd();
        if (s < 0.5) kind = r < 0.45 ? 'cluster' : (r < 0.8 ? 'angular' : 'slab');
        else if (s > 1.3) kind = r < 0.4 ? 'erratic' : (r < 0.68 ? 'slab' : (r < 0.88 ? 'angular' : 'spire'));
        else kind = r < 0.32 ? 'erratic' : (r < 0.56 ? 'angular' : (r < 0.76 ? 'slab' : (r < 0.92 ? 'cluster' : 'spire')));
      }
      // Wet, low ground grows moss; exposed high ground stays bare and pale.
      const h = sampleHeight(x, z);
      const damp = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.max(0, h - 4) / 30) * (1 - smoothBand(26, 46, h) * 0.8);

      const parts = [];
      let footR = 0, topY = 0;
      // solid pieces set the collision cylinder; scree and moss deliberately don't.
      const add = (geo, hex, px, py, pz, scale, rotv, solid = true) => {
        const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, stoneTint(hex));
        m.position.set(px, py, pz);
        if (scale) m.scale.set(scale[0], scale[1], scale[2]);
        if (rotv) m.rotation.set(rotv[0], rotv[1], rotv[2]);
        parts.push(m);
        if (solid) {
          // Box extents, not a bounding sphere: a spire is 5x taller than it is wide,
          // and a sphere around it would hand the collider a radius nothing can walk
          // past. Rotation is ignored here — these shapes are near enough symmetric.
          geo.computeBoundingBox();
          const bb = geo.boundingBox;
          const hx = Math.max(Math.abs(bb.min.x), Math.abs(bb.max.x)) * m.scale.x;
          const hz = Math.max(Math.abs(bb.min.z), Math.abs(bb.max.z)) * m.scale.z;
          footR = Math.max(footR, Math.hypot(px, pz) + Math.max(hx, hz));
          topY = Math.max(topY, py + bb.max.y * m.scale.y);
        }
        return m;
      };
      // How much growth this rock carries. Painted into the vertices after the merge
      // (see shadeStoneMesh) rather than added as blobs on top of the stone.
      const mossHex = ROCK_MOSS[(rnd() * ROCK_MOSS.length) | 0];
      const lichenHex = ROCK_LICHEN[(rnd() * ROCK_LICHEN.length) | 0];
      let mossAmt = 0, lichenAmt = 0;
      const scree = (count, spread, size) => {
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          const a = rnd() * 6.28, d = spread * (0.55 + rnd() * 0.65);
          const r = size * (0.5 + rnd() * 0.7);
          add(roughenStone(new THREE.TetrahedronGeometry(r, 0), 0.22, seed + 61 + i * 17),
            stoneShade(type, -0.5 + rnd() * 0.3),
            Math.cos(a) * d, r * 0.35, Math.sin(a) * d,
            [1, 0.7, 1], [rnd() * 3, rnd() * 6.28, rnd() * 3], false);
        }
      };

      if (kind === 'erratic') {
        const R = 0.55 * s;
        add(roughenStone(new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(R, 1), 0.2, seed), stoneShade(type, 0.2),
          0, R * 0.62, 0, [1, 0.82 + rnd() * 0.2, 0.94 + rnd() * 0.2], [rnd() * 0.25, rnd() * 6.28, rnd() * 0.25]);
        const lumps = 1 + ((rnd() * 2) | 0);
        for (let i = 0; i < lumps; i++) {
          const a = rnd() * 6.28, lr = R * (0.3 + rnd() * 0.25);
          add(roughenStone(new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(lr, 0), 0.24, seed + 11 + i * 7),
            stoneShade(type, -0.1 + rnd() * 0.5),
            Math.cos(a) * R * 0.62, R * (0.35 + rnd() * 0.55), Math.sin(a) * R * 0.62,
            [1, 0.85, 1], [rnd() * 6.28, rnd() * 6.28, rnd() * 6.28]);
        }
        // Rounded stone holds soil, so an erratic is the mossiest of the five.
        mossAmt = damp * (0.5 + rnd() * 0.5);
        lichenAmt = 0.25 + rnd() * 0.45;
        scree(2 + ((rnd() * 3) | 0), R * 1.25, R * 0.16);
      } else if (kind === 'angular') {
        const R = 0.52 * s;
        add(roughenStone(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(R, 0), 0.15, seed), stoneShade(type, 0.25),
          0, R * 0.6, 0, [1.05, 0.9 + rnd() * 0.3, 1], [rnd() * 0.3, rnd() * 6.28, rnd() * 0.3]);
        // The sheared face: a flattened wedge cutting the profile off on one side.
        const wa = rnd() * 6.28;
        add(roughenStone(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(R * 0.78, 0), 0.1, seed + 5),
          stoneShade(type, 0.55),
          Math.cos(wa) * R * 0.34, R * 0.78, Math.sin(wa) * R * 0.34,
          [1.15, 0.42, 1.15], [0.18 + rnd() * 0.3, wa, 0.1]);
        for (let i = 0; i < 2 + ((rnd() * 2) | 0); i++) {
          const a = wa + 1.4 + rnd() * 3.4, sr = R * (0.16 + rnd() * 0.2);
          add(roughenStone(new THREE.TetrahedronGeometry(sr, 0), 0.2, seed + 31 + i * 9),
            stoneShade(type, -0.35 + rnd() * 0.4),
            Math.cos(a) * R * (0.9 + rnd() * 0.5), sr * 0.55, Math.sin(a) * R * (0.9 + rnd() * 0.5),
            [1.2, 0.85, 1.2], [rnd() * 1.2, rnd() * 6.28, rnd() * 1.2]);
        }
        // A fresh fracture has had less time to green over.
        mossAmt = damp * (0.15 + rnd() * 0.3);
        lichenAmt = 0.3 + rnd() * 0.4;
      } else if (kind === 'slab') {
        // Plates get thinner going up, each one is oblong rather than square, turned
        // off the last and shoved sideways so its edges overhang — bedded stone that
        // has shifted, rather than a tidy stack. The whole pile leans on one axis.
        const R = 0.62 * s;
        const layers = 2 + ((rnd() * 3) | 0);
        const tilt = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.3;
        const lean = rnd() * 6.28;
        let y = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < layers; i++) {
          const f = 1 - i * (0.12 + rnd() * 0.1);
          const th = R * (0.16 + rnd() * 0.12) * (1 - i * 0.1);
          const long = 1.5 + rnd() * 0.8;      // bedding planes are never square
          const wide = 0.95 + rnd() * 0.45;

          // soft, cloud-like light across the whole crown with the facets still there.
          const ox = (P[0] - crown.cx) / crown.rx, oy = (P[1] - crown.cy) / crown.ry, oz = (P[2] - crown.cz) / crown.rx;
          const ol = Math.hypot(ox, oy, oz) || 1;
          let nx = fx * 0.35 + U[0] * 0.3 + ox / ol * 0.85;
          let ny = fy * 0.35 + U[1] * 0.3 + oy / ol * 0.85;
          let nz = fz * 0.35 + U[2] * 0.3 + oz / ol * 0.85;
          const nl = Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz) || 1; nx /= nl; ny /= nl; nz /= nl;
          const up = 0.5 + 0.5 * (ny * 0.6 + (oy / ol) * 0.4);
          leafShade(base, up, Math.min(1, ol), speckle, _cl3);
          accVert(acc, P[0], P[1], P[2], nx, ny, nz, _cl3[0], _cl3[1], _cl3[2]);
        }
      }
      return { start, count: acc.p.length / 3 - start, center: new THREE.Vector3(cx, cy, cz), r: R * Math.max(sx, sy, sz) };
    }

    // One pine skirt: a drooping cone of needles with a star-shaped hem, and a dark,
    // hollow underside you see from below.
    function addSkirt(acc, y, R, H, points, rot, base, seed, crown) {
      const start = acc.p.length / 3;
      const apex = [(hash3(seed, 1, 2) - 0.5) * 0.08 * R, y + H, (hash3(seed, 3, 4) - 0.5) * 0.08 * R];
      const under = [0, y + H * 0.3, 0];
      const rim = [];
      const n = points * 2;
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        const a = rot + (k / n) * Math.PI * 2;
        const tip = (k % 2) === 0;
        const rr = R * (tip ? 1 + (hash3(seed, k, 9) - 0.5) * 0.18 : 0.66);
        const droop = tip ? R * (0.2 + hash3(seed, k, 5) * 0.12) : R * 0.02;
        rim.push([Math.cos(a) * rr, y - droop, Math.sin(a) * rr, tip]);
      }
      const push = (P, nx, ny, nz, up, out, spk) => {
        leafShade(base, up, out, spk, _cl3);
        accVert(acc, P[0], P[1], P[2], nx, ny, nz, _cl3[0], _cl3[1], _cl3[2]);
      };
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        const A = rim[k], B = rim[(k + 1) % n];
        const spk = (hash3(seed, k, 17) - 0.5) * 0.12;
        // Top face: normal leans outward from the trunk as much as up.
        for (const P of [apex, B, A]) {
          const hx = P[0], hz = P[2], hl = Math.hypot(hx, hz) || 1;
          const out = Math.min(1, hl / R);
          const nx = hx / hl * 0.6, ny = 0.8, nz = hz / hl * 0.6;
          const up = 0.55 + 0.45 * ((P[1] - crown.cy) / crown.ry * 0.5 + 0.5);
          const isTip = P[3] === true;
          push(P, nx, ny, nz, Math.min(1, up), isTip ? 1 : (P === apex ? 0.35 : out * 0.85), spk + (isTip ? 0.08 : 0));
        }
        // Underside: dark needles and shadow.
        for (const P of [under, A, B]) {
          const hx = P[0], hz = P[2], hl = Math.hypot(hx, hz) || 1;
          push(P, hx / hl * 0.4, -0.9, hz / hl * 0.4, 0.05, P === under ? 0.1 : 0.55, spk);
        }
      }
      return { start, count: acc.p.length / 3 - start, center: new THREE.Vector3(0, y + H * 0.35, 0), r: R };
    }

    // A tapered tube along a spine of points. `radius(i, a)` gives the radius at ring
    // i and angle a (roots and lobes); `color(i, a, y)` fills `out3`.
    const _tb = new THREE.Vector3(), _tn = new THREE.Vector3(), _tt = new THREE.Vector3(), _tq = new THREE.Vector3();
    function addTube(acc, spine, segs, radius, color, capTop) {
      const rings = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < spine.length; i++) {
        const P = spine[i], Pn = spine[Math.min(spine.length - 1, i + 1)], Pp = spine[Math.max(0, i - 1)];
        _tt.set(Pn[0] - Pp[0], Pn[1] - Pp[1], Pn[2] - Pp[2]).normalize();
        _tq.set(0, 1, 0);
        if (Math.abs(_tt.y) > 0.9) _tq.set(1, 0, 0);
        _tn.crossVectors(_tq, _tt).normalize();
        _tb.crossVectors(_tt, _tn).normalize();
        const ring = [];
        for (let j = 0; j <= segs; j++) {
          const a = (j / segs) * Math.PI * 2;
          const r = radius(i, a);
          const dx = _tn.x * Math.cos(a) + _tb.x * Math.sin(a);
          const dy = _tn.y * Math.cos(a) + _tb.y * Math.sin(a);
          const dz = _tn.z * Math.cos(a) + _tb.z * Math.sin(a);
          ring.push([P[0] + dx * r, P[1] + dy * r, P[2] + dz * r, dx, dy, dz, a]);
        }
        rings.push(ring);
      }
      const col = [0, 0, 0];
      const vert = (i, j) => {
        const q = rings[i][j];
        color(i, q[6], q[1], col);
        accVert(acc, q[0], q[1], q[2], q[3], q[4], q[5], col[0], col[1], col[2]);
      };
      for (let i = 0; i < rings.length - 1; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < segs; j++) {
          vert(i, j); vert(i, j + 1); vert(i + 1, j + 1);
          vert(i, j); vert(i + 1, j + 1); vert(i + 1, j);
        }
      }
      if (capTop) {
        const last = rings.length - 1, P = spine[last];
        color(last, 0, P[1], col);
        for (let j = 0; j < segs; j++) {
          const a = rings[last][j], b = rings[last][j + 1];
          accVert(acc, P[0], P[1], P[2], 0, 1, 0, col[0] * 1.1, col[1] * 1.1, col[2] * 1.1);
          accVert(acc, b[0], b[1], b[2], b[3], b[4] + 0.5, b[5], col[0], col[1], col[2]);
          accVert(acc, a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4] + 0.5, a[5], col[0], col[1], col[2]);
        }
      }
    }
    // A bent spine from `a` to `b`: `bow` pushes the middle along (bx, by, bz).
    function spineBetween(a, b, n, bow) {
      const out = [];
      for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        const t = i / n, k = Math.sin(t * Math.PI);
        out.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t + bow[0] * k, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t + bow[1] * k, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t + bow[2] * k]);
      }
      return out;
    }
    // Bark colour: streaked along the grain, darker and damper at the foot.
    function barkColor(kind, seed) {
      const [c0, c1, cDark] = BARK[kind].map((h) => new THREE.Color(h));
      return (i, a, y, out, t) => {
        const streak = vnoise3(Math.cos(a) * 1.6 + seed, y * 0.7, Math.sin(a) * 1.6 - seed);
        _lc.copy(c0).lerp(c1, streak);
        if (kind === 'birch') {
          // Lenticels: short dark horizontal dashes on white, and a black, cracked
          // base where the bark gets old.
          const dash = vnoise3(Math.cos(a) * 2.2 + seed, y * 3.2, Math.sin(a) * 2.2);
          if (dash > 0.62) _lc.lerp(cDark, Math.min(0.85, (dash - 0.62) * 4));
          const foot = Math.max(0, 1 - y / (0.9 + hash3(seed, 2, 2) * 0.4));
          _lc.lerp(cDark, foot * 0.75);
        } else {
          _lc.lerp(cDark, Math.max(0, 1 - y / 0.8) * 0.45);
          // A faint green of moss on one side of the lower trunk.
          const moss = Math.max(0, Math.cos(a - seed * 3)) * Math.max(0, 1 - y / 2.2) * (kind === 'oak' ? 0.35 : 0.15);
          _lc.r += (0.27 - _lc.r) * moss; _lc.g += (0.36 - _lc.g) * moss; _lc.b += (0.18 - _lc.b) * moss;
        }
        out[0] = _lc.r; out[1] = _lc.g; out[2] = _lc.b;
      };
    }

    // --- Species ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Each returns { wood (trunk acc, tree-local), crownWood (branches, canopy-local),
    // leaves (canopy acc), pieces, trunkH, trunkR, canopyBottom/Top/Radius, pivotY }.
    // Canopy-local = tree-local minus pivotY: the canopy group sits at the top of the
    // trunk, so wind sway and a hit bend the crown about the trunk, not the ground.
    function growTree(kind, scale, rnd) {
      const s = scale;
      const seed = rnd() * 100;
      const wood = makeAcc(), crownWood = makeAcc(), leaves = makeAcc();
      const pieces = [];
      const pal = paletteSets[kind].map((h) => new THREE.Color(h));
      const bark = barkColor(kind, seed);
      const pick = () => pal[Math.floor(rnd() * pal.length)];
      let trunkH, trunkR, top, bottom, radius, pivotY, crown;
      // The trunk's spine: a gentle random bend.
      const bendX = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.35 * s, bendZ = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.35 * s;
      const trunkSpine = (h, n) => {
        const out = [];
        for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) { const t = i / n; out.push([bendX * t * t, h * t, bendZ * t * t]); }
        return out;
      };
      const trunkAt = (y, h) => { const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, y / h)); return [bendX * t * t, y, bendZ * t * t]; };
      // Buttress roots: the foot of the trunk flares out in lobes.
      const lobes = 4 + Math.floor(rnd() * 3), lobeRot = rnd() * 6.28;
      const flare = (i, a, n, r0, r1, flareAmt) => {
        const t = i / n;
        const base = r0 + (r1 - r0) * t;
        const foot = Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - t * 3.2), 2);
        return base * (1 + foot * flareAmt * (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.max(0, Math.cos(a * lobes + lobeRot))));
      };

      if (kind === 'pine') {
        trunkH = 2.4 * s; trunkR = 0.24 * s;
        const H = trunkH + 2.7 * s;
        const n = 8;
        addTube(wood, trunkSpine(H * 0.92, n), 7, (i, a) => flare(i, a, n, trunkR, trunkR * 0.18, 0.9), bark, false);
        pivotY = trunkH * 0.6;
        bottom = trunkH * 0.55; top = H; radius = 1.55 * s;
        crown = { cx: bendX * 0.5, cy: (bottom + top) / 2 - pivotY, cz: bendZ * 0.5, rx: radius, ry: (top - bottom) / 2 };
        const tiers = 6 + (s > 1.2 ? 1 : 0);
        for (let i = 0; i < tiers; i++) {
          const t = i / (tiers - 1);
          const y = bottom + 0.15 * s + t * (H - bottom - 1.1 * s);
          const R = (1.55 - t * 1.2) * s * (0.92 + rnd() * 0.16);
          const at = trunkAt(y, H);
          const p = addSkirt(leaves, y - pivotY, R, (0.95 - t * 0.25) * s, 8 + (i < 3 ? 2 : 0), rnd() * 6.28, pal[i % pal.length], seed + i * 11, crown);
          // Skirts sit on the bent trunk.
          const arr = leaves.p;
          for (let v = p.start; v < p.start + p.count; v++) { arr[v * 3] += at[0]; arr[v * 3 + 2] += at[2]; }
          p.center.x += at[0]; p.center.z += at[2];
          pieces.push(p);
        }
        // A little leader spike at the very top.
        {
          const at = trunkAt(H - 0.4 * s, H);
          const p = addSkirt(leaves, H - 0.55 * s - pivotY, 0.32 * s, 0.75 * s, 6, rnd() * 6.28, pal[3], seed + 99, crown);
          const arr = leaves.p;
          for (let v = p.start; v < p.start + p.count; v++) { arr[v * 3] += at[0]; arr[v * 3 + 2] += at[2]; }
          p.center.x += at[0]; p.center.z += at[2];
          pieces.push(p);
        }
      } else {
        // Broadleaves share one recipe with different proportions.
        const P = {
          oak: { th: 1.9, tr: 0.33, top: 2.45, rad: 2.15, n: 13, cr: [0.68, 0.98], sy: 0.85, dome: 0.62, br: 5, flare: 1.1, droop: 0, spread: 0.55 },
          autumn: { th: 2.0, tr: 0.29, top: 2.25, rad: 1.85, n: 12, cr: [0.6, 0.88], sy: 0.9, dome: 0.75, br: 4, flare: 0.8, droop: 0, spread: 0.55 },
          birch: { th: 2.8, tr: 0.16, top: 2.05, rad: 1.5, n: 10, cr: [0.5, 0.72], sy: 1.3, dome: 0.9, br: 5, flare: 0.5, droop: 0.4, spread: 0.55 }
        }[kind];
        trunkH = P.th * s; trunkR = P.tr * s;
        top = trunkH + P.top * s; radius = P.rad * s;
        const crownCY = trunkH + (P.top * 0.45) * s;
        const crownRY = P.top * 0.55 * s;
        pivotY = trunkH * 0.85;
        const tt = trunkAt(trunkH, trunkH);
        crown = { cx: tt[0], cy: crownCY - pivotY, cz: tt[2], rx: radius * 0.85, ry: crownRY };
        const n = kind === 'birch' ? 14 : 7;
        const trunkTop = trunkH + (kind === 'birch' ? 1.0 : 0.55) * s;
        addTube(wood, trunkSpine(trunkTop, n), kind === 'birch' ? 7 : 9,
          (i, a) => flare(i, a, n, trunkR, trunkR * (kind === 'birch' ? 0.35 : 0.55), P.flare), bark, true);
        // Clump positions over a dome, golden-angle spaced, lower ones further out.
        const spots = [];
        const golden = 2.39996, rot0 = rnd() * 6.28;
        for (let i = 0; i < P.n; i++) {
          const t = (i + 0.5) / P.n;
          const el = Math.asin(1 - t * (1 + P.dome)) ; // from the crown top down past the equator
          const az = rot0 + i * golden;
          const rr = Math.cos(el) * radius * (P.spread + rnd() * 0.2);
          let y = crownCY + Math.sin(el) * crownRY * 0.8 + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.25 * s;
          if (P.droop) y -= P.droop * s * (1 - Math.sin(el)) * 0.9;
          spots.push({ x: tt[0] + Math.cos(az) * rr, y, z: tt[2] + Math.sin(az) * rr, r: (P.cr[0] + rnd() * (P.cr[1] - P.cr[0])) * s * (1 - t * 0.12) });
        }
        // A core clump over the trunk so the crown is never hollow from below.
        spots.push({ x: tt[0], y: crownCY - crownRY * 0.1, z: tt[2], r: P.cr[1] * s * 1.05 });
        // Branches: from the upper trunk out into the lower, outer clumps.
        const lower = spots.slice(0, -1).sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y).slice(0, P.br + 3).sort(() => rnd() - 0.5).slice(0, P.br);
        for (let b = 0; b < lower.length; b++) {
          const sp = lower[b];
          const y0 = trunkH * (0.62 + b * 0.07);
          const a = trunkAt(y0, trunkH);
          const end = [sp.x * 0.85 + a[0] * 0.15, sp.y - sp.r * 0.35, sp.z * 0.85 + a[2] * 0.15];
          // Part of the trunk's mesh (one draw fewer a tree). Their tips sit well
          // inside the clumps, so the crown's small sway never shows the join.
          const spn = spineBetween([a[0], y0, a[2]], [end[0], end[1], end[2]], 3, [0, 0.25 * s, 0]);
          const r0 = trunkR * 0.42, r1 = trunkR * 0.12;
          addTube(wood, spn, 5, (i) => r0 + (r1 - r0) * (i / 3), (i, a2, y, out) => bark(i, a2, y + 1.5, out), false);
        }
        // One main colour per tree, each clump drifting from it: a crown reads as one
        // tree, not a patchwork (autumn keeps more spread — maples turn unevenly).
        const main = pick();
        for (let i = 0; i < spots.length; i++) {
          const sp = spots[i];
          const col = main.clone().lerp(pick(), kind === 'autumn' ? 0.55 : 0.4);
          // The top of an autumn crown turns first.
          if (kind === 'autumn' && sp.y > crownCY) col.lerp(pal[3], 0.3);
          const p = addClump(leaves, sp.x, sp.y - pivotY, sp.z, sp.r, 1, P.sy, 1, col, seed + i * 13.7, crown);
          pieces.push(p);
        }
        bottom = Math.min(...spots.map((sp) => sp.y - sp.r * P.sy * 0.7));
        top = Math.max(...spots.map((sp) => sp.y + sp.r * P.sy * 0.95));
      }
      return { wood, crownWood, leaves, pieces, trunkH, trunkR, canopyBottom: bottom, canopyTop: top, canopyRadius: radius, pivotY };
    }

    // Built once per species at a unit scale and seed would be cheaper, but every tree
    // being its own shape is the point; 430 trees take a few hundred ms here.
    function buildTreeMeshes(kind, scale, rnd) {
      const T = growTree(kind, scale, rnd);
      const trunkMesh = new THREE.Mesh(accToGeometry(T.wood), treeWoodMat);
      trunkMesh.castShadow = true; trunkMesh.receiveShadow = true;
      const crownWoodMesh = T.crownWood.p.length ? new THREE.Mesh(accToGeometry(T.crownWood), treeWoodMat) : null;
      if (crownWoodMesh) { crownWoodMesh.castShadow = true; crownWoodMesh.receiveShadow = true; }
      const leafGeo = accToGeometry(T.leaves);
      return { T, trunkMesh, crownWoodMesh, leafGeo };
    }

    const barkDarkMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2e1c0e, roughness: 0.98 });
    const mossMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x4a7a3a, roughness: 1 });

    // Bark/root/branch geometry merges into one vertex-coloured mesh per tree.
    const woodMergedMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.95 });

    // === Merged canopies ========================================================
    // Canopy foliage was 2,612 of the scene's ~6,600 meshes: every tree carried five to
    // eight separate blobs, each its own draw. They could not simply be merged, because
    // shooting a tree strips its canopy one blob at a time and a merged canopy has no
    // blobs to strip.
    //
    // First attempt was an InstancedMesh per canopy. On a real GPU that turned out to
    // be wrong in a way the headless harness could not see: three's WebGPU renderer
    // built one uniform buffer for the instance matrices per *program*, and since every
    // canopy's material is structurally identical, every tree with the same blob count
    // drew with the FIRST such tree's matrices and colours. Orange autumn crowns
    // floating over birches. Backed out.
    //
    // This is the approach that cannot have that problem, because it uses nothing but
    // the plain Mesh + BufferGeometry + vertexColors path the trunks already use: the
    // blobs are merged into one geometry per tree, exactly like mergeParts, but each
    // blob's vertex range is remembered. Destroying a blob collapses its vertices to its
    // centre (degenerate triangles draw nothing); shrinking the survivors scales theirs
    // about their centres. Both are a buffer write that happens on a hit — a discrete
    // event, not per frame — and never a shader rebuild. One draw per canopy, down from
    // five to eight.
    //
    // While the colours are being baked per vertex anyway, two cheap shading terms go
    // in: a hemispheric term (up-facing faces a little lighter, undersides a little
    // darker) and a mild vertical gradient across the canopy. Low-poly foliage reads
    // as far more solid with them, and they cost nothing at runtime.
    //
    // ?canopy=legacy restores the old per-blob canopy.
    const CANOPY_LEGACY = /[?&]canopy=legacy(&|=|$)/i.test(location.search);
    const _canopyWorld = new THREE.Vector3();
    const _mcV = new THREE.Vector3();
    const _mcN = new THREE.Vector3();

    function mergeCanopy(canopy, canopyMat) {
      const children = canopy.children.slice();
      const prepared = [];
      let total = 0;
      let yMin = Infinity, yMax = -Infinity;
      for (const ch of children) {
        const geo = ch.geometry.index ? ch.geometry.toNonIndexed() : ch.geometry;
        total += geo.attributes.position.count;
        prepared.push({ geo, mesh: ch });
        const r = (ch.geometry.parameters && (ch.geometry.parameters.radius || ch.geometry.parameters.height / 2)) || 1;
        yMin = Math.min(yMin, ch.position.y - r);
        yMax = Math.max(yMax, ch.position.y + r);
      }
      const span = Math.max(0.01, yMax - yMin);
      const positions = new Float32Array(total * 3);
      const normals = new Float32Array(total * 3);
      const colors = new Float32Array(total * 3);
      const pieces = [];
      let o = 0;
      for (const { geo, mesh } of prepared) {
        mesh.updateMatrix();
        const pos = geo.attributes.position, nrm = geo.attributes.normal;
        const col = mesh.material.color;
        const start = o;
        for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
          const w = (o + i) * 3;
          _mcV.fromBufferAttribute(pos, i).applyMatrix4(mesh.matrix);
          positions[w] = _mcV.x; positions[w + 1] = _mcV.y; positions[w + 2] = _mcV.z;
          if (nrm) { _mcN.fromBufferAttribute(nrm, i).normalize(); } else { _mcN.set(0, 1, 0); }
          normals[w] = _mcN.x; normals[w + 1] = _mcN.y; normals[w + 2] = _mcN.z;
          // Hemispheric shading + vertical gradient, both mild.
          const hemi = 0.86 + 0.14 * (0.5 + 0.5 * _mcN.y);
          const grad = 0.90 + 0.10 * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (_mcV.y - yMin) / span));
          const k = hemi * grad;
          colors[w] = col.r * k; colors[w + 1] = col.g * k; colors[w + 2] = col.b * k;
        }
        pieces.push({
          start, count: pos.count,
          center: mesh.position.clone(),
          base: positions.slice(start * 3, (start + pos.count) * 3),
          colorHex: col.getHex(),
          visible: true, shrink: 1
        });
        o += pos.count;
      }
      const merged = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      merged.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
      merged.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
      merged.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
      merged.computeBoundingSphere();
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(merged, canopyMat);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      for (const p of pieces) p.mesh = null, p.geo = merged;
      for (const ch of children) canopy.remove(ch);
      canopy.add(mesh);
      return { pieces, mesh };
    }

    // Rewrites one blob's vertex range: collapsed to its centre when hidden, scaled
    // about its centre otherwise. A buffer upload, never a shader rebuild.
    function writeLeafPiece(piece) {
      const s = piece.visible ? piece.shrink : 0;
      const arr = piece.geo.attributes.position.array;
      const base = piece.base, c = piece.center;
      const o = piece.start * 3;
      for (let i = 0; i < base.length; i += 3) {
        arr[o + i] = c.x + (base[i] - c.x) * s;
        arr[o + i + 1] = c.y + (base[i + 1] - c.y) * s;
        arr[o + i + 2] = c.z + (base[i + 2] - c.z) * s;
      }
      piece.geo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
    }

    // One accessor set so the gameplay code below doesn't care which mode it is in.
    function leafPieceY(p) { return p.mesh ? p.mesh.position.y : p.center.y; }
    function leafPieceVisible(p) { return p.mesh ? p.mesh.visible : p.visible; }
    function leafPieceColorHex(p) {
      if (p.mesh) return (p.mesh.material && p.mesh.material.color) ? p.mesh.material.color.getHex() : 0x5b7a3a;

        const h = sampleHeight(x, z);

        if (!t.alive || t.falling || t.stump) continue;

    // and skin. dressMarine = CU-70's applyWardrobe (camo, boots) + dressParts; dressWorld calls it. ===
    const DRESS_HAIR = { black: 0x16130f, darkBrown: 0x3a2c1e, brown: 0x6b4a2b, auburn: 0x7c3b1d, blond: 0xc9a466, grey: 0x8c8a84 };

    const DRESS_SKIN = [0xf2d3b8, 0xe2bc98, 0xd3b08a, 0xc4a882, 0x8f6a4a, 0x5c4030];   // light to dark; 3 is the original
    const DRESS = {
      cap: WARDROBE_LISTS.CAP_STYLES, eyewear: WARDROBE_LISTS.EYEWEAR_STYLES, sleeves: WARDROBE_LISTS.SLEEVES,
      cut: WARDROBE_LISTS.TROUSER_CUTS, boots: BOOT_HEX, hair: DRESS_HAIR, eyes: DRESS_EYES, skin: DRESS_SKIN,
    };
    const eyewearMats = {
      gold: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xc9a85c, roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.85 }),
      aviLens: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x3a4a3a, roughness: 0.08, metalness: 0.8, emissive: 0x0c140e, emissiveIntensity: 0.4 }),
      viperFrame: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xeeeeea, roughness: 0.35, metalness: 0.1 }),
      viperLens: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x7a2fa0, roughness: 0.08, metalness: 0.9, emissive: 0x2a1060, emissiveIntensity: 0.35 }),
      wayFrame: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x0e0e0e, roughness: 0.28, metalness: 0.1 }),
      wayLens: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x151a1c, roughness: 0.1, metalness: 0.6 }),
      gogFrame: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x7d6d4f, roughness: 0.7, metalness: 0.05 }),
      gogLens: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2a2e30, roughness: 0.1, metalness: 0.65 }),

    };
    function dressParts(m, state) {
      const d = m && m.userData && m.userData.dress;
      if (!d) return;
      const it = (state && state.items) || {}, body = (state && state.body) || {};
      const pick = (list, v) => (list.includes(v) ? v : list[0]);
      const hat = pick(DRESS.cap, it.cap && it.cap.style);
      for (const k of Object.keys(d.hats)) d.hats[k].visible = k === hat;
      const eye = pick(DRESS.eyewear, it.eyewear && it.eyewear.style);
      for (const k of Object.keys(d.eyes)) d.eyes[k].visible = k === eye;

    // TT.dressMarine(marine, wardrobe): the whole wardrobe on any marine (the profile's when none is given).

    }
    // CL-97 part 2: camo on each gun's furniture (the stock, grip and handguard: its wood and polymer), one pick per
    // gun (wardrobe.guns). Metal stays metal. Each gun gets its own copies of the furniture materials once, with
    // camo UVs at the marine's scale; the offhand, carry and rack copies are clones, so they share them.
    let gunFurniture = null;
    function registerGunFurniture(guns) {
      const FURNITURE = new Set([woodMat, woodDark, gunPoly, gunOlive, gunTan]);
      const out = {};
      for (const [id, gun] of Object.entries(guns)) {
        const copies = new Map();
        gun.traverse((o) => {
          if (!o.isMesh || Array.isArray(o.material) || !FURNITURE.has(o.material)) return;
          let c = copies.get(o.material);
          if (!c) { c = o.material.clone(); c.name = 'furniture:' + id; c.userData.issueColor = c.color.getHex(); copies.set(o.material, c); }
          o.material = c;
          const src = o.geometry.index ? o.geometry.toNonIndexed() : o.geometry.clone();
          const P = src.attributes.position, uv = new Float32Array(P.count * 2);
          boxProjectUV(P.array, uv);
          src.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.BufferAttribute(uv, 2));
          o.geometry = src;
        });
        out[id] = [...copies.values()];
      }
      return out;
    }
    function dressGuns(state) {
      if (!gunFurniture) return;

      for (const [id, mats] of Object.entries(gunFurniture)) {
        const key = picks[id];
        const tex = key && isGunFinishKey(key) ? camoTile(key) : null;   // CL-111: or the rune finish, once it is his
        const rune = tex && key === RUNE_FINISH_KEY;
        for (const mat of mats) {
          mat.map = tex;
          if (mat.emissive) {   // the rune finish's faint light at night; every other finish has none
            mat.emissiveMap = rune ? runeFinish.glowTex : null;
            mat.emissive.setHex(rune ? 0xffffff : 0x000000);
            mat.emissiveIntensity = rune ? 0.55 * Math.max(0, runeFinish.level) : 1;

        }

    }

    function makeMarine({ legacyBody = false } = {}) {
      const g = new THREE.Group();

      const buckleMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x7a7c74, roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.6 });
      const padMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x3a3f33, roughness: 0.85, metalness: 0.1 });
      const put = (parent, mesh, x, y, z, rx = 0, ry = 0, rz = 0) => { mesh.position.set(x, y, z); mesh.rotation.set(rx, ry, rz); parent.add(mesh); return mesh; };
      const cyl = (rt, rb, h, mat, seg = 10) => addCast(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rt, rb, h, seg), mat));
      // CL-94 (D-64, D-66): every wearable item has its own material for its main surface, so the

        let c = m.get(base);

        return c;
      };

      const capW = wear('cap')(coverMat), capBandW = wear('cap')(camoOD), shellW = wear('helmet')(coverMat);

      const packW = wear('pack')(camoGreen), packTrimW = wear('pack')(camoOD), padW = wear('pads')(padMat), plateW = wear('pads')(plateMat);
      // GP-163: shared fine weave/leather response preserves each live wardrobe color.

        cloth: [uniformW, trouserW, maskW, capW, shellW, carrierW, carrierPouchW, packW, packTrimW, beltW, holsterW],

      bootW.userData.dress = 'colour';
