      const dress = { hats: {}, eyes: {}, sleeveDown: [], sleeveRolled: [], legLong: [], legShort: [], gloveOn: [], handBare: [], mats: { skin: skinW, hair: hairW, iris: irisW } };
      const part = (parent, list) => { const grp = new THREE.Group(); parent.add(grp); if (list) list.push(grp); return grp; };

          mats: {uniformW, trouserW, bootW, soleW, gloveW, beltW, holsterW,

      } else {

      hipGrip = put(lowerBody, rmesh(0.035, 0.05, 0.045, leatherMat, 0.012), -0.23, 0.6, 0.055);   // pistol grip showing (CL-90 hides it: the real pistol sits there)

    function punchBodyRecoil(scale) {

          reloadArmOffL.x = reloadArmOffL.y = reloadArmOffL.z = 0;
          reloadElbowOffR.x = reloadElbowOffR.y = reloadElbowOffR.z = 0;
          reloadElbowOffL.x = reloadElbowOffL.y = reloadElbowOffL.z = 0;

      const count = Math.max(1, n | 0);
      const rnd = mulberry32(15);
      const cx = 0, cz = 18;
      let made = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = rnd() * Math.PI * 2;
        const r = 4 + rnd() * 18;
        const z = spawnZombie(cx + Math.cos(a) * r, cz + Math.sin(a) * r, 'shambler', true, true);

      resetPerf();

    }
    function runDevCommand(raw) {
      const cmd = String(raw || '').replace(/[`~]/g, '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
      if (!cmd) return;

        devInfiniteCash = true;
        bigtexWheel = true;   // CL-113: the one exception to the wheel's five spaces

        if (typeof grantAllWeapons === 'function') grantAllWeapons();
        updateCoinHud();
        updateHpHud();
        updateAmmoHud();
        showBanner('BIGTEX SHOOTER', 'Everything unlocked · Unlimited cash', 2.6, '#ffd24a');
        AudioSys.sellChime();
      } else if (cmd === 'dapper dan') {
        debugTouched = true;   // A console unlock is never an earned badge or camo.

      } else if (cmd === 'bigtex shooter off' || cmd === 'broke') {
        devInfiniteCash = false;
        bigtexWheel = false;   // CL-113
        if (gameStarted && !weaponInReach(currentWeapon)) setWeapon(WEAPON_ORDER.indexOf('pistol'));
        bank = 0;
        updateCoinHud();
        showBanner('CASH CHEAT OFF', '', 2, '#ffb347');
      } else if (cmd === 'rip') {
        // Instant death (godmode or not), straight into the burial.
        if (gameStarted && !gameOver && !won) {
          devGodMode = false;
          lastDeathCause = null;   // a dev command is not one of the catalogued deaths
          playerHp = 0; updateHpHud();

        }
      } else if (cmd === 'godmode') {
        devGodMode = true;
        playerHp = PLAYER_MAX_HP;
        playerArmor = armorMax();
        updateHpHud();
        showBanner('GODMODE', 'Invincible', 2.2, '#ffd24a');
      } else if (cmd === 'godmode off') {
        devGodMode = false;
        showBanner('GODMODE OFF', '', 1.8, '#ffb347');
      } else if (cmd === 'megaswarm' || cmd.indexOf('megaswarm ') === 0) {
        const n = cmd === 'megaswarm' ? 500 : (parseInt(cmd.slice(10), 10) || 500);
        const made = spawnMegaswarm(n);
        showBanner('MEGASWARM', made + ' shamblers', 2.2, '#ffb347');
      } else if (cmd === 'horde') {
        // Claude 2026-09-27: where the horde is when it "vanishes": counts by what could hide it.
        const r = hordeReport();
        showBanner('HORDE', r.line, 6, '#9ad0ff');
        console.log('[horde]', r);
      } else if (cmd === 'bench') {
        devBench();
      } else if (cmd === 'nodead') {
        devNoZombies = true;
        clearZombies();
        waveQueue = [];
        caveByIndex = [];
        wavePreview = null;
        waveSpawned = 0;
        waveTotal = 0;
        zombiesRemaining = 0;
        if (typeof warnActiveCaves === 'function') warnActiveCaves(0);
        else if (typeof caveWarn === 'function' && POI.caves) for (let i = 0; i < POI.caves.length; i++) caveWarn(i, 0);
        updateWaveHud();
        showBanner('NODEAD', 'Zombies and waves disabled', 2.4, '#7cdea0');
      } else if (cmd === 'swarm') {

      } else if (cmd === 'basebuild') {
        devBaseBuild();
      } else if (cmd === 'nodead off' || cmd === 'godead') {
        // "godead" is the other half of "nodead": the day/wave clock starts again and

        devNoZombies = false;
        updateWaveHud();
        showBanner(cmd === 'godead' ? 'GODEAD' : 'NODEAD OFF', 'Zombies and waves are back', 2.2, '#ff7a5a');
      } else if (cmd === 'night ops') {
        worldTime = 0.02; // just after midnight
        hoursSinceDawn = Math.max(hoursSinceDawn, DAWN_GRACE_HOURS);

      } else if (cmd === 'shower') {

        weather.rainTimeLeft = 90;
        weather.intensity = Math.max(weather.intensity, 0.12);
        updateDayNight(0);
        updateWeather(0);
        showBanner('SHOWER', 'Storm rolling in', 2.4, '#a9bdcf');
      } else if (cmd === 'strike' || cmd === 'strike me' || cmd === 'strike tree' || cmd === 'strike dead') {
        // CL-92: a bolt now: off in the trees, on him, into a tree near him, or among the nearest dead.

        showBanner('STRIKE', r.target + (r.killed ? ' · ' + r.killed + ' dead' : '') + (r.saved ? ' · the boots held' : ''), 1.6, '#eaf4ff');
      } else if (cmd === 'rabbit') {
        // CL-93: wake the mound's rabbit (it comes for you wherever you are within 45 m), or say where the mound is.
        ensureRabbitMound();
        const S = rabbitMound.site;
        if (S && Math.hypot(S.x - localPlayer.position.x, S.z - localPlayer.position.z) > RABBIT.GIVE_UP_R) {
          const tx = S.x + Math.sin(S.yaw) * 12, tz = S.z + Math.cos(S.yaw) * 12;   // 12 m in front of its mouth
          localPlayer.position.set(tx, sampleHeight(tx, tz), tz);
        }
        wakeKillerRabbit();
        showBanner('RABBIT', 'Something stirs in the mound', 2.0, '#f4f2ee');
      } else if (cmd === 'holy') {
        ensureRabbitMound();
        rabbitMound.holy = true;
        if (rabbitMound.reliquary) rabbitMound.reliquary.userData.grenade.visible = false;
        showBanner('HOLY', 'The holy grenade is yours (it waits in the graveyard tree\u2019s roots)', 2.4, '#ffe28a');
      } else if (cmd === 'rune') {
        // CL-111: grant the rune finish and put it on every gun (the CIF's gun tab can change it back).
        unlockRuneFinish();
        let next = wardrobeState;
        for (const id of WARDROBE_LISTS.GUNS || []) next = withGun(next, id, RUNE_FINISH_KEY, isGunFinishKey) || next;
        commitWardrobe(next);
        showBanner('RUNE', 'The rune finish is yours, on every gun', 2.2, '#9eeeff');
      } else if (cmd === 'boots') {
        wearInsulatedBoots(localPlayer);
        showBanner('BOOTS', 'Insulated boots on (they wait at the radio mast)', 2.2, '#f2d35a');
      } else if (cmd === 'reset') {
        resetMatchToSpawn();
      } else if (/^night \d+( now)?$/.test(cmd)) {
        devJumpToNight(parseInt(cmd.slice(6), 10), / now$/.test(cmd));

    }

    // Jerry (2026-10-06): "night 5" jumps the run to night 5 for a playthrough: the day before it (shop and build,
    // then sound the alarm at the HQ panel when ready), with that night's plan, its gun stock and its moon; "night 5
    // now" starts the night at once. Whatever was out there is cleared. A console jump is never an earned badge
    // (debugTouched). Nights 1 to 20 (20 is the extraction).
    const NIGHT_JUMP_MAX = 20;
    let nightJumpQuiet = false;   // startPrep skips the "night cleared" card for a night that wasn't played
    function devJumpToNight(n, now) {
      const no = (why) => { showBanner('NIGHT', why, 2, '#ff5a44'); AudioSys.invalid(); return false; };
      if (!gameStarted || gameOver || won) return no('Start a run first');
      if (training.active) return no('Not in the Training Ground');
      if (hollow && hollow.state().below) return no('Come up out of the Hollows first');
      if (scriptedKill || hq.seq || loopCine) return no('Wait a moment and try again');
      n = Math.max(1, Math.min(NIGHT_JUMP_MAX, n | 0));
      debugTouched = true;
      if (paused) setPaused(false);
      clearZombies();
      phase = 'idle';
      finisherJustEnded = false;
      day = n - 1;
      nightClearedDay = day;   // no dawn for a night he didn't play
      nightJumpQuiet = true;
      try { startPrep(); } finally { nightJumpQuiet = false; }
      updateWaveHud();
      if (now) { skipPrep(); showBanner('NIGHT ' + day, 'Here they come', 2.6, '#ff7a5a'); }
      else showBanner('NIGHT ' + day, 'Get ready, then sound the alarm at the HQ panel', 3, '#ffd24a');
      return true;
    }

    // "bench": the stress test — the whole base up, a hundred zombies on it, and
    // twenty-five seconds of frame times recorded. Reports average and 1% low fps,
    // draw calls and triangles, on screen and in the console.
    let benchT = -1, benchFrames = [], benchLast = 0, benchDraws = 0, benchTris = 0;
    function devBench() {
      if (!gameStarted || gameOver || won) return;
      unlockAllBuilds();
      bank += 200000; updateCoinHud();
      if (builds.length < 200) devBaseBuild();
      if (!devGodMode) runDevCommand('godmode');
      devSwarm();
      showPerf = true;
      benchT = 0; benchFrames = []; benchLast = 0; benchDraws = 0; benchTris = 0;
      showBanner('BENCHMARK', 'Recording 25 seconds \u2014 stand and watch', 3, '#7cdea0');
    }
    function updateBench() {
      if (benchT < 0) return;
      const now = (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.now) ? performance.now() : Date.now();
      if (benchLast) { const ms = now - benchLast; benchT += ms / 1000; if (ms < 1000) benchFrames.push(ms); }
      benchLast = now;
      {
        // Read the counters every frame: they are reset per frame, so reading them at
        // the end of the run only ever saw zero.
        const inf = (renderer.info && renderer.info.render) || {};
        const d = inf.drawCalls != null ? inf.drawCalls : (inf.calls || 0);
        if (d > benchDraws) benchDraws = d;
        if ((inf.triangles || 0) > benchTris) benchTris = inf.triangles;
      }
      if (benchT < 25) return;
      benchT = -1;
      const f = benchFrames.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b);
      if (!f.length) return;
      const sum = f.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
      const avg = 1000 / (sum / f.length);
      const p99 = 1000 / f[Math.floor(f.length * 0.99)];      // the 1% worst frames
      const p95 = 1000 / f[Math.floor(f.length * 0.95)];
      const line = 'avg ' + avg.toFixed(1) + ' fps \u00b7 5% low ' + p95.toFixed(1) + ' \u00b7 1% low ' + p99.toFixed(1) +
        ' \u00b7 worst ' + f[f.length - 1].toFixed(0) + 'ms \u00b7 ' + benchDraws + ' draws \u00b7 ' +
        (benchTris / 1000).toFixed(0) + 'k tris \u00b7 ' + builds.length + ' pieces \u00b7 ' +
        zombies.filter((z) => z.alive).length + ' alive';
      showBanner('BENCHMARK', line, 8, '#7cdea0');
      console.info('Grave Shift bench: ' + line);
      benchResult = line;
    }
    let benchResult = null;

    // "swarm": a hundred zombies of every kind rise in a ring fifty metres out and all
    // come for the marine at once — whatever the wave clock is doing, nodead or not,
    // and past the usual cap on how many can be up at once.
    function devSwarm() {
      endZombieGrace();
      // Scripted encounter actors belong to their own sequence, never the horde.
      const types = Object.keys(ZOMBIE_TYPES).filter(key => key !== 'caveguard');
      const px = player.position.x, pz = player.position.z;
      let made = 0;
      for (let tries = 0; made < 100 && tries < 400; tries++) {
        let tk = types[made % types.length];
        if (tk === 'colossus' && made >= types.length) tk = 'shambler';   // one colossus is plenty
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, r = 46 + Math.random() * 8;
        const c = clampToLand(px + Math.cos(a) * r, pz + Math.sin(a) * r, 3);
        if (waterDepthAt(c.x, c.z) > 0.3 && !ZOMBIE_TYPES[tk].aquatic) continue;
        const zz = spawnZombie(c.x, c.z, tk, true);
        if (!zz) continue;
        zz.huntPlayer = true;
        made++;
      }
      showBanner('SWARM', made + ' zombies closing in from 50m', 2.6, '#ff5a44');
      AudioSys.invalid();
    }

    // "basebuild": puts up a two-storey test base just ahead of the marine with one of
    // everything in it — boarded ground floor, walls with a door and windows, a
    // stairwell, an upper floor with railings, a room and a roof up top, platforms
    // with every turret, a mortar, pillars, and a belt of sandbags, wire, barricades,
    // spike traps, mines, a drum and a beacon outside. Free, and it unlocks every
    // blueprint so the pieces can be added to by hand.
    function devBaseBuild() {
      unlockAllBuilds();
      const pgx = gridIndex(player.position.x), pgz = gridIndex(player.position.z);
      const W = 6, D = 6;
      // The compound: the three-storey keep (cells 0..W-1 x 0..D-1) inside a walled
      // yard (PX0..PX1 x PZ0..PZ1), and outside that wall a killing field RINGS deep.
      const PX0 = -6, PX1 = W + 5, PZ0 = -5, PZ1 = D + 6, RINGS = 6;
      const GATE = 2;                      // the gate column, in line with the keep door
      const FEATHER = 10;                  // metres of slope back into the land round the lot
      // The lot in world metres (cell edges), killing field included.
      const lotOf = (x0, z0) => ({
        x0: gridCentre(x0 + PX0 - RINGS) - BUILD_GRID / 2, x1: gridCentre(x0 + PX1 + RINGS) + BUILD_GRID / 2,
        z0: gridCentre(z0 + PZ0 - RINGS) - BUILD_GRID / 2, z1: gridCentre(z0 + PZ1 + RINGS) + BUILD_GRID / 2
      });
      // A site is usable when the lot (and the slope round it) stays on the map, off
      // the water, clear of the cabin, the tower, bridges and the dock, and anything
      // else that cannot be knocked down. Fences, camps, sheds, signs and the like are
      // cleared off it. Returns how uneven the ground is, or -1 when it will not do.
      const siteScore = (x0, z0) => {
        const L = lotOf(x0, z0), m = FEATHER * 0.6;
        for (const [cx, cz] of [[L.x0 - m, L.z0 - m], [L.x1 + m, L.z0 - m], [L.x0 - m, L.z1 + m], [L.x1 + m, L.z1 + m]]) {
          if (Math.hypot(cx, cz) > landRadius - 4) return -1;
        }
        const inLot = (x, z, pad) => x > L.x0 - pad && x < L.x1 + pad && z > L.z0 - pad && z < L.z1 + pad;
        if (house.present) {
          const hx = house.group.position.x, hz = house.group.position.z;
          if (inLot(hx, hz, house.half + 3)) return -1;
        }
        if (tower && inLot(tower.x, tower.z, 4)) return -1;
        for (const ws of worldSolids) {
          if (ws.landmark || ws.rubble || ws.build) continue;
          if (inLot(ws.x, ws.z, ws.radius + 1)) return -1;
        }
        for (const pd of platforms) if (!pd.build && inLot(pd.x, pd.z, Math.max(pd.hw, pd.hl) + 2)) return -1;
        let lo = Infinity, hi = -Infinity;
        for (let x = L.x0 - m; x <= L.x1 + m; x += 3) for (let z = L.z0 - m; z <= L.z1 + m; z += 3) {
          if (waterDepthAt(x, z) > 0 || distToRiver(x, z) < RIVER_WIDTH * 1.5 + 4 || distToStream(x, z) < STREAM_WIDTH * 1.5 + 4) return -1;
          if (inLot(x, z, 0)) { const h = sampleHeight(x, z); if (h < lo) lo = h; if (h > hi) hi = h; }
        }
        return hi - lo;
      };
      // Nearest usable site to the marine; among the first few found, the flattest.
      let ox = pgx + 2, oz = pgz - 3, best = Infinity, found = 0;
      search: for (let r = 0; r <= 45; r++) {
        for (let a = 0; a < 16; a++) {
          const cx = pgx + 2 + Math.round(Math.cos(a * Math.PI / 8) * r * 2), cz = pgz - 3 + Math.round(Math.sin(a * Math.PI / 8) * r * 2);
          const sc = siteScore(cx, cz);
          if (sc < 0) continue;
          if (sc < best) { best = sc; ox = cx; oz = cz; }
          found++;
        }
        if (found >= 6 || (found && best < 1.5)) break search;
      }
      const lot = lotOf(ox, oz);
      // Clear the lot. Trees and rocks go, and so does anything a player would
      // otherwise have to knock down first: fences, camps, sheds, signs, drums, and
      // the rubble of anything already knocked down.
      const inLot = (x, z, pad = 0) => x > lot.x0 - pad && x < lot.x1 + pad && z > lot.z0 - pad && z < lot.z1 + pad;
      for (const t of trees) {
        if (!inLot(t.x, t.z, 1)) continue;
        t.alive = false; t.falling = false; t.stump = false;
        if (t.group) t.group.visible = false;
        if (t.stumpMesh) t.stumpMesh.visible = false;
      }
      for (const r of rocks) {
        if (!inLot(r.x, r.z, 1)) continue;
        r.alive = false; if (r.mesh) r.mesh.visible = false;
      }
      for (const lm of landmarks) {
        if (lm === tower) continue;
        let hit = inLot(lm.x, lm.z, 1);
        if (!hit && lm.kind === 'fence' && lm.ax != null) {
          for (let t = 0; t <= 1.0001 && !hit; t += 0.1) hit = inLot(lm.ax + (lm.bx - lm.ax) * t, lm.az + (lm.bz - lm.az) * t, 0.5);
        }
        if (!hit) for (const c of lm.colliders) if (inLot(c.x, c.z, c.radius)) { hit = true; break; }
        if (hit) removeLandmarkQuietly(lm);
      }
      for (const bu of burrows.slice()) if (inLot(bu.x, bu.z, 1)) removeBurrow(bu);
      // Lay the whole lot flat, at the middle height of the ground under the walls.
      const hs = [];
      for (let i = PX0; i <= PX1; i++) for (let k = PZ0; k <= PZ1; k++) hs.push(sampleHeight(gridCentre(ox + i), gridCentre(oz + k)));
      hs.sort((p, q) => p - q);
      const flatY = hs[hs.length >> 1];
      levelGroundRect(lot.x0, lot.z0, lot.x1, lot.z1, flatY, FEATHER);
      for (let x = lot.x0 + 1; x < lot.x1; x += BUILD_GRID) for (let z = lot.z0 + 1; z < lot.z1; z += BUILD_GRID) clearFoliageInSquare(x, z, BUILD_GRID / 2 + 0.05);
      // Anything already built on the lot sits back down on the new ground.
      for (const b of builds.slice()) if (b.gx != null && inLot(b.x, b.z)) reseatColumn(b.gx, b.gz);
      // If the marine is standing on it, he stands on the new ground too.
      if (inLot(player.position.x, player.position.z) && !playerUpstairs()) player.position.y = sampleHeight(player.position.x, player.position.z);
      let n = 0;
      const failed = [];
      const put = (kind, x, z, yaw = 0, opts = null) => {
        const cx = kind === 'pillar' ? cornerPos(x) : gridCentre(x), cz = kind === 'pillar' ? cornerPos(z) : gridCentre(z);
        if (house.present && houseBoxDist(cx, cz) < 1.6) { failed.push(kind + ' @' + (x - ox) + ',' + (z - oz) + ': cabin'); return null; }
        const b = placeBuildAt(kind, x, z, yaw, opts);
        if (b) n++;
        else failed.push(kind + ' @' + (x - ox) + ',' + (z - oz) + ': ' + (resolveTarget(kind, x, z, yaw, opts).refusal || '?'));
        return b;
      };
      const X = (i) => ox + i, Z = (k) => oz + k;

      // ---------------- The keep ----------------
      for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) for (let k = 0; k < D; k++) put('floor', X(i), Z(k), 0, { forceLv: 0 });
      // Outer walls: north edge 2, south 0, west 3, east 1.
      const walls = {};
      for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) { walls['n' + i] = put('wall', X(i), Z(0), 2); walls['s' + i] = put('wall', X(i), Z(D - 1), 0); }
      for (let k = 0; k < D; k++) { walls['w' + k] = put('wall', X(0), Z(k), 3); walls['e' + k] = put('wall', X(W - 1), Z(k), 1); }
      put('door', X(2), Z(D - 1), 0, walls['s2'] ? { piece: walls['s2'] } : null);
      for (const i of [1, 4]) put('window', X(i), Z(0), 2, walls['n' + i] ? { piece: walls['n' + i] } : null);
      put('window', X(W - 1), Z(3), 1, walls['e3'] ? { piece: walls['e3'] } : null);
      put('window', X(0), Z(2), 3, walls['w2'] ? { piece: walls['w2'] } : null);
      // Upper floor, with a stairwell left open; laid in passes from the walls inward.
      const hole = (i, k) => (i === 1 || i === 2) && (k === 2 || k === 3);
      for (let pass = 0; pass < 4; pass++) for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) for (let k = 0; k < D; k++) {
        if (hole(i, k) || cellOccupant(X(i), Z(k), 1, 'base')) continue;
        if (resolveTarget('floor', X(i), Z(k), 0, { forceLv: 1 }).refusal && pass < 3) continue;
        put('floor', X(i), Z(k), 0, { forceLv: 1 });
      }
      put('stairs', X(1), Z(3));
      for (const [i, k, q] of [[1, 1, 0], [2, 1, 0], [2, 4, 2], [0, 2, 1], [0, 3, 1], [3, 2, 3], [3, 3, 3]]) put('railing', X(i), Z(k), q, { lv: 1 });
      // Upstairs rim: railings along the south and west, sandbags along the rest of
      // the west side as a firing step.
      for (let i = 1; i < W - 1; i++) put('railing', X(i), Z(D - 1), 0, { lv: 1 });
      for (const k of [1, 2, 3, 4]) put('sandbag', X(0), Z(k), 3, { lv: 1 });
      // A room upstairs in the north-east corner, roofed over as a third floor.
      for (const [i, k, q] of [[4, 0, 2], [5, 0, 2], [5, 0, 1], [5, 1, 1], [4, 1, 3], [4, 0, 3], [4, 1, 0], [5, 1, 0]]) put('wall', X(i), Z(k), q, { lv: 1 });
      put('door', X(4), Z(1), 0, null);
      for (const [i, k] of [[4, 0], [5, 0], [4, 1], [5, 1]]) put('floor', X(i), Z(k), 0, { forceLv: 2 });
      // Gun platforms at the keep's corners, the mortar in the middle, and the roof
      // guns on top of the room.
      const p1 = put('platform', X(0), Z(0), 0, { lv: 1 }); if (p1) put('heavy', X(0), Z(0), 0, { lv: p1.level });
      const p2 = put('platform', X(5), Z(5), 0, { lv: 1 }); if (p2) put('heavy', X(5), Z(5), 0, { lv: p2.level });
      const p3 = put('platform', X(0), Z(5), 0, { lv: 1 }); if (p3) put('flame', X(0), Z(5), 0, { lv: p3.level });
      put('mortar', X(3), Z(4), 0, { lv: 1 });
      put('mortar', X(4), Z(3), 0, { lv: 1 });
      put('light', X(5), Z(0), 0, { lv: 2 });
      put('heavy', X(4), Z(1), 0, { lv: 2 });
      // Pillars: a deck held up off the keep's east side with a gun on it, and a
      // lone pillar with a turret covering the path to the gate.
      // (on ground floor, like the keep's walls, so the deck meets the keep flush)

        } else if (kind === 'stone') {
          // Courses of dressed blocks in a running bond, mortar showing between.
          grp.add(_box(x1 - x0, y1 - y0, 0.22, tierMats.mortar, (x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2, 0));
          const rh = 0.3;
          for (let r = 0, y = y0; y < y1 - 0.02; r++, y += rh) {
            const yt = Math.min(y1, y + rh), off = (r % 2) ? 0.27 : 0;
            let x = x0 - off;
            for (let k = 0; x < x1 - 0.02; k++) {
              const xa = Math.max(x0, x), xb = Math.min(x1, x + 0.54);
              if (xb - xa > 0.04) {
                const m = tierMats.stone[Math.floor(_hash(r * 7 + k, x0 * 3 + y0) * 3) % 3];
                grp.add(_box((xb - xa) - 0.03, (yt - y) - 0.03, 0.27, m, (xa + xb) / 2, (y + yt) / 2, 0));
              }
              x += 0.54;
            }
          }
        } else {
          // Steel plate, ribbed on the inside, riveted along its top and bottom.
          grp.add(_box(x1 - x0, y1 - y0, 0.14, tierMats.steel, (x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2, 0));
          for (let x = x0 + 0.2; x < x1 - 0.1; x += 0.42) grp.add(_box(0.06, y1 - y0, 0.06, tierMats.steelDark, x, (y0 + y1) / 2, -0.09));
          for (const ry of [Math.max(y0, 0) + 0.08, y1 - 0.08]) {
            for (let x = x0 + 0.08; x < x1 - 0.04; x += 0.19) grp.add(_box(0.04, 0.04, 0.03, tierMats.rivet, x, ry, 0.085));
          }
        }
      };
      run(lower, -inX, inX, -WALL_SKIRT, WALL_SILL);
      run(upper, -inX, -WALL_WIN_W / 2, WALL_SILL, capY);
      run(upper, WALL_WIN_W / 2, inX, WALL_SILL, capY);
      run(upperMid, -WALL_WIN_W / 2, WALL_WIN_W / 2, WALL_SILL, capY);
      // The cap.
      if (kind === 'wood') inner.add(_box(S, 0.18, 0.4, wood, 0, WALL_TOP - 0.09, 0));
      else if (kind === 'stone') {
        inner.add(_box(S, 0.22, 0.46, tierMats.stoneDark, 0, WALL_TOP - 0.11, 0));
        if (T >= 3) inner.add(_box(S, 0.03, 0.48, tierMats.steelDark, 0, WALL_TOP - 0.005, 0));
      } else {
        inner.add(_box(S, 0.16, 0.36, tierMats.steelDark, 0, WALL_TOP - 0.08, 0));
        for (let x = -S / 2 + 0.12; x < S / 2; x += 0.22) inner.add(_box(0.045, 0.03, 0.045, tierMats.rivet, x, WALL_TOP - 0.005, 0.1));
      }
      // Bands: steel straps on the inside of a wooden wall; reinforced wood has them
      // on both faces with an X-brace across the lower half; reinforced stone is
      // girdled with iron bands front and back.
      const band = (y, z, m) => {
        lower.add(_box(2 * inX, 0.13, 0.06, m, 0, Math.min(y, WALL_SILL - 0.1), z));
      };
      const bandUp = (y, z, m) => {
        const wL = inX - WALL_WIN_W / 2;
        upper.add(_box(wL, 0.13, 0.06, m, -(inX + WALL_WIN_W / 2) / 2, y, z), _box(wL, 0.13, 0.06, m, (inX + WALL_WIN_W / 2) / 2, y, z));
        upperMid.add(_box(WALL_WIN_W, 0.13, 0.06, m, 0, y, z));
      };
      if (kind === 'wood') {
        band(0.55, -0.13, metal); bandUp(1.4, -0.13, metal);
        if (T >= 1) {
          band(0.2, 0.13, tierMats.steelDark); band(0.8, 0.13, tierMats.steelDark);
          bandUp(1.4, 0.13, tierMats.steelDark); bandUp(1.78, 0.13, tierMats.steelDark);
          const dx = 2 * inX - 0.2, dy = WALL_SILL - 0.1, diag = Math.hypot(dx, dy), a = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
          for (const sgn of [1, -1]) {
            const s = _box(diag, 0.1, 0.04, tierMats.steelDark, 0, dy / 2 + 0.03, 0.15);
            s.rotation.z = sgn * a; lower.add(s);
          }
          for (let x = -inX + 0.15; x < inX; x += 0.3) for (const y of [0.2, 0.8]) lower.add(_box(0.05, 0.05, 0.03, tierMats.rivet, x, y, 0.17));
        }
      } else if (kind === 'stone' && T >= 3) {
        for (const z of [-0.145, 0.145]) { band(0.35, z, tierMats.steelDark); bandUp(1.45, z, tierMats.steelDark); }
        for (let x = -inX + 0.2; x < inX; x += 0.4) for (const z of [-0.18, 0.18]) lower.add(_box(0.06, 0.06, 0.03, tierMats.rivet, x, 0.35, z));
      }
      // The sill a window leaves across the opening.
      const sillMat = kind === 'wood' ? wood : (kind === 'stone' ? tierMats.stoneDark : tierMats.steelDark);
      const sill = _box(WALL_WIN_W + 0.1, 0.07, kind === 'wood' ? 0.3 : 0.4, sillMat, 0, WALL_SILL + 0.035, 0);
      sill.visible = false;
      inner.add(sill);
      outer.userData.lower = lower;
      outer.userData.upper = upper;
      outer.userData.upperMid = upperMid;
      outer.userData.sill = sill;
      return outer;
    }

    // Iron bars across a window: rounds still go out between them, nothing comes in.
    function addWindowBars(b) {
      const u = b.mesh.userData;
      if (u.bars) { u.inner.remove(u.bars); u.bars = null; }
      if (!b.barred) return;
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      const y0 = WALL_SILL + 0.07, y1 = WALL_TOP - 0.2, h = y1 - y0;
      for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        const x = -WALL_WIN_W / 2 + WALL_WIN_W * (i + 0.5) / 9;
        const bar = _mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.009, 0.009, h, 4), tierMats.iron);
        bar.position.set(x, y0 + h / 2, 0);
        bar.castShadow = true;
        g.add(bar);
      }
      for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y += 0.11) g.add(_box(WALL_WIN_W + 0.02, 0.014, 0.018, tierMats.iron, 0, y, 0));
      for (const x of [-WALL_WIN_W / 2, WALL_WIN_W / 2]) g.add(_box(0.04, h, 0.04, tierMats.iron, x, y0 + h / 2, 0));
      mergeStatic(g);
      u.inner.add(g);
      u.bars = g;
    }

    // A spike trap is a buried bed: all that shows is a square of turned earth with a
    // steel frame. The spikes wait under it (group `spikes`, sunk SPIKE_SINK) and punch
    // up through the whole square the moment something steps onto it — once.
    const SPIKE_SINK = 0.95;
    const SPIKE_DMG = 160;
    function makeSpikesMesh(matOverride = null) {
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      const dirtMat = matOverride || new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x4a3a28, roughness: 1 });
      const frameMat = matOverride || new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x3e434a, metalness: 0.5, roughness: 0.55 });
      const spikeMat = matOverride || new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x9aa4ae, metalness: 0.75, roughness: 0.3 });
      const bed = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.8, 0.06, 1.8), dirtMat);
      bed.position.y = 0.02;
      bed.receiveShadow = true;
      g.add(bed);
      for (const [sx, sz, w, d] of [[1, 0, 0.08, 1.9], [-1, 0, 0.08, 1.9], [0, 1, 1.9, 0.08], [0, -1, 1.9, 0.08]]) {
        const rail = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, 0.07, d), frameMat);
        rail.position.set(sx * 0.91, 0.03, sz * 0.91);
        g.add(rail);
      }
      const spikes = new THREE.Group();
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
        const h = 0.7 + ((i + k) % 3) * 0.14;
        const spike = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.06, h, 5), spikeMat);
        spike.position.set(-0.72 + i * 0.36, h / 2, -0.72 + k * 0.36);
        spike.rotation.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2, 0, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2);
        spike.castShadow = true;
        spikes.add(spike);
      }
      // The ghost shows what it will do; the real trap starts buried.
      if (!matOverride) { spikes.position.y = -SPIKE_SINK; spikes.visible = false; }
      g.add(spikes);
      g.userData.spikes = spikes;
      return g;
    }
    // Spring any trap something has walked onto: the spikes shoot up through the whole
    // square, everything standing in it takes SPIKE_DMG, and a moment later the trap is
    // spent and gone, the square free to build on again.
    function updateSpikeTraps(dt) {
      _zgFrame++;
      for (const b of spikeBuilds.slice()) {
        const sp = b.mesh.userData.spikes;
        if (!b.sprung) {
          const G2 = BUILD_GRID / 2;
          let hit = false;
          for (const z of zombiesNear(b.x, b.z, G2 + 0.2, _zNear)) {
            if (Math.abs(z.mesh.position.x - b.x) < G2 && Math.abs(z.mesh.position.z - b.z) < G2 &&
                Math.abs(z.mesh.position.y - b.mesh.position.y) < 1.2) { hit = true; break; }
          }
          if (!hit) continue;
          b.sprung = true; b.sprungT = 0;
          b.uses = (b.uses == null ? UPGRADE_TRACKS.spikes.uses[b.tier | 0] : b.uses) - 1;
          if (sp) sp.visible = true;
          AudioSys.spikeSnap();
          spawnDust(b.x, b.mesh.position.y + 0.2, b.z, 8);
          for (const z of zombies.slice()) {
            if (!z.alive) continue;
            if (Math.abs(z.mesh.position.x - b.x) < G2 + 0.15 && Math.abs(z.mesh.position.z - b.z) < G2 + 0.15 &&
                Math.abs(z.mesh.position.y - b.mesh.position.y) < 1.2) {
              spawnBlood(z.mesh.position.x, z.mesh.position.y + 0.5, z.mesh.position.z, 0, 0, 10, 1.2);
              const st = b.tier | 0;
              z.slowT = st >= 2 ? 2.4 : 1.2;                       // a steel bed leaves them bleeding
              damageZombie(z, UPGRADE_TRACKS.spikes.dmg[st], { kind: 'melee', dir: { x: 0, z: 0 }, defense: true });
            }
          }
          continue;
        }
        b.sprungT += dt;
        const st = b.tier | 0;
        const reset = UPGRADE_TRACKS.spikes.reset[st];
        if (sp && b.sprungT < 1.1) sp.position.y = -SPIKE_SINK * Math.max(0, 1 - b.sprungT / 0.08);
        if (b.sprungT > 1.1) {
          // A plain bed is spent. A resetting one winds itself back down and waits —
          // keeping its square, so nothing can be built over it meanwhile.
          if (reset > 0 && b.uses > 0) {
            if (sp) sp.position.y = -SPIKE_SINK;
            if (b.sprungT > 1.1 + reset) {
              b.sprung = false; b.sprungT = 0;
              if (sp) sp.visible = false;
              spawnDust(b.x, b.mesh.position.y + 0.2, b.z, 4);
              AudioSys.buildSound('spikes');
            }
          } else { spawnChunks(b.x, b.mesh.position.y + 0.3, b.z, 0x6b6250, 5, 3); removeBuild(b, true); }
        }
      }
    }

    function makeFlameTurretMesh(matOverride = null) {
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      const tankMat = matOverride || new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xb33a2a, metalness: 0.45, roughness: 0.45 });
      const metal = matOverride || new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x555b63, metalness: 0.6, roughness: 0.45 });
      const pilot = matOverride || new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({

      const tank = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.32, 0.32, 0.85, 12), tankMat);
      tank.position.y = 0.72;

      const cap = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.32, 12, 8), tankMat);

      valve.position.set(0, 0.12, 0.3);
      pitchG.add(valve);

      flameTip.position.set(0, 0, 0.8);
      pitchG.add(flameTip);
      g.userData.pitchG = pitchG;
      g.userData.pilot = flameTip;
      g.userData.muzzleLocal = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.9, 0.8);

    function makeGhostMeshFor(kind, mat) {
      switch (kind) {
        case 'barricade': return makeBarricadeMesh(mat);
        case 'wall': return makeWallMesh(mat);
        case 'spikes': return makeSpikesMesh(mat);
        case 'light': return makeLightTurretMesh(mat);
        case 'flame': return makeFlameTurretMesh(mat);
        case 'sandbag': return makeSandbagMesh(mat);
        case 'barrel': return makeBarrelBuildMesh(mat);
        case 'mine': return makeMineMesh(mat);
        case 'lure': return makeLureMesh(mat);
        case 'mortar': return makeMortarMesh(mat);
        case 'm240': {
          const g = makeM240Mesh(false);
          g.name = 'watchman-build-ghost';
          g.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh) { o.material = mat; o.castShadow = false; o.receiveShadow = false; } });
          return g;
        }
        case 'platform': return makePlatformMesh(mat);
        case 'floor': return makeFloorMesh(mat);
        case 'stairs': return makeStairsMesh(mat);
        case 'wire': return makeWireMesh(mat);
        case 'railing': return makeRailingMesh(mat);
        case 'pillar': return makePillarMesh(mat);
        default: return makeHeavyTurretMesh(mat);
      }
    }
    // A panel ghost standing alone has no arms showing (they are only switched on by
    // the linker), so give it the pair along its own facing, like a lone wall.
    function showLoneArms(mesh) {
      const arms = mesh && mesh.userData.arms;
      if (arms) { arms[0].visible = true; arms[2].visible = true; }
    }
    function rebuildGhost() {
      clearGhostChildren();
      clearDragGhosts();
      buildDrag = null;
      if (!placeMode) { ghostGroup.visible = false; return; }
      const ghostMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x22c55e, transparent: true, opacity: 0.45, depthWrite: false
      });
      if (placeMode === 'shovel' || placeMode === 'window' || placeMode === 'door' || placeMode === 'gate' || placeMode === 'upgrade') {
        ghostGroup.visible = false; ghostGroup.userData.mat = ghostMat; return;
      }
      const mesh = makeGhostMeshFor(placeMode, ghostMat);
      showLoneArms(mesh);
      ghostGroup.add(mesh);
      ghostGroup.userData.mat = ghostMat;
      ghostGroup.visible = true;
    }

    function setPlaceMode(mode) {
      if (!gameStarted || gameOver || won) return;
      if (mode && paused) return;
      if (mortarCarried) return; // hands full
      if (mode && nightLockdown()) { refuseLockdown(); return; }   // CU-82
      if (mode && !buildUnlocked[mode]) {
        AudioSys.invalid();
        showBanner(BUILD_NAMES[mode].toUpperCase() + ' — NO BLUEPRINT', 'Buy the plans at the kiosk ($' + BUILD_UNLOCK_PRICE[mode] + ')', 1.6, '#ffb347');
        return;
      }
      placeMode = mode;
      buildDrag = null;
      if (!mode) { scrapHeld = false; scrapDrag = null; }
      if (mode) {
        buildMode = true;
        const bi = BUILD_ORDER.indexOf(mode);
        if (bi >= 0) buildIndex = bi;
        mouseFireHeld = false;
        fireHeld = false;
      }
      rebuildGhost();
      if (mode) {
        refreshPlaceBanner();
      } else {
        placeBannerEl.classList.remove('on');
        placeBannerEl.textContent = '';
      }
    }

    function refreshPlaceBanner() {
      if (!placeMode) { placeBannerEl.classList.remove('on'); placeBannerEl.textContent = ''; return; }
      renderBuildBanner(placeBannerEl, {
        name: BUILD_NAMES[placeMode], cost: COST[placeMode], upgrade: placeMode === 'upgrade',
        drag: !!DRAG_KINDS[placeMode], bearing: ['N', 'E', 'S', 'W'][buildYaw],
        hints: [
          { text: placeMode === 'upgrade' ? upgradeHint : placeHint, className: placeMode === 'upgrade' ? 'place-upgrade' : 'place-why' },
          { text: scrapHint, className: 'place-scrap' }, { text: placeMode === 'upgrade' ? '' : upgradeAvailHint, className: 'place-upgrade' }   /* GB-139 */
        ]
      });
    }

    function cancelPlaceMode() {
      if (mortarCarried) {
        // Esc while carrying: drop it at your feet rather than losing it.
        const fx = Math.sin(aimYaw), fz = Math.cos(aimYaw);
        let x = player.position.x + fx * 1.4, z = player.position.z + fz * 1.4;
        if (!validatePlace(x, z)) { x = player.position.x - fx * 1.4; z = player.position.z - fz * 1.4; }
        setDownMortar(x, z);
        return;
      }
      buildMode = false;
      buildGridHelper.visible = false;
      buildCellMark.visible = false;
      upgradeDrag = null;
      setPlaceMode(null);
    }

    function toggleBuildMode() {
      if (!gameStarted || gameOver || won || paused) return;
      if (buildMode || placeMode) {
        cancelPlaceMode();
      } else {
        let mode = BUILD_ORDER[buildIndex] || 'barricade';
        if (!buildUnlocked[mode]) mode = firstUnlockedBuild();
        setPlaceMode(mode);
      }
    }

    // --- The build lattice ------------------------------------------------------
    // One fixed lattice over the whole map, not a patch that trails the cursor: cell
    // (gx,gz) is always the same two metres of ground whoever is standing where, so a
    // piece laid down today lines up with one laid down from the far side tomorrow.
    // 2m because that is exactly how wide a wall section is (its foot is a 2.0 box),
    // so a run of them meets edge to edge with no gap for the horde to walk through.
    // One piece per cell, like a brick in a course.
    const BUILD_GRID = 2.0;
    const BUILD_REACH = 9.0;           // how far from the marine you can lay a piece
    let buildYaw = 0;                  // quarter turns, 0..3 — R rotates the piece
    function gridIndex(v) { return Math.round((v - (training.active ? BUILD_GRID / 2 : 0)) / BUILD_GRID); }
    function gridCentre(i) { return i * BUILD_GRID + (training.active ? BUILD_GRID / 2 : 0); }
    function snapToGrid(v) { return gridCentre(gridIndex(v)); }
    // === What can go where ======================================================
    // Every placeable is described by one row here instead of by branches scattered
    // through placeRefusal, spawnBuild and the linker. Adding a piece should be a row
    // plus a mesh, not an edit in six places.
    //
    // A cell is (gx, gz, level). Each level has three slots:
    //   base   the load-bearing piece   — wall, sandbag, barricade, platform, floor
    //   top    a half-height addition standing on the base — wire, railing
    //   object something free-standing sitting on a floor — turrets, mines, drums
    // so a wall can carry barbed wire on its head AND a platform above it without the
    // two fighting over the same slot.
    //
    //   slot     which of the three it fills
    //   on       what it will stand on: 'ground', or the type of the piece beneath
    //   height   how far its top is above its own base — what the next thing up sits on
    //   maxStack for 'base' pieces, how many of this type may stack in one column
    //   armour   how much it adds to the hp of the piece it is standing on
    const LEVEL_H = 2.0;      // one storey; matches WALL_TOP so a wall IS a storey
    // Stack slots, not storeys: a platform laid on a floor takes a level of its own
    // while only adding a few centimetres, so wall / floor / platform / second wall
    // needs four.
    const MAX_LEVEL = 5;   // three storeys of floor, with platforms and walls between
    // A cell-level has:
    //   base      a deck, a floor, stairs, spikes, a mine, a drum — the middle of the cell
    //   edge0..3  a wall, sandbags, a barricade, wire or a railing along one EDGE
    //   cap0..3   wire, sandbags or a barricade strung along the top of that edge's wall
    //   object    a turret, a mortar, a beacon — free-standing in the middle
    // Edge index = the quarter-turn the piece faces: 0 south (+Z), 1 east, 2 north, 3 west.
    // A deck at level L+1 stands on the walls round its cell at level L.
    const EDGE_SLOTS = ['edge0', 'edge1', 'edge2', 'edge3'];
    const CAP_SLOTS = ['cap0', 'cap1', 'cap2', 'cap3'];
    const UPPER_SLOTS = ['top', 'edge0', 'edge1', 'edge2', 'edge3', 'cap0', 'cap1', 'cap2', 'cap3', 'object'];
    const ALL_SLOTS = ['base'].concat(UPPER_SLOTS);
    // The concrete slot a piece of this kind takes at this rotation.
    function slotFor(rule, yaw) { return rule.slot === 'edge' ? 'edge' + (((yaw | 0) % 4 + 4) % 4) : rule.slot; }
    const BUILD_RULES = {
      // `on`: what an edge piece stands on at its own level (the ground, or the deck of
      // the level). `stack`: may go straight on top of one of its own kind on the same
      // edge. `capOn`: may instead be strung along the top of the edge piece already
      // there (wire on a wall, a barricade on a wall).
      wall:      { slot: 'edge', on: ['ground', 'platform', 'floor'], stack: true, height: 2.0, maxStack: 2 },
      sandbag:   { slot: 'edge', on: ['ground', 'platform', 'floor'], capOn: ['wall'], height: 1.05, armour: 25 },
      barricade: { slot: 'edge', on: ['ground', 'platform', 'floor'], capOn: ['wall'], height: 1.4 },
      spikes:    { slot: 'base', on: ['ground'], height: 0.3 },
      // Things that stand ON a surface are objects: on bare ground they sit at the
      // bottom of the column, on a deck they sit on the deck.
      mortar:    { slot: 'object', on: ['ground', 'platform', 'floor'], height: 1.2 },
      m240:      { slot: 'object', on: ['ground', 'platform', 'floor'], height: 1.2 },
      lure:      { slot: 'object', on: ['ground', 'platform', 'floor'], height: 1.7 },
      mine:      { slot: 'base', on: ['ground'], height: 0.15 },
      barrel:    { slot: 'base', on: ['ground'], height: 1.0 },
      light:     { slot: 'object', on: ['ground', 'platform', 'floor'], height: 1.35 },
      flame:     { slot: 'object', on: ['ground', 'platform', 'floor'], height: 1.3 },
      heavy:     { slot: 'object', on: ['ground', 'platform', 'floor'], height: 1.5 },
      // A steel deck on the walls of its cell — or laid on a wooden floor, once, as a
      // gun mount. Its middle stands proud of its rim (`height` is the raised centre,
      // what a turret sits on; `edgeH` is the rim, where edge pieces go).
      // The raised middle stands three-quarters of a railing's height proud of its
      // base, so a turret on it looks out over the rails round its rim.
      platform:  { slot: 'base', on: ['wall', 'floor'], height: RAIL_H * 0.75, edgeH: 0.25, deck: true, armour: 15 },
      // Wooden boards: a floor for the storey above, a roof for the one below. On
      // walls, never on a platform. `spans`: it may also rest its edge on the wall of
      // the cell next door, or reach out from another floor, up to FLOOR_SPAN cells
      // from something solid — which is what lets you roof over a room.
      // On the bare ground too: a raised boardwalk that lifts you a little for shooting
      // out of a window.
      floor:     { slot: 'base', on: ['ground', 'wall'], height: 0.25, deck: true, armour: 20, spans: true },

      // thing it carries is a turret on its cap.
      pillar:    { slot: 'pillar', on: ['ground'], height: PILLAR_H },

      stairs:    { slot: 'base', on: ['ground', 'platform', 'floor'], height: LEVEL_H, ramp: true },

      // Low enough that a marine shooting down off a deck clears it.

    function baseUnder(gx, gz, lv, kind) {

    function buildOnMyStorey(b, band = storeyBand()) {
      const y0 = b.mesh.position.y, y1 = y0 + (b.rise || Math.max(0.2, pieceHeight(b.type)));

      const px = player.position.x, py = player.position.y + 0.9, pz = player.position.z;

      const y0 = b.mesh.position.y, h = b.rise || Math.max(0.2, pieceHeight(b.type));

    function findRepairCandidate(maxDist) {

    // X — scrap a structure for a partial refund weighted by its condition. While

      const refund = scrapRefund(best);

    // What the reticle says about a placement: the level and the piece it is on.
    function placeOpts(pt) {

      if (!pt) return null;

    function tryPlace() {

      const why = placeRefusal(pt.x, pt.z, pt.gx, pt.gz, buildYaw, opts);

      const canNot = (sub) => { AudioSys.invalid(); showBanner(sayText('build.message.cannotBuild', null, 'CAN\u0027T BUILD THERE'), sub, 1.2, '#ffb347'); };

    // Shared HP-bar bits: one green fill + dark back, billboarded per build when hurt.

    // Four courses of bags along the edge, the bond staggered course to course, and a

    function makeBarrelBuildMesh(matOverride = null) {

    }
    // A platform is steel: a grated rim on a welded frame, and a raised mount plate

    const PLATFORM_PAD = 0.88;   // half-width of the raised plate: the Watchman tripod and the mortar baseplate both sit on it, clear of the rail posts

      const g = new THREE.Group();

      const dark = matOverride || new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x3d434b, metalness: 0.65, roughness: 0.5 });

    }
    // A structural pillar: a steel post on a foot plate, with a wide cap plate on top

    // Half height and mostly air: you shoot over it, it shreds whatever pushes through.

    function makeWireMesh(matOverride = null) {
      const { outer, inner } = edgeGroups(EDGE_SPEC.wire.edge);

    function makeRailingMesh(matOverride = null) {

    function makeMineMesh(matOverride = null) {
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      const body = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.34, 0.38, 0.12, 14), matOverride || new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x3f4a3a, metalness: 0.5, roughness: 0.55 }));

    function makeLureMesh(matOverride = null) {

    }
    // `collapsed` is the carrying configuration: legs folded flat along the tube and
    // the baseplate swung up against it, so what goes on the shoulder is one bundle
    // rather than a deployed mortar floating at an angle.
    function makeMortarMesh(matOverride = null, collapsed = false) {
      return makeMortarModel(weaponModelContext(), matOverride, collapsed);
    }

    // Cut a window or a door into a wall that is already up: hide the boards the
    // opening takes out, and mark the wall so bullets and bodies know about it.
    function applyOpening(b, kind) {
      if (!b || b.opening) return;
      b.opening = kind;
      if (kind === 'door' || kind === 'gate') {
        b.doorOpen = false;       // what E last asked for
        b.doorAmt = 0;            // 0 shut .. 1 wide open, eased toward doorOpen
        b.doorSide = 1;           // which way the leaves swing
      }
      if (kind === 'gate') {
        // The run it replaces goes; the gate's own toughness takes over.
        b.gateTier = 0;
        buildGateLeaves(b);
        b.maxHp = UPGRADE_TRACKS.gate.hp[0];
        b.hp = b.maxHp;
        AudioSys.repairClank();
        return;
      }
      // The wall is rebuilt with its opening, so the whole of it can bake together.
      if (b.type === 'wall') rebuildBuildMesh(b);
      else { applyOpeningLook(b); if (kind === 'door') buildDoorLeaves(b); }
      const rule = ruleFor(kind);
      const cut = rule ? rule.weakens : 0;
      b.maxHp = Math.max(10, b.maxHp - cut);
      b.hp = Math.min(b.hp, b.maxHp);
      AudioSys.repairClank();
    }
    // A window takes out the middle of the upper boards — one opening in the middle of
    // the wall, with a sill — and a door everything between the posts under the cap.
    function applyOpeningLook(b) {
      const u = b.mesh.userData;
      if (u.upperMid) u.upperMid.visible = !b.opening;
      if (u.upper) u.upper.visible = b.opening !== 'door';
      if (u.lower) u.lower.visible = b.opening !== 'door';
      if (u.sill) u.sill.visible = b.opening === 'window';
    }

    // A pair of leaves hung from the inside faces of the two posts, meeting in the
    // middle. They hang in the wall's own frame (local X along the wall, +Z out
    // through the edge), so they follow it whichever way it faces.
    const DOOR_H = WALL_TOP - 0.2;
    const DOOR_OPEN_ANG = 1.62;   // a touch past square: open leaves stand clear of the doorway
    const DOOR_SWING_T = 0.32;    // seconds from shut to open
    // Shared by every door: a material first drawn mid-wave costs a pipeline compile.
    const doorWoodMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x5e4428, roughness: 0.88 });
    const doorIronMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x3a3f46, metalness: 0.6, roughness: 0.45 });
    // Door leaves, by tier: wood, reinforced wood, iron, reinforced iron, steel. A pair
    // of leaves hung from the inside faces of the posts, meeting in the middle, in the
    // wall's own frame (local X along the wall, +Z out through the edge).
    function buildDoorLeaves(b) {
      const u = b.mesh.userData;
      if (u.doorFrame) { u.inner.remove(u.doorFrame); u.doorFrame = null; u.doorLeaves = null; }
      const T = b.doorTier | 0;
      const frame = new THREE.Group();
      const jamb = BUILD_GRID / 2 - WALL_T;      // inside face of each post
      const W = jamb - 0.02, H = DOOR_H;
      const leaves = [];
      for (const end of [1, -1]) {
        const hinge = new THREE.Group();
        hinge.position.set(end * jamb, 0, 0);
        const cx = -end * W / 2;
        const add = (m) => { hinge.add(m); return m; };
        if (T <= 1) {
          add(_box(W, H, 0.08, doorWoodMat, cx, H / 2 + 0.01, 0));
          const straps = T === 0 ? [0.35, H - 0.35] : [0.25, 0.75, H - 0.75, H - 0.25];
          for (const hy of straps) add(_box(W * (T ? 0.9 : 0.62), 0.07, 0.1, doorIronMat, -end * W * (T ? 0.45 : 0.31), hy, 0));
          const diag = Math.hypot(W * 0.8, H - 0.8);
          const brace = add(_box(diag, 0.09, 0.1, T ? doorIronMat : doorWoodMat, cx, H / 2, 0));
          brace.rotation.z = end * Math.atan2(H - 0.8, W * 0.8);
          if (T === 1) {
            // Iron edging round the leaf and a stud at every strap end.
            for (const [w, h, x, y] of [[W, 0.05, cx, 0.03], [W, 0.05, cx, H - 0.02], [0.05, H, -end * (W - 0.025), H / 2], [0.05, H, -end * 0.025, H / 2]]) add(_box(w, h, 0.1, doorIronMat, x, y, 0));
            for (const hy of straps) for (const fx of [0.12, 0.5, 0.85]) add(_box(0.045, 0.045, 0.12, tierMats.rivet, -end * W * fx, hy, 0));
          }
        } else if (T <= 3) {
          // Iron: a dark plate with ribs; reinforced adds a heavy X and a bolt at each end.
          add(_box(W, H, 0.07, tierMats.iron, cx, H / 2 + 0.01, 0));
          for (const hy of [0.3, H / 2, H - 0.3]) add(_box(W, 0.08, 0.1, tierMats.steelDark, cx, hy, 0));
          for (let y = 0.15; y < H; y += 0.3) for (const fx of [0.1, 0.9]) add(_box(0.04, 0.04, 0.1, tierMats.rivet, -end * W * fx, y, 0));
          if (T === 3) {
            const diag = Math.hypot(W - 0.1, H - 0.2);
            for (const sgn of [1, -1]) { const x = add(_box(diag, 0.12, 0.12, tierMats.steelDark, cx, H / 2, 0)); x.rotation.z = sgn * Math.atan2(H - 0.2, W - 0.1); }
            for (const [fx, fy] of [[0.1, 0.1], [0.9, 0.1], [0.1, 0.95], [0.9, 0.95], [0.5, 0.5]]) add(_box(0.09, 0.09, 0.14, tierMats.rivet, -end * W * fx, H * fy, 0));
          }
        } else {
          // Steel: a bright slab with a recessed panel, a heavy bar across, a wheel lock.
          add(_box(W, H, 0.1, tierMats.steelLight, cx, H / 2 + 0.01, 0));
          for (const z of [-0.055, 0.055]) add(_box(W - 0.16, H - 0.3, 0.02, tierMats.steel, cx, H / 2 + 0.01, z));
          add(_box(W, 0.12, 0.14, tierMats.steelDark, cx, H * 0.55, 0));
          for (const hy of [0.25, H - 0.25]) add(_box(0.12, 0.22, 0.14, tierMats.steelDark, -end * 0.07, hy, 0)); // hinge blocks
          if (end === 1) {
            const wheel = _mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.13, 0.025, 6, 12), tierMats.steelDark);
            wheel.position.set(-end * (W - 0.22), H * 0.55, 0.1);
            add(wheel);
            add(_box(0.26, 0.03, 0.03, tierMats.steelDark, -end * (W - 0.22), H * 0.55, 0.1));
          }
        }
        add(_box(0.05, 0.05, 0.16, T >= 2 ? tierMats.rivet : doorIronMat, -end * (W - 0.12), 1.0, 0)); // handle
        mergeStatic(hinge);   // a leaf swings as one piece: bake it to a mesh or two
        frame.add(hinge);

      u.doorFrame = frame;
      u.doorLeaves = leaves;
      poseSwing(b);
    }
    // Put the leaves (door or gate) where the current open amount says, straight away.
    function poseSwing(b) {
      const k = (b.doorAmt || 0) * (b.doorAmt || 0) * (3 - 2 * (b.doorAmt || 0));
      for (const L of b.mesh.userData.doorLeaves || []) L.hinge.rotation.y = -L.end * (b.doorSide || 1) * DOOR_OPEN_ANG * k;
    }

    // A gate cut into a run of wire, a barricade or a railing: the run is replaced by a
    // pair of swinging leaves between two posts, E to open like a door. Wood, iron,
    // steel.
    const GATE_H = { wire: 1.3, barricade: 1.45, railing: RAIL_H + 0.08 };
    function buildGateLeaves(b) {
      const u = b.mesh.userData;
      if (u.doorFrame) { u.inner.remove(u.doorFrame); u.doorFrame = null; u.doorLeaves = null; }
      // Hide the run the gate replaces.
      for (const c of u.inner.children) c.visible = false;
      const T = b.gateTier | 0, H = GATE_H[b.type] || 1.3, S = BUILD_GRID;
      const frame = new THREE.Group();
      const postMat = T === 0 ? tierMats.wood : (T === 1 ? tierMats.iron : tierMats.steelDark);
      for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
        frame.add(_box(0.16, H + 0.5, 0.16, postMat, sx * (S / 2 - 0.08), (H + 0.5) / 2 - 0.4, 0));
        if (T === 1) { const f = _mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.07, 0.16, 6), tierMats.iron); f.position.set(sx * (S / 2 - 0.08), H + 0.18, 0); frame.add(f); }
        if (T === 2) frame.add(_box(0.2, 0.05, 0.2, tierMats.rivet, sx * (S / 2 - 0.08), H + 0.11, 0));
      }

          for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) add(_box(0.1, H - 0.05, 0.05, tierMats.wood, -end * (0.08 + i * (W - 0.16) / 3), H / 2, 0.03));
          const d = Math.hypot(W - 0.1, H - 0.5), br = add(_box(d, 0.09, 0.05, tierMats.wood, cx, H / 2 + 0.05, -0.03));

          for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {

          add(_box(W, H * 0.45, 0.06, tierMats.steel, cx, H * 0.225 + 0.03, 0));                   // solid lower plate
          for (const [w, h, x, y] of [[W, 0.07, cx, H - 0.035], [0.07, H, -end * (W - 0.035), H / 2], [0.07, H, -end * 0.035, H / 2]]) add(_box(w, h, 0.08, tierMats.steelDark, x, y, 0));
          for (let i = 1; i < 5; i++) add(_box(0.03, H * 0.55, 0.03, tierMats.steelDark, -end * (i * W / 5), H * 0.72, 0)); // upper grille

      u.doorFrame = frame;
      u.doorLeaves = leaves;
      poseSwing(b);
    }

    // Floors: wood, stone flags, steel tread plate. Same top height and footprint.
    function makeTierFloorMesh(tier) {
      if (!tier) return makeFloorMesh();
      const g = new THREE.Group(), G = BUILD_GRID;
      if (tier === 1) {
        g.add(_box(G * 0.99, 0.14, G * 0.99, tierMats.mortar, 0, 0.12, 0));
        const n = 4, s = G / n;

        }

        for (const [sx, sz, w, d] of [[1, 0, 0.05, G], [-1, 0, 0.05, G], [0, 1, G, 0.05], [0, -1, G, 0.05]]) g.add(_box(w, 0.6, d, tierMats.steelDark, sx * (G / 2 - 0.03), -0.17, sz * (G / 2 - 0.03)));

    }

    // Turrets, Mk II and Mk III: the same gun with more on it.
    //   Light: Mk II gets olive side armour and a second barrel; Mk III a gun shield,

    //   Heavy: Mk II twin cannon and armour skirts; Mk III an armoured hood over the
    //          breech and a radar dish.
    //   Flame: Mk II a second tank and a heat shield; Mk III three tanks, a wide flared
    //          nozzle and a blue-hot pilot.
    function decorateTurret(mesh, type, tier) {
      if (!tier) return;
      const u = mesh.userData, pg = u.pitchG;
      if (!pg) return;
      if (type === 'light') {
        const armour = tier >= 2 ? tierMats.black : tierMats.olive;
        for (const sx of [-1, 1]) pg.add(_box(0.05, 0.3, 0.42, armour, sx * 0.21, 0.02, 0.08));
        const b2 = _mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.03, 0.03, 0.55, 8), tierMats.steelDark);
        b2.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2; b2.position.set(0.075, 0, 0.42); pg.add(b2);

          const shield = _box(0.56, 0.42, 0.04, tierMats.black, 0, 0.05, 0.36);
          pg.add(shield);
          pg.add(_box(0.2, 0.05, 0.05, tierMats.brass, 0, 0.27, 0.36));
          const eye = _mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.06, 10, 8), tierMats.lensRed);
          eye.position.set(0.16, 0.2, 0.3); pg.add(eye);

          whip.position.set(-0.18, 0.45, -0.1); pg.add(whip);

          if (u.brake) { const b2 = new THREE.Mesh(u.brake.geometry.clone(), u.brake.material); b2.rotation.copy(u.brake.rotation); b2.position.set(0.22, 0, 1.1); pg.add(b2); }
        }
        for (const sx of [-1, 1]) mesh.add(_box(0.06, 0.5, 0.9, tier >= 2 ? tierMats.black : tierMats.olive, sx * 0.5, 0.35, 0));
        if (tier >= 2) {
          const hood = _box(0.9, 0.18, 0.8, tierMats.black, 0.06, 0.34, 0.0); hood.rotation.x = -0.12; pg.add(hood);
          pg.add(_box(0.92, 0.04, 0.12, tierMats.brass, 0.06, 0.25, 0.42));
          const mast = _mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.025, 0.025, 0.5, 6), tierMats.steelDark);
          mast.position.set(-0.3, 0.6, -0.25); pg.add(mast);

        const tankMat = tier >= 2 ? tierMats.black : tierMats.rust;
        const tanks = tier >= 2 ? [[-0.34, 0], [0.34, 0], [0, -0.34]] : [[-0.34, 0]];
        for (const [x, z] of tanks) {

          mesh.add(_box(0.05, 0.05, 0.3, tierMats.steelDark, x * 0.55, 0.7, z * 0.55));

        shield.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2; shield.position.set(0, 0, 0.36); pg.add(shield);
        if (tier >= 2) {

          flare.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2; flare.position.set(0, 0, 0.72); pg.add(flare);
          const blue = _mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.05, 8, 6), tierMats.lensBlue);

    }
    // Tier looks for the rest of the buildables. Most are dressing added over the piece
    // as built; the ones that change shape outright (a hedgehog, a gabion, razor wire,
    // a parapet) hide the run underneath first.
    // The tiers that change shape outright drop the run they replace, rather than
    // hiding it: a hidden mesh is still a mesh to keep track of.
    function hideBuilt(mesh) { const g = mesh.userData.inner || mesh; for (const c of g.children.slice()) g.remove(c); }
    function decoratePiece(mesh, kind, tier) {
      if (!tier) return;
      const u = mesh.userData, root = u.inner || mesh, S = BUILD_GRID;
      const add = (m) => { root.add(m); return m; };
      if (kind === 'barricade') {
        if (tier === 1) {
          add(_box(S, 0.5, 0.1, tierMats.steel, 0, 0.2, 0.02));                                    // welded plate along the bottom
          const d = Math.hypot(S / 2 - 0.1, BARRICADE_TOP - 0.5);
          for (const sgn of [1, -1]) { const br = add(_box(d, 0.1, 0.1, tierMats.steelDark, 0, (BARRICADE_TOP + 0.35) / 2, -0.06)); br.rotation.z = sgn * Math.atan2(BARRICADE_TOP - 0.5, S / 2 - 0.1); }
          for (let x = -S / 2 + 0.2; x < S / 2; x += 0.4) add(_box(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, tierMats.rivet, x, 0.42, 0.08));
        } else {
          // Czech hedgehog: three crossed beams on a rail.

          add(_box(S, 0.12, 0.12, tierMats.steelDark, 0, 0.06, 0));
          for (const cx of [-S / 3, 0, S / 3]) {
            for (const [rz, rx] of [[0.9, 0], [-0.9, 0], [0, 0.9]]) {
              const beam = add(_box(0.11, 1.5, 0.11, tierMats.steel, cx, 0.6, 0));

    // === Upgrades =================================================================
    // Every upgrade track, tier by tier. `bp` is the kiosk price of that tier's
    // blueprint (each needs the one before it); `cost` what it costs to take ONE piece
    // up to that tier with the upgrade tool. Tier 0 is what you build.
    const UPGRADE_TRACKS = {
      wall:  { what: 'Walls', names: ['Wood wall', 'Reinforced wood wall', 'Stone wall', 'Reinforced stone wall', 'Steel wall'],
               hp: [130, 210, 330, 480, 680], cost: [0, 22, 40, 60, 85], bp: [0, 140, 300, 520, 800] },
      door:  { what: 'Doors', names: ['Wood door', 'Reinforced wood door', 'Iron door', 'Reinforced iron door', 'Steel door'],
               hp: [0, 45, 100, 170, 260], cost: [0, 16, 28, 42, 60], bp: [0, 110, 240, 400, 620] },
      floor: { what: 'Floors', names: ['Wood floor', 'Stone floor', 'Steel floor'], hp: [85, 170, 290], cost: [0, 30, 60], bp: [0, 240, 560] },

      bars:  { what: 'Window mesh', names: ['Window', 'Steel mesh window'], cost: [0, 18], bp: [0, 160] },
      // Defensive lines.
      barricade: { what: 'Barricades', names: ['Barricade', 'Braced barricade', 'Czech hedgehog'], hp: [40, 90, 170], cost: [0, 16, 28], bp: [0, 100, 220] },
      sandbag:   { what: 'Sandbag walls', names: ['Sandbag wall', 'Double-stacked sandbags', 'Gabion wall'], hp: [90, 160, 260], cost: [0, 18, 32], bp: [0, 110, 240], armour: [25, 40, 60] },
      wire:      { what: 'Barbed wire', names: ['Barbed wire', 'Concertina wire', 'Razor wire'], hp: [22, 40, 60], cost: [0, 16, 30], bp: [0, 120, 280], bites: [7, 12, 18] },
      railing:   { what: 'Railings', names: ['Railing', 'Mesh railing', 'Armoured parapet'], hp: [30, 60, 110], cost: [0, 20, 36], bp: [0, 100, 230] },
      // Structure.
      platform:  { what: 'Platforms', names: ['Platform', 'Plated platform', 'Gun emplacement'], hp: [70, 140, 230], cost: [0, 35, 60], bp: [0, 180, 400] },
      pillar:    { what: 'Pillars', names: ['Structural pillar', 'Concrete pillar', 'Steel column'], hp: [110, 200, 320], cost: [0, 35, 65], bp: [0, 200, 450] },
      stairs:    { what: 'Stairs', names: ['Stairs', 'Steel stairs', 'Retractable stairs'], hp: [60, 120, 180], cost: [0, 40, 70], bp: [0, 160, 420] },
      mortar:    { what: 'Mortars', names: ['Mortar', 'Mortar Mk II', 'Mortar Mk III'], hp: [80, 150, 240], cost: [0, 90, 160], bp: [0, 400, 900], blast: [1, 1.25, 1.5], reload: [1, 0.8, 0.65] },
      // Traps and devices.
      spikes:    { what: 'Spike traps', names: ['Spike trap', 'Resetting spikes', 'Steel spike bed'], hp: [70, 110, 160], cost: [0, 25, 45], bp: [0, 220, 500], dmg: [160, 160, 200], uses: [1, 3, Infinity], reset: [0, 20, 10] },
      mine:      { what: 'Land mines', names: ['Land mine', 'Frag mine', 'Bounding mine'], hp: [20, 24, 30], cost: [0, 20, 36], bp: [0, 200, 460], dmg: [85, 110, 150], blast: [1, 1.3, 1.3] },
      lure:      { what: 'Decoy beacons', names: ['Decoy beacon', 'Siren beacon', 'Shock beacon'], hp: [25, 40, 60], cost: [0, 35, 60], bp: [0, 180, 420], life: [20, 35, 45], pull: [40, 60, 60] },
      barrel:    { what: 'Fuel drums', names: ['Fuel drum', 'Napalm drum'], cost: [0, 30], bp: [0, 240] }
    };
    // Turret tiers scale the gun: damage, reach, rate of fire and toughness.
    const TURRET_TIER = { dmg: [1, 1.45, 2.0], range: [1, 1.15, 1.3], interval: [1, 0.85, 0.7], hp: [1, 1.8, 2.8] };
    const UPGRADE_BLURB = {
      wall: ['', 'Steel straps both faces and an X-brace: tougher, same timber.', 'Dressed stone courses. A real wall.', 'Stone girdled with iron bands and plated corners.', 'Ribbed, riveted steel plate on I-beam posts. The last word.'],
      door: ['', 'Iron-edged, strapped and studded.', 'A ribbed iron plate door.', 'Iron, cross-braced and bolted.', 'A steel vault door with a wheel lock.'],
      floor: ['', 'Stone flags on a mortar bed.', 'Riveted steel tread plate.'],
      light: ['', 'Twin barrels and side armour.', 'Triple barrels, a gun shield and a sensor eye.'],
      flame: ['', 'A second tank and a heat shield.', 'Three tanks, a flared nozzle, blue-hot.'],
      heavy: ['', 'Twin cannon and armour skirts.', 'An armoured hood and a radar dish.'],
      gate: ['', 'Wrought iron bars with spear tips.', 'A steel gate: solid below, grilled above.'],
      bars: ['', 'Steel mesh across the window: fire out while stopping zombie climbs and claws.'],
      barricade: ['', 'A welded plate and a second brace.', 'Crossed steel beams. Anything that swings at it is knocked back a step.'],
      sandbag: ['', 'A fifth course and a plank on top. Armours what it stands on by 40.', 'Wire baskets packed with rock. Armours what it stands on by 60.'],
      wire: ['', 'A coiled spiral: 12 damage to whatever tears at it.', 'Razor tape on steel pickets: 18 damage, and it leaves them slowed.'],
      railing: ['', 'Welded mesh panels.', 'Steel plate to the waist with a firing ledge. Acid and spit no longer reach you through it.'],
      platform: ['', 'A steel skirt round the rim.', 'Sandbagged rim and an ammo locker: the gun on it fires 10% faster.'],
      pillar: ['', 'Poured concrete: braced by a wall within four squares.', 'A steel column: braced within five squares.'],
      stairs: ['', 'Checker-plate treads on steel stringers.', 'Steel, and it folds: press E to pull the flight up behind you.'],
      mortar: ['', 'Sandbagged base and a second crate: 25% more blast, reloads 20% faster.', 'A long tube on a turntable: 50% more blast, reloads 35% faster.'],
      spikes: ['', 'Springs three times, re-arming 20 seconds after each.', 'A steel bed that never wears out: re-arms in 10 seconds, 200 damage, and leaves them bleeding.'],
      mine: ['', 'Fragmentation casing: 110 damage over a wider blast.', 'Bounding charge: it jumps waist-high first. 150 damage.'],
      lure: ['', 'A siren: calls for 35 seconds, and from half again as far.', 'A shock beacon: 45 seconds, and it zaps anything within 2 m.'],
      barrel: ['', 'Napalm: the blast leaves a burning pool that sets them alight.']
    };
    let upgradeOwned = {};   // track -> highest tier whose blueprint you own
    function resetUpgrades() { upgradeOwned = {}; }
    function unlockAllUpgrades() { for (const k of Object.keys(UPGRADE_TRACKS)) upgradeOwned[k] = UPGRADE_TRACKS[k].names.length - 1; }
    function buyUpgradeBlueprint(track, tier) {
      if ((upgradeOwned[track] | 0) + 1 !== tier) return;
      if (!spend(UPGRADE_TRACKS[track].bp[tier])) return;
      upgradeOwned[track] = tier;
      reportPurchase('upgrade-blueprint:' + track + ':' + tier, UPGRADE_TRACKS[track].bp[tier]);
      renderShop();
    }

    // Where a piece is on each of its tracks.
    function tierOf(b, track) {
      if (track === 'barrel') return b.napalm ? 1 : 0;
      if (track === 'door') return b.doorTier | 0;
      if (track === 'gate') return b.gateTier | 0;
      if (track === 'bars') return b.barred ? 1 : 0;
      return b.tier | 0;
    }
    // Which tracks a piece can go up (its parts), in the order R cycles them.
    function upgradeParts(b) {
      if (!b) return [];
      if (b.kind === 'barrel') return ['barrel'];
      if (b.opening === 'gate') return ['gate'];
      if (b.type === 'wall') {
        if (b.opening === 'door') return ['door', 'wall'];
        if (b.opening === 'window') return ['bars', 'wall'];
        return ['wall'];
      }
      if (UPGRADE_TRACKS[b.type]) return [b.type];
      return [];
    }
    // What the tool would do to this piece: { track, from, to, cost, name } or { why }.
    let upgradePart = 0;          // R cycles which part of a multi-part piece
    function upgradePlan(b) {
      const parts = upgradeParts(b);
      if (!parts.length) { const name = b ? nameOf(b) : 'That'; return { why: sayText('build.message.noUpgrades', { name }, name + ' has no upgrades') }; }   // GB-139: keyed
      const track = parts[upgradePart % parts.length];
      const tr = UPGRADE_TRACKS[track], from = tierOf(b, track), to = from + 1;
      const base = { track, from, parts };
      if (to >= tr.names.length) return Object.assign(base, { why: sayText('build.message.maxUpgrade', { name: tr.names[from] }, tr.names[from] + ' — fully upgraded') });
      if ((upgradeOwned[track] | 0) < to) return Object.assign(base, { why: dwText('build.message.requiresUpgrade', { name: tr.names[to] }) });   // GB-133: the catalogue's line
      return Object.assign(base, { to, cost: tr.cost[to], name: tr.names[to], fromName: tr.names[from] });
    }
    // The piece the reticle is on, in reach, for upgrading.
    function upgradeTarget() {
      const b = pickOnMyStorey() || pickBuildOnRay();
      if (b && b.gx != null) {
        const m = edgeMid(b);
        if (Math.hypot(m.x - player.position.x, m.z - player.position.z) <= BUILD_REACH + 1.5) return b;
      }
      // A fuel drum is a landmark rather than a build, so it is looked for separately.
      const pt = getPlacePoint();
      const lm = landmarkInSquare(pt.x, pt.z, BUILD_GRID / 2, false);
      if (lm && lm.kind === 'barrel' && lm.alive && Math.hypot(lm.x - player.position.x, lm.z - player.position.z) <= BUILD_REACH + 1.5) return lm;
      return null;
    }

    // Take one part of one piece up a tier: stats, then the model.
    function applyUpgrade(b, track, to) {
      const from = tierOf(b, track);
      if (to <= from) return;
      const tr = UPGRADE_TRACKS[track];
      if (track === 'barrel') { b.napalm = true; applyBarrelNapalm(b); return; }
      const bump = (dh) => { b.maxHp += dh; b.hp = Math.min(b.maxHp, b.hp + dh); };
      if (track === 'sandbag' && b.armourOn && tr.armour) {
        // The bags armour what they stand on: more bags, more armour.
        const extra = tr.armour[to] - tr.armour[from];
        b.armourOn.maxHp += extra; b.armourOn.hp += extra; b.armourAmt = (b.armourAmt || 0) + extra;
      }
      if (track === 'lure' && tr.life) b.lureT = Math.max(b.lureT || 0, tr.life[to]);
      if (tr.hp && track !== 'gate') bump(tr.hp[to] - tr.hp[from]);
      if (track === 'wall' || track === 'floor' || track === 'door') { /* handled above */ }
      else if (track === 'gate') { const frac = b.hp / b.maxHp; b.maxHp += tr.hp[to] - tr.hp[from]; b.hp = Math.max(1, Math.min(b.maxHp, b.maxHp * frac + (tr.hp[to] - tr.hp[from]))); }
      else if (TURRET_TIER.dmg[to] != null && BUILD_STATS[b.type] && BUILD_STATS[b.type].range) {
        const st = BUILD_STATS[b.type];
        b.damage = st.damage * TURRET_TIER.dmg[to];
        b.range = st.range * TURRET_TIER.range[to];
        b.fireInterval = (st.fireInterval || 0.7) * TURRET_TIER.interval[to];
        bump(st.hp * (TURRET_TIER.hp[to] - TURRET_TIER.hp[from]));
      }
      if (track === 'door') b.doorTier = to;
      else if (track === 'gate') b.gateTier = to;
      else if (track === 'bars') b.barred = true;
      else b.tier = to;
      rebuildBuildMesh(b);
    }

    // Napalm: olive bands and a stencil on the drum.
    function applyBarrelNapalm(lm) {
      if (!lm.mesh) return;
      lm.mesh.add(_box(0.78, 0.12, 0.78, tierMats.olive, 0, 0.95, 0),
                  _box(0.8, 0.1, 0.8, tierMats.black, 0, 0.55, 0),
                  _box(0.2, 0.3, 0.06, tierMats.brass, 0, 0.75, 0.38));
    }
    // A fresh model for a piece at its current tier, swapped in where the old one
    // stood, with everything that hangs off it put back: the opening, the leaves and
    // how far open they are, the bars, the aim of a turret.
    // The kinds whose model changes with their tier.
    const TIERED_MESH = { wall: 1, floor: 1, light: 1, heavy: 1, flame: 1, barricade: 1, sandbag: 1, wire: 1, railing: 1, platform: 1, pillar: 1, stairs: 1, spikes: 1, mine: 1, lure: 1, mortar: 1 };
    function makeTieredMesh(b) {
      const k = b.type, t = b.tier | 0;
      if (k === 'wall') return makeWallMesh(null, t);

    // The tool itself: click to take the piece under the reticle up one tier.

    let upgradeHint = '';

    function upgradeAvailableHint() {
      const b = upgradeTarget();

    // GB-139: a first-time tip, once per browser profile (like the coach's cards), on the big banner.

    }
    function upgradeHintFor(b) {
      if (!b) return sayText('build.message.upgradePoint', {}, 'Point at something you built');

    // Middle of a wall-type piece's edge, in the world.

    function toggleDoor(b) {
      if (!b || !isSwing(b)) return;

    // Nearest door within reach of the marine, on the storey he is standing on.
    const DOOR_USE_R = 2.2;
    function nearestDoor() {

      for (const b of builds) {

        if (py < y0 - 0.6 || py > y0 + 1.4) continue;
        const m = edgeMid(b);

    }
    function dragOpts() { return buildDrag && buildDrag.lv != null ? { lv: buildDrag.lv } : null; }

    // A floor reaching out over open space leans on the one before it in the run, so

    function dragPlan(pt) {
      const { cells, axis } = dragLine(buildDrag.gx, buildDrag.gz, pt.gx, pt.gz);

    // LMB down in build mode. A piece that makes sense in a line starts a drag and is

    // Everything in the drag box that this upgrade applies to, cheapest first so a

      const yaw = dragYaw(placeMode, axis, drag.edge);

    // === What X would scrap ======================================================

    // what stands on it, when it is a wall) in a fainter box around the lot. The banner

    function makeOutlineBox(color, fillOpacity) {
      const g = new THREE.Group();

      const E = [[0, 1], [1, 2], [2, 3], [3, 0], [4, 5], [5, 6], [6, 7], [7, 4], [0, 4], [1, 5], [2, 6], [3, 7]];
      const pts = [];
      for (const [a, b] of E) pts.push(...c[a], ...c[b]);

      geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pts, 3));

    function nightPushSizes(total, pushes) {
      const P = Math.max(1, Math.min(pushes | 0, total));

    function waveComposition(dayNum) {

      const sizes = nightPushSizes(plan.total, plan.pushes || 1);

      const kinds = plan.kinds || {}, packs = plan.packs || {}, late = plan.late || [];

      const packBy = sizes.map(() => []);     // packs that come out together in each push
      const spread = [];

        for (; p < P - 1; p++) { acc += pw[p]; if (f < acc) break; }

      for (let p = 0; p < P; p++) {
        const sp = spreadBy[p];
        for (let i = sp.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
          if (Math.random() < 0.3) { const j = (Math.random() * (i + 1)) | 0; const tmp = sp[i]; sp[i] = sp[j]; sp[j] = tmp; }

        const n = Math.max(0, sizes[p] - packN(p));
        const seg = new Array(n).fill('shambler');
        for (let i = 0; i < sp.length && i < n; i++) seg[Math.floor((i + 0.5) * n / sp.length)] = sp[i];

        const head = packBy[p].filter((pk) => HEADLINE_PACKS.includes(pk[0])).sort((a, b) => HEADLINE_PACKS.indexOf(a[0]) - HEADLINE_PACKS.indexOf(b[0]));
        const rest = packBy[p].filter((pk) => !HEADLINE_PACKS.includes(pk[0]));
        const Q = rest.length;
        for (let q = Q - 1; q >= 0; q--) seg.splice(Math.floor(n * (0.2 + 0.6 * q / Math.max(1, Q))), 0, ...rest[q]);

      out.pushSizes = sizes.slice();
      out.packRuns = packRuns;   // GB-73: where each set-piece pack sits in the queue

    }

    function pickRadioDefenderSeat(cx, cz, taken) {
      const px = nearestPlayer(0, 0).position.x, pz = nearestPlayer(0, 0).position.z;
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 48; attempt++) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;

        const x = cx + Math.cos(a) * r;

    function magazineSupplyTarget(cal) {

    function applyOneSupply(id, qty) {
      let cal = id;
      if (typeof id === 'string' && id.startsWith('ammo:')) cal = id.slice(5);
      const isSaw = (id === 'ammo:chainsaw' || cal === 'chainsaw' || cal === 'saw');
      // D-16 / GB-17: saw fuel stays fractional; other supplies stay whole units.
      const want = isSaw ? Math.max(0, Number(qty) || 0) : Math.max(0, qty | 0);
      if (want <= 0) return { id, accepted: 0, remaining: 0 };
      if (id === 'medkit' || id === 'medpen' || id === 'MedPen' || id === 'medkits') {
        const space = Math.max(0, MAX_MEDKITS - medkits);
        const take = Math.min(space, want);
        medkits += take;
        return { id: 'medkit', accepted: take, remaining: want - take };

        const space = Math.max(0, maxGrenades() - grenades);
        const take = Math.min(space, want);
        grenades += take;
        return { id: 'grenade', accepted: take, remaining: want - take };

      }

      const have = reserveAmmo[cal] | 0;
      const space = Math.max(0, cap - have);

      return { id: 'ammo:' + cal, accepted: take, remaining: want - take };

    function damagePlayer(amount, cause = null, attacker = null, info = null, p = localPlayer) {
      // CU-63: a dummy counts the hit and never dies, and never ends the run.
      if (p && p.dummy) { p.hits++; p.damage += amount; return; }
      if (devGodMode) return; // "godmode" dev cheat — every damage source funnels through here
      if (gameOver || won || !gameStarted) return;
      if (scriptedKill) return; // a scripted kill owns the ending; nothing else gets a bite
      if (rollT > 0) return; // untouchable mid-roll
      // Armour takes the first ARMOR_ABSORB of a hit while there is any left; the
      // rest goes to health. A hit that is fully soaked still counts as being hurt
      // (regen delay, flash) — the plates ring, you flinch.
      // GODLIKE (30+ streak): a quarter of everything shrugged off before the armour.
      if (streakResist() > 0) amount = Math.round(amount * (1 - streakResist()));
      let toHp = amount;
      let soaked = 0;
      if (playerArmor > 0) {
        soaked = Math.min(playerArmor, amount * ARMOR_ABSORB);
        playerArmor -= soaked;
        toHp = amount - soaked;
      }
      playerHp -= toHp;
      if (attacker && attacker.typeKey && playerHp > 0 && playerHp < PLAYER_MAX_HP * 0.25) { const s = skillState(); if (s.cbNight !== day && !(s.cbT > 0)) s.cbT = 30; }   // GB-101: a comeback watch starts
      sinceHurt = 0;

      // GB-16 (c): ChatGPT hold-E radio repair listens; any landed hit (incl. armour soak) interrupts.
      objDamaged = true;
      publishUI('player-damaged', {
        cause, amount, toHp, soaked,
        hp: playerHp, armor: playerArmor,
        fatal: playerHp <= 0
