      const attackerPos = attacker?.mesh?.position || attacker?.position;
      let dx = attackerPos ? attackerPos.x - player.position.x : Math.sin(aimYaw);
      let dz = attackerPos ? attackerPos.z - player.position.z : Math.cos(aimYaw);
      const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
      dx /= dist; dz /= dist;
      hitReaction.time = hitReaction.duration;
      hitReaction.front = dx * Math.sin(aimYaw) + dz * Math.cos(aimYaw);
      hitReaction.side = dx * Math.cos(aimYaw) - dz * Math.sin(aimYaw);
      hitReaction.strength = Math.min(1.6, 0.55 + amount / 34) * (soaked > toHp ? 0.65 : 1);
      if (attackerPos && grounded) {
        // GB-50 (see hitStumble): knocked back along the blow, a stumble, maybe a knee.
        const heavy = !!(attacker && (attacker.brute || attacker.tactics === 'tank' || attacker.tactics === 'boss'));
        const soakK = soaked > toHp ? 0.7 : 1;
        const kv = Math.min(7, (1.6 + amount * 0.14) * (heavy ? 1.6 : 1)) * soakK;
        hitStumble.kvx = -dx * kv; hitStumble.kvz = -dz * kv;
        hitStumble.stumbleT = HIT_STUMBLE_S;
        hitStumble.aimOff = (hitReaction.side >= 0 ? -1 : 1) * Math.min(0.14, 0.04 + amount * 0.004) * soakK;
        hitStumble.aimT = HIT_AIM_S;
        hitStumble.jx = -dx; hitStumble.jz = -dz;
        hitStumble.jolt = Math.min(0.55, 0.18 + amount * 0.014) * soakK;
        if ((heavy || amount >= HIT_KNEE_DMG) && toHp > 0 && hitStumble.kneeCd <= 0) {
          hitStumble.kneeT = HIT_KNEE_S; hitStumble.kneeCd = HIT_KNEE_CD; hitStumble.knees++;
        }
        hitStumble.hits++;
      }
      addShake(Math.min(0.5, 0.1 + amount * 0.012));
      if (toHp > 0.5) spawnBlood(player.position.x, player.position.y + getStanceEyeY() * 0.7, player.position.z, 0, 0, 5);
      else spawnEmbers(player.position.x, player.position.y + getStanceEyeY() * 0.6, player.position.z, 3, 0.5); // plates ring: a few sparks, no blood
      if (soaked > 0) AudioSys.armorHit(soaked > toHp);
      if (playerHp > 0 || !(AudioSys.playerDeath && AudioSys.playerDeath())) AudioSys.playerHurt(amount >= HIT_KNEE_DMG || !!(attacker && (attacker.brute || attacker.tactics === 'tank' || attacker.tactics === 'boss')));   // CL-161: the last hit his death, a big one heavy

      }
    }

    // Dropped MedPens: picked up on touch (or used on the spot if your pockets are full). Rare, and rarer still from

    function spawnMedDrop(x, z) {

    function clearMedDrops() { for (const m of medDrops) scene.remove(m.mesh); medDrops.length = 0; }

    // GB-94 follow-up (Jerry 2026-10-05, 8:27 PM): "Get rid of zombies dropping med pens." The kiosk, supply drops and

    // === Your name and your grave ====================================================
    // All of it lives for this page session only — close the tab and the dead are
    // forgotten. Each death is buried in the next of six fresh plots beside the old

    const GRAVE_PLOTS = 6;

    function cleanName(s) { return String(s || '').replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N} .'\-]/gu, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 18); }

    // --- The plots: a row of six just south of the old stones.
    function plotSpot(i) {

      const x = g.x + (i - (GRAVE_PLOTS - 1) / 2) * 2.0, z = g.z + 6.2;
      return { x, z, gy: sampleHeight(x, z) };
    }
    const graveStoneMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8b8b84, roughness: 0.92 });
    const graveStoneDark = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x6c6c66, roughness: 0.95 });
    const graveDirtFresh = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x4e3a28, roughness: 1 });
    const plotPegMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8a6a45, roughness: 0.9 });
    const plotLineMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xd8d2b8 });

    const MOUND = { rx: 0.55, ry: 0.26, rz: 1.0 };
    function moundHeight(u, v) { const k = 1 - (u / MOUND.rx) ** 2 - (v / MOUND.rz) ** 2; return k > 0 ? MOUND.ry * Math.sqrt(k) : 0; }
    // Empty plots are surveyed out: four pegs and a string, so you can see how many are left.
    let plotMarkers = null;
    function ensurePlotMarkers() {
      if (plotMarkers || !POI.graveyard) return;
      plotMarkers = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < GRAVE_PLOTS; i++) {
        const p = plotSpot(i), g = new THREE.Group();
        g.position.set(p.x, p.gy, p.z);
        for (const [sx, sz] of [[-1, -1], [1, -1], [1, 1], [-1, 1]]) {
          const peg = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05, 0.3, 0.05), plotPegMat);
          peg.position.set(sx * 0.55, 0.12, sz * 1.0); g.add(peg);
        }
        for (const [w, d, x, z] of [[1.1, 0.012, 0, -1], [1.1, 0.012, 0, 1], [0.012, 2.0, -0.55, 0], [0.012, 2.0, 0.55, 0]]) {
          const line = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, 0.012, d), plotLineMat); line.position.set(x, 0.2, z); g.add(line);
        }

    }
    // The headstone's face is a canvas: stone grey, the words cut in (dark, with a
    // lit lower lip), revealed a letter at a time while the camera watches.
    function drawPlaque(rec, reveal = 1) {
      const c = rec.canvas, ctx = c && c.getContext ? c.getContext('2d') : null;
      if (!ctx) return;
      const W = c.width, H = c.height;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8b8b84'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      let seed = 7; for (const ch of rec.name) seed = (seed * 31 + ch.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0;
      const rnd = () => ((seed = (seed * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0) / 4294967296);
      for (let i = 0; i < 260; i++) { ctx.fillStyle = rnd() < 0.5 ? 'rgba(60,60,55,0.18)' : 'rgba(200,200,190,0.16)'; ctx.fillRect(rnd() * W, rnd() * H, 1 + rnd() * 2, 1 + rnd() * 2); }
      const carve = (text, x, y, font, align = 'center') => {
        ctx.font = font; ctx.textAlign = align; ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(210,210,200,0.85)'; ctx.fillText(text, x + 1.5, y + 1.8);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#34342f'; ctx.fillText(text, x, y);
      };
      carve('R.I.P.', W / 2, 52, 'bold 30px Georgia, serif');
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(52,52,47,0.6)'; ctx.fillRect(W * 0.3, 70, W * 0.4, 3);
      // The name: as large as fits, cut left to right in its final place.
      let size = 58;
      const fontFor = (s) => '700 ' + s + 'px "Black Ops One", Impact, "Arial Black", sans-serif';
      ctx.font = fontFor(size);
      while (size > 20 && ctx.measureText(rec.name).width > W - 28) { size -= 2; ctx.font = fontFor(size); }
      const full = ctx.measureText(rec.name).width;
      const shown = rec.name.slice(0, Math.round(rec.name.length * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, reveal))));
      if (shown) carve(shown, W / 2 - full / 2, 150 + size * 0.3, fontFor(size), 'left');
      if (reveal >= 1) {
        carve('FELL ON DAY ' + rec.day, W / 2, 232, 'bold 22px Georgia, serif');
        carve(rec.kills + (rec.kills === 1 ? ' KILL' : ' KILLS'), W / 2, 266, '20px Georgia, serif');
      }
      if (rec.tex) rec.tex.needsUpdate = true;
    }
    function makeGrave(rec) {
      const p = plotSpot(rec.plot);
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      g.position.set(p.x, p.gy, p.z);
      const add = (m, x, y, z, parent = g) => { m.position.set(x, y, z); m.castShadow = true; m.receiveShadow = true; parent.add(m); return m; };
      const mound = add(new THREE.Mesh(_moundGeo, graveDirtFresh), 0, 0.0, 0);

      add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.66, 0.78, 0.14), graveStoneMat), 0, 0.53, 0, stone);

      const plaque = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.58, 0.68), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: rec.tex, roughness: 0.9 }));
      plaque.position.set(0, 0.64, 0.073); stone.add(plaque);

    }
    function nearestGrave(r) {
      let best = null, bd = r;

        const d = Math.hypot(player.position.x - sx, player.position.z - (sz + 0.6));
        if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = rec; }

    }

    // --- The burial party: two marines, a shovel each. Built once and reused.
    function makeShovelMesh() {
      const g = new THREE.Group();

      const steelM = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x5d636a, metalness: 0.6, roughness: 0.45 });
      const put = (geo, mat, y) => { const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat); m.position.y = y; m.castShadow = true; g.add(m); return m; };
      put(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.02, 0.022, 1.2, 8), wood, 0.6);
      put(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.14, 0.03, 0.03), wood, 0.0);
      put(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.03, 0.05, 0.12, 8), steelM, 1.2);
      put(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.24, 0.3, 0.025), steelM, 1.4);
      g.userData.len = 1.55;

    }
    let cineCrew = null;
    const DIG_LEAN = 0.3;
    // CL-105 (Jerry, 2026-09-29): the burial detail always wears woodland MARPAT, whatever camo the player picked in
    // the CIF. Their uniform pieces get their own copies of the uniform materials, painted once with MARPAT.
    let marpatTex = null;
    const marpatMats = new Map();
    function dressInMarpat(m) {

        const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = camoTex.image.width; cv.height = camoTex.image.height;
        paintCamoTile('marpat', cv);

        if (THREE.RepeatWrapping) marpatTex.wrapS = marpatTex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      }
      m.traverse((o) => {
        if (!o.isMesh) return;
        const swap = (mat) => {
          if (!mat || mat.map !== camoTex) return mat;
          if (!marpatMats.has(mat)) { const c = mat.clone(); c.map = marpatTex; marpatMats.set(mat, c); }
          return marpatMats.get(mat);

    function ensureCrew() {
      if (cineCrew) return cineCrew;

        const m = makeMarine();

        for (const k of Object.keys(gp)) { const on = k === 'helmet' || k === 'vest' || k === 'pads'; for (const o of gp[k]) o.visible = on; }
        dressInMarpat(m);   // CL-105: the burial detail is always in woodland MARPAT

        const shovel = makeShovelMesh(); shovel.visible = false; scene.add(shovel);

    // One pose knob for the diggers: a = 0 shovel raised, a = 1 driven down at the
    // earth. walk > 0 swings the legs.
    function poseCrew(c, a, lean = 0, walkPh = null) {
      const ud = c.m.userData;

      c.pitch = -0.25 + a * 0.9;          // the shovel's angle below level, with the arms

      ud.armRG.rotation.set(ARM_R_BASE.x + off, ARM_R_BASE.y, ARM_R_BASE.z);
      ud.elbowLG.rotation.set(ELBOW_L_BASE.x, 0, 0);

    const REM = {
      bone: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xcdc6ae, roughness: 0.84, metalness: 0.03 }),
      boneWet: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x9d8b72, roughness: 0.52, metalness: 0.06 }),
      socket: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x0b0908, roughness: 1 }),
      gristle: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x6b2120, roughness: 0.42, metalness: 0.08 }),
      // Camo at this size is three or four shades of scrap, not a printed pattern — a
      // 256px woodland tile on a 6cm rag is mud with extra steps.
      rags: [
        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x4e5733, roughness: 1, side: THREE.DoubleSide }),
        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x5d4a2f, roughness: 1, side: THREE.DoubleSide }),
        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x323a24, roughness: 1, side: THREE.DoubleSide }),
        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2a231c, roughness: 1, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
      ],
      strap: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x24261c, roughness: 0.95 }),
      steel: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8b8d86, roughness: 0.4, metalness: 0.7 })
    };
    // One bone: a tapered shaft with a knuckle on each end, lying along +y from its base.
    function remBone(len, r, mat = REM.bone) {
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      const shaft = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r * 0.72, r * 0.8, len, 6), mat);
      shaft.position.y = len * 0.5;
      g.add(shaft);
      for (const y of [0, len]) {
        const k = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(r * 1.35, 6, 5), mat);
        k.position.y = y;
        k.scale.set(1, 0.8, 1.05);
        g.add(k);
      }
      return g;
    }
    function remSkull(s = 1) {
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      const cran = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.11 * s, 8, 6), REM.bone);
      cran.scale.set(0.94, 1, 1.12);
      g.add(cran);
      const face = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.13 * s, 0.09 * s, 0.08 * s), REM.bone);
      face.position.set(0, -0.055 * s, 0.1 * s);
      g.add(face);
      for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
        const eye = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.031 * s, 6, 5), REM.socket);
        eye.position.set(sx * 0.045 * s, -0.012 * s, 0.108 * s);
        eye.scale.set(1, 0.9, 0.6);
        g.add(eye);
      }
      const nose = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.022 * s, 0.03 * s, 0.02 * s), REM.socket);
      nose.position.set(0, -0.055 * s, 0.14 * s);
      g.add(nose);
      // Jaw on its own pivot at the hinge, so it can hang open and swing.
      const jaw = new THREE.Group();
      jaw.position.set(0, -0.05 * s, 0.02 * s);
      const jawBone = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.115 * s, 0.035 * s, 0.11 * s), REM.bone);
      jawBone.position.set(0, -0.04 * s, 0.062 * s);
      jaw.add(jawBone);
      for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
        const ramus = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.02 * s, 0.06 * s, 0.022 * s), REM.bone);
        ramus.position.set(sx * 0.05 * s, -0.015 * s, 0.012 * s);
        jaw.add(ramus);
      }
      g.add(jaw);
      g.userData.jaw = jaw;
      return g;
    }
    // Ribcage and pelvis on one spine. Returns the group; ribs are arcs, not a barrel,
    // so you can see through it — which is most of why a ribcage reads as a ribcage.
    function remTorso(s = 1) {
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        const t = i / 6;
        const rr = (0.145 - t * 0.035) * s;
        const rib = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(rr, 0.014 * s, 4, 9, Math.PI * 1.15), REM.bone);
        rib.rotation.set(Math.PI / 2, 0, Math.PI * 0.42);
        rib.position.set(0, (0.34 - i * 0.055) * s, 0.012 * s);
        rib.scale.set(1, 1, 0.78);
        g.add(rib);
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        const v = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05 * s, 0.035 * s, 0.045 * s), REM.bone);
        v.position.set(0, (0.4 - i * 0.055) * s, -0.085 * s);
        g.add(v);
      }
      const sternum = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05 * s, 0.2 * s, 0.022 * s), REM.bone);
      sternum.position.set(0, 0.25 * s, 0.105 * s);
      g.add(sternum);
      for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
        const clav = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.014 * s, 0.014 * s, 0.14 * s, 5), REM.bone);
        clav.position.set(sx * 0.075 * s, 0.375 * s, 0.05 * s);
        clav.rotation.set(0, 0, Math.PI / 2 - sx * 0.35);
        g.add(clav);
      }
      const pelvis = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.2 * s, 0.09 * s, 0.13 * s), REM.bone);
      pelvis.position.y = -0.1 * s;
      g.add(pelvis);
      for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
        const ilium = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.06 * s, 0.11 * s, 0.1 * s), REM.bone);
        ilium.position.set(sx * 0.1 * s, -0.055 * s, 0);
        ilium.rotation.z = sx * 0.22;
        g.add(ilium);
      }
      return g;
    }
    // A hanging scrap. Thin boxes rather than planes so it still catches the light from
    // the side when the body tumbles.
    function remRag(w, h, mat) {
      const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, 0.006), mat);
      m.castShadow = false;
      return m;
    }
    function remBlood(r, flat = 0.3) {
      const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(r, 7, 5), REM.gristle);
      m.scale.set(1, flat, 1);
      return m;
    }

    // The body the guardian throws back out: skeletonised, still wet, with what is left
    // of the uniform hanging off it. Limbs are on pivots so the throw can make them
    // trail and the landing can let them fold.
    function makeSkeletalMarine() {
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      const s = 1.0;
      const rag = (i) => REM.rags[i % REM.rags.length];
      const spine = new THREE.Group();
      spine.position.y = 0.95;
      g.add(spine);
      const torso = remTorso(s);
      spine.add(torso);
      // Shreds of the shirt still caught on the ribs and webbing straps gone slack.
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        const w = 0.07 + Math.random() * 0.1, h = 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.16;
        const r = remRag(w, h, rag(i));
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        r.position.set(Math.cos(a) * 0.12, 0.3 - Math.random() * 0.38, Math.sin(a) * 0.1);
        r.rotation.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5, a, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7);
        spine.add(r);
      }
      const strapA = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.035, 0.42, 0.012), REM.strap);
      strapA.position.set(-0.06, 0.16, 0.1); strapA.rotation.z = 0.24;
      spine.add(strapA);
      const strapB = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.035, 0.3, 0.012), REM.strap);
      strapB.position.set(0.08, 0.1, 0.1); strapB.rotation.z = -0.4;
      spine.add(strapB);
      // Dog tags on a chain: one small bright thing in all that bone.
      const tag = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.035, 0.05, 0.006), REM.steel);
      tag.position.set(0.01, 0.13, 0.13);
      spine.add(tag);
      spine.add(remBlood(0.1, 0.5).translateY(-0.04).translateZ(0.06));

      const neck = new THREE.Group();
      neck.position.y = 0.44 * s;
      spine.add(neck);
      const skull = remSkull(s);
      skull.position.y = 0.1 * s;
      skull.rotation.x = 0.5;                       // head fallen back off the spine
      neck.add(skull);
      const gore = remBlood(0.055, 0.8);
      gore.position.y = 0.02;
      neck.add(gore);

      const limbs = {};
      for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
        const k = sx < 0 ? 'L' : 'R';
        const upper = new THREE.Group();
        upper.position.set(sx * 0.135 * s, 0.35 * s, 0.02);
        upper.rotation.z = sx * 0.2;
        upper.add(remBone(0.3 * s, 0.026 * s));
        // Humerus hangs down: the bone is modelled +y, so flip the group over.
        upper.rotation.x = Math.PI;
        const fore = new THREE.Group();
        fore.position.y = 0.3 * s;
        const foreBone = remBone(0.26 * s, 0.021 * s);
        fore.add(foreBone);
        const hand = new THREE.Group();
        hand.position.y = 0.26 * s;
        for (let f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
          const fing = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.013 * s, 0.07 * s, 0.013 * s), REM.bone);
          fing.position.set((f - 1.5) * 0.017 * s, 0.035 * s, 0);
          fing.rotation.x = -0.3 - f * 0.12;
          hand.add(fing);
        }
        fore.add(hand);
        upper.add(fore);
        spine.add(upper);
        limbs['arm' + k] = upper;
        limbs['fore' + k] = fore;

        const leg = new THREE.Group();
        leg.position.set(sx * 0.085 * s, -0.12 * s, 0);
        leg.rotation.x = Math.PI;                    // femur hangs down
        leg.add(remBone(0.42 * s, 0.032 * s));
        const shin = new THREE.Group();
        shin.position.y = 0.42 * s;
        shin.add(remBone(0.38 * s, 0.026 * s));
        // The boots outlasted him. One is still laced on.
        const boot = new THREE.Group();
        boot.position.y = 0.38 * s;
        if (sx > 0) {
          const b = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.11 * s, 0.1 * s, 0.24 * s), REM.strap);
          b.position.set(0, 0.03 * s, 0.04 * s);
          boot.add(b);
          const sole = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.115 * s, 0.022 * s, 0.26 * s), REM.socket);
          sole.position.set(0, -0.02 * s, 0.045 * s);
          boot.add(sole);
        } else {
          for (let f = 0; f < 3; f++) {
            const t = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.018 * s, 0.016 * s, 0.07 * s), REM.bone);
            t.position.set((f - 1) * 0.022 * s, 0, 0.04 * s);
            boot.add(t);
          }
        }
        boot.rotation.x = Math.PI;                   // undo the femur flip for the foot
        shin.add(boot);
        // Trouser shreds round the thigh and the knee.
        for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
          const r = remRag(0.1 + Math.random() * 0.06, 0.14 + Math.random() * 0.1, rag(i + sx + 2));
          r.position.set(sx * 0.04, 0.12 + i * 0.16, 0.03 * (i ? -1 : 1));
          r.rotation.set(0.2, sx * 0.6, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5);
          leg.add(r);
        }
        leg.add(shin);
        spine.add(leg);
        limbs['leg' + k] = leg;
        limbs['shin' + k] = shin;
      }
      g.traverse((o) => { if (o.isMesh) { o.castShadow = true; o.receiveShadow = false; } });
      g.userData.parts = limbs;
      g.userData.spine = spine;
      g.userData.neck = neck;
      g.userData.skull = skull;
      g.userData.jaw = skull.userData.jaw;
      g.userData.mats = [];          // REM materials are shared; the prop owns no material
      return g;
    }
    // Set the whole thing limp, with a little sway driven by the caller's phase.
    function poseRemains(rm, sway = 0) {
      const p = rm.userData.parts;
      const w = Math.sin(sway * 5.5), v = Math.cos(sway * 4.1);
      p.armL.rotation.set(Math.PI - 0.25 + w * 0.2, 0, 0.3);
      p.armR.rotation.set(Math.PI - 0.15 - w * 0.2, 0, -0.26);
      p.foreL.rotation.set(0.5 + v * 0.35, 0, 0);
      p.foreR.rotation.set(0.62 - v * 0.35, 0, 0);
      p.legL.rotation.set(Math.PI + 0.1 + v * 0.14, 0, 0.08);
      p.legR.rotation.set(Math.PI - 0.06 - v * 0.14, 0, -0.1);
      p.shinL.rotation.set(0.45 + w * 0.2, 0, 0);
      p.shinR.rotation.set(0.3 - w * 0.2, 0, 0);
      if (rm.userData.jaw) rm.userData.jaw.rotation.x = 0.4 + Math.abs(w) * 0.25;
      if (rm.userData.skull) rm.userData.skull.rotation.x = 0.5 + w * 0.12;
    }

    // What comes up out of the pit: a slick of blood with the bones turning over in it.
    // Nothing here is assembled — that is the point. The ribcage rides half under, the
    // skull bobs face-up, and the long bones drift apart on the surface.
    // A slick of blood on water is not a clean disc: the radius wanders, and there are
    // two of them — a thin spread edge and a thicker, brighter middle.
    function remSlickGeo(r, wobble, seed) {
      const N = 30;
      const pos = [0, 0, 0];
      const idx = [];
      let s = seed;
      const rnd = () => ((s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0) / 4294967296);
      const rr = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) rr.push(r * (1 - wobble * 0.5 + rnd() * wobble));
      for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        // Smooth the radii so the edge is lobed rather than spiky.
        const a = (i / N) * Math.PI * 2;
        const rad = (rr[i] * 2 + rr[(i + 1) % N] + rr[(i + N - 1) % N]) / 4;
        pos.push(Math.cos(a) * rad, 0, Math.sin(a) * rad);
        idx.push(0, 1 + i, 1 + (i + 1) % N);
      }
      const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
      geo.setIndex(idx);
      geo.computeVertexNormals();
      return geo;
    }
    function makeBoneRaft() {
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      const slickMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x2b0506, roughness: 0.14, metalness: 0.12, transparent: true, opacity: 0,
        depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide
      });
      const filmMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x590d0c, roughness: 0.08, metalness: 0.22, transparent: true, opacity: 0,
        depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide
      });
      const slick = new THREE.Mesh(remSlickGeo(1.55, 0.42, 0x51c3), slickMat);
      slick.renderOrder = 3;
      g.add(slick);
      const film = new THREE.Mesh(remSlickGeo(0.95, 0.5, 0x9ab1), filmMat);
      film.position.set(0.22, 0.014, -0.16);
      film.renderOrder = 4;
      g.add(film);
      const bits = [];
      const float = (obj, x, z, spin) => {
        obj.position.set(x, 0, z);
        obj.userData.bobPhase = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        obj.userData.spin = spin;
        obj.userData.baseY = -0.02 - Math.random() * 0.05;
        g.add(obj);
        bits.push(obj);
        return obj;
      };
      // Everything is built at 1.4x: at a distance a life-sized ribcage is four pale
      // pixels, and this is the shot the whole death rests on.
      const S = 1.4;
      const cage = remTorso(S);
      cage.rotation.set(-Math.PI / 2 + 0.3, 0.6, 0.18);   // rolled over, ribs breaking surface
      float(cage, -0.1, 0.06, 0.05);
      const skull = remSkull(S);
      skull.rotation.set(-0.45, 2.1, 0.3);
      if (skull.userData.jaw) skull.userData.jaw.rotation.x = 0.8;
      float(skull, 0.72, -0.42, -0.09);
      const pelvis = remTorso(S * 0.6);
      pelvis.rotation.set(-Math.PI / 2 - 0.4, 1.9, 0.5);
      float(pelvis, -0.66, 0.5, 0.06);
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        const b = remBone((0.34 + Math.random() * 0.2) * S, (0.026 + Math.random() * 0.01) * S,
          Math.random() < 0.4 ? REM.boneWet : REM.bone);
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, d = 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.95;
        b.rotation.set(Math.PI / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5, a, 0);
        float(b, Math.cos(a) * d, Math.sin(a) * d, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.12);
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const r = remRag((0.16 + Math.random() * 0.14) * S, (0.12 + Math.random() * 0.14) * S, REM.rags[i % REM.rags.length]);
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, d = 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.95;
        r.rotation.set(-Math.PI / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35, a, 0);
        float(r, Math.cos(a) * d, Math.sin(a) * d, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2);
      }
      // One boot, still laced, floating sole-up.
      const boot = new THREE.Group();
      const bootBody = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.13 * S, 0.11 * S, 0.3 * S), REM.strap);
      boot.add(bootBody);
      const bootSole = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.135 * S, 0.026 * S, 0.32 * S), REM.socket);
      bootSole.position.y = 0.06 * S;
      boot.add(bootSole);
      boot.rotation.set(0.2, 1.1, 0.3);
      float(boot, 0.5, 0.78, 0.04);
      const tag = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05, 0.07, 0.006), REM.steel);
      tag.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
      float(tag, -0.58, -0.6, 0.3);
      g.traverse((o) => { if (o.isMesh) { o.castShadow = false; o.receiveShadow = false; } });
      g.userData.bits = bits;
      g.userData.slick = slick;
      g.userData.film = film;
      g.userData.mats = [slickMat, filmMat];
      return g;
    }
    // Both remains props hold blood in the water / on the ground; this drives the bob.
    function updateBoneRaft(raft, t, spread) {
      for (const b of raft.userData.bits) {
        const ph = b.userData.bobPhase;
        b.position.y = b.userData.baseY + Math.sin(t * 1.5 + ph) * 0.035;
        b.rotation.y += b.userData.spin * 0.006;
        const d = Math.hypot(b.position.x, b.position.z) || 1;
        // They drift apart as the pool spreads.
        b.position.x += (b.position.x / d) * spread * 0.0016;
        b.position.z += (b.position.z / d) * spread * 0.0016;
      }
    }

    // The guardian (world/cave-guardian.js): a built rig, not a re-dressed zombie. A pale
    // long-armed crawler coloured from the cave it lives in. The group the scenes move is the
    // outer one; its root sits at the creature's chest so "its position" is where it is, and
    // the rig hangs off an inner pivot, scaled up and set back so the hind feet land behind.
    const GUARDIAN_SCALE = 1.3, GUARDIAN_SETBACK = 1.15;
    // CL-64 (D-41): the cave drag is a studio scene, studio/scenes/guardian-grab-drag.json, played on
    // the game's own guardian and marine (what review/guardian-grab-drag/ shows is what plays here).
    // Loaded off the critical path; if it isn't in yet, or can't load, the drag keeps its old hand
    // code (updateCaveDrag below).
    let caveGrab = null;
    // The cave drag plays the scene with no reacting body: the marine is animated by the clips alone.
    // CL-84 part 2: the magazine change for the mag-fed long guns, a hand path clip (studio/clips/marine/reload-rifle.json).
    // Until it arrives (or if it fails) the old straight-line path in holdWeapon runs.
    let RELOAD_CLIP = null;
    const RELOAD_CLIP_GUNS = new Set(['m4', 'ak', 'aa12']);
    Studio.fetchHandPath('reload-rifle').then((c) => { RELOAD_CLIP = c; }).catch((e) => console.warn('reload clip:', e && e.message || e));
    let KNIFE_CLIP = null, MACHETE_CLIP = null, _kc = null;   // CU-107: knife thrust, machete chop
    Studio.fetchHandPath('knife-slash').then((c) => { KNIFE_CLIP = c; }).catch((e) => console.warn('knife clip:', e && e.message || e));
    Studio.fetchHandPath('machete-chop').then((c) => { MACHETE_CLIP = c; }).catch((e) => console.warn('machete clip:', e && e.message || e));
    Studio.fetchScene('guardian-grab-drag', { transform: Studio.sceneWithoutMotion })
      .then((plain) => { caveGrab = { Studio, scene: plain, plain }; })
      .catch((e) => console.warn('[cave grab] the scene did not load; the drag uses its old code:', e));
    function makeCaveGuardian(cave) {
      const d = (cave && cave.design) || CAVE_DESIGNS.wet;
      const outer = new THREE.Group();
      const rigRoot = CaveGuardian.makeCaveGuardianRig(d);
      rigRoot.scale.setScalar(GUARDIAN_SCALE);
      rigRoot.position.z = -GUARDIAN_SETBACK;
      outer.add(rigRoot);
      outer.userData.rigRoot = rigRoot;
      outer.userData.rig = rigRoot.userData.rig;
      outer.userData.mats = rigRoot.userData.mats;
      outer.userData.hands = rigRoot.userData.rig.hands;
      outer.userData.stride = 0;
      scene.add(outer);
      return outer;
    }
    // Every joint of the rig, with the damping rate its part gets (see rigDamp).
    function guardianJointRate(j) {
      const n = j.name || '';
      if (n.startsWith('shoulder') || n.startsWith('elbow') || n.startsWith('wrist')) return RIG_RATE.arm;
      if (n.startsWith('hip') || n.startsWith('knee') || n.startsWith('ankle')) return RIG_RATE.leg;
      if (n === 'jaw') return RIG_RATE.jaw;
      if (n === 'neck' || n === 'head') return RIG_RATE.head;
      if (n.startsWith('thumb')) return RIG_RATE.claw;
      return RIG_RATE.torso;
    }
    // The pit's arms (world/pit-tentacles.js): smooth tubes swept along curves that the
    // scene moves each frame, so an arm can be run round a leg as a real coil. Always out
    // of the abyss itself, never the player's feet.
    function makeTentacleRing() {
      const g = PitArms.makePitTentacles({
        cx: LAKE_HOLE.x, cz: LAKE_HOLE.z, floorY: LAKE.level - 11.5, ringR: LAKE_HOLE.r * 0.42,
        count: 7, glow: 0x9eeeff, waterY: LAKE.level
      });
      scene.add(g);
      return g;
    }
    function disposeRigProp(root) {
      if (!root) return;
      root.removeFromParent();
      root.traverse((o) => { if (o.isMesh && o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose(); });
      for (const m of root.userData.mats || []) m.dispose();
      for (const m of root.userData.extraMats || []) m.dispose();
    }
    const SK_PARTS = ['armLG', 'armRG', 'elbowLG', 'elbowRG', 'legLG', 'legRG', 'kneeLG', 'kneeRG', 'torsoG', 'headG'];   // GB-54: torso and head react too
    function beginScriptedKill(kind, cave, opts) {
      if (scriptedKill || cine || gameOver || won || !gameStarted) return;

    // Wedge path: outer arc from a0 to a1, back along the inner arc. Angles in
    // radians, zero at twelve o'clock, growing clockwise (screen y is down).
    function wheelWedgePath(a0, a1, rIn, rOut) {
      const px = (r, a) => [(Math.sin(a) * r).toFixed(2), (-Math.cos(a) * r).toFixed(2)];
      const [x0o, y0o] = px(rOut, a0), [x1o, y1o] = px(rOut, a1);
      const [x1i, y1i] = px(rIn, a1), [x0i, y0i] = px(rIn, a0);
      const big = (a1 - a0) > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
      return 'M' + x0o + ',' + y0o +
             'A' + rOut + ',' + rOut + ' 0 ' + big + ' 1 ' + x1o + ',' + y1o +
             'L' + x1i + ',' + y1i +
             'A' + rIn + ',' + rIn + ' 0 ' + big + ' 0 ' + x0i + ',' + y0i + 'Z';
    }

    // CL-113 (Jerry): the weapon wheel never has more than five spaces: Primary 1 and 2, Secondary 1 and 2 (the
    // Armory's loadout) and the hip pistol. An empty slot is an empty space. Unarmed is the hub: let go in the middle.
    // The Bigtex shooter cheat alone shows every gun he owns.
    let bigtexWheel = false;
    const WHEEL_SLOT_NAMES = ['Primary 1', 'Primary 2', 'Secondary 1', 'Secondary 2'];
    function wheelLoadoutKeys() {
      const load = carriedLoadout();
      return [...load.primary, ...load.secondary].map((k) => (k && weaponOwned[k] ? k : null));
    }
    function weaponsInReach() {
      if (bigtexWheel) return WEAPON_ORDER.filter((k) => weaponOwned[k]);
      const out = [];
      for (const k of wheelLoadoutKeys()) if (k && k !== 'pistol' && !out.includes(k)) out.push(k);
      out.push('pistol');
      return out;
    }
    function weaponInReach(k) { return k === 'pistol' || weaponsInReach().includes(k); }
    function buildWheelItems(kind) {
      const out = [];
      if (kind === 'weapon' && !bigtexWheel) {
        const seen = new Set(['pistol']);
        wheelLoadoutKeys().forEach((key, i) => {
          if (key && !seen.has(key)) {
            seen.add(key);
            const st = WEAPON_STATS[key];
            const meta = st.melee ? Math.max(0, Math.ceil(sawFuel)) + 's gas'
              : (Number.isFinite(ammoByWeapon[key]) ? Math.ceil(ammoByWeapon[key]) : '∞') + ' + ' + reserveOf(key);
            out.push({ key, name: st.name, meta, locked: false, current: !unarmed && key === currentWeapon, slot: WHEEL_SLOT_NAMES[i] });
          } else {
            out.push({ key: 'empty' + i, name: WHEEL_SLOT_NAMES[i], empty: true, locked: true, current: false,
              meta: key ? sayText('armory.wheelPair', { gun: WEAPON_STATS[key].name }, WEAPON_STATS[key].name + ' pair · Y') : sayText('armory.wheelEmpty', {}, 'Empty · fill it at the Armory') });
          }
        });
        const pst = WEAPON_STATS.pistol;
        out.push({ key: 'pistol', name: pst.name, slot: 'Hip', locked: false, current: !unarmed && currentWeapon === 'pistol',
          meta: (Number.isFinite(ammoByWeapon.pistol) ? Math.ceil(ammoByWeapon.pistol) : '∞') + ' + ' + reserveOf('pistol') });
      } else if (kind === 'weapon') {
        for (const key of WEAPON_ORDER) {
          if (!weaponOwned[key]) continue;   // CL-113: the cheat shows what he owns, nothing for sale
          const st = WEAPON_STATS[key];
          const owned = !!weaponOwned[key];
          let meta;
          if (!owned) meta = equipmentStocked(key, day) ? '$' + weaponPrice(key) : dwText('shop.weaponArrives', { night: GUN_STOCK_NIGHT[key] });
          else if (st.melee) meta = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(sawFuel)) + 's gas';
          else meta = (Number.isFinite(ammoByWeapon[key]) ? Math.ceil(ammoByWeapon[key]) : '∞') + ' + ' + reserveOf(key);
          out.push({ key, name: st.name, meta, locked: !owned, current: !unarmed && key === currentWeapon });
        }
      } else {
        const focus = placeMode || BUILD_ORDER[buildIndex] || 'barricade';
        for (const key of BUILD_PAGES[wheelPage].keys) {
          const unlocked = !!buildUnlocked[key];
          out.push({
            key, name: BUILD_NAMES[key],
            meta: key === 'upgrade' ? 'price per tier' : (unlocked ? '$' + COST[key] : 'plans $' + BUILD_UNLOCK_PRICE[key]),
            locked: !unlocked, current: key === focus
          });
        }
      }
      return out;
    }

    function syncWheelSelection() {
      for (let i = 0; i < wheelItems.length; i++) {
        const w = wheelItems[i], on = i === wheelSel;
        w.seg.classList.toggle('sel', on);
        w.icon.classList.toggle('sel', on);
        // The pointed-at wedge reaches further out. Swapping between two prebuilt
        // paths keeps the inner edge exactly on the hub, which a transform would not.
        w.seg.setAttribute('d', w.seg.getAttribute(on ? 'data-dsel' : 'data-dnorm'));
      }
      const hub = wheelSel === WHEEL_HUB_UNARMED && wheelKind === 'weapon';   // CL-113: unarmed is the hub
      const it = wheelSel >= 0 ? wheelItems[wheelSel] : hub ? { name: sayText('armory.unarmed', {}, 'Unarmed'), meta: sayText('armory.unarmedMeta', {}, 'Put the gun away · U') } : null;
      if (wheelHubEl) wheelHubEl.classList.toggle('unarmed', hub);
      wheelHubNameEl.textContent = it ? it.name : '—';
      wheelHubMetaEl.textContent = !it ? (wheelKind === 'weapon' ? sayText('armory.hubHint', {}, 'Middle: unarmed') : '')
        : it.empty ? it.meta
        : (it.locked ? (wheelKind === 'weapon' ? 'Not bought · kiosk ' + it.meta : 'No blueprint · kiosk ' + it.meta) : (it.slot ? it.slot + ' · ' : '') + it.meta);
    }

    function openWheel(kind) {
      if (!gameStarted || gameOver || won || paused || shopOpen || devConsoleOpen) return false;
      if (mortarMounted || mortarCarried) return false; // hands are on the tube
      if (kind === 'build' && nightLockdown()) { refuseLockdown(); return true; }   // CU-82: handled, so B doesn't toggle a ghost
      if (wheelKind === kind) return true;
      wheelKind = kind;
      if (kind === 'build') wheelPage = pageOfBuild(placeMode || BUILD_ORDER[buildIndex] || 'barricade');
      wheelOpenedAt = wheelNowMs();
      wheelMovedOut = false;
      renderWheelRing();
      wheelEl.classList.add('show');
      mouseFireHeld = false;
      fireHeld = false;
      return true;
    }
    // Turn the build ring's page (delta +1 / -1), or jump to one.
    function wheelTurnPage(delta, to = null) {
      if (wheelKind !== 'build') return;
      const n = BUILD_PAGES.length;
      const next = to != null ? to : (((wheelPage + delta) % n) + n) % n;
      if (next === wheelPage) return;
      wheelPage = next;
      wheelMovedOut = true;       // turning a page is not a tap
      renderWheelRing();
      AudioSys.wheelTick();
    }
    function renderWheelRing() {
      const kind = wheelKind;
      wheelItems = buildWheelItems(kind);
      // Start on what is already in hand, so letting go without pointing changes nothing.
      wheelSel = wheelItems.findIndex((it) => it.current);
      if (kind === 'weapon' && unarmed) wheelSel = WHEEL_HUB_UNARMED;   // CL-113
      const n = wheelItems.length;
      const span = Math.PI * 2 / n;
      const gap = WHEEL_GAP_DEG * Math.PI / 180;
      // Icon only, dead centre of the wedge. Counts and prices used to sit in every
      // wedge as well, which meant eleven little strings at eleven different
      // rotations and the ring read as clutter; the hub names the one you are
      // pointing at instead, which is the only one you are reading anyway.
      const rIcon = (WHEEL_R_IN + WHEEL_R_OUT) / 2;
      // Icons shrink as the ring fills up. At 54px they fit ten wedges comfortably;
      // the build ring holds nineteen now, and at a fixed size neighbouring icons ran
      // into each other. Sized off the arc length each wedge actually gets.
      const ICON = Math.max(30, Math.min(54, (Math.PI * 2 * rIcon / n) * 0.72));
      let svg = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const it = wheelItems[i];
        const mid = i * span;                    // slot 0 at twelve o'clock, clockwise
        const a0 = mid - span / 2 + gap, a1 = mid + span / 2 - gap;
        const lock = it.locked ? ' locked' : '';
        svg += '<path class="wSeg' + lock + '" data-i="' + i + '"' +
               ' d="' + wheelWedgePath(a0, a1, WHEEL_R_IN, WHEEL_R_OUT) + '"' +
               ' data-dsel="' + wheelWedgePath(a0, a1, WHEEL_R_IN, WHEEL_R_POP) + '"' +
               ' data-dnorm="' + wheelWedgePath(a0, a1, WHEEL_R_IN, WHEEL_R_OUT) + '"/>';
        const ix = Math.sin(mid) * rIcon, iy = -Math.cos(mid) * rIcon;
        const glyph = WHEEL_ICONS[it.key] || '';
        svg += '<g class="wIcon' + lock + '" data-i="' + i + '"' +
               ' transform="translate(' + (ix - ICON / 2).toFixed(1) + ',' + (iy - ICON / 2).toFixed(1) + ') scale(' + (ICON / 24).toFixed(3) + ')">' +
               glyph + '</g>';
      }
      // Page tabs across the top of the build ring.
      if (kind === 'build') {
        const w = 118;
        BUILD_PAGES.forEach((pg, i) => {
          const x = (i - (BUILD_PAGES.length - 1) / 2) * w, on = i === wheelPage;
          svg += '<text x="' + x + '" y="-216" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="' + (on ? 700 : 500) + '"' +
                 ' fill="' + (on ? 'rgba(255,210,74,.95)' : 'rgba(226,238,250,.5)') + '" style="letter-spacing:.08em">' +
                 (i + 1) + ' · ' + pg.name.toUpperCase() + '</text>';
        });
        svg += '<text x="0" y="230" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="rgba(226,238,250,.45)">scroll or 1-2-3 for more</text>';
      }
      wheelSvgEl.innerHTML = svg;
      const segs = wheelSvgEl.querySelectorAll('.wSeg');
      const icons = wheelSvgEl.querySelectorAll('.wIcon');
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        wheelItems[i].seg = segs[i];
        wheelItems[i].icon = icons[i];
      }
      syncWheelSelection();
    }

    function wheelPointerMove(clientX, clientY) {
      if (!wheelIsOpen()) return;
      const dx = clientX - window.innerWidth / 2;
      const dy = clientY - window.innerHeight / 2;
      if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < WHEEL_DEADZONE) {
        // CL-113: back in the middle after pointing at a space: the hub, unarmed.
        if (wheelMovedOut && wheelKind === 'weapon' && wheelSel !== WHEEL_HUB_UNARMED) { wheelSel = WHEEL_HUB_UNARMED; syncWheelSelection(); AudioSys.wheelTick(); }
        return;
      }
      wheelMovedOut = true;
      const n = wheelItems.length;
      // Bearing measured the same way the ring is laid out: 0 at the top, clockwise.
      let a = Math.atan2(dy, dx) + Math.PI / 2;
      a = ((a % (Math.PI * 2)) + Math.PI * 2) % (Math.PI * 2);
      const idx = Math.round(a / (Math.PI * 2 / n)) % n;
      if (idx !== wheelSel) {
        wheelSel = idx;
        syncWheelSelection();
        AudioSys.wheelTick();   // CL-135: the dial ticking past a channel (it was a case landing)
      }
    }

    function closeWheel(commit) {
      if (!wheelIsOpen()) return;
      const kind = wheelKind, sel = wheelSel, moved = wheelMovedOut;
      const heldMs = wheelNowMs() - wheelOpenedAt;
      const items = wheelItems;
      wheelKind = null;
      wheelItems = [];
      wheelSel = -1;
      wheelEl.classList.remove('show');
      wheelSvgEl.innerHTML = '';
      if (!commit) return;
      // A quick tap that never left the hub keeps the old single-key behaviour:
      // Q steps to the next gun, B toggles the ghost on and off.
      if (!moved && heldMs < WHEEL_TAP_MS) {
        if (kind === 'weapon') cycleWeapon(1); else toggleBuildMode();
        return;
      }
      const it = sel >= 0 ? items[sel] : (sel === WHEEL_HUB_UNARMED && kind === 'weapon' ? { key: 'unarmed' } : null);
      if (!it) return;
      if (kind === 'weapon') {
        if (it.empty) {   // CL-113
          AudioSys.invalid();
          showBanner(it.name.toUpperCase(), it.meta, 1.6, '#ffb347');
          return;
        }
        if (it.locked) {
          AudioSys.invalid();
          showBanner(dwText('weapon.message.notBought', { weapon: it.name.toUpperCase() }),
            equipmentStocked(it.key, day) ? dwText('weapon.message.buy', { price: weaponPrice(it.key) }) : dwText('shop.weaponArrives', { night: GUN_STOCK_NIGHT[it.key] }), 1.6, '#ffb347');
          return;
        }
        if (it.key === 'unarmed') { if (!unarmed) { holsteredKey = currentWeapon; unarmed = true; AudioSys.weaponSwitch(); } return; }   // CL-135
        if (unarmed) { unarmed = false; if (it.key === currentWeapon) AudioSys.weaponSwitch(); }
        if (it.key !== currentWeapon) setWeapon(WEAPON_ORDER.indexOf(it.key));
      } else {
        setPlaceMode(it.key); // refuses and explains on its own when the plans are missing
      }
    }

    // GB-128: a focused text field (any input you type into) keeps the game's toggles off its keys.
    function typingInField(el) {
      if (!el || el === window || el === document) return false;
      if (el.isContentEditable) return true;
      const tag = el.tagName;

    // The glowing bed under a ground fire: embers and cracks of orange in the burnt

    const emberBedTex = (() => {
      const N = 128, cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = cv.height = N;
      const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
      const img = ctx.createImageData(N, N);
      const rnd = mulberry32(0xe3be0d);
      const a = tileNoise(N, 6, rnd), b = tileNoise(N, 16, rnd), c = tileNoise(N, 32, rnd);
      for (let y = 0; y < N; y++) for (let x = 0; x < N; x++) {

        const i = y * N + x;

        const fall = Math.max(0, 1 - r) ** 0.8;

        const crack = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(b[i] - 0.5) * 9) * 0.9 + Math.max(0, c[i] - 0.62) * 2.2;
        const heat = Math.min(1, fall * (0.18 + crack) * (0.7 + a[i] * 0.6));

        img.data[i * 4 + 1] = 255 * Math.min(1, heat * heat * 1.1);
        img.data[i * 4 + 2] = 255 * heat * heat * heat * 0.4;
        img.data[i * 4 + 3] = 255 * Math.min(1, heat * 1.8);

      ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);

    // Everything above wants compiling before the first fire, not during it. Called by
    // the pre-roll: every flame frame, every smoke step and the ember bed, drawn once.
    let _fireWarmGroup = null;
    function stageFireWarmup(x, y, z) {
      _fireWarmGroup = new THREE.Group();
      _fireWarmGroup.position.set(x, y, z);
      flameFrameMats.forEach((m, i) => { const s = new THREE.Sprite(m); s.position.set((i - 4) * 0.2, 0, 1); s.scale.set(0.3, 0.5, 1); _fireWarmGroup.add(s); });
      let k = 0;

      scene.add(_fireWarmGroup);
    }
    function clearFireWarmup() { if (_fireWarmGroup) { scene.remove(_fireWarmGroup); _fireWarmGroup = null; } }

    // --- Burning zombies ----------------------------------------------------------------
    // A zombie on fire used to shed a few sparks and nothing else. Now it goes up: a
    // few flames riding its body, climbing its back, smoke off it, and its own glow.
    // The flame sets are pooled; a set rides as a child of the body mesh, so it scales
    // with the body and goes where it goes.
    const zombieFireSets = [];
    const _zfV = new THREE.Vector3();
    const _zfPool = [];
    function takeZombieFire() {
      let g = _zfPool.pop();
      if (!g) {
        g = new THREE.Group();
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
          const fl = newFlameSprite();
          const a = i * 2.2;
          fl.position.set(Math.cos(a) * 0.2, 0.15 + i * 0.26, Math.sin(a) * 0.14);
          fl.userData.height = 0.95 - i * 0.07;

    function updateZombieFires(dt) {

    function clearZombieFires() {

    // --- Scorch ----------------------------------------------------------------
    // What a fire leaves behind. Pooled and capped like the blood decals, laid along

    const scorchDecals = [];
    const MAX_SCORCH = 90;
    const scorchGeo = new THREE.CircleGeometry(1.25, 12);
    const _scorchMats = [];

        _scorchMats.push(m);

      return _scorchMats[(Math.random() * _scorchMats.length) | 0];
    }
    function spawnScorch(x, z, scale) {
      if (scorchDecals.length >= MAX_SCORCH) releaseEffectMesh(scorchDecals.shift());
      const d = acquireEffectMesh(scorchGeo, scorchMatPool(), MAX_SCORCH + 6);
      d.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(AXIS_Z, terrainNormal(x, z));
      d.position.set(x, sampleHeight(x, z) + 0.045, z);
      d.scale.setScalar(scale || (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.5));
      scorchDecals.push(d);
    }
    function clearScorch() { for (const d of scorchDecals) releaseEffectMesh(d); scorchDecals.length = 0; }

    const burnedFireCells = new Set();
    const fireCell = (x, z) => Math.round(x / 1.5) + ':' + Math.round(z / 1.5);
    function spawnGroundFire(x, z, defense = false, generation = 0, cigarette = false) {
      // A dropped cigarette is a tiny cosmetic ember: no damage or spreading forest fire.

      if (cigarette && rainWet() > 0.1) return null;   // GB-102: a butt dropped in the rain leaves no ember

        if (generation === 0) { f.age = Math.min(f.age, GROUND_FIRE_LIFE * 0.35); f.defense = defense; }
        return f;
      }
      if (groundFires.length >= MAX_GROUND_FIRES || (generation > 0 && burnedFireCells.has(fireCell(x, z)))) return null;
      if (!cigarette) burnedFireCells.add(fireCell(x, z));

        g.userData.disc = d;

      }

      disc.visible = true;

      disc.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(AXIS_Z, terrainNormal(x, z));

      groundFires.push(f);

    }
    // Cap on how much of the map can be alight at once. Fire that spreads without a

    const MAX_GROUND_FIRES = 44;
    // Where fire will not go: water, the stream, and bare rock. Everything else on
    // this map is grass or leaf litter and burns happily.
    function fireCanSpreadTo(x, z) {
      if (Math.hypot(x, z) > landRadius - 1) return false;
      if (waterDepthAt(x, z) > 0.02) return false;
      if (distToStream(x, z) < STREAM_WIDTH * 0.8) return false;
      if (distToPath(x, z) < 0.65) return false;

      return true;
    }
    function releaseGroundFire(f) {

    function clearGroundFires() { for (const f of groundFires) releaseGroundFire(f); groundFires.length = 0; burnedFireCells.clear(); }
    function updateGroundFires(dt) {
      for (let i = groundFires.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {

        const duration = f.cigarette ? 4 : GROUND_FIRE_LIFE;
        // Lay the scorch down a little before the flame dies, so the ground is already
        // blackening under it rather than a mark appearing out of nowhere.

        if (f.age >= duration) { releaseGroundFire(f); groundFires.splice(i, 1); continue; }

        // Young fire creeps outward; rain puts a stop to it. Each beat tries one

          continue;
        }
        if (Math.random() < dt * 2) { const sa = sndAt(f.x, f.z, 18); AudioSys.fireCrackle(sa.v, sa.pan); }
        if (Math.random() < dt * 9 * (0.3 + life)) spawnFireEmbers(f.x, f.y + 0.2, f.z, 1, 1.3, 0.7);

    function tryFire(dt) {

            t.pieceBurn[i] = b + dt * (1 + (onGround ? 0.3 : 0));
            const u = t.pieceBurn[i] / t.pieceLife[i];
            if (u >= 1) {
              setLeafPiece(p, false, null);
              leafPieceWorldPos(p, _burnWP);
              spawnFireEmbers(_burnWP.x, _burnWP.y, _burnWP.z, 6, 1.4, 1.2);
              spawnSmokePuff(_burnWP.x, _burnWP.y + 0.4, _burnWP.z, { tone: 'dark', size: 1.6, grow: 2.6, life: 3.2 });
            } else {
              setLeafPiece(p, true, (p.burnS0 != null ? p.burnS0 : (p.burnS0 = p.shrink != null ? p.shrink : 1)) * (1 - Math.max(0, (u - 0.35) / 0.65) * 0.85));
              paintPiece(t, p, i, t.pieceBurn[i], t.pieceLife[i]);
              burning++;
              leafPieceWorldPos(p, _burnWP);
              bx += _burnWP.x; by += _burnWP.y; bz += _burnWP.z;
            }
          }
          if (leafPieceVisible(p) && t.pieceBurn[i] < t.pieceLife[i]) left++;
        }
        if (burning && t.canopyMeshes) {
          const g = t.canopyMeshes[0].geometry;
          g.attributes.color.needsUpdate = true; g.attributes.ember.needsUpdate = true;
        }
        // Leaf health follows what's left of the crown (LOS and collision read it).
        t.leafHealth = Math.min(t.leafHealth, t.leafHealthMax * (left / Math.max(1, pieces.length)));

        // --- Crown flames: one on each clump that is burning, sized to it ---
        if (f) {
          for (let s = 0; s < CROWN_FLAMES; s++) {
            const i = f.slot[s];
            if (i >= 0 && !(t.pieceBurn[i] > 0 && t.pieceBurn[i] < t.pieceLife[i])) f.slot[s] = -1;
          }
          for (let i = 0; i < pieces.length; i++) {
            if (!(t.pieceBurn[i] > 0 && t.pieceBurn[i] < t.pieceLife[i])) continue;
            if (f.slot.includes(i)) continue;
            const free = f.slot.indexOf(-1);
            if (free < 0) break;
            f.slot[free] = i;
          }
          for (let s = 0; s < CROWN_FLAMES; s++) {
            const fl = f.crownF[s], i = f.slot[s];
            if (i < 0) { fl.visible = false; continue; }
            const p = pieces[i], u = t.pieceBurn[i] / t.pieceLife[i];
            const R = p.r || 0.8;
            const env = Math.min(1, u / 0.15) * (1 - Math.max(0, (u - 0.6) / 0.4));
            fl.visible = env > 0.02;
            fl.position.set(p.center.x, p.center.y - R * 0.15, p.center.z);
            const pulse = 0.85 + Math.sin(t.burnAge * 8 + fl.userData.phase) * 0.12;
            poseFlame(fl, t.burnAge, R * 3.6 * env * pulse * fade, R * 2.4 * env * pulse * fade);
          }
          // Foot and trunk flames.
          const footS = Math.min(1, t.burnAge * 1.5) * fade * (onGround ? 0.6 : 1);
          for (const fl of f.base) {
            const pulse = 0.85 + Math.sin(t.burnAge * 7 + fl.userData.phase) * 0.12;
            const h = (0.9 + t.trunkRadius * 2.5) * footS * pulse;
            poseFlame(fl, t.burnAge, h, h * 0.62);
          }
          const trunkTop = t.canopyBottom + 0.3;
          f.climb.forEach((fl, k) => {
            const y = Math.min(trunkTop, t.fireFront) - 0.3 - k * 0.9;
            const on = y > 0.3 && t.fireFront < t.canopyTop + 0.4 ? 1 : 0.45;
            fl.position.set((k ? -1 : 1) * t.trunkRadius * 0.7, Math.max(0.1, y), (k ? 0.5 : -0.5) * t.trunkRadius);
            const h = (0.8 + t.trunkRadius * 2) * on * fade * Math.min(1, t.burnAge);

          });
        }

        // --- Bark ---
        t.charT -= dt;
        if (t.charT <= 0) {
          t.charT = 0.12;
          paintTrunk(t, t.fireFront, 0.35 + 0.65 * fade);
        }

        // --- Smoke, sparks, light, sound ---
        const cx = burning ? bx / burning : t.x, cy = burning ? by / burning : baseY + Math.min(t.fireFront, t.canopyBottom), cz = burning ? bz / burning : t.z;
        if (Math.random() < dt * (1.6 + burning * 0.7)) {
          const sp = 1 + (t.canopyRadius || 1.5) * 0.8;
          spawnSmokePuff(cx + (Math.random() - 0.5) * sp, cy + 0.8, cz + (Math.random() - 0.5) * sp, { tone: burning > 1 ? 'dark' : 'grey', size: 0.9 + burning * 0.1, grow: 2.4, vy: 1.8 + Math.random(), life: 3.0 + Math.random() * 1.5, peak: 0.75 + Math.random() * 0.25 });
        }
        if (Math.random() < dt * (5 + burning * 5)) spawnFireEmbers(cx, cy, cz, 1, 1.6 + burning * 0.2, 1 + burning * 0.08);
        const flick = 0.8 + Math.sin(t.burnAge * 11) * 0.12 + Math.sin(t.burnAge * 23.7) * 0.08;
        requestEffectLight(cx, cy + 0.5, cz, 0xff7a2a, (1.3 + burning * 0.45) * flick * fade, 9 + burning * 1.2);
        if (Math.random() < dt * (2 + burning)) { const sa = sndAt(t.x, t.z, 26); AudioSys.fireCrackle(sa.v, sa.pan); }

        // --- Spread ---
        // Keeps the ground under it alight, which is how the fire gets past the trunk.
        if (!onGround && Math.random() < dt * 0.55 && groundFires.length < MAX_GROUND_FIRES) spawnGroundFire(t.x, t.z, !!t.burnDefense, 1);
        // A crown fire jumps to a neighbour whose crown it's touching (not in rain).
        t.spreadCd -= dt;
        if (t.spreadCd <= 0 && burning >= 2 && !onGround) {
          t.spreadCd = 1.0;
          for (const o of trees) {
            if (o === t || !o.alive || o.falling || o.burnT > 0) continue;
            const d = Math.hypot(o.x - t.x, o.z - t.z);
            if (d > t.canopyRadius + o.canopyRadius + 0.6) continue;
            if (Math.random() < 0.3 * (1 - wet)) igniteTree(o, !!t.burnDefense, o.canopyBottom);
          }
        }

        if (t.burnT <= 0) {
          t.burnT = 0;
          hideTreeFire(t);
          // What's left: a charred, smouldering skeleton.
          for (let i = 0; i < pieces.length; i++) if (t.pieceBurn[i] > 0) setLeafPiece(pieces[i], false, null);
          paintTrunk(t, t.canopyTop + 2, 0.5);
          t.smoulder = 1;
          if (t.alive) {
            spawnScorch(t.x, t.z, 1.5);
            // It goes over downwind, more or less.
            const a = Math.atan2(wind.dirZ, wind.dirX) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.6;

    }
    function hideTreeFire(t) {

    }

      if (t.smoulderT <= 0) {

        setTreeEmber(t, t.smoulder * 0.3);
        if (t.stumpMesh && t.stumpMesh.geometry.attributes.ember) {
          const a = t.stumpMesh.geometry.attributes.ember;
          for (let v = 0; v < a.array.length; v++) a.array[v] = t.smoulder * 0.6 * (0.5 + 0.5 * hash3(v, 2, 9));
          a.needsUpdate = true;
        }
      }
      if (t.group.visible && Math.random() < dt * 1.4 * t.smoulder) {
        const along = Math.random() * (t.canopyBottom || 2);
        let x = t.x, y = t.group.position.y + along, z = t.z;
        if (t.log || t.falling) { x += t.fallDirX * along; z += t.fallDirZ * along; y = sampleHeight(x, z) + 0.3; }
        spawnSmokePuff(x, y, z, { tone: 'grey', size: 0.45, grow: 3, vy: 0.9, life: 3.5, peak: 0.55 });
      }

    }

    // === Felling ===================================================================
    // A tree used to swing down on a fixed 1.15-second curve about the ground, stop
    // "just short of flat" wherever that happened to be, stand its stump up only once it
    // had landed, and squash its crown by scaling the whole canopy.
    //
    // Now it breaks at the stump — the stump is there the moment it goes, and the
    // trunk hinges over it — and it falls like a falling pole: barely moving at first,
    // then gathering speed (angular acceleration ∝ sin θ / height, so tall trees fall
    // slower). It lands on the ground that is actually there: the resting angle is
    // solved against the terrain along its line, crown first, so on a slope it stops
    // early or tips past flat. It bounces once, the crown crumples down against the
    // ground (its clumps flattened where they hit), branches snap off in a spray of bark
    // and leaves, and while it lies there its leaves wilt brown.
    const TREE_FALL_G = 14;
    // Felled trees block lanes (Phase 2, "a world that reacts"): a log lies for two
    // minutes, solid to the player, zombies and bullets (addLogSolids), then sinks away.
    // It was 22 s, too short to matter in a fight.
    const TREE_LOG_LIE = 120;      // seconds the log stays before sinking
    const TREE_LOG_SINK = 1.6;     // seconds it takes to sink
    const _fallQ = new THREE.Quaternion(), _fallAxis = new THREE.Vector3(), _fallV = new THREE.Vector3();
    const _baseQ = new THREE.Quaternion(), _fallE = new THREE.Euler();

    // How high up the trunk it breaks: the stump's height.
    function stumpHeightOf(t) { return Math.max(0.3, Math.min(0.6, 0.32 + t.trunkRadius * 0.6)); }

    // First angle from vertical at which some part of the tree meets the ground.
    function solveRestAngle(t) {
      const hinge = t.fallHinge, L = t.canopyTop;

    // The log breaks off at the hinge: everything of the trunk below it (the root
    // flare, which stays behind as the stump) is folded up into a flat, pale, broken
    // end, instead of swinging round with the log like a trumpet bell.
    function cutTrunkAtHinge(t) {
      const m = t.trunkMesh;
      if (!m || !m.geometry.attributes.position) return;

      const pos = m.geometry.attributes.position.array, col = m.geometry.attributes.color.array;
      if (!t.woodPos0) t.woodPos0 = pos.slice();

    function beginTreeFall(tree, dirX, dirZ) {

      cutTrunkAtHinge(tree);
      spawnFallingLeaves(tree, tree.fallDirX, tree.fallDirZ, 10);
      tree.alive = false;
      AudioSys.treeFell();
      // The stump stands from the first crack; the trunk hinges over it.
      if (!tree.stumpMesh) tree.stumpMesh = makeStumpMesh(tree);
      spawnChunks(tree.x, tree.group.position.y + tree.fallHinge, tree.z, BARK[tree.kind] ? BARK[tree.kind][0] : 0x5c3a1e, 4, 2.2);

      // A nest riding this tree down: whichever bird calls it home turns furious
      // rather than just quietly losing its home — it'll swoop the player for a
      // while, until it's driven off or shot down.
      for (const nest of nests) {
        if (nest.tree !== tree || !nest.alive) continue;
        nest.alive = false;
        for (const b of birds) {
          if (b.alive && b.home === nest) {
            b.mode = 'attack';
            b.attackT = BIRD_ATTACK_DURATION;
            b.swoopPhase = 'dive';
            b.swoopCd = 0;
            b.vel.x = b.vel.y = b.vel.z = 0;
            showBanner('NEST DESTROYED', 'A bird is furious', 1.6, '#e8c86a');
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Place the tree at fall angle `th`: rotate about the hinge, toward the fall.
    function poseFallenTree(t, th) {

      t.group.quaternion.copy(_fallQ).multiply(t.fallBaseQ);
      _fallV.set(0, -t.fallHinge, 0).applyQuaternion(_fallQ);
      t.group.position.set(t.x + _fallV.x, t.logBaseY + t.fallHinge + _fallV.y, t.z + _fallV.z);
    }

    function treeImpact(t) {

      const bx = t.x, bz = t.z;

        const px = bx + dx * d, pz = bz + dz * d;
        spawnDust(px, sampleHeight(px, pz) + 0.05, pz, d > t.canopyBottom ? 3 : 2);
      }
      const pd = Math.hypot(nearestPlayer(0, 0).position.x - bx, nearestPlayer(0, 0).position.z - bz);
      addShake(Math.max(0, 0.35 - pd * 0.012) * Math.min(1.3, 0.6 + t.scale * 0.4));
      { const sa = sndAt(bx + dx * reach * 0.5, bz + dz * reach * 0.5, 60); AudioSys.treeThud(sa.v, sa.pan, t.scale || 1); }
      // Branches snap: bark splinters and a burst of leaves where the crown hits.
      const cx = bx + dx * (t.canopyBottom + t.canopyTop) * 0.5, cz = bz + dz * (t.canopyBottom + t.canopyTop) * 0.5;
      const cy = sampleHeight(cx, cz) + 0.6;
      spawnChunks(cx, cy, cz, BARK[t.kind] ? BARK[t.kind][0] : 0x5c3a1e, 7, 3.5);
      if (t.leafHealth > 0) spawnFallingLeaves(t, dx, dz, 18);
      if (t.burnT > 0 || t.smoulder > 0) spawnFireEmbers(cx, cy, cz, 16, 3, 1.3);

      // sideways from it, in the fall frame.

          showBanner('TIMBER', 'Watch where they fall', 1.4, '#e8c86a');
        }
      }
      crumpleCanopy(t);
    }

    // The crown meets the ground: every leaf vertex that would be below the surface is

    // splay instead of passing through the field. Done once, at rest pose.

        const above = _crV.y - (g + 0.25);
        if (above > 0) _crV.y = g + 0.25 + above * 0.62;
        // ...and what would be underground is pressed flat onto the ground and splayed.
        else {

    // Lying leaves dry out: toward a dead brown over the time the log lies there.
    const _cWilt = new THREE.Color(0x7a5a2e);
    function wiltCanopy(t, k) {

          t.fallOmega += acc * dt;
          t.fallTheta += t.fallOmega * dt;

          t.group.position.y = t.logBaseY - s * (t.trunkRadius * 2 + 1.2);
          if (s >= 1) {

    // A lying log is a row of short solids along the trunk, from the stump to where the

    function restoreTree(tree) {

    }

    // === Knockdown ==============================================================
    // A hard enough hit puts a zombie on the ground: it topples (about its own feet,
    // in the direction the blast pushed it), lies there helpless for a moment, then
    // hauls itself back up. Explosions do it to anything short of a colossus; a
    // point-blank shotgun blast does it to the smaller types. Not chainable — there is
    // a cooldown so a grenade spam can't keep the whole horde permanently flat.

    const pendingShots = new Set();

    // Test hook: one shell (or AA-12 round) from a point, its pellets sharing a shot id.
    function fireShellDbg(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, weapon = 'shotgun') {
      const st = WEAPON_STATS[weapon] || WEAPON_STATS.shotgun;

    const KNOCK_FALL = 0.32, KNOCK_RISE = 0.55;

      z.knockCd = z.knockDur + 2.5;

    // Returns the pitch to apply this frame (0 when not knocked), advancing the state.

    // Volume and pan for a sound at a world point, heard from the marine: full up

    const _snd = { v: 0, pan: 0 };
    function sndAt(x, z, range = 45) {
      const dx = x - player.position.x, dz = z - player.position.z;

      _snd.v = Math.pow(f, 1.6);

    }

    // GB-75 (P-26): plates. PLATE_CUT against bullets, pellets, blades and the saw (plus an iron cave's extra

    // in its tall column (measured walking at him: chin 0.69-0.77, head centre 0.78-0.87), so a head-centre shot sat
    // right on 0.78 and only sometimes counted. Its line is 0.74: the whole head counts, with a margin. hitH is unchanged.
    const HEAD_LINE = 0.78, HEAD_LINE_BY_TYPE = { brute: 0.74, feral: 0.70, leaper: 0.55, spider: 0.60 };   // GB-99; feral/leaper/spider lines from Claude, 2026-09-29 (spider 0.65 -> 0.60, under its walking p10)
    function headLineOf(z) { const v = z && HEAD_LINE_BY_TYPE[z.typeKey]; return v != null ? v : HEAD_LINE; }
    // GB-104 (P-119, D-62): every kind has one weakness and one resistance by damage type. WEAKNESS (game/weaknesses.js)
    // is the share of a hit each kind takes: bullet, pellet, fire, blast, blade, crush (the brute's row is GB-75's plates,
    // the demon's fire its old fireResist, the spider's pellet GB-96's edge). It replaces the flat armour and fireResist
    // for every kind with a row; a cave role still stacks on top (iron's armorAdd off every column, wet's fireResistAdd

    }
    // type: a WEAKNESS column, or 'burn' (the burn tick: the row's burn, else its fire). null: no row or no type.
    function weakShare(z, type) {

      if (s == null) return null;

      if (type === 'fire' || type === 'burn') s *= 1 - (z.roleFireAdd || 0);

    function damageZombie(z, amount, info = null) {

        if (z.hp <= 0 || Math.random() < 0.5) {

        spawnExitSpray(z.mesh.position.x, hitY, z.mesh.position.z, dx, dz, Math.min(1.6, dmg / 30));
      }
